examples.en: 3D printing allows engineers to produce complex parts at a low cost.
examples.zh: 3D 打印让工程师能以低成本制造复杂的零件。

examples.en: Traders in ancient China used an abacus to keep their accounts.
examples.zh: 古代中国的商人用算盘记账。

examples.en: Many farmers were forced to abandon their land during the long drought.
examples.zh: 在长期干旱期间,许多农民被迫放弃土地。

examples.en: The king was forced to abdicate after he lost the support of the army.
examples.zh: 失去军队支持后,国王被迫退位。

examples.en: Common symptoms of the infection include fever and abdominal pain.
examples.zh: 这种感染的常见症状包括发烧和腹痛。

examples.en: Member countries agreed to abide by the rules set out in the treaty.
examples.zh: 成员国同意遵守条约中规定的规则。

examples.en: Blood tests showed abnormal levels of iron in some of the workers.
examples.zh: 血液检查显示,部分工人体内铁含量异常。

examples.en: Some people believe that governments should abolish all school fees.
examples.zh: 有些人认为政府应该废除所有学费。

examples.en: Aboriginal Australians have one of the oldest continuous cultures in the world.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚土著拥有世界上最古老的延续文化之一。

examples.en: Laws on abortion differ greatly from one country to another.
examples.zh: 关于堕胎的法律在不同国家差异很大。

examples.en: The publisher decided to abridge the novel to make it easier for schools.
examples.zh: 出版商决定删节这部小说,让它更适合学校使用。

examples.en: Poor working conditions can lead to high levels of absenteeism among staff.
examples.zh: 恶劣的工作条件可能导致员工缺勤率居高不下。

examples.en: Dark surfaces absorb more heat than light-coloured surfaces.
examples.zh: 深色表面比浅色表面吸收更多热量。

examples.en: Vitamin D helps with the absorption of calcium in the body.
examples.zh: 维生素 D 有助于人体吸收钙。

examples.en: Read the abstract first to see if the article is useful to you.
examples.zh: 先读摘要,看看这篇文章对你是否有用。

examples.en: Young children often find it hard to understand abstract ideas like time.
examples.zh: 幼儿往往很难理解时间这样的抽象概念。

examples.en: Mathematics requires a high level of abstraction from everyday experience.
examples.zh: 数学需要从日常经验中进行高度抽象。

examples.en: The idea of flying machines once seemed absurd to most people.
examples.zh: 飞行器的想法曾让大多数人觉得荒谬。

examples.en: Developed countries enjoy an abundance of cheap food all year round.
examples.zh: 发达国家全年都有丰富的廉价食品。

examples.en: The country has abundant natural resources but poor transport links.
examples.zh: 这个国家自然资源丰富,但交通不便。

examples.en: Children who suffer abuse may have problems with relationships as adults.
examples.zh: 遭受虐待的孩子成年后可能在人际关系上出现问题。

examples.en: Some officials abuse their power to gain money for themselves.
examples.zh: 一些官员滥用权力为自己谋取钱财。

examples.en: Academic success does not always lead to a satisfying career.
examples.zh: 学术上的成功并不总能带来令人满意的职业。

examples.en: Some studies suggest that regular exercise can improve academic performance.
examples.zh: 一些研究表明,经常锻炼可以提高学业表现。

examples.en: Rising temperatures may accelerate the melting of the polar ice.
examples.zh: 气温上升可能加速极地冰层的融化。

examples.en: The acceleration of an object depends on the force acting on it.
examples.zh: 物体的加速度取决于作用在它上面的力。

examples.en: Listeners often make quick judgements about people based on their accent.
examples.zh: 听者常常根据口音对人作出快速判断。

examples.en: Everyone should have access to clean water and basic health care.
examples.zh: 每个人都应该能获得清洁的水和基本医疗。

examples.en: Students can access the library's books from any computer on the campus.
examples.zh: 学生可以从校园里的任何电脑访问图书馆的书籍。

examples.en: The internet has made higher education accessible to people in remote areas.
examples.zh: 互联网让偏远地区的人们也能接受高等教育。

examples.en: A nice scarf is my favourite accessory because it goes with everything.
examples.zh: 漂亮的围巾是我最喜欢的配饰,因为它什么都能搭。

examples.en: The university offers cheap accommodation to all first-year students.
examples.zh: 这所大学为所有大一新生提供便宜的住宿。

examples.en: Ask at the accommodation office if you need help finding a room.
examples.zh: 如果需要帮忙找房间,可以到住宿办公室咨询。

examples.en: The team accomplished the task with very limited equipment and funding.
examples.zh: 团队在设备和资金都很有限的情况下完成了任务。

examples.en: Conditions change quickly, and farmers must adjust their methods accordingly.
examples.zh: 环境变化很快,农民必须相应地调整耕作方法。

examples.en: I'd like to open an account for my wages, please.
examples.zh: 我想开一个账户用来收工资。

examples.en: Differences in diet may account for the lower rates of heart disease.
examples.zh: 饮食差异也许能解释心脏病发病率较低的原因。

examples.en: Older people now account for a quarter of the town's population.
examples.zh: 老年人现在占该镇人口的四分之一。

examples.en: There should be more accountability in the way public money is spent.
examples.zh: 公共资金的使用应该有更多问责。

examples.en: Harmful chemicals can accumulate in the bodies of large fish.
examples.zh: 有害化学物质可能在大型鱼类体内积累。

examples.en: The accuracy of weather forecasts has improved greatly over the last thirty years.
examples.zh: 过去三十年,天气预报的准确性大大提高。

examples.en: The instrument gives a more accurate reading than older equipment.
examples.zh: 这种仪器的读数比旧设备更准确。

examples.en: The minister has denied the accusation that he misused public money.
examples.zh: 这位部长否认了他滥用公共资金的指控。

examples.en: Critics accuse the government of ignoring the needs of rural communities.
examples.zh: 批评者指控政府忽视农村社区的需求。

examples.en: The country hopes to achieve its target of zero emissions by 2050.
examples.zh: 这个国家希望到 2050 年实现零排放目标。

examples.en: Family income has a strong influence on a child's achievement at school.
examples.zh: 家庭收入对孩子在学校的成就有很大影响。

examples.en: Strong acid can burn the skin and damage most metals.
examples.zh: 强酸能灼伤皮肤,并损坏大多数金属。

examples.en: Acid rain has damaged forests and lakes across northern Europe.
examples.zh: 酸雨破坏了北欧各地的森林和湖泊。

examples.en: Water in the lake became more acidic after years of pollution.
examples.zh: 多年污染后,湖水的酸性变强了。

examples.en: Ocean acidification makes it harder for shellfish to build their shells.
examples.zh: 海洋酸化使贝类更难形成外壳。

examples.en: The author acknowledges that the sample used in the study was small.
examples.zh: 作者承认这项研究使用的样本量很小。

examples.en: The acoustic qualities of the hall make it ideal for concerts.
examples.zh: 这个大厅的声学效果使它非常适合举办音乐会。

examples.en: Young children acquire language without any formal teaching.
examples.zh: 幼儿不需要正规教学就能习得语言。

examples.en: The acquisition of a first language happens without formal teaching.
examples.zh: 第一语言的习得不需要正规教学。

examples.en: The company's acquisition of a smaller rival made it the largest in Europe.
examples.zh: 这家公司收购了一家较小的竞争对手,成为欧洲最大的公司。

examples.en: The jury decided to acquit the woman because the evidence was weak.
examples.zh: 由于证据不足,陪审团决定宣判这名女子无罪。

examples.en: The sensor will activate the alarm if the water level rises too high.
examples.zh: 水位过高时,传感器会启动警报。

examples.en: Students learn more when they take part actively in discussions.
examples.zh: 学生积极参与讨论时学到的更多。

examples.en: Patients with acute pain were treated immediately in the emergency room.
examples.zh: 急性疼痛的患者在急诊室立即得到治疗。

examples.en: Dogs have an acute sense of smell that can detect some diseases.
examples.zh: 狗有敏锐的嗅觉,能察觉某些疾病。

examples.en: According to an old adage, a picture is worth a thousand words.
examples.zh: 有句古老的谚语说,一图胜千言。

examples.en: Many species adapt quickly to changes in temperature.
examples.zh: 许多物种能很快适应温度变化。

examples.en: The novel was adapted for television and watched by millions of people.
examples.zh: 这部小说被改编成电视剧,有数百万人观看。

examples.en: Thick fur is an adaptation that allows the animal to survive severe cold.
examples.zh: 厚皮毛是一种适应,使这种动物能够在严寒中生存。

examples.en: Many children have become addicted to computer games and social media.
examples.zh: 许多孩子沉迷于电脑游戏和社交媒体。

examples.en: Internet addiction can seriously affect the health of young people.
examples.zh: 网瘾可能严重影响年轻人的健康。

examples.en: Food labels should list every additive used in the product.
examples.zh: 食品标签应该列出产品中使用的每种添加剂。

examples.en: The report fails to address the causes of poverty in rural areas.
examples.zh: 这份报告未能处理农村贫困的根源。

examples.en: Many people in the region still do not have adequate access to clean water.
examples.zh: 该地区的许多人仍然无法获得足够的清洁水。

examples.en: Many patients fail to adhere to the treatment plan given by their doctor.
examples.zh: 许多患者未能坚持医生给出的治疗方案。

examples.en: The insect produces a natural adhesive that holds its eggs to leaves.
examples.zh: 这种昆虫分泌一种天然粘合剂,把卵粘在叶子上。

examples.en: The car park is adjacent to the museum, so you won't have far to walk.
examples.zh: 停车场紧邻博物馆,所以不用走很远。

examples.en: It takes the eyes several minutes to adjust to the dark.
examples.zh: 眼睛需要几分钟才能适应黑暗。

examples.en: The money is administered by a committee of local residents.
examples.zh: 这笔钱由当地居民组成的委员会管理。

examples.en: The new administration promised to spend more on public transport.
examples.zh: 新政府承诺在公共交通上投入更多资金。

examples.en: I think it's admirable that she looks after her parents and works full-time.
examples.zh: 她既全职工作又照顾父母,我觉得令人钦佩。

examples.en: What I admire most about my mum is how calm she stays.
examples.zh: 我最佩服妈妈的一点是她总能保持冷静。

examples.en: Admission to the museum is free for children under twelve.
examples.zh: 十二岁以下儿童免费进入博物馆。

examples.en: The brain continues to change in important ways during adolescence.
examples.zh: 在青春期,大脑继续发生重要变化。

examples.en: Most adolescents need more sleep than either children or adults.
examples.zh: 大多数青少年比儿童和成年人都需要更多睡眠。

examples.en: The advanced course is only for people who've been climbing for years.
examples.zh: 高级课程只面向有多年攀岩经验的人。

examples.en: I'm not very adventurous, so I usually order the same food every time.
examples.zh: 我不太爱冒险,所以每次都点同样的食物。

examples.en: Most patients taking the drug reported no adverse effects.
examples.zh: 大多数服用这种药的患者报告没有不良反应。

examples.en: The first newspaper advertisement for the product appeared in 1890.
examples.zh: 这种产品的第一则报纸广告于 1890 年出现。

examples.en: Children are especially easily influenced by television advertising.
examples.zh: 儿童尤其容易受到电视广告的影响。

examples.en: The advertising campaign increased sales by more than twenty percent.
examples.zh: 这次广告宣传活动使销售额增长了百分之二十多。

examples.en: Many doctors advocate a diet rich in vegetables and whole grains.
examples.zh: 许多医生提倡多吃蔬菜和全谷物的饮食。

examples.en: She was a strong advocate of equal education for girls.
examples.zh: 她是女孩平等受教育的坚定提倡者。

examples.en: Aerosols from burning coal reflect some sunlight back into space.
examples.zh: 燃煤产生的气溶胶把部分阳光反射回太空。

examples.en: New buildings should be judged on aesthetic grounds as well as on cost.
examples.zh: 评价新建筑既要看成本,也要看审美。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can affect both memory and the ability to make decisions.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足会影响记忆力和决策能力。

examples.en: Our cat is very affectionate and sleeps on my bed every night.
examples.zh: 我们的猫很黏人,每晚都睡在我床上。

examples.en: The local radio station is an affiliate of a national network.
examples.zh: 这家地方电台是一家全国性广播网的附属机构。

examples.en: Young people often feel a natural affinity with new technology.
examples.zh: 年轻人往往对新技术有一种天然的亲近感。

examples.en: The results of the study affirm the value of early education.
examples.zh: 这项研究的结果肯定了早期教育的价值。

examples.en: People in affluent countries tend to throw away large amounts of food.
examples.zh: 富裕国家的人往往扔掉大量食物。

examples.en: The restaurants near my university are pretty affordable for students.
examples.zh: 我们大学附近的餐馆对学生来说挺实惠的。

examples.en: Afforestation programmes aim to create new forests on empty land.
examples.zh: 植树造林项目旨在在荒地上营造新的森林。

examples.en: The volcano erupted in 1815, and the climate cooled for several years afterwards.
examples.zh: 这座火山于 1815 年喷发,此后几年气候变冷。

examples.en: An ageing population will increase the demand for health care.
examples.zh: 人口老龄化将增加对医疗保健的需求。

examples.en: Climate change is now high on the political agenda in many countries.
examples.zh: 气候变化现在在许多国家的政治议程上占据重要位置。

examples.en: The aggregate for the three years was just under two million.
examples.zh: 这三年的总计略低于两百万。

examples.en: Some drivers in my city get really aggressive during the rush hour.
examples.zh: 我们城市的一些司机在高峰期特别有攻击性。

examples.en: New machines led to a rapid increase in agricultural production.
examples.zh: 新机器使农业产量迅速增长。

examples.en: Agriculture still employs most of the population in the region.
examples.zh: 农业仍然雇用了该地区的大多数人口。

examples.en: Foreign aid should be spent on projects that help people become independent.
examples.zh: 外国援助应该用于帮助人们实现自立的项目。

examples.en: All the rooms have air conditioning, which is useful in hot weather.
examples.zh: 所有房间都有空调,天热时很有用。

examples.en: Air pollution is a major cause of breathing problems in large cities.
examples.zh: 空气污染是大城市呼吸问题的主要原因。

examples.en: New aircraft use far less fuel than those built thirty years ago.
examples.zh: 新飞机比三十年前制造的飞机省油得多。

examples.en: Would you prefer a seat by the window or on the aisle?
examples.zh: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位?

examples.en: The number of young people with mental health problems has reached alarming levels.
examples.zh: 有心理健康问题的年轻人数量已达到令人担忧的水平。

examples.en: My parents still keep an old photo album from their wedding.
examples.zh: 我父母还保留着一本他们婚礼的旧相册。

examples.en: Alchemy was the early attempt to change ordinary metals into gold.
examples.zh: 炼金术是早期把普通金属变成黄金的尝试。

examples.en: I need a strong coffee in the morning to feel alert at work.
examples.zh: 我早上需要一杯浓咖啡,上班才觉得清醒警觉。

examples.en: Warm water and pollution can cause algae to spread rapidly across the lake.
examples.zh: 温暖的水和污染可能导致藻类在湖面迅速蔓延。

examples.en: Algebra was developed further by Arab scholars during the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 中世纪时,阿拉伯学者进一步发展了代数。

examples.en: The algorithm learns to recognise faces from millions of photographs.
examples.zh: 这种算法从数百万张照片中学习识别人脸。

examples.en: Alien plants brought in by ships can quickly replace local species.
examples.zh: 船只带来的外来植物可能迅速取代本地物种。

examples.en: Films about aliens reflect people's interest in life on other planets.
examples.zh: 有关外星人的电影反映出人们对其他星球生命的兴趣。

examples.en: Plants of this kind grow best in alkaline soil rich in lime.
examples.zh: 这类植物最适合生长在富含石灰的碱性土壤中。

examples.en: Schools should aim to provide an all-round education for every child.
examples.zh: 学校应该致力于为每个孩子提供全面的教育。

examples.en: Critics allege that the company ignored safety warnings for many years.
examples.zh: 批评者声称该公司多年来无视安全警告。

examples.en: Local rulers were forced to swear allegiance to the new king.
examples.zh: 地方统治者被迫宣誓效忠新国王。

examples.en: Please tell the waiter if you have an allergy to nuts.
examples.zh: 如果你对坚果过敏,请告诉服务员。

examples.en: The new medicine can alleviate pain without causing drowsiness.
examples.zh: 这种新药可以缓解疼痛,而且不会让人犯困。

examples.en: The little café is hidden in an alley behind the market.
examples.zh: 这家小咖啡馆藏在市场后面的小巷里。

examples.en: The two nations formed an alliance to protect their trade routes.
examples.zh: 两国结成联盟,保护贸易路线。

examples.en: The government chose to allocate more money to health than to defence.
examples.zh: 政府选择把更多资金分配给医疗,而不是国防。

examples.en: My parents give me a small monthly allowance while I'm at university.
examples.zh: 我上大学期间,父母每月给我一小笔零用钱。

examples.en: Steel is an alloy of iron and a small amount of carbon.
examples.zh: 钢是铁和少量碳的合金。

examples.en: The country relied heavily on its closest ally for protection.
examples.zh: 这个国家严重依赖最亲密的盟友提供保护。

examples.en: The farmers' almanac lists the best dates for planting each year.
examples.zh: 农民年鉴列出了每年最佳的种植日期。

examples.en: Exercise, along with a healthy diet, can greatly reduce the risk of illness.
examples.zh: 运动连同健康饮食,可以大大降低患病风险。

examples.en: The modern English alphabet developed from a much older Roman one.
examples.zh: 现代英语字母表由更古老的罗马字母发展而来。

examples.en: Alpine plants have adapted to cold temperatures and strong winds.
examples.zh: 高山植物已适应低温和强风。

examples.en: Human activity has greatly altered the shape of the coastline.
examples.zh: 人类活动极大地改变了海岸线的形状。

examples.en: Investment in alternative energy would reduce our dependence on fossil fuels.
examples.zh: 投资替代能源将减少我们对化石燃料的依赖。

examples.en: Waste can be burned for energy or, alternatively, turned into fertiliser.
examples.zh: 废弃物可以焚烧发电,或者制成肥料。

examples.en: Although the plant looks dead in summer, its roots remain alive underground.
examples.zh: 尽管这种植物夏天看起来已经枯死,但它的根在地下依然活着。

examples.en: Breathing becomes more difficult at high altitude because the air is thin.
examples.zh: 在高海拔地区,空气稀薄,呼吸变得更困难。

examples.en: Some birds show altruism by helping to raise the young of others.
examples.zh: 有些鸟表现出利他行为,帮助抚养其他鸟的幼鸟。

examples.en: Aluminium is light and strong, so it is widely used in aircraft.
examples.zh: 铝又轻又坚固,所以被广泛用于飞机。

examples.en: Many of the college's alumni come back to give talks to students.
examples.zh: 学院的许多校友回校给学生做讲座。

examples.en: Alzheimer's disease gradually destroys memory and the ability to think clearly.
examples.zh: 阿尔茨海默病会逐渐破坏记忆和清晰思考的能力。

examples.en: Our team is made up of amateur players who train after work.
examples.zh: 我们队由下班后训练的业余球员组成。

examples.en: Although she's only an amateur, her paintings are sold in local galleries.
examples.zh: 虽然她只是业余爱好者,但她的画在当地画廊出售。

examples.en: I was amazed by how friendly people were when I visited Japan.
examples.zh: 我去日本时,对人们的友好感到惊讶。

examples.en: The ambassador met local business leaders to discuss trade between the countries.
examples.zh: 大使会见了当地商界领袖,讨论两国贸易。

examples.en: My aunt gave me a lovely necklace made of amber from Poland.
examples.zh: 我阿姨送了我一条来自波兰的漂亮琥珀项链。

examples.en: The results of the test were ambiguous and open to different interpretations.
examples.zh: 测试结果模棱两可,可以有不同的解释。

examples.en: I'm quite ambitious, and I hope to run my own company one day.
examples.zh: 我挺有抱负的,希望有一天能经营自己的公司。

examples.en: An ambulance arrived within minutes and took him to hospital.
examples.zh: 救护车几分钟内就到了,把他送进了医院。

examples.en: An amendment to the law now gives women equal rights to property.
examples.zh: 法律的一项修正案现在赋予女性平等的财产权。

examples.en: The nearest amenities, such as shops and a bank, are within walking distance.
examples.zh: 最近的商店、银行等便利设施走路就能到。

examples.en: Proteins are made up of long chains of amino acids.
examples.zh: 蛋白质由长链氨基酸构成。

examples.en: Ammonia is widely used in the production of farm fertilisers.
examples.zh: 氨被广泛用于生产农业化肥。

examples.en: The army ran out of ammunition after a month of fighting.
examples.zh: 经过一个月的战斗,军队的弹药用完了。

examples.en: The custom is still common amongst people in the northern islands.
examples.zh: 这一习俗在北部岛屿的人们之中仍很常见。

examples.en: The amount of waste produced by each household fell over the period.
examples.zh: 在此期间,每户家庭产生的垃圾量有所减少。

examples.en: Frogs and other amphibians are very sensitive to pollution in the water.
examples.zh: 青蛙和其他两栖动物对水污染非常敏感。

examples.en: An amplifier makes weak signals from the microphone much stronger.
examples.zh: 放大器把麦克风发出的微弱信号大大增强。

examples.en: The amplitude of a sound wave determines how loud the sound is.
examples.zh: 声波的振幅决定声音的大小。

examples.en: The children watched the old man's card tricks with great amusement.
examples.zh: 孩子们津津有味地看着老人变纸牌戏法。

examples.en: We went to an amusement park for my son's tenth birthday.
examples.zh: 我们去游乐园庆祝儿子十岁生日。

examples.en: The use of anaesthetic made surgery far less painful in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 十九世纪麻醉剂的使用大大减轻了手术的痛苦。

examples.en: The author uses the analogy of a computer to explain how memory works.
examples.zh: 作者用计算机作类比来解释记忆的运作方式。

examples.en: Scientists analysed samples of ice to learn about the climate of the past.
examples.zh: 科学家分析了冰样,以了解过去的气候。

examples.en: Our analysis of the results will take at least another two weeks.
examples.zh: 我们对结果的分析至少还需要两周。

examples.en: Studying mathematics helps children to develop strong analytical skills.
examples.zh: 学习数学有助于孩子培养强大的分析能力。

examples.en: Early doctors learned about human anatomy by studying the bodies of animals.
examples.zh: 早期的医生通过研究动物的身体来了解人体解剖学。

examples.en: Modern horses evolved from a much smaller ancestor that lived in forests.
examples.zh: 现代马是从一种生活在森林中、体型小得多的祖先进化而来的。

examples.en: The ship dropped its anchor in the shelter of the bay.
examples.zh: 船在海湾的避风处抛了锚。

examples.en: Ancient Egyptians used papyrus plants to make an early type of paper.
examples.zh: 古埃及人用纸莎草制造一种早期的纸。

examples.en: The light strikes the surface of the water at a narrow angle.
examples.zh: 光线以很小的角度照射到水面。

examples.en: Japanese animation is really popular among young people in my country.
examples.zh: 日本动画在我国的年轻人中很受欢迎。

examples.en: I twisted my ankle on the stairs and can't walk very far.
examples.zh: 我在楼梯上扭了脚踝,走不了太远。

examples.en: My parents are going to Paris for their wedding anniversary next month.
examples.zh: 我父母下个月要去巴黎过结婚纪念日。

examples.en: There will be an announcement about the exam dates next week.
examples.zh: 下周会发布关于考试日期的公告。

examples.en: I get annoyed when people talk loudly on their phones on the train.
examples.zh: 有人在火车上大声打电话时,我会很恼火。

examples.en: Annual sales rose from two million to five million over the period.
examples.zh: 在此期间,年销售额从两百万增长到五百万。

examples.en: Staff get twenty-five days of annual leave plus public holidays.
examples.zh: 员工除公共假期外还有二十五天年假。

examples.en: One unusually warm year may be an anomaly rather than part of a trend.
examples.zh: 某一年异常温暖可能只是个例外情况,而不代表某种趋势。

examples.en: All the answers in the survey were kept anonymous to protect the participants.
examples.zh: 调查的所有答案都是匿名的,以保护参与者。

examples.en: Few plants can survive in the freezing Antarctic climate.
examples.zh: 很少有植物能在严寒的南极气候中存活。

examples.en: Insects use their antennae to touch and smell things around them.
examples.zh: 昆虫用触角触碰和嗅闻周围的东西。

examples.en: The anthropologist lived with the tribe for two years to study their customs.
examples.zh: 这位人类学家与部落一起生活了两年,研究他们的习俗。

examples.en: Antibiotics do not work against illnesses caused by viruses.
examples.zh: 抗生素对病毒引起的疾病不起作用。

examples.en: The body produces an antibody to fight each new infection.
examples.zh: 身体针对每种新的感染都会产生抗体。

examples.en: Few experts anticipated how quickly the internet would change society.
examples.zh: 很少有专家预料到互联网会如此迅速地改变社会。

examples.en: The route goes anticlockwise round the park, starting from the south gate.
examples.zh: 路线从南门出发,逆时针绕公园一圈。

examples.en: The museum bought the antique clock from a private collector.
examples.zh: 博物馆从一位私人收藏家手中买下了这座古董钟。

examples.en: The city has been an important centre of trade since antiquity.
examples.zh: 这座城市自古代起就是重要的贸易中心。

examples.en: Many students suffer from anxiety in the weeks before an exam.
examples.zh: 许多学生在考前几周感到焦虑。

examples.en: I was quite anxious about moving to a new city on my own.
examples.zh: 一个人搬到新城市,我当时挺焦虑的。

examples.en: Apart from cost, there are few reasons for not using public transport.
examples.zh: 除了费用之外,几乎没有什么理由不乘坐公共交通。

examples.en: I'm looking for a two-bedroom apartment close to the city centre.
examples.zh: 我在找一套靠近市中心的两居室公寓。

examples.en: Chimpanzees and other apes are able to use simple tools.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩和其他猿类能够使用简单的工具。

examples.en: A new app helps patients to remember when to take their medicine.
examples.zh: 一款新应用程序帮助患者记住服药时间。

examples.en: The scientist built a simple apparatus to test his idea about air.
examples.zh: 这位科学家制作了一个简单的器械来检验他关于空气的想法。

examples.en: It soon became apparent that the water was no longer safe to drink.
examples.zh: 很快人们就发现,这些水已经不能安全饮用了。

examples.en: The apparent increase in cases may simply reflect better testing.
examples.zh: 病例表面上的增加可能只是反映了检测手段的改善。

examples.en: Working from home sounds appealing, but I'd probably miss my colleagues.
examples.zh: 在家工作听起来很有吸引力,但我可能会想念同事。

examples.en: I don't think you should judge people by their appearance.
examples.zh: 我认为不应该以貌取人。

examples.en: Put a copy of your questionnaire in the appendix at the end.
examples.zh: 把问卷放在文末的附录中。

examples.en: I had no appetite for days after I got back from the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行回来后,我好几天都没有食欲。

examples.en: The crowd began to applaud as soon as the runner came into view.
examples.zh: 跑者一出现,人群就开始鼓掌。

examples.en: The audience gave the young actors a long round of applause.
examples.zh: 观众为年轻演员们报以长时间的掌声。

examples.en: Each applicant will be asked to give a short talk at the interview.
examples.zh: 每位申请人都要在面试时做一个简短的发言。

examples.en: Please fill in the application form and return it by Friday.
examples.zh: 请填写申请表,并在周五前交回。

examples.en: The same principle can be applied to the design of aircraft wings.
examples.zh: 同样的原理可以应用于飞机机翼的设计。

examples.en: Farmers can apply for government grants to plant new forests.
examples.zh: 农民可以申请政府补助来种植新的森林。

examples.en: I'd like to make an appointment with the doctor for Thursday morning.
examples.zh: 我想预约周四上午看医生。

examples.en: You'll have an appraisal with your manager at the end of each year.
examples.zh: 每年年底,你都会和经理进行一次工作考核。

examples.en: I didn't appreciate my hometown until I moved far away from it.
examples.zh: 直到搬到很远的地方,我才懂得欣赏我的家乡。

examples.en: Many patients feel some apprehension before a major operation.
examples.zh: 许多患者在大手术前会感到一些忧虑。

examples.en: He started as an apprentice in a garage when he was sixteen.
examples.zh: 他十六岁时在一家修车厂当学徒。

examples.en: This approach to teaching encourages students to solve problems on their own.
examples.zh: 这种教学方法鼓励学生自己解决问题。

examples.en: As birds approach the end of their journey, they begin to fly lower.
examples.zh: 鸟类接近旅程终点时,会开始飞得更低。

examples.en: My manager is very approachable, so I can ask her about anything.
examples.zh: 我的经理很平易近人,所以我什么都可以问她。

examples.en: Teachers must choose materials that are appropriate for the age of the children.
examples.zh: 教师必须选择适合孩子年龄的教材。

examples.en: The new drug has not yet received approval from the health authorities.
examples.zh: 这种新药尚未获得卫生部门的批准。

examples.en: The map shows the approximate location of the ancient settlement.
examples.zh: 地图标出了这处古代聚落的大致位置。

examples.en: Approximately half of the people surveyed said they exercised regularly.
examples.zh: 大约一半的受访者表示他们经常锻炼。

examples.en: My dad puts on a funny apron whenever he cooks for the family.
examples.zh: 我爸爸给家人做饭时总穿着一条搞笑的围裙。

examples.en: Children with an aptitude for music should be given extra support.
examples.zh: 有音乐天资的孩子应该得到额外支持。

examples.en: The aquarium has a large tank where you can watch sharks being fed.
examples.zh: 水族馆有一个大水箱,可以看到鲨鱼喂食。

examples.en: Many aquatic plants absorb nutrients directly from the surrounding water.
examples.zh: 许多水生植物直接从周围的水中吸收养分。

examples.en: Only a small part of the country's land is arable.
examples.zh: 该国只有一小部分土地可以耕种。

examples.en: The two sides agreed to settle their dispute through arbitration.
examples.zh: 双方同意通过仲裁解决争端。

examples.en: The Romans used the arch to build long bridges and large buildings.
examples.zh: 罗马人利用拱修建长桥和大型建筑。

examples.en: An archaeologist discovered the remains of a Roman villa beneath the farm.
examples.zh: 一位考古学家在农场下面发现了一座罗马别墅的遗迹。

examples.en: Advances in archaeology have changed our view of how early towns developed.
examples.zh: 考古学的进步改变了我们对早期城镇发展的看法。

examples.en: The legal document was written in an archaic form of the language.
examples.zh: 这份法律文件是用这种语言的古老形式写成的。

examples.en: The archipelago consists of more than a thousand small islands.
examples.zh: 这个群岛由一千多个小岛组成。

examples.en: The architect designed the museum to make the best use of natural light.
examples.zh: 建筑师在设计博物馆时充分利用了自然光。

examples.en: The old railway station is one of the town's finest architectural treasures.
examples.zh: 这座老火车站是镇上最精美的建筑瑰宝之一。

examples.en: The city's architecture reflects the influence of several different cultures.
examples.zh: 这座城市的建筑风格反映了几种不同文化的影响。

examples.en: The town's archive holds old photos and letters from the last century.
examples.zh: 小镇的档案馆收藏着上个世纪的老照片和信件。

examples.en: The Arctic is warming faster than almost any other part of the world.
examples.zh: 北极变暖的速度几乎比世界其他任何地方都快。

examples.en: The sun does not set for weeks in the summer above the Arctic Circle.
examples.zh: 夏季,北极圈以北的太阳数周不落。

examples.en: Mining remains an arduous and dangerous job in many parts of the world.
examples.zh: 在世界许多地方,采矿仍是一项艰巨而危险的工作。

examples.en: The concert will be held at the indoor arena near the river.
examples.zh: 音乐会将在河边的室内竞技场举行。

examples.en: The printing press was arguably the most important invention of that period.
examples.zh: 可以说,印刷机是那个时期最重要的发明。

examples.en: The main argument of the article is that cities need more green space.
examples.zh: 这篇文章的主要论点是城市需要更多绿地。

examples.en: The plan led to a long argument among members of the committee.
examples.zh: 这项计划在委员会成员中引发了长时间的争论。

examples.en: Very few people live in the arid regions of central Australia.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚中部的干旱地区人烟稀少。

examples.en: Problems can arise when a new species is brought into an area.
examples.zh: 把新物种引入某个地区时可能出现问题。

examples.en: Land ownership allowed the aristocracy to keep its political power for centuries.
examples.zh: 贵族阶层凭借土地所有权,掌握政治权力长达数百年。

examples.en: Children first learn basic arithmetic by counting objects with their fingers.
examples.zh: 孩子们最初通过掰手指数东西来学习基本算术。

examples.en: Too much public money is spent on armament rather than on schools.
examples.zh: 太多公共资金花在军备上,而不是学校上。

examples.en: There's a comfortable armchair next to the window for reading.
examples.zh: 窗边有一把舒服的扶手椅,可以坐着看书。

examples.en: Metal armour protected knights in battle but made movement difficult.
examples.zh: 金属盔甲在战斗中保护骑士,但也使行动不便。

examples.en: The strange discovery aroused great interest among scientists around the world.
examples.zh: 这一奇特的发现引起了世界各地科学家的极大兴趣。

examples.en: The rainforest contains a remarkable array of plants and animals.
examples.zh: 雨林中有种类惊人的动植物。

examples.en: The police made an arrest within two days of the crime.
examples.zh: 案发两天内,警方就实施了逮捕。

examples.en: Please check in at the reception desk on arrival at the hotel.
examples.zh: 到达酒店后,请在前台办理入住。

examples.en: I don't like people who are arrogant about how much money they have.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢那些因为有钱就傲慢的人。

examples.en: Just follow the red arrows on the wall to find the exit.
examples.zh: 只要跟着墙上的红色箭头走就能找到出口。

examples.en: Investigators believe that the fire at the school was a case of arson.
examples.zh: 调查人员认为学校的火灾是一起纵火案。

examples.en: Entry to the national art gallery should be free for all children.
examples.zh: 所有儿童都应免费进入国家美术馆。

examples.en: Each artefact was carefully cleaned and photographed before being moved.
examples.zh: 每件人工制品在移动前都经过仔细清理和拍照。

examples.en: A blocked artery can reduce the flow of blood to the heart.
examples.zh: 动脉堵塞可能减少流向心脏的血液。

examples.en: Young children may struggle to articulate their feelings clearly.
examples.zh: 幼儿可能难以清楚表达自己的感受。

examples.en: She was an articulate speaker who could explain difficult ideas simply.
examples.zh: 她善于表达,能把难懂的观点解释得很简单。

examples.en: Artificial lighting allowed factories to continue working through the night.
examples.zh: 人造照明让工厂能够彻夜运转。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence is now being used to help doctors identify diseases.
examples.zh: 人工智能现在被用来帮助医生识别疾病。

examples.en: Heavy artillery could destroy the old stone walls of a castle.
examples.zh: 重型火炮能摧毁城堡古老的石墙。

examples.en: A local artisan can spend many weeks making a single wooden chair.
examples.zh: 当地的工匠可能花几周时间制作一把木椅。

examples.en: Schools should encourage artistic ability as much as academic success.
examples.zh: 学校应该像鼓励学业成功一样鼓励艺术才能。

examples.en: Public artwork can make a city centre more attractive to visitors.
examples.zh: 公共艺术品能让市中心对游客更有吸引力。

examples.en: Many young people move to cities; as a result, rural communities are shrinking.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人迁往城市,因此农村社区正在萎缩。

examples.en: Better education benefits society as a whole, not only individual students.
examples.zh: 更好的教育有益于整个社会,而不仅是学生个人。

examples.en: Exercise improves mental health as well as physical fitness.
examples.zh: 运动既能改善身体素质,也能改善心理健康。

examples.en: Warm air ascends and cools as it moves higher above the ground.
examples.zh: 暖空气上升,离地面越高温度越低。

examples.en: Investigators were unable to ascertain the exact cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 调查人员无法查明火灾的确切原因。

examples.en: Early people often ascribed natural disasters to the anger of the gods.
examples.zh: 早期的人们常常把自然灾害归因于神的愤怒。

examples.en: I felt ashamed of myself for shouting at my little brother.
examples.zh: 我对弟弟大吼之后,感到很羞愧。

examples.en: The study focuses on one aspect of memory that is often overlooked.
examples.zh: 这项研究聚焦于记忆中常被忽视的一个方面。

examples.en: Dark asphalt roads absorb heat and make cities warmer in summer.
examples.zh: 深色的沥青路面吸收热量,使城市夏天更热。

examples.en: My cousin is an aspiring actor who goes to auditions almost every week.
examples.zh: 我的表弟是一位有抱负的演员,几乎每周都去试镜。

examples.en: The assassination of the archduke in 1914 helped to start the First World War.
examples.zh: 1914 年大公遇刺促成了第一次世界大战的爆发。

examples.en: He received a two-year sentence for assault on a police officer.
examples.zh: 他因袭击警察被判处两年徒刑。

examples.en: Workers assemble the parts in a large factory near the port.
examples.zh: 工人在港口附近的一家大工厂组装这些零件。

examples.en: The national assembly voted to raise the school-leaving age.
examples.zh: 国民议会投票决定提高离校年龄。

examples.en: The author asserts that early education shapes a child's later success.
examples.zh: 作者断言,早期教育影响孩子日后的成功。

examples.en: It is difficult to assess the long-term effects of the new policy.
examples.zh: 很难评估这项新政策的长期影响。

examples.en: The assessment for this course includes a test and a group project.
examples.zh: 这门课的评估包括一次测验和一个小组项目。

examples.en: The company's main asset is its well-known brand name.
examples.zh: 公司的主要资产是它的知名品牌。

examples.en: Participants were asked to assign a score to each of the images.
examples.zh: 参与者被要求给每张图片打分。

examples.en: The history assignment has to be at least two thousand words long.
examples.zh: 这份历史作业至少要写两千词。

examples.en: Plants assimilate nitrogen from the soil through their roots.
examples.zh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收氮。

examples.en: Immigrants often assimilate into local society within a few generations.
examples.zh: 移民往往在几代之内融入当地社会。

examples.en: The assimilation of immigrants into a new society can take several generations.
examples.zh: 移民融入新社会可能需要几代人的时间。

examples.en: Many of the poorest farmers rely on assistance from the government.
examples.zh: 许多最贫困的农民依靠政府的帮助。

examples.en: She started as an assistant in the shop and now runs the business.
examples.zh: 她从店里的助理做起,现在经营着这家店。

examples.en: The model rests on the assumption that prices will remain stable.
examples.zh: 这个模型基于一个假定:价格将保持稳定。

examples.en: The authorities assured residents that the water was safe to drink.
examples.zh: 当局向居民保证,这些水可以安全饮用。

examples.en: Many scientists think an asteroid helped to wipe out the dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 许多科学家认为小行星促成了恐龙的灭绝。

examples.en: Dust and pollution can make asthma much worse in young children.
examples.zh: 灰尘和污染可能使幼儿的哮喘严重恶化。

examples.en: I was astonished to see how much the town had changed.
examples.zh: 看到小镇变化这么大,我很震惊。

examples.en: Unlike astronomy, astrology has no scientific basis at all.
examples.zh: 与天文学不同,占星术完全没有科学依据。

examples.en: Living in space causes an astronaut's bones and muscles to weaken.
examples.zh: 在太空生活使宇航员的骨骼和肌肉变弱。

examples.en: The astronomer spent years recording the movement of the planets.
examples.zh: 这位天文学家花了多年时间记录行星的运动。

examples.en: The Mayans kept detailed astronomical records of the movements of the stars.
examples.zh: 玛雅人保留了详细的恒星运行天文记录。

examples.en: The cost of the project rose to an astronomical figure.
examples.zh: 这个项目的费用升到了天文数字。

examples.en: Ancient farmers used astronomy to work out when to plant their crops.
examples.zh: 古代农民利用天文学确定何时播种。

examples.en: She studied astrophysics in order to understand how stars are formed.
examples.zh: 她学习天体物理学,以了解恒星是如何形成的。

examples.en: Many people seek asylum in order to escape war in their own countries.
examples.zh: 许多人寻求庇护,以逃离本国的战争。

examples.en: Economic growth should not be achieved at the expense of the environment.
examples.zh: 不应以牺牲环境为代价实现经济增长。

examples.en: The book traces the growth of atheism in nineteenth-century Europe.
examples.zh: 这本书追溯了十九世纪欧洲无神论的发展。

examples.en: She's very athletic and plays almost every sport you can think of.
examples.zh: 她很健壮,几乎你能想到的运动她都玩。

examples.en: You'll find an atlas of the world on the shelf by the window.
examples.zh: 窗边的书架上有一本世界地图集。

examples.en: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere and warms the planet.
examples.zh: 二氧化碳把热量困在大气中,使地球变暖。

examples.en: The old market has a lively atmosphere that attracts many visitors.
examples.zh: 这个老市场氛围热闹,吸引了许多游客。

examples.en: Every atom of an element contains the same number of protons.
examples.zh: 同一种元素的每个原子含有相同数量的质子。

examples.en: Atomic clocks can measure time with extraordinary accuracy.
examples.zh: 原子钟能以极高的精度测量时间。

examples.en: Young children form a strong attachment to the people who care for them.
examples.zh: 幼儿对照顾他们的人产生强烈的依恋。

examples.en: Few birds of this species attain full adult size before their second year.
examples.zh: 这种鸟大多要到第二年以后才能长到成年体型。

examples.en: Attendance at all the seminars is compulsory for first-year students.
examples.zh: 大一学生必须出席所有研讨课。

examples.en: Ask the flight attendant if you need another blanket or a drink.
examples.zh: 如果还需要毯子或饮料,可以问空乘人员。

examples.en: Young children can pay attention to a single task for only a short time.
examples.zh: 幼儿只能在短时间内把注意力集中在一项任务上。

examples.en: We turned the attic into an extra bedroom for our son.
examples.zh: 我们把阁楼改成了儿子的卧室。

examples.en: The attorney argued that the evidence against his client was not reliable.
examples.zh: 律师辩称,对他当事人不利的证据并不可靠。

examples.en: I find people with a good sense of humour really attractive.
examples.zh: 我觉得有幽默感的人特别有吸引力。

examples.en: Some experts attribute the fall in crime to better street lighting.
examples.zh: 一些专家把犯罪率下降归因于街道照明的改善。

examples.en: Patience is an important attribute for anyone working with young children.
examples.zh: 耐心是与幼儿打交道的人应具备的重要特质。

examples.en: Rocks in the river become smooth through attrition over long periods.
examples.zh: 河里的石头经过长期磨损变得光滑。

examples.en: The painting was sold at auction for over a million pounds.
examples.zh: 这幅画在拍卖会上以一百多万英镑售出。

examples.en: The government decided to auction the rights to use the radio frequencies.
examples.zh: 政府决定拍卖无线电频率的使用权。

examples.en: The audience stood and clapped for several minutes after the show.
examples.zh: 演出结束后,观众起立鼓掌了好几分钟。

examples.en: The museum provides audio guides in more than twenty languages.
examples.zh: 博物馆提供二十多种语言的音频导览。

examples.en: An outside company carries out an audit of the club's accounts every year.
examples.zh: 每年都由外部公司对俱乐部的账目进行审计。

examples.en: The talk has moved to the main auditorium because so many people signed up.
examples.zh: 报名的人太多,讲座改到了主礼堂。

examples.en: Tourists often want an authentic experience of local life.
examples.zh: 游客往往希望真正体验当地生活。

examples.en: Performances for tourists can lose their cultural authenticity over time.
examples.zh: 为游客举办的表演可能随着时间推移而失去文化真实性。

examples.en: The author of this book will give a talk at the library tomorrow.
examples.zh: 这本书的作者明天将在图书馆做讲座。

examples.en: People need authoritative sources of information during a health crisis.
examples.zh: 在健康危机期间,人们需要权威的信息来源。

examples.en: The local authority is responsible for collecting household waste.
examples.zh: 地方当局负责收集生活垃圾。

examples.en: I really enjoyed the singer's autobiography, as it was so honest.
examples.zh: 我很喜欢这位歌手的自传,因为写得很坦诚。

examples.en: Automatic doors allow people to enter the building without using their hands.
examples.zh: 自动门让人们不用手就能进入大楼。

examples.en: Automation may replace many routine jobs in the coming decades.
examples.zh: 未来几十年,自动化可能取代许多重复性工作。

examples.en: The invention of the automobile changed the shape of modern cities.
examples.zh: 汽车的发明改变了现代城市的形态。

examples.en: Universities should have greater autonomy in deciding what they teach.
examples.zh: 大学在决定教学内容方面应该有更大的自主权。

examples.en: The availability of cheap food has changed the way people eat.
examples.zh: 廉价食品容易买到,这改变了人们的饮食方式。

examples.en: Heavy snowfall increases the risk of an avalanche on steep mountain slopes.
examples.zh: 大雪增加了陡峭山坡上发生雪崩的风险。

examples.en: The theatre is on Park Avenue, opposite the main post office.
examples.zh: 剧院在公园大街,就在邮政总局对面。

examples.en: The average for the whole country was about twelve percent.
examples.zh: 全国的平均数约为百分之十二。

examples.en: The average price of a house rose by a third in ten years.
examples.zh: 十年间,平均房价上涨了三分之一。

examples.en: Early action helped to avert a serious shortage of food.
examples.zh: 及早采取行动有助于避免严重的粮食短缺。

examples.en: Early aviation was very dangerous, and many pilots lost their lives.
examples.zh: 早期航空非常危险,许多飞行员丧生。

examples.en: Some animals move only at night to avoid the heat of the sun.
examples.zh: 有些动物只在夜间活动,以避开太阳的炎热。

examples.en: She won an award for the best young chef in the region.
examples.zh: 她获得了该地区最佳青年厨师奖。

examples.en: The college will award a prize to the student with the highest marks.
examples.zh: 学院将向成绩最高的学生颁发奖品。

examples.en: Awareness of the dangers of too much sugar has grown in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来,人们对过量摄入糖分危害的意识有所增强。

examples.en: The food at that hotel was awful, so we ate out every night.
examples.zh: 那家酒店的饭菜很糟糕,所以我们每晚都出去吃。

examples.en: Moving such a heavy statue was an awkward and dangerous task.
examples.zh: 搬运这么重的雕像既笨拙又危险。

examples.en: Euclid began his work on geometry with a small number of axioms.
examples.zh: 欧几里得的几何学著作从少数几条公理开始。

examples.en: The vertical axis shows the number of people, measured in thousands.
examples.zh: 纵轴显示人数,单位为千。

examples.en: The wheels turn on a metal axle fixed underneath the cart.
examples.zh: 车轮绕着固定在车下的金属车轴转动。

examples.en: Baboons live in large groups with a strict order of rank.
examples.zh: 狒狒生活在有严格等级的大群体中。

examples.en: You need a bachelor's degree to apply for this teaching course.
examples.zh: 申请这门教师课程需要有学士学位。

examples.en: You can find back issues of the journal in the basement.
examples.zh: 你可以在地下室找到这本期刊的过刊。

examples.en: The town is popular with young backpackers because food and rooms are cheap.
examples.zh: 这个小镇很受年轻背包客欢迎,因为吃住都便宜。

examples.en: After the show, we were invited backstage to meet the actors.
examples.zh: 演出结束后,我们受邀到后台与演员见面。

examples.en: In the nineteenth century, the region was seen as economically backward.
examples.zh: 在十九世纪,这一地区被视为经济落后。

examples.en: Some bacteria in the gut are essential for good health.
examples.zh: 肠道中的一些细菌对健康至关重要。

examples.en: All visitors must wear a badge while they are in the building.
examples.zh: 所有访客在楼内必须佩戴徽章。

examples.en: Please collect your baggage from the belt in the arrivals hall.
examples.zh: 请到到达大厅的传送带提取行李。

examples.en: Your baggage allowance on this flight is twenty kilos per passenger.
examples.zh: 这趟航班的行李限额是每位乘客二十公斤。

examples.en: Scientists used fish as bait to attract the sharks to their cameras.
examples.zh: 科学家用鱼作诱饵,把鲨鱼吸引到相机前。

examples.en: The bakery on the corner sells fresh bread from seven every morning.
examples.zh: 街角的面包店每天早上七点开始卖新鲜面包。

examples.en: I got into baking during the holidays, and now I make bread every week.
examples.zh: 我假期时迷上了烘焙,现在每周都做面包。

examples.en: You can check your account balance at any cash machine.
examples.zh: 你可以在任何一台取款机上查询账户余额。

examples.en: It's hard to find a balance between part-time work and my studies.
examples.zh: 很难在兼职和学习之间找到平衡。

examples.en: Students must learn to balance their spending against their income each month.
examples.zh: 学生必须学会每月平衡自己的支出和收入。

examples.en: Schools should teach children the importance of a balanced diet.
examples.zh: 学校应该教导孩子均衡饮食的重要性。

examples.en: The bedroom has a small balcony with a lovely view of the sea.
examples.zh: 卧室有一个小阳台,能看到美丽的海景。

examples.en: My dad started going bald when he was only about thirty.
examples.zh: 我爸爸才三十岁左右就开始秃头了。

examples.en: The government should support ballet and other art forms that struggle financially.
examples.zh: 政府应该支持芭蕾舞和其他经济困难的艺术形式。

examples.en: Citizens cast their ballot in secret to ensure a fair election.
examples.zh: 公民以无记名方式投票,以确保选举公平。

examples.en: The island's balmy weather makes it a popular destination in winter.
examples.zh: 这座岛气候温和宜人,是冬季热门的旅游目的地。

examples.en: Several countries have banned the use of this pesticide on farms.
examples.zh: 几个国家已经禁止在农场使用这种农药。

examples.en: A ban on hunting has allowed the number of whales to recover.
examples.zh: 禁猎令使鲸鱼的数量得以恢复。

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the cut and put a bandage around my hand.
examples.zh: 护士清理了伤口,在我手上缠了绷带。

examples.en: Most scientists think the universe began with a big bang.
examples.zh: 大多数科学家认为宇宙始于一场大爆炸。

examples.en: You'll need to show a recent bank statement to rent the flat.
examples.zh: 租这套公寓需要出示最近的银行对账单。

examples.en: Several small airlines went bankrupt when the price of fuel rose.
examples.zh: 燃油价格上涨后,几家小型航空公司破产了。

examples.en: Falling sales forced the company into bankruptcy after fifty years in business.
examples.zh: 销量下滑迫使这家经营了五十年的公司破产。

examples.en: Fans held up a huge banner with the team's name on it.
examples.zh: 球迷举起一条印有球队名字的巨大横幅。

examples.en: If the weather stays fine, we'll have a barbecue in the garden on Sunday.
examples.zh: 如果天气一直这么好,我们周日就在花园里烧烤。

examples.en: The village is barely visible from the road because of the trees.
examples.zh: 由于树木遮挡,从公路上几乎看不见这个村庄。

examples.en: This coat was a real bargain at half the original price.
examples.zh: 这件大衣打对折,真是捡了个便宜。

examples.en: Tourists in the market often bargain with the sellers over prices.
examples.zh: 市场里的游客经常和小贩讨价还价。

examples.en: The bark of this tree was used to make medicine for fevers.
examples.zh: 这种树的树皮曾被用来制作退烧药。

examples.en: Barley grows well in cool climates and is often used to make beer.
examples.zh: 大麦在凉爽气候中长得很好,常用来酿啤酒。

examples.en: The farm has turned its old barn into a café for visitors.
examples.zh: 农场把旧谷仓改成了接待游客的咖啡馆。

examples.en: A falling barometer is often a sign that a storm is coming.
examples.zh: 气压计读数下降往往是风暴来临的征兆。

examples.en: The price of oil rose above one hundred dollars a barrel.
examples.zh: 石油价格涨到了每桶一百多美元。

examples.en: After years of overuse, the land became barren and could not be farmed.
examples.zh: 经过多年过度使用,这片土地变得贫瘠,无法耕种。

examples.en: Language can be a serious barrier to finding work in a new country.
examples.zh: 在新的国家,语言可能成为求职的严重障碍。

examples.en: You can keep your bikes in the basement, next to the washing machines.
examples.zh: 你可以把自行车放在地下室,就在洗衣机旁边。

examples.en: The Amazon basin contains the largest rainforest on the planet.
examples.zh: 亚马孙流域拥有地球上最大的雨林。

examples.en: We'll send out the next batch of letters to students on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们将在周五给学生寄出下一批信件。

examples.en: Better battery technology has made electric cars far more practical.
examples.zh: 更好的电池技术让电动汽车实用多了。

examples.en: Ships shelter in the bay when storms come in from the ocean.
examples.zh: 海上风暴来袭时,船只在海湾里避风。

examples.en: Long working hours are associated with poor physical and mental health.
examples.zh: 长时间工作与身心健康不佳有关。

examples.en: People should be aware of the dangers of sharing personal information online.
examples.zh: 人们应该意识到在网上分享个人信息的危险。

examples.en: Rising prices are bound to affect people on low incomes most.
examples.zh: 物价上涨必然对低收入人群影响最大。

examples.en: Young children are capable of learning several languages at the same time.
examples.zh: 幼儿能够同时学习几种语言。

examples.en: Children are exposed to too much advertising on the internet.
examples.zh: 孩子们在互联网上接触到太多广告。

examples.en: I've always been fond of old films, especially black and white ones.
examples.zh: 我一直喜欢老电影,特别是黑白片。

examples.en: Many people are inclined to believe everything that they read online.
examples.zh: 许多人倾向于相信网上读到的一切。

examples.en: I'm not really keen on sports, but I do enjoy watching football.
examples.zh: 我不太热衷运动,但确实喜欢看足球。

examples.en: Children who read at home are likely to do well at school.
examples.zh: 在家读书的孩子很可能在学校表现好。

examples.en: I'm passionate about cooking and try a new recipe every weekend.
examples.zh: 我对烹饪充满热情,每个周末都尝试新食谱。

examples.en: Many health problems are related to a lack of regular exercise.
examples.zh: 许多健康问题与缺乏规律运动有关。

examples.en: Parents are responsible for the behaviour of their young children.
examples.zh: 父母要对年幼孩子的行为负责。

examples.en: Imported goods are subject to a tax of ten percent.
examples.zh: 进口商品须缴纳百分之十的税。

examples.en: The shape of a bird's beak depends on the kind of food it eats.
examples.zh: 鸟喙的形状取决于它吃的食物种类。

examples.en: Heavy wooden beams hold up the roof of the old market hall.
examples.zh: 沉重的木横梁支撑着老市场大厅的屋顶。

examples.en: My dad has had a beard for as long as I can remember.
examples.zh: 从我记事起,我爸爸就留着胡须。

examples.en: A beaver can build a dam that changes the flow of a whole river.
examples.zh: 河狸能筑起改变整条河流流向的水坝。

examples.en: We stayed at a small bed and breakfast run by a local couple.
examples.zh: 我们住在一家由当地夫妇经营的小民宿。

examples.en: As a student, I lived in a tiny bedsit with a cooker beside the bed.
examples.zh: 上学时我住在一间很小的单间出租房里,灶具就在床边。

examples.en: The guest room has a matching bedspread and curtains in pale blue.
examples.zh: 客房的床罩和窗帘是配套的淡蓝色。

examples.en: Some species of beetle can damage entire forests within a few years.
examples.zh: 某些种类的甲虫能在几年内毁掉整片森林。

examples.en: This class is for complete beginners, so you don't need any experience.
examples.zh: 这门课面向零基础的初学者,所以你不需要任何经验。

examples.en: Researchers filmed the animals to study their behaviour in the wild.
examples.zh: 研究者拍摄这些动物,以研究它们在野外的行为。

examples.en: Behavioural changes are often the first sign of the illness.
examples.zh: 行为变化往往是这种疾病的最初迹象。

examples.en: I've got a beige coat that goes with almost everything I own.
examples.zh: 我有一件米色大衣,几乎能配我所有的衣服。

examples.en: My dad gave me this leather belt when I got my first job.
examples.zh: 我得到第一份工作时,爸爸送了我这条皮腰带。

examples.en: Slow down here, because there's a sharp bend just after the bridge.
examples.zh: 这里请减速,因为过桥后有一个急转弯。

examples.en: A moderate amount of exercise is beneficial for people of all ages.
examples.zh: 适量运动对各个年龄段的人都有益。

examples.en: Free health insurance is one of the main benefits of this job.
examples.zh: 免费医疗保险是这份工作的主要福利之一。

examples.en: The whole team will benefit from the new training programme.
examples.zh: 整个团队都将从新的培训计划中受益。

examples.en: I booked a lower berth on the night train to Edinburgh.
examples.zh: 我订了去爱丁堡夜车的下铺。

examples.en: Her first novel became a best-seller in more than twenty countries.
examples.zh: 她的第一部小说在二十多个国家成为畅销书。

examples.en: A slight change in the voice can betray a person's true feelings.
examples.zh: 声音的细微变化可能泄露一个人的真实情感。

examples.en: Hot beverages are served in the hall during the morning break.
examples.zh: 上午休息时,大厅里供应热饮。

examples.en: Researchers must be careful to avoid bias when they select participants.
examples.zh: 研究者在挑选参与者时必须小心避免偏差。

examples.en: News reports may be biased in favour of those who own the media.
examples.zh: 新闻报道可能偏袒媒体的所有者。

examples.en: Remember to list every book you've used in the bibliography.
examples.zh: 记得在参考书目中列出你用过的每一本书。

examples.en: Someone made a bid of £200 for the old painting at the sale.
examples.zh: 拍卖会上有人出价 200 英镑买这幅旧画。

examples.en: Three local companies will bid for the contract to build the new library.
examples.zh: 当地三家公司将投标建造新图书馆的合同。

examples.en: Companies use big data to predict what their customers will buy next.
examples.zh: 公司利用大数据预测顾客接下来会买什么。

examples.en: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement on trade and education.
examples.zh: 两国签署了一项关于贸易和教育的双边协议。

examples.en: Bilingual children can often switch between languages with little effort.
examples.zh: 双语儿童常常能毫不费力地在两种语言之间切换。

examples.en: Could you pay the electricity bill before you go on holiday?
examples.zh: 你去度假前能把电费账单付了吗?

examples.en: A large billboard beside the road can distract drivers and cause accidents.
examples.zh: 路边的大广告牌可能分散司机的注意力,引发事故。

examples.en: My friends and I sometimes play billiards at a small club near the station.
examples.zh: 我和朋友有时在车站附近的小俱乐部打台球。

examples.en: Computers store all their information in binary code using ones and zeros.
examples.zh: 计算机用由一和零组成的二进制代码存储所有信息。

examples.en: The treaty will bind all member countries to reducing their carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 这项条约将约束所有成员国减少碳排放。

examples.en: Remember to bring binoculars if you want to watch the birds.
examples.zh: 如果想观鸟,记得带双筒望远镜。

examples.en: Biochemistry is a difficult subject, but there are plenty of jobs for graduates.
examples.zh: 生物化学很难学,但毕业生的工作机会很多。

examples.en: Biodegradable materials could replace much of the plastic used today.
examples.zh: 可生物降解材料可以取代今天使用的大部分塑料。

examples.en: Tropical forests have the highest level of biodiversity on land.
examples.zh: 热带森林拥有陆地上最高的生物多样性。

examples.en: Biofuel made from food crops may push up the price of food.
examples.zh: 用粮食作物制成的生物燃料可能推高粮价。

examples.en: I've just finished a biography of a famous Chinese scientist.
examples.zh: 我刚读完一本关于一位著名中国科学家的传记。

examples.en: A marine biologist studies the plants and animals that live in the sea.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家研究生活在海中的动植物。

examples.en: Advances in biotechnology have produced crops that can resist disease.
examples.zh: 生物技术的进步培育出了能抵抗疾病的作物。

examples.en: The eagle is a large bird of prey with extremely sharp eyesight.
examples.zh: 雕是一种视力极其敏锐的大型猛禽。

examples.en: A falling birth rate means there will be fewer workers in the future.
examples.zh: 出生率下降意味着未来工人减少。

examples.en: My hometown is the birthplace of a very famous Chinese poet.
examples.zh: 我的家乡是一位著名中国诗人的出生地。

examples.en: I had a bizarre dream last night about flying over my old school.
examples.zh: 我昨晚做了个怪梦,梦见自己飞过以前的学校。

examples.en: Nothing can escape from a black hole, not even light.
examples.zh: 任何东西都无法逃脱黑洞,甚至光也不行。

examples.en: Criminals used stolen photographs to blackmail people on social media.
examples.zh: 犯罪分子利用盗取的照片在社交媒体上敲诈他人。

examples.en: You'll find an extra blanket in the cupboard if you get cold.
examples.zh: 如果觉得冷,橱柜里还有一条毯子。

examples.en: Bleach is sometimes used to remove the natural colour from paper.
examples.zh: 漂白剂有时被用来去除纸张的天然颜色。

examples.en: Press firmly on the cut if it starts to bleed again.
examples.zh: 如果伤口再次流血,就用力按住。

examples.en: The fruit is blended with sugar and water to produce juice.
examples.zh: 水果与糖和水混合,制成果汁。

examples.en: The blizzard left many remote villages without power for several days.
examples.zh: 这场暴风雪使许多偏远村庄断电数日。

examples.en: The post office is two blocks from here, on your left.
examples.zh: 邮局离这里两个街区,在你的左边。

examples.en: Fallen trees may block the road after a heavy storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后,倒下的树可能会挡住道路。

examples.en: The block of flats was built in the 1960s to house factory workers.
examples.zh: 这栋公寓楼建于 20 世纪 60 年代,供工厂工人居住。

examples.en: A Hollywood blockbuster can earn more than the budget of a small country.
examples.zh: 一部好莱坞大片的收入可能超过一个小国的预算。

examples.en: My cousin has blond hair, which is quite unusual in my family.
examples.zh: 我的表妹是金发,这在我家很少见。

examples.en: High blood pressure often has no obvious symptoms in its early stages.
examples.zh: 高血压在早期通常没有明显症状。

examples.en: Smoking damages the walls of the blood vessels and raises the risk of illness.
examples.zh: 吸烟会损害血管壁,增加患病风险。

examples.en: This rare flower blooms for just a single night each year.
examples.zh: 这种珍稀的花每年只开一夜。

examples.en: Cherry blossom attracts large crowds of visitors to the park each spring.
examples.zh: 樱花每年春天吸引大批游客来到公园。

examples.en: Apple trees blossom in spring, and the fruit is picked in autumn.
examples.zh: 苹果树春天开花,秋天摘果。

examples.en: Blue-collar jobs in factories have declined in many developed countries.
examples.zh: 在许多发达国家,工厂里的蓝领工作减少了。

examples.en: The engineer's original blueprint for the bridge is kept in the city museum.
examples.zh: 工程师最初的桥梁蓝图保存在市博物馆。

examples.en: Early stone tools were often blunt and had to be sharpened regularly.
examples.zh: 早期的石器常常很钝,需要定期打磨。

examples.en: Please have your boarding pass and passport ready at the gate.
examples.zh: 请在登机口准备好登机牌和护照。

examples.en: Some children find it hard to live away from home at boarding school.
examples.zh: 有些孩子觉得在寄宿学校离家生活很难。

examples.en: The city boasts one of the finest collections of Roman art in Europe.
examples.zh: 这座城市拥有欧洲最好的罗马艺术藏品之一。

examples.en: Sleep affects many bodily functions, including digestion and breathing.
examples.zh: 睡眠影响许多身体机能,包括消化和呼吸。

examples.en: Body language can reveal what people really feel about each other.
examples.zh: 肢体语言能透露人们对彼此的真实感受。

examples.en: Water boils at a lower temperature at the top of a high mountain.
examples.zh: 在高山山顶,水的沸点较低。

examples.en: The architect's bold design was criticised by many people at the time.
examples.zh: 这位建筑师大胆的设计在当时受到许多人的批评。

examples.en: Each steel bolt in the bridge is checked regularly for signs of weakness.
examples.zh: 桥上的每个钢螺栓都定期检查是否有松动迹象。

examples.en: Eating together strengthens the bond between parents and children.
examples.zh: 一起吃饭能加强父母和孩子之间的纽带。

examples.en: All staff receive a bonus at the end of a good year.
examples.zh: 业绩好的年份,全体员工年底都会拿到奖金。

examples.en: You should book your train tickets early to get a better price.
examples.zh: 你应该早点预订火车票,这样价格更便宜。

examples.en: The booklet you've been given explains how to use the library.
examples.zh: 发给你们的小册子说明了如何使用图书馆。

examples.en: My flatmate is a real bookworm and reads at least two novels a week.
examples.zh: 我的室友是个十足的书虫,每周至少读两本小说。

examples.en: The oil boom brought great wealth to the region in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代的石油繁荣给该地区带来了巨大财富。

examples.en: Tourism has helped to boost the local economy in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来,旅游业推动了当地经济的发展。

examples.en: The new railway gave a major boost to trade between the two cities.
examples.zh: 新铁路大大推动了两座城市之间的贸易。

examples.en: I bought a pair of warm winter boots before moving to Canada.
examples.zh: 搬到加拿大之前,我买了一双保暖的冬靴。

examples.en: You can buy tickets for the boat trip at the booth by the pier.
examples.zh: 你可以在码头旁的售票亭买游船票。

examples.en: My hometown is right on the border, so many people there speak two languages.
examples.zh: 我的家乡就在边境上,所以那里很多人会说两种语言。

examples.en: The botanical garden contains plants collected from all over the world.
examples.zh: 这座植物园收藏着来自世界各地的植物。

examples.en: Her interest in botany began with the wild flowers near her home.
examples.zh: 她对植物学的兴趣始于家附近的野花。

examples.en: The narrow bridge has become a serious bottleneck for traffic entering the city.
examples.zh: 这座窄桥已成为进城交通的严重瓶颈。

examples.en: The figures appeared to bottom out in 2009 and then slowly recovered.
examples.zh: 这些数字似乎在 2009 年触底,然后缓慢回升。

examples.en: The heavy snow broke a large bough from the old oak tree.
examples.zh: 大雪压断了老橡树上一根粗大的树枝。

examples.en: We walked along a wide boulevard lined with cafés and old trees.
examples.zh: 我们沿着一条宽阔的林荫大道走,路边都是咖啡馆和老树。

examples.en: With so many cars on the road, traffic problems are bound to get worse.
examples.zh: 路上汽车这么多,交通问题必定会恶化。

examples.en: The river forms a natural boundary between the two regions.
examples.zh: 这条河构成了两个地区之间的天然边界。

examples.en: She works in a small boutique selling designer dresses and handbags.
examples.zh: 她在一家卖名牌连衣裙和手提包的小精品店工作。

examples.en: A diet high in fibre may reduce the risk of bowel cancer.
examples.zh: 高纤维饮食可能降低肠癌风险。

examples.en: We went bowling for my friend's birthday, and I was terrible at it.
examples.zh: 我们为朋友庆生去打保龄球,我打得很差。

examples.en: Call the box office to check whether any seats are left.
examples.zh: 打电话给售票处,看看还有没有座位。

examples.en: People in the 25 to 34 age bracket spent the most on travel.
examples.zh: 25 至 34 岁年龄段的人旅游支出最多。

examples.en: The brain drain has left many poor countries short of doctors.
examples.zh: 人才流失使许多贫穷国家缺少医生。

examples.en: Some critics describe constant advertising as a form of brainwashing.
examples.zh: 一些批评者把持续不断的广告说成是一种洗脑。

examples.en: The driver's foot pressed the brake just before the collision.
examples.zh: 就在相撞之前,司机踩下了刹车。

examples.en: Our nearest branch is on the High Street, next to the post office.
examples.zh: 我们最近的分行在高街,紧邻邮局。

examples.en: A large branch fell from the tree and damaged the roof of the shed.
examples.zh: 一根大树枝从树上掉下来,砸坏了棚屋的屋顶。

examples.en: People often pay more for a product with a well-known brand.
examples.zh: 人们常常愿意为知名品牌的产品付更多的钱。

examples.en: I saved for a year to buy a brand-new laptop.
examples.zh: 我攒了一年钱才买了一台全新的笔记本电脑。

examples.en: Brass is a yellow metal made from a mixture of copper and zinc.
examples.zh: 黄铜是由铜和锌混合而成的黄色金属。

examples.en: The company's use of personal data was a clear breach of the law.
examples.zh: 该公司使用个人数据的做法明显违反了法律。

examples.en: In many families today, the woman is the main breadwinner.
examples.zh: 如今在许多家庭中,女性是主要的养家糊口的人。

examples.en: Strong communities may break down when young people move away.
examples.zh: 年轻人搬走后,紧密的社区可能会瓦解。

examples.en: Companies that break the law should pay heavy fines.
examples.zh: 违法的公司应该支付高额罚款。

examples.en: A breakdown in communication between the two teams caused the project to fail.
examples.zh: 两个团队之间的沟通崩溃导致项目失败。

examples.en: The table gives a breakdown of the costs by country.
examples.zh: 这张表按国家列出了费用细目。

examples.en: The discovery of penicillin was a major breakthrough in the treatment of infection.
examples.zh: 青霉素的发现是治疗感染方面的重大突破。

examples.en: I can only swim breaststroke, but I'd really like to learn something faster.
examples.zh: 我只会蛙泳,但很想学点游得更快的泳姿。

examples.en: The view from the top of the tower was absolutely breathtaking.
examples.zh: 从塔顶看到的景色令人叹为观止。

examples.en: Sea birds return to these islands each year to breed.
examples.zh: 海鸟每年回到这些岛屿繁殖。

examples.en: Farmers developed this breed of sheep for its soft wool.
examples.zh: 农民培育这种羊的品种是为了获取柔软的羊毛。

examples.en: A cool breeze from the sea keeps the town comfortable in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天来自海上的凉爽微风让小镇很舒适。

examples.en: I'd like to make a few brief comments before we start the discussion.
examples.zh: 开始讨论之前,我想简短说几句。

examples.en: Our manager gave us a brief on the new project this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午经理就新项目给我们做了简报。

examples.en: My friend is a brilliant cook, and her food is better than any restaurant's.
examples.zh: 我朋友是个杰出的厨师,她做的菜比任何餐馆都好吃。

examples.en: New technology can bring about great changes in the way we work.
examples.zh: 新技术可以给我们的工作方式带来巨大变化。

examples.en: Hunting had pushed the species to the brink of extinction by 1900.
examples.zh: 到 1900 年,狩猎已把这一物种逼到了灭绝的边缘。

examples.en: Glass is hard but brittle, so it breaks easily when dropped.
examples.zh: 玻璃坚硬但易碎,所以掉在地上很容易破。

examples.en: Fast broadband is still unavailable in many remote rural villages.
examples.zh: 许多偏远农村仍然用不上高速宽带。

examples.en: Television stations should broadcast more programmes about science.
examples.zh: 电视台应该播放更多科学节目。

examples.en: Travelling abroad is an excellent way to broaden one's horizons.
examples.zh: 出国旅行是开阔眼界的极好方式。

examples.en: A broadsheet usually offers more serious news than a popular daily paper.
examples.zh: 大报通常提供比流行日报更严肃的新闻。

examples.en: This brochure lists all the hotels and day trips we offer.
examples.zh: 这本宣传册列出了我们提供的所有酒店和一日游。

examples.en: People began to use bronze tools about five thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 人们大约在五千年前开始使用青铜工具。

examples.en: Trade across the region grew rapidly during the Bronze Age.
examples.zh: 青铜时代,这一地区的贸易迅速发展。

examples.en: I like to browse the shelves in the library when I have time.
examples.zh: 有时间时,我喜欢在图书馆的书架间浏览。

examples.en: Each browser stores information about the websites that users visit.
examples.zh: 每个浏览器都会存储用户访问网站的信息。

examples.en: I fell off my bike and got a big bruise on my leg.
examples.zh: 我从自行车上摔下来,腿上青了一大块。

examples.en: We usually meet for brunch on Sundays at about eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 我们通常周日十一点左右见面吃早午餐。

examples.en: Workers in early coal mines often faced brutal conditions underground.
examples.zh: 早期煤矿的工人在地下常常面临残酷的条件。

examples.en: Tiny bubbles of air trapped in the ice show what the ancient atmosphere was like.
examples.zh: 困在冰中的微小气泡显示了古代大气的样子。

examples.en: When I was little, I'd take a bucket to the beach and collect shells.
examples.zh: 我小时候常提着一个桶去海滩捡贝壳。

examples.en: New buds appear on the branches as soon as the weather warms.
examples.zh: 天气一转暖,枝头就长出新芽。

examples.en: Buddhism spread from India to China along the old trade routes.
examples.zh: 佛教沿着古老的贸易路线从印度传到中国。

examples.en: We have a budget of about £800 for the whole holiday.
examples.zh: 我们整个假期的预算大约是 800 英镑。

examples.en: Breakfast is a buffet, so you can help yourself to whatever you like.
examples.zh: 早餐是自助餐,想吃什么可以自己取。

examples.en: The bulb in the hall has gone, so we need a new one.
examples.zh: 门厅的灯泡坏了,所以我们需要换个新的。

examples.en: We planted some tulip bulbs along the fence last autumn.
examples.zh: 去年秋天我们沿着围栏种了一些郁金香球茎。

examples.en: The bulk of the country's energy came from coal in 1990.
examples.zh: 1990 年,该国的大部分能源来自煤炭。

examples.en: My old suitcase was so bulky that I could hardly carry it.
examples.zh: 我的旧手提箱太笨重了,几乎拎不动。

examples.en: The bullet missed the police officer and hit a car parked nearby.
examples.zh: 子弹没有击中警察,而是打中了停在附近的一辆车。

examples.en: The department sends out a weekly bulletin with news about upcoming events.
examples.zh: 院系每周发一份简报,介绍即将举行的活动。

examples.en: Schools must take strong action against all forms of bullying.
examples.zh: 学校必须采取有力行动,打击各种形式的欺凌。

examples.en: I found a bundle of old letters from my parents in the attic.
examples.zh: 我在阁楼上发现了一捆父母的旧信。

examples.en: My grandparents moved to a bungalow because they can't manage the stairs.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母搬到了平房,因为他们爬不动楼梯了。

examples.en: An ageing population may become a heavy burden on younger taxpayers.
examples.zh: 人口老龄化可能成为年轻纳税人的沉重负担。

examples.en: Too much bureaucracy can make it difficult to start a small business.
examples.zh: 官僚主义过重可能使创办小企业变得困难。

examples.en: Good street lighting can help to reduce burglary in residential areas.
examples.zh: 良好的街道照明有助于减少住宅区的入室盗窃。

examples.en: Gold and weapons were placed in the burial chamber of the king.
examples.zh: 黄金和武器被放在国王的墓室里。

examples.en: Long hours and constant pressure can lead to burnout among nurses.
examples.zh: 长时间工作和持续的压力可能导致护士职业倦怠。

examples.en: Rabbits live in an underground burrow that protects them from predators.
examples.zh: 兔子住在地下洞穴里,可以躲避捕食者。

examples.en: Some animals burrow deep into the sand to escape the desert heat.
examples.zh: 有些动物深挖沙洞来躲避沙漠的炎热。

examples.en: Small birds often hide their nests deep inside a thick bush.
examples.zh: 小鸟常把巢藏在茂密灌木丛的深处。

examples.en: I love walking through the bustling market near my flat on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 周六我喜欢穿过公寓附近熙熙攘攘的市场。

examples.en: The local butcher closed when a large supermarket opened nearby.
examples.zh: 附近开了一家大超市后,当地的肉贩关了店。

examples.en: The butterfly travels thousands of kilometres from Canada to Mexico each autumn.
examples.zh: 这种蝴蝶每年秋天从加拿大飞越数千公里到达墨西哥。

examples.en: Cars pollute the air; by contrast, bicycles produce no harmful gases.
examples.zh: 汽车污染空气;相比之下,自行车不产生有害气体。

examples.en: Many people now learn languages by means of mobile phone apps.
examples.zh: 现在许多人通过手机应用学习语言。

examples.en: The new road will bypass the town and reduce traffic in the centre.
examples.zh: 新公路将绕过小镇,减少市中心的交通流量。

examples.en: It was raining heavily, so we took a cab back to the hotel.
examples.zh: 雨下得很大,所以我们打车回了酒店。

examples.en: Each cabin on the ship has two beds and a small window.
examples.zh: 船上每间船舱都有两张床和一扇小窗。

examples.en: We stayed in a wooden cabin beside the lake for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末我们住在湖边的一间木屋里。

examples.en: A cable under the Atlantic first linked Europe and America by telegraph.
examples.zh: 大西洋海底的电缆首次用电报连接了欧洲和美洲。

examples.en: A cactus stores water in its thick stem during long dry periods.
examples.zh: 仙人掌在漫长的干旱期把水分储存在粗壮的茎中。

examples.en: You can get a cheap lunch at the cafeteria on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 你可以在一楼的自助餐厅吃到便宜的午餐。

examples.en: Keeping large birds in a small cage can cause them great stress.
examples.zh: 把大型鸟类关在小笼子里会让它们承受巨大压力。

examples.en: Calcium is needed to build strong bones and teeth.
examples.zh: 强健的骨骼和牙齿需要钙。

examples.en: Early astronomers were able to calculate the size of the Earth.
examples.zh: 早期的天文学家能够计算出地球的大小。

examples.en: Pocket calculators became cheap and widely available in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 袖珍计算器在 20 世纪 70 年代变得便宜且普及。

examples.en: Newton and Leibniz developed calculus at about the same time.
examples.zh: 牛顿和莱布尼茨几乎同时创立了微积分。

examples.en: My grandfather taught me calligraphy when I was about eight years old.
examples.zh: 我大约八岁时,爷爷教我书法。

examples.en: My mum stays calm even when something goes badly wrong at home.
examples.zh: 即使家里出了大问题,我妈妈也能保持冷静。

examples.en: This salad has fewer calories than most of the other lunches on the menu.
examples.zh: 这份沙拉的卡路里比菜单上大多数午餐都低。

examples.en: The insect's green colour provides excellent camouflage among the leaves.
examples.zh: 这种昆虫的绿色在树叶间提供了极好的伪装。

examples.en: A national campaign has helped to reduce the number of people who smoke.
examples.zh: 一场全国性运动帮助减少了吸烟人数。

examples.en: My family used to go camping by the lake every summer.
examples.zh: 我家以前每年夏天都去湖边露营。

examples.en: The campsite has hot showers and a small shop near the entrance.
examples.zh: 营地有热水淋浴,入口附近还有一家小商店。

examples.en: Most of the shops and cafés are in the centre of campus.
examples.zh: 大多数商店和咖啡馆都在校园中心。

examples.en: Goods were carried along the canal from the coast to the factories.
examples.zh: 货物沿运河从海岸运到工厂。

examples.en: There's a small charge for any cancellation made after Friday.
examples.zh: 周五之后取消预订要收取少量费用。

examples.en: The best candidate for this job will have experience of working with children.
examples.zh: 这份工作的最佳人选应有与儿童打交道的经验。

examples.en: The new cannon could fire heavy stone balls over great distances.
examples.zh: 这种新式大炮能把沉重的石弹射得很远。

examples.en: We went canoeing on the river and saw lots of birds along the way.
examples.zh: 我们在河上划独木舟,一路上看到很多鸟。

examples.en: I can't stand waiting in long queues, especially when I'm in a hurry.
examples.zh: 我无法忍受排长队,尤其是赶时间的时候。

examples.en: The staff canteen serves hot meals from twelve until two o'clock.
examples.zh: 员工食堂从十二点到两点供应热餐。

examples.en: The artist painted the huge canvas for a public building in the capital.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家为首都的一座公共建筑绘制了这幅巨大的画布作品。

examples.en: Over millions of years, the river cut a deep canyon through the rock.
examples.zh: 数百万年间,这条河在岩石中切割出一道深深的大峡谷。

examples.en: She's a very capable manager who always gets things done on time.
examples.zh: 她是一位很有能力的经理,总能按时把事情办好。

examples.en: The new power station has twice the capacity of the old one.
examples.zh: 新发电站的容量是旧发电站的两倍。

examples.en: Sailing around the cape was one of the most dangerous parts of the voyage.
examples.zh: 绕过这个海角是航程中最危险的部分之一。

examples.en: Oxygen passes from the blood into the tissues through tiny capillaries.
examples.zh: 氧气通过微小的毛细血管从血液进入组织。

examples.en: The company needed more capital to develop its new product.
examples.zh: 公司需要更多资本来开发新产品。

examples.en: Canberra was chosen as the capital of Australia in 1908.
examples.zh: 1908 年,堪培拉被选为澳大利亚的首都。

examples.en: Supporters of capital punishment argue that it prevents serious crime.
examples.zh: 死刑的支持者认为它能防止严重犯罪。

examples.en: Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water, and don't chew it.
examples.zh: 用一杯水整粒吞下胶囊,不要嚼。

examples.en: The pandas bred in captivity will later be released into the wild.
examples.zh: 这些圈养繁殖的大熊猫之后将被放归野外。

examples.en: Cameras in the forest captured images of the rare animal at night.
examples.zh: 森林里的相机在夜间捕捉到了这种珍稀动物的影像。

examples.en: The car park behind the theatre is free after six o'clock.
examples.zh: 剧院后面的停车场六点以后免费。

examples.en: We hired a caravan and drove along the coast for two weeks.
examples.zh: 我们租了一辆房车,沿着海岸开了两周。

examples.en: Athletes often eat more carbohydrates before a long race.
examples.zh: 运动员在长距离比赛前通常会多吃碳水化合物。

examples.en: Trees store carbon in their wood as they grow.
examples.zh: 树木在生长过程中把碳储存在木材里。

examples.en: Carbon dating showed that the wooden tools were about six thousand years old.
examples.zh: 碳定年显示这些木制工具约有六千年历史。

examples.en: Forests absorb large amounts of carbon dioxide from the air.
examples.zh: 森林从空气中吸收大量二氧化碳。

examples.en: Taxes on air travel could help to reduce carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 对航空旅行征税有助于减少碳排放。

examples.en: Eating less meat is an easy way to reduce your carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 少吃肉是减少碳足迹的简单方法。

examples.en: The city aims to become carbon neutral within the next twenty years.
examples.zh: 这座城市的目标是在未来二十年内实现碳中和。

examples.en: Staff in a care home should receive proper training and fair pay.
examples.zh: 护理院的员工应该接受适当的培训并获得公平的薪水。

examples.en: Young people should think carefully about their career before choosing a degree.
examples.zh: 年轻人在选择学位前应该仔细考虑职业生涯。

examples.en: Learning a foreign language can greatly improve your career prospects.
examples.zh: 学习外语能大大改善你的职业前景。

examples.en: The careers service can check your CV and help you prepare for interviews.
examples.zh: 就业指导中心可以帮你检查简历并准备面试。

examples.en: A family caregiver often needs support as well as the person being looked after.
examples.zh: 家庭照料者往往和被照顾者一样需要支持。

examples.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of grain when it sank.
examples.zh: 这艘船沉没时正运载着一批谷物。

examples.en: The newspaper printed a caricature of the prime minister on its front page.
examples.zh: 这家报纸在头版刊登了一幅首相的讽刺漫画。

examples.en: My mum is such a caring person, always worrying about everybody else.
examples.zh: 我妈妈是个很有爱心的人,总是为别人操心。

examples.en: Thousands of people dance through the streets during the summer carnival.
examples.zh: 夏季狂欢节期间,成千上万的人在街上跳舞。

examples.en: Lions and other large carnivores need very large areas in which to hunt.
examples.zh: 狮子和其他大型食肉动物需要很大的狩猎范围。

examples.en: Carnivorous plants obtain extra nutrients by trapping small insects.
examples.zh: 食肉植物通过捕捉小昆虫获取额外的养分。

examples.en: Low-cost carriers have made air travel affordable for many more people.
examples.zh: 低成本运输公司让更多人负担得起航空旅行。

examples.en: A person can be a carrier of the disease without showing any symptoms.
examples.zh: 一个人可能是这种疾病的携带者而没有任何症状。

examples.en: Vultures have a strong sense of smell that helps them to find carrion.
examples.zh: 秃鹫嗅觉灵敏,这有助于它们找到腐肉。

examples.en: You may take one carry-on bag and a small handbag on the plane.
examples.zh: 你可以带一个随身行李包和一个小手提包上飞机。

examples.en: Scientists carry out regular tests to check the quality of the water.
examples.zh: 科学家定期开展测试,检查水质。

examples.en: The island has already exceeded its carrying capacity for tourists.
examples.zh: 这座岛的游客数量已经超过了它的承载能力。

examples.en: Vegetables were taken to market by horse and cart until the 1920s.
examples.zh: 直到 20 世纪 20 年代,蔬菜还靠马车运到市场。

examples.en: My parents have a beautifully carved wooden chest in their living room.
examples.zh: 我父母的客厅里有一个雕刻精美的木箱。

examples.en: We looked at one small company as a case study for the course.
examples.zh: 我们把一家小公司作为这门课的个案研究对象。

examples.en: Please pay the cashier at the front of the shop before you leave.
examples.zh: 离开前请到店铺前方的收银员处付款。

examples.en: My aunt gave me a soft cashmere scarf for my last birthday.
examples.zh: 上次生日,我阿姨送了我一条柔软的羊绒围巾。

examples.en: Is there a cashpoint near here where I can get some money?
examples.zh: 这附近有可以取钱的自动取款机吗?

examples.en: The castle is open to visitors every day except Monday.
examples.zh: 这座城堡除周一外每天对游客开放。

examples.en: I usually wear casual clothes like jeans and a T-shirt at weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我通常穿牛仔裤和 T 恤这样的休闲装。

examples.en: They took her straight to casualty because the cut was so deep.
examples.zh: 伤口太深,他们直接把她送到了急诊室。

examples.en: Search the library catalogue to find out where the book is kept.
examples.zh: 查一下图书馆目录,看看这本书放在哪里。

examples.en: Catalysis is used in the production of most modern chemicals.
examples.zh: 大多数现代化学品的生产都要用到催化作用。

examples.en: The metal acts as a catalyst and speeds up the chemical process.
examples.zh: 这种金属起催化剂作用,加快了化学过程。

examples.en: The invention of printing was a catalyst for great social change.
examples.zh: 印刷术的发明促进了巨大的社会变革。

examples.en: Scientists warn of a catastrophe if the ice sheets continue to melt.
examples.zh: 科学家警告,如果冰盖继续融化,将发生灾难。

examples.en: Many busy workers use their weekends to catch up on lost sleep.
examples.zh: 许多忙碌的上班族利用周末补觉。

examples.en: I try to catch up with my old school friends at least once a year.
examples.zh: 我尽量每年至少和老同学叙一次旧。

examples.en: The researchers categorised the responses as either positive or negative.
examples.zh: 研究者把这些回答归为正面或负面两类。

examples.en: A local company will handle the catering for the conference next month.
examples.zh: 下个月会议的餐饮服务由当地一家公司负责。

examples.en: The caterpillar eats large amounts of leaves before forming a hard case.
examples.zh: 毛毛虫吃下大量树叶后,才形成坚硬的外壳。

examples.en: It took nearly two hundred years to complete the great cathedral.
examples.zh: 这座宏伟的大教堂花了近两百年才建成。

examples.en: Herds of cattle were once driven long distances across the plains to market.
examples.zh: 牛群曾被长途驱赶,穿越平原去往市场。

examples.en: Scientists are still trying to find the main cause of the disease.
examples.zh: 科学家仍在努力寻找这种疾病的主要原因。

examples.en: Heavy rain can cause serious damage to crops in low-lying areas.
examples.zh: 暴雨可能给低洼地区的庄稼造成严重损害。

examples.en: I'm a cautious driver, especially when the roads are wet.
examples.zh: 我开车很谨慎,尤其是路面湿滑的时候。

examples.en: Paintings found in the cave are more than thirty thousand years old.
examples.zh: 在这个洞穴里发现的壁画已有三万多年历史。

examples.en: The underground river opens into a huge cavern filled with stone columns.
examples.zh: 这条地下河通向一个布满石柱的巨大洞穴。

examples.en: Sugar helps bacteria to create a cavity in a tooth.
examples.zh: 糖会促使细菌在牙齿上形成蛀洞。

examples.en: The volcano ceased to be active about two thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 这座火山大约两千年前就停止了活动。

examples.en: We're having a meal on Friday to celebrate the end of exams.
examples.zh: 我们周五要聚餐,庆祝考试结束。

examples.en: There'll be a big celebration in the village for the school's anniversary.
examples.zh: 村里将为学校周年举行盛大的庆典。

examples.en: Young people are often too interested in the lives of celebrities.
examples.zh: 年轻人常常对名人的生活过于感兴趣。

examples.en: Ancient navigators used celestial objects such as stars to find their position.
examples.zh: 古代航海者利用恒星等天体确定自己的位置。

examples.en: Every cell in the body contains a complete set of genes.
examples.zh: 体内每个细胞都含有一整套基因。

examples.en: The house has a cellar, but it's too damp for storing anything.
examples.zh: 这栋房子有地窖,但太潮湿,放不了东西。

examples.en: My daughter began learning the cello at the age of six.
examples.zh: 我女儿六岁开始学大提琴。

examples.en: Producing cement releases a large amount of carbon dioxide into the air.
examples.zh: 生产水泥向空气中释放大量二氧化碳。

examples.en: The old cemetery contains the graves of many early settlers.
examples.zh: 这座老墓地里有许多早期定居者的坟墓。

examples.en: Censorship of the internet limits people's access to information.
examples.zh: 互联网审查限制了人们获取信息。

examples.en: According to the last census, the city had about two million inhabitants.
examples.zh: 根据最近一次人口普查,这座城市约有两百万居民。

examples.en: Water freezes at zero degrees centigrade and boils at one hundred.
examples.zh: 水在零摄氏度结冰,在一百摄氏度沸腾。

examples.en: Office rents are highest in the central business district of the city.
examples.zh: 城市中央商务区的办公室租金最高。

examples.en: The flat has central heating, so it stays warm all winter.
examples.zh: 这套公寓有集中供暖,所以整个冬天都很暖和。

examples.en: Some governments centralise power, leaving local leaders with little control.
examples.zh: 一些政府把权力集中起来,使地方领导人几乎没有控制权。

examples.en: The city's population grew rapidly in the early part of the century.
examples.zh: 这座城市的人口在本世纪初迅速增长。

examples.en: I bought a little ceramic bowl from a local artist on my holiday.
examples.zh: 度假时,我从当地一位艺术家那里买了一只小陶瓷碗。

examples.en: Wheat and other cereals provide much of the world's food.
examples.zh: 小麦和其他谷物提供了世界上大部分的食物。

examples.en: The new king was crowned in a long ceremony at the cathedral.
examples.zh: 新国王在大教堂举行的漫长典礼上加冕。

examples.en: We cannot say with certainty when the first humans reached the island.
examples.zh: 我们无法确切地说出最早的人类何时到达这座岛。

examples.en: You'll receive a certificate when you complete the first aid course.
examples.zh: 完成急救课程后,你将获得一份证书。

examples.en: These discoveries challenge the traditional view of how farming began.
examples.zh: 这些发现质疑了关于农业起源的传统观点。

examples.en: Feeding a growing population is a major challenge for many developing countries.
examples.zh: 养活不断增长的人口是许多发展中国家面临的重大挑战。

examples.en: Learning to drive was challenging at first, but I soon got used to it.
examples.zh: 学开车一开始很有挑战性,但我很快就适应了。

examples.en: The king's burial chamber was discovered beneath the floor of the hall.
examples.zh: 国王的墓室是在大厅地板下发现的。

examples.en: A chameleon can move each of its eyes in a different direction.
examples.zh: 变色龙的两只眼睛能分别朝不同方向转动。

examples.en: She became the national swimming champion when she was only sixteen.
examples.zh: 她年仅十六岁就成为全国游泳冠军。

examples.en: The chancellor announced an increase in spending on schools and hospitals.
examples.zh: 财政大臣宣布增加对学校和医院的支出。

examples.en: Please leave your wet shoes outside the changing room.
examples.zh: 请把湿鞋子放在更衣室外面。

examples.en: Some people get their news from a single television channel.
examples.zh: 有些人只从一个电视频道获取新闻。

examples.en: The sudden flood brought chaos to the transport system of the city.
examples.zh: 突如其来的洪水使城市交通系统陷入混乱。

examples.en: The small chapel on the island was built by monks in the seventh century.
