examples.zh: 岛上这座小教堂是七世纪时修道士建造的。

examples.en: For Monday, please read the first chapter of the book.
examples.zh: 周一之前,请读完这本书的第一章。

examples.en: My favourite character in the series is a funny old doctor.
examples.zh: 这部剧里我最喜欢的角色是一位风趣的老医生。

examples.en: There's a small charge for using the swimming pool at weekends.
examples.zh: 周末使用游泳池要收取少量费用。

examples.en: The hotel will charge you for any drinks taken from the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱里的饮料一经取用,酒店将向你收费。

examples.en: Police decided to charge the driver with careless driving after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后,警方决定以驾驶疏忽罪控告这名司机。

examples.en: My favourite teacher was so charismatic that everyone listened whenever she spoke.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的老师特别有魅力,她一开口大家都认真听。

examples.en: All the money from the book sale will go to a children's charity.
examples.zh: 图书义卖的所有收入都将捐给一家儿童慈善机构。

examples.en: He's a charming man, and everyone at work seems to like him.
examples.zh: 他是个迷人的人,公司里每个人好像都喜欢他。

examples.en: The chart on page ten shows how spending has changed since 2000.
examples.zh: 第十页的图表显示了 2000 年以来支出的变化。

examples.en: The tour company has arranged a charter flight directly to the island.
examples.zh: 旅行社安排了一架直飞该岛的包机。

examples.en: The earthquake opened a deep chasm across the floor of the valley.
examples.zh: 地震在山谷底部撕开了一道深深的裂口。

examples.en: My neighbour is really chatty, so it takes ages to walk past her door.
examples.zh: 我的邻居特别健谈,所以经过她家门口总要聊好久。

examples.en: Check-in opens two hours before the flight and closes forty minutes before it.
examples.zh: 值机在航班起飞前两小时开放,起飞前四十分钟关闭。

examples.en: Check-out is at eleven, but you can leave your bags at the desk.
examples.zh: 退房时间是十一点,但你可以把包寄存在前台。

examples.en: It's a good idea to have a dental check-up every six months.
examples.zh: 最好每六个月做一次牙科检查。

examples.en: My dad always wears a checked shirt when he goes fishing.
examples.zh: 我爸爸钓鱼时总穿格子衬衫。

examples.en: There was a long queue at the checkout, so I used the machines instead.
examples.zh: 收银台排着长队,所以我改用了自助机。

examples.en: My roommate is always cheerful, even early in the morning.
examples.zh: 我的室友总是很开朗,就连大清早也一样。

examples.en: A chef often has to work long hours in hot and crowded conditions.
examples.zh: 厨师常常要在炎热拥挤的环境中长时间工作。

examples.en: Knowledge of chemistry helped early metal workers to produce stronger tools.
examples.zh: 化学知识帮助早期的金属工匠制造出更坚固的工具。

examples.en: Chemotherapy kills cancer cells but can also damage healthy ones.
examples.zh: 化疗能杀死癌细胞,但也可能损伤健康细胞。

examples.en: My mother wore a red cheongsam at my cousin's wedding last year.
examples.zh: 去年表姐的婚礼上,我妈妈穿了一件红色旗袍。

examples.en: We no longer accept payment by cheque, only by card or cash.
examples.zh: 我们不再接受支票付款,只收银行卡或现金。

examples.en: I really cherish the time I spent with my grandparents as a child.
examples.zh: 我非常珍惜小时候和祖父母一起度过的时光。

examples.en: My grandfather taught me to play chess when I was six.
examples.zh: 我六岁时,爷爷教我下国际象棋。

examples.en: Each chick must leave the nest within about two months of hatching.
examples.zh: 每只雏鸟都要在孵化后大约两个月内离巢。

examples.en: Teachers are trained to recognise the signs of child abuse.
examples.zh: 教师接受培训,学习识别虐待儿童的迹象。

examples.en: The high cost of childcare prevents many mothers from returning to work.
examples.zh: 高昂的托儿费用使许多母亲无法重返工作岗位。

examples.en: A sudden chill in the air warned the farmers that winter was near.
examples.zh: 空气中突然的寒意提醒农民,冬天快到了。

examples.en: The mountain air becomes chilly as soon as the sun goes down.
examples.zh: 太阳一落山,山里的空气就变得寒冷。

examples.en: A chimpanzee can learn to use a stick to catch insects.
examples.zh: 黑猩猩能学会用树枝捕捉昆虫。

examples.en: The tiny chip contains billions of electronic parts.
examples.zh: 这块小芯片包含数十亿个电子元件。

examples.en: Sodium chloride is the chemical name for common salt.
examples.zh: 氯化钠是食盐的化学名称。

examples.en: Chlorophyll gives plants their green colour and absorbs energy from the sun.
examples.zh: 叶绿素使植物呈现绿色,并吸收太阳能量。

examples.en: I sing in the university choir, and we practise on Monday evenings.
examples.zh: 我在大学合唱团唱歌,我们周一晚上排练。

examples.en: Foods high in fat can raise the level of cholesterol in the blood.
examples.zh: 高脂肪食物可能升高血液中的胆固醇水平。

examples.en: The vegetables are chopped into small pieces and then cooked.
examples.zh: 蔬菜被切碎,然后烹煮。

examples.en: Children should help with household chores from an early age.
examples.zh: 孩子应该从小帮忙做家务。

examples.en: The school chorus gave a performance at the local home for older people.
examples.zh: 学校合唱团在当地养老院演出。

examples.en: Christianity spread rapidly through the Roman Empire after the fourth century.
examples.zh: 四世纪后,基督教在罗马帝国迅速传播。

examples.en: Humans normally have twenty-three pairs of chromosomes in each cell.
examples.zh: 人类每个细胞通常有二十三对染色体。

examples.en: Chronic back pain is one of the most common reasons for missing work.
examples.zh: 慢性背痛是请假最常见的原因之一。

examples.en: A monk wrote a detailed chronicle of events during the king's reign.
examples.zh: 一位修道士详细记录了国王统治时期的事件,写成编年史。

examples.en: The objects are displayed in chronological order, from oldest to newest.
examples.zh: 这些物品按时间顺序展出,从最古老的到最新的。

examples.en: Language learners often remember useful phrases as a single chunk.
examples.zh: 语言学习者常把有用的短语作为一个语块来记忆。

examples.en: The palace was built circa 1500 BC, according to the archaeologists.
examples.zh: 据考古学家说,这座宫殿约建于公元前 1500 年。

examples.en: Electricity can flow only when the circuit is complete.
examples.zh: 只有电路闭合时,电流才能流动。

examples.en: We sat around a circular table so that everyone could talk easily.
examples.zh: 我们围坐在圆桌旁,这样大家都方便交谈。

examples.en: Regular walking can improve blood circulation in older people.
examples.zh: 经常散步可以改善老年人的血液循环。

examples.en: The newspaper had a daily circulation of more than a million copies.
examples.zh: 这份报纸的日发行量超过一百万份。

examples.en: An ancient Greek scholar made an early estimate of the circumference of the Earth.
examples.zh: 一位古希腊学者很早就估算出了地球的周长。

examples.en: The circus comes to town every summer and stays for a week.
examples.zh: 马戏团每年夏天都来镇上,待一周。

examples.en: Many studies cite this early work as the starting point of the field.
examples.zh: 许多研究引用这项早期成果,把它视为该领域的起点。

examples.en: Every citizen has a duty to obey the law and pay tax.
examples.zh: 每个公民都有义务遵守法律和纳税。

examples.en: Lessons in citizenship teach young people about their rights and duties.
examples.zh: 公民课教导年轻人了解自己的权利和义务。

examples.en: I don't usually drive into the city centre because parking is so expensive.
examples.zh: 我通常不开车去市中心,因为停车太贵了。

examples.en: Tall glass buildings have transformed the cityscape over the past twenty years.
examples.zh: 过去二十年,高大的玻璃建筑改变了城市景观。

examples.en: Voting is one of the most important civic duties in a democracy.
examples.zh: 投票是民主国家最重要的公民义务之一。

examples.en: The Maya civilisation developed a sophisticated calendar and system of writing.
examples.zh: 玛雅文明发展出了精密的历法和文字系统。

examples.en: The company's claim that its product saves energy has been questioned.
examples.zh: 该公司声称产品节能,这一说法受到了质疑。

examples.en: Some historians claim that the tower was built much earlier than records show.
examples.zh: 一些历史学家声称,这座塔的建造时间比记载的要早得多。

examples.en: A giant clam can live for more than a hundred years.
examples.zh: 巨蛤可以活一百多年。

examples.en: Each clan in the Scottish Highlands had its own leader and land.
examples.zh: 苏格兰高地的每个宗族都有自己的首领和土地。

examples.en: The group held clandestine meetings to plan their campaign against the government.
examples.zh: 这个团体秘密开会,策划反政府运动。

examples.en: Further tests are needed to clarify the cause of the illness.
examples.zh: 需要进一步检查来澄清病因。

examples.en: Your tutor will give you marks for clarity as well as for your ideas.
examples.zh: 导师既看你的观点,也会就表达是否清晰给分。

examples.en: Reducing class size allows teachers to give each student more attention.
examples.zh: 缩小班级规模让老师能给每个学生更多关注。

examples.en: I listen to classical music when I need to concentrate on my work.
examples.zh: 需要集中精力工作时,我会听古典音乐。

examples.en: Students should still read the classics, even in the age of the internet.
examples.zh: 即使在互联网时代,学生也应该读经典著作。

examples.en: Biologists classify animals according to their shared physical features.
examples.zh: 生物学家根据共同的身体特征对动物进行分类。

examples.en: A clause in the contract allows the company to end the agreement early.
examples.zh: 合同中的一项条款允许公司提前终止协议。

examples.en: The animal uses its sharp claws to dig for insects under the ground.
examples.zh: 这种动物用锋利的爪子在地下挖昆虫。

examples.en: Bricks are made by baking clay at very high temperatures.
examples.zh: 砖是把黏土在高温下烧制而成的。

examples.en: Investing in clean energy would create jobs and reduce air pollution.
examples.zh: 投资清洁能源既能创造就业机会,又能减少空气污染。

examples.en: Large-scale forest clearance has destroyed the habitat of many animals.
examples.zh: 大规模森林砍伐破坏了许多动物的栖息地。

examples.en: Staff need security clearance to enter this part of the laboratory.
examples.zh: 工作人员需要安全许可才能进入实验室的这一区域。

examples.en: I worked as a clerk in a law firm before I went to college.
examples.zh: 上大学前,我在一家律师事务所当职员。

examples.en: The bank gave each client advice on how to invest their savings.
examples.zh: 银行就如何投资积蓄为每位客户提供建议。

examples.en: Thousands of sea birds nest on the cliffs along this coast.
examples.zh: 数千只海鸟在这段海岸的悬崖上筑巢。

examples.en: The climate of the region has become much drier over the past century.
examples.zh: 过去一个世纪,这一地区的气候变得干燥多了。

examples.en: Climate change is the most serious environmental problem facing the world.
examples.zh: 气候变化是世界面临的最严重的环境问题。

examples.en: Climatic changes may have forced early people to leave the region.
examples.zh: 气候变化可能迫使早期的人们离开这一地区。

examples.en: The climax of the film comes in the final fifteen minutes.
examples.zh: 这部电影的高潮出现在最后十五分钟。

examples.en: The figure continued to climb, reaching a peak of eighty percent in 2015.
examples.zh: 这一数字持续攀升,在 2015 年达到百分之八十的峰值。

examples.en: The clinic is open from eight until six on weekdays.
examples.zh: 这家诊所工作日从八点开到六点。

examples.en: The vaccine will enter a clinical trial with two thousand volunteers.
examples.zh: 这种疫苗将进入有两千名志愿者参加的临床试验。

examples.en: A short video clip can spread around the world within hours.
examples.zh: 一段短视频可能在几小时内传遍全球。

examples.en: Walk clockwise around the lake and you'll reach the boat house first.
examples.zh: 沿顺时针方向绕湖走,你会先到船屋。

examples.en: The cloning of a sheep in 1996 caused great public debate.
examples.zh: 1996 年克隆羊引发了公众的激烈争论。

examples.en: The flat has a closet in the hall for coats and boots.
examples.zh: 公寓门厅有一个壁橱,可以放外套和靴子。

examples.en: The closure of the mine left hundreds of local people without work.
examples.zh: 矿山关闭导致数百名当地人失业。

examples.en: A blood clot in the leg can become dangerous if it moves to the lungs.
examples.zh: 腿部的血块如果移动到肺部,可能会很危险。

examples.en: I use an old cloth to clean the windows in my flat.
examples.zh: 我用一块旧布擦公寓的窗户。

examples.en: I spend very little money on clothing because I don't care about fashion.
examples.zh: 我在服装上花钱很少,因为我不在乎时尚。

examples.en: Cloud computing allows small firms to store data at a low cost.
examples.zh: 云计算让小公司能以低成本存储数据。

examples.en: I joined a badminton club when I started at university.
examples.zh: 我上大学时加入了一个羽毛球俱乐部。

examples.en: The shape of the bones provides a clue to how the animal moved.
examples.zh: 骨骼的形状为了解这种动物的运动方式提供了线索。

examples.en: Co-educational schools help boys and girls to learn how to work together.
examples.zh: 男女同校有助于男孩和女孩学会合作。

examples.en: The coach to Oxford leaves from the bus station every half hour.
examples.zh: 开往牛津的长途汽车每半小时从汽车站发车。

examples.en: Our swimming coach makes us train three times a week.
examples.zh: 我们的游泳教练要我们每周训练三次。

examples.en: Coal was the main source of energy during the Industrial Revolution.
examples.zh: 煤炭是工业革命时期的主要能源。

examples.en: The two parties formed a coalition after neither won a majority.
examples.zh: 两党都未获得多数席位,于是组成了联合政府。

examples.en: The cloth was made from coarse wool and was worn by farm workers.
examples.zh: 这种布是用粗羊毛织成的,供农场工人穿着。

examples.en: Rising seas are slowly changing the shape of the country's coastline.
examples.zh: 不断上升的海平面正慢慢改变该国海岸线的形状。

examples.en: Police found a large amount of cocaine hidden in the ship.
examples.zh: 警方在船上发现了大量隐藏的可卡因。

examples.en: The hotel bar serves a free cocktail to guests on their first night.
examples.zh: 酒店酒吧在客人入住第一晚免费赠送一杯鸡尾酒。

examples.en: A high coefficient shows that the two variables are closely related.
examples.zh: 系数高表明这两个变量密切相关。

examples.en: The report presents a cogent argument for reforming the education system.
examples.zh: 这份报告为改革教育体系提出了令人信服的论证。

examples.en: Poor sleep has a clear effect on cognition in older adults.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足对老年人的认知有明显影响。

examples.en: Learning a second language may improve certain cognitive skills.
examples.zh: 学习第二语言可能提高某些认知能力。

examples.en: More couples now cohabit for several years before getting married.
examples.zh: 现在越来越多的情侣在结婚前同居几年。

examples.en: The author fails to present a coherent explanation of the data.
examples.zh: 作者未能对数据作出条理清楚的解释。

examples.en: An electric current passing through a coil of wire creates a magnetic field.
examples.zh: 电流通过线圈时产生磁场。

examples.en: Writers often coin new words to describe recent technologies.
examples.zh: 作家常常创造新词来描述新技术。

examples.en: A Roman coin was found among the remains of the old house.
examples.zh: 在这座老房子的遗迹中发现了一枚罗马硬币。

examples.en: The arrival of the birds coincides with the appearance of certain insects.
examples.zh: 这些鸟到来的时间恰好与某些昆虫出现的时间相同。

examples.en: Scientists from twelve countries collaborated on the project.
examples.zh: 来自十二个国家的科学家在这个项目上开展了协作。

examples.en: I don't like shirts with a tight collar, as they feel uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢领口紧的衬衫,穿着不舒服。

examples.en: The bank asked him to use his house as collateral for the loan.
examples.zh: 银行要求他用房子作为这笔贷款的抵押品。

examples.en: My colleagues organised a small party when I left the company.
examples.zh: 我离开公司时,同事们办了一个小型聚会。

examples.en: I've been collecting stamps from different countries since I was a child.
examples.zh: 我从小就开始收藏各国的邮票。

examples.en: In cultures based on collectivism, the needs of the group come first.
examples.zh: 在以集体主义为基础的文化中,群体的需求放在首位。

examples.en: Birds sometimes collide with tall glass buildings during migration.
examples.zh: 鸟类在迁徙时有时会撞上高大的玻璃建筑。

examples.en: A collision between two ships closed the port for several days.
examples.zh: 两艘船相撞导致港口关闭数日。

examples.en: European powers began to colonise large parts of Africa in the 1880s.
examples.zh: 19 世纪 80 年代,欧洲列强开始殖民非洲的大片地区。

examples.en: Ants live in a large colony with a single queen.
examples.zh: 蚂蚁生活在只有一只蚁后的大群体中。

examples.en: The British established their first colony in North America in the 1600s.
examples.zh: 英国人在 17 世纪在北美建立了第一个殖民地。

examples.en: I love the colourful houses along the seafront in my hometown.
examples.zh: 我喜欢家乡海滨那些色彩丰富的房子。

examples.en: The front of the building is decorated with tall marble columns.
examples.zh: 建筑正面装饰着高大的大理石圆柱。

examples.en: Her weekly newspaper column discusses issues in modern education.
examples.zh: 她每周的报纸专栏讨论现代教育问题。

examples.en: One columnist argued that the government should do more for young people.
examples.zh: 一位专栏作家认为,政府应该为年轻人做更多事情。

examples.en: Knights trained from childhood to prepare for combat on horseback.
examples.zh: 骑士从小接受训练,为骑马作战做准备。

examples.en: New laws were passed to combat corruption in the government.
examples.zh: 新法律的出台是为了打击政府腐败。

examples.en: Tin and copper were combined to produce a much harder metal.
examples.zh: 锡和铜结合后产生了一种硬度高得多的金属。

examples.en: The combustion of coal releases large quantities of carbon dioxide.
examples.zh: 煤的燃烧释放大量二氧化碳。

examples.en: Governments must come up with new ways to reduce traffic in cities.
examples.zh: 政府必须想出新办法减少城市交通流量。

examples.en: I prefer comedy to serious films, because I like to relax after work.
examples.zh: 比起严肃的电影,我更喜欢喜剧,因为下班后想放松。

examples.en: A bright comet was recorded by Chinese astronomers more than two thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 中国天文学家在两千多年前记录了一颗明亮的彗星。

examples.en: I used to read comic books under the blanket when I was a kid.
examples.zh: 我小时候常躲在被子里看漫画书。

examples.en: A misplaced comma can sometimes change the meaning of a legal document.
examples.zh: 一个放错位置的逗号有时会改变法律文件的含义。

examples.en: A national holiday was created to commemorate the end of the war.
examples.zh: 设立了一个全国性节日来纪念战争结束。

examples.en: The report commends the school for its work with disabled children.
examples.zh: 报告称赞这所学校在帮助残障儿童方面所做的工作。

examples.en: The programme included live commentary from two former players.
examples.zh: 这个节目有两位前球员的现场解说。

examples.en: She studied commerce at university and now runs her own small business.
examples.zh: 她在大学学的是商业,现在经营自己的小公司。

examples.en: The old warehouses have been turned into commercial and office space.
examples.zh: 这些旧仓库被改造成了商业和办公空间。

examples.en: The commercialisation of traditional festivals has reduced their cultural meaning.
examples.zh: 传统节日的商业化削弱了它们的文化意义。

examples.en: Our sales staff earn a commission on every car they sell.
examples.zh: 我们的销售人员每卖一辆车都能拿到佣金。

examples.en: The council has decided to commission a new statue for the square.
examples.zh: 市议会决定委托制作一座新雕像放在广场上。

examples.en: Young people who commit a crime should not automatically go to prison.
examples.zh: 犯罪的年轻人不应该自动被送进监狱。

examples.en: A special committee was formed to study the causes of youth crime.
examples.zh: 成立了一个特别委员会来研究青少年犯罪的原因。

examples.en: Oil is the world's most heavily traded commodity.
examples.zh: 石油是世界上交易量最大的商品。

examples.en: Short-sightedness has become increasingly common among children in cities.
examples.zh: 近视在城市儿童中变得越来越常见。

examples.en: The communal kitchen must be kept clean by everyone who uses it.
examples.zh: 公用厨房要靠每个使用者保持干净。

examples.en: Elephants communicate over long distances using very low sounds.
examples.zh: 大象利用极低的声音进行远距离交流。

examples.en: Strong community ties can reduce loneliness among older residents.
examples.zh: 紧密的社区联系能减少老年居民的孤独感。

examples.en: Community service may be better than prison for people who commit minor crimes.
examples.zh: 对于轻微犯罪者,社区服务可能比监禁更好。

examples.en: Many of our staff commute to London by train every day.
examples.zh: 我们很多员工每天乘火车去伦敦上班。

examples.en: My commute takes about an hour each way, so I leave home early.
examples.zh: 我单程通勤大约要一小时,所以很早就出门。

examples.en: The average commuter spends more than an hour a day travelling to work.
examples.zh: 普通通勤者每天上班路上要花一个多小时。

examples.en: My new camera is really compact, so it fits easily in my pocket.
examples.zh: 我的新相机很小巧,很容易放进口袋。

examples.en: My dog has been my faithful companion on long walks for years.
examples.zh: 多年来,我的狗一直是我长途散步的忠实同伴。

examples.en: The figures for the two countries were comparable throughout the period.
examples.zh: 这两个国家的数字在整个时期都是可比的。

examples.en: The town remained comparatively small until the arrival of the railway.
examples.zh: 铁路通车之前,这座城镇一直比较小。

examples.en: The study compares the health of people in rural and urban areas.
examples.zh: 这项研究比较了农村和城市居民的健康状况。

examples.en: The new software is not compatible with older types of computer.
examples.zh: 新软件与旧型号的计算机不兼容。

examples.en: Rising costs may compel many farmers to sell their land.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的成本可能迫使许多农民出售土地。

examples.en: Blind people may develop better hearing to compensate for their loss of sight.
examples.zh: 盲人的听力可能会变得更好,以弥补视力的丧失。

examples.en: Families whose homes were destroyed received compensation from the government.
examples.zh: 房屋被毁的家庭获得了政府的补偿。

examples.en: Students should reach a basic level of competence in computer skills.
examples.zh: 学生的计算机能力应该达到基本水平。

examples.en: Students can enter the photography competition by sending in three pictures.
examples.zh: 学生提交三张照片即可参加摄影比赛。

examples.en: Lower wages have helped to make the country's exports more competitive.
examples.zh: 较低的工资帮助该国的出口产品更具竞争力。

examples.en: The company's main competitor has just lowered its prices.
examples.zh: 公司的主要竞争者刚刚降低了价格。

examples.en: Scholars spent decades compiling the first complete dictionary of the language.
examples.zh: 学者们花了几十年编纂这种语言的第一部完整词典。

examples.en: The company received thousands of complaints about its poor service.
examples.zh: 这家公司收到了数千份关于服务差的投诉。

examples.en: The human brain is the most complex organ in the body.
examples.zh: 人脑是身体中最复杂的器官。

examples.en: She has a lovely clear complexion, even though she never wears make-up.
examples.zh: 她肤色清透好看,虽然从不化妆。

examples.en: Inspectors visit factories regularly to check compliance with safety rules.
examples.zh: 检查员定期走访工厂,检查是否遵守安全规定。

examples.en: Serious complications can occur if the infection is not treated quickly.
examples.zh: 如果感染不及时治疗,可能出现严重的并发症。

examples.en: Companies that fail to comply with safety laws should face heavy fines.
examples.zh: 不遵守安全法规的公司应当面临高额罚款。

examples.en: Sleep is an essential component of a healthy lifestyle.
examples.zh: 睡眠是健康生活方式的重要组成部分。

examples.en: The composer's music is still played regularly by orchestras around the world.
examples.zh: 这位作曲家的音乐至今仍被世界各地的管弦乐队经常演奏。

examples.en: Salt is a compound made from sodium and chlorine.
examples.zh: 盐是由钠和氯构成的化合物。

examples.en: The reading comprehension test takes about one hour to finish.
examples.zh: 阅读理解测试大约需要一小时完成。

examples.en: The waste paper is compressed into large blocks at the recycling centre.
examples.zh: 废纸在回收中心被压缩成大块。

examples.en: The group comprises twenty teachers from six different schools.
examples.zh: 这个小组包含来自六所不同学校的二十名教师。

examples.en: The final plan was a compromise between the two opposing groups.
examples.zh: 最终方案是两个对立群体之间的妥协。

examples.en: Neither side was willing to compromise on the question of water rights.
examples.zh: 在水权问题上,双方都不愿意妥协。

examples.en: Statistics is compulsory for all first-year psychology students.
examples.zh: 统计学是心理学专业大一学生的必修课。

examples.en: Compulsory education should continue until the age of eighteen.
examples.zh: 义务教育应该延续到十八岁。

examples.en: Early computers could perform only a few simple computations each second.
examples.zh: 早期计算机每秒只能完成几次简单的计算。

examples.en: The machine could compute the positions of the planets accurately.
examples.zh: 这台机器能准确计算行星的位置。

examples.en: Even its supporters concede that the policy has been expensive.
examples.zh: 连这项政策的支持者也承认它花费很大。

examples.en: Loud noise can seriously affect concentration in the classroom.
examples.zh: 巨大的噪音可能严重影响课堂上的专注力。

examples.en: The concentration of carbon dioxide in the air continues to rise.
examples.zh: 空气中二氧化碳的浓度继续上升。

examples.en: The concept of time differs greatly from one culture to another.
examples.zh: 时间的概念在不同文化之间差异很大。

examples.en: There's a free concert in the park on Saturday evening.
examples.zh: 周六晚上公园里有一场免费音乐会。

examples.en: Students and pensioners can get a concession if they show their cards.
examples.zh: 学生和退休人员出示证件可享受优惠票价。

examples.en: Keep your answers clear and concise, as you only have ten minutes.
examples.zh: 回答要清楚简洁,因为你只有十分钟。

examples.en: The authors conclude that noise has a clear effect on concentration.
examples.zh: 作者得出结论:噪音对注意力有明显影响。

examples.en: You should restate your main idea in the conclusion of your essay.
examples.zh: 你应该在论文结论中重申你的主要观点。

examples.en: Concrete is now the most widely used building material in the world.
examples.zh: 混凝土现在是世界上使用最广泛的建筑材料。

examples.en: The study offers few concrete suggestions for solving the problem.
examples.zh: 这项研究几乎没有提出解决问题的具体建议。

examples.en: World leaders were quick to condemn the attack on the hospital.
examples.zh: 世界各国领导人迅速谴责了对医院的袭击。

examples.en: Condensation forms on cold windows when warm air touches the glass.
examples.zh: 暖空气接触到冷玻璃时,窗户上就会产生冷凝水。

examples.en: Warm air rises, cools and condenses to form clouds.
examples.zh: 暖空气上升、冷却后冷凝形成云。

examples.en: Pavlov's work on conditioning showed that dogs could learn to expect food.
examples.zh: 巴甫洛夫关于条件反射的研究表明,狗能学会期待食物。

examples.en: Society should never condone violence against children in any form.
examples.zh: 社会绝不应纵容任何形式的针对儿童的暴力。

examples.en: The team conducted a survey of over two thousand households.
examples.zh: 研究团队对两千多户家庭进行了调查。

examples.en: Copper is a good conductor of both heat and electricity.
examples.zh: 铜是热和电的良导体。

examples.en: The conductor of the orchestra chose a programme of modern music.
examples.zh: 乐团指挥选了一组现代音乐曲目。

examples.en: Volcanoes often take the shape of a cone as lava builds up.
examples.zh: 随着熔岩堆积,火山常常形成圆锥形。

examples.en: The shop sells chocolates, sweets and other confectionery made by hand.
examples.zh: 这家店出售手工制作的巧克力、糖果和其他糖果糕点。

examples.en: A university degree may confer certain advantages in the job market.
examples.zh: 大学学位可能在就业市场上带来某些优势。

examples.en: Learning a musical instrument can give children greater confidence.
examples.zh: 学习乐器能让孩子更加自信。

examples.en: Public confidence in the health system fell after the scandal.
examples.zh: 丑闻发生后,公众对医疗系统的信任下降了。

examples.en: Medical records are confidential and should be protected by law.
examples.zh: 病历是机密的,应受到法律保护。

examples.en: The configuration of the seats can be changed for different events.
examples.zh: 座位的配置可以根据不同活动调整。

examples.en: The disease was confined to a small area in the south of the country.
examples.zh: 这种疾病被限制在该国南部的一小片地区。

examples.en: Please call us two days before the trip to confirm your place.
examples.zh: 请在出行前两天致电我们,确认你的名额。

examples.en: Schools have the right to confiscate phones used during lessons.
examples.zh: 学校有权没收上课时使用的手机。

examples.en: Conflict in the region has forced many families to leave their homes.
examples.zh: 该地区的冲突迫使许多家庭离开家园。

examples.en: Children often feel pressure to conform to the behaviour of their friends.
examples.zh: 孩子们常常感到要与朋友的行为保持一致的压力。

examples.en: Differences in diet could confound the results of the exercise study.
examples.zh: 饮食差异可能混淆这项运动研究的结果。

examples.en: Coastal cities must now confront the problem of rising sea levels.
examples.zh: 沿海城市现在必须面对海平面上升的问题。

examples.en: The similar names of the two species have caused much confusion among scientists.
examples.zh: 这两个物种名称相似,在科学家中引起了很多混乱。

examples.en: A charge for driving in the city centre has reduced traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 市中心行车收费减少了交通拥堵。

examples.en: Congress passed a new law to protect the country's national parks.
examples.zh: 国会通过了一项保护国家公园的新法律。

examples.en: Two triangles are congruent if they have exactly the same shape and size.
examples.zh: 两个三角形如果形状和大小完全相同,就是全等的。

examples.en: A conifer has narrow leaves that help it to survive cold winters.
examples.zh: 针叶树的叶子细长,有助于它度过寒冬。

examples.en: The drug works best when used in conjunction with regular exercise.
examples.zh: 这种药与规律运动结合使用时效果最好。

examples.en: Better connectivity allows people in rural areas to work from home.
examples.zh: 更好的网络连接让农村地区的人们可以在家工作。

examples.en: The word 'cheap' often has a negative connotation for English speakers.
examples.zh: 对说英语的人来说,“cheap” 一词往往带有负面的含义。

examples.en: The Norman conquest of 1066 brought thousands of French words into English.
examples.zh: 1066 年的诺曼征服把成千上万的法语词带入了英语。

examples.en: Scientists still do not fully understand how the brain produces consciousness.
examples.zh: 科学家仍未完全理解大脑如何产生意识。

examples.en: The region has experienced drought for five consecutive years.
examples.zh: 该地区已经连续五年遭遇干旱。

examples.en: There is now a broad consensus among scientists that the climate is warming.
examples.zh: 现在科学家普遍达成共识:气候正在变暖。

examples.en: Doctors must obtain a patient's consent before any operation.
examples.zh: 医生必须在任何手术前征得患者的同意。

examples.en: Parents must consent before their children can join the school trip.
examples.zh: 孩子参加学校旅行前,必须得到父母的同意。

examples.en: The loss of forests has had serious consequences for local wildlife.
examples.zh: 森林消失给当地野生动物带来了严重后果。

examples.en: Prices rose sharply, and consequently many families could not afford bread.
examples.zh: 价格急剧上涨,因此许多家庭买不起面包。

examples.en: Conservation groups are working to protect the last areas of old forest.
examples.zh: 保护组织正在努力保护最后的原始森林区。

examples.en: My grandparents are quite conservative about what young people should wear.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母对年轻人的穿着观念挺保守的。

examples.en: She won a place to study piano at the national conservatory.
examples.zh: 她考入国家音乐学院学习钢琴。

examples.en: Many desert plants have small leaves in order to conserve water.
examples.zh: 许多沙漠植物的叶子很小,以节约水分。

examples.en: Planners must consider the needs of older residents when designing new towns.
examples.zh: 规划者在设计新城镇时必须考虑老年居民的需求。

examples.en: A considerable number of graduates went on to work overseas.
examples.zh: 相当多的毕业生后来去了海外工作。

examples.en: The cost of solar panels has fallen considerably over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年,太阳能电池板的成本大幅下降。

examples.en: My neighbour is so considerate that she always turns her music down at night.
examples.zh: 我的邻居特别体贴,晚上总会把音乐调小。

examples.en: The process consists of five main stages, beginning with the collection of materials.
examples.zh: 这个过程由五个主要阶段组成,首先是收集材料。

examples.en: Sleep appears to consolidate new memories formed during the day.
examples.zh: 睡眠似乎能巩固白天形成的新记忆。

examples.en: Some languages have long groups of consonants that are hard to pronounce.
examples.zh: 有些语言有一长串难以发音的辅音。

examples.en: Male birds often have conspicuous colours that attract females.
examples.zh: 雄鸟通常有吸引雌鸟的显眼颜色。

examples.en: Many people still believe the conspiracy theories that spread on social media.
examples.zh: 许多人仍然相信社交媒体上流传的阴谋论。

examples.en: The speed of light in a vacuum is a physical constant.
examples.zh: 真空中的光速是一个物理常数。

examples.en: The cave stays at a constant temperature throughout the entire year.
examples.zh: 这个洞穴全年保持恒定的温度。

examples.en: Sailors used the constellation in the northern sky to find their way.
examples.zh: 水手利用北方天空中的星座辨别方向。

examples.en: Older people constitute about a quarter of the total population.
examples.zh: 老年人约占总人口的四分之一。

examples.en: The country's constitution guarantees freedom of speech to all citizens.
examples.zh: 该国宪法保障所有公民的言论自由。

examples.en: A lack of funding has constrained research in this field for many years.
examples.zh: 多年来,资金短缺一直制约着这一领域的研究。

examples.en: A new bridge was constructed across the river between the two maps.
examples.zh: 在两张地图所示时间之间,河上建造了一座新桥。

examples.en: Patients should consult a doctor before taking any new medicine.
examples.zh: 服用任何新药前,患者都应该咨询医生。

examples.en: The firm hired a consultant to advise them on saving energy.
examples.zh: 公司聘请了一位顾问,就节能问题提供建议。

examples.en: The new rules were introduced without consultation with local residents.
examples.zh: 新规定在没有与当地居民磋商的情况下出台了。

examples.en: Large data centres consume enormous amounts of electricity every year.
examples.zh: 大型数据中心每年消耗大量电力。

examples.en: Consumers are increasingly choosing products that do not harm the environment.
examples.zh: 消费者越来越多地选择不损害环境的产品。

examples.en: Consumerism encourages people to buy things they do not really need.
examples.zh: 消费主义鼓励人们购买并不真正需要的东西。

examples.en: Meat consumption has risen rapidly as incomes have increased.
examples.zh: 随着收入增加,肉类消费迅速增长。

examples.en: The illness is highly contagious and spreads easily through physical contact.
examples.zh: 这种疾病传染性极强,很容易通过身体接触传播。

examples.en: The use of the shipping container greatly reduced the cost of transporting goods.
examples.zh: 集装箱的使用大大降低了货物运输成本。

examples.en: Chemicals used on farms can contaminate drinking water supplies.
examples.zh: 农场使用的化学品可能污染饮用水源。

examples.en: Drinking contaminated water is a major cause of death in poor countries.
examples.zh: 饮用受污染的水是贫穷国家的主要死因。

examples.en: Contamination of food can lead to serious illness among consumers.
examples.zh: 食品污染可能导致消费者患上严重疾病。

examples.en: Few people at that time would contemplate travelling so far from home.
examples.zh: 当时很少有人会考虑去离家这么远的地方。

examples.en: Contemporary artists are exploring new ways of using digital technology.
examples.zh: 当代艺术家正在探索运用数字技术的新方式。

examples.en: Shakespeare and his contemporaries wrote many plays for the London stage.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚和与他同时代的人为伦敦舞台写了许多戏剧。

examples.en: Early critics treated the painter's new style with open contempt.
examples.zh: 早期的评论家公开蔑视这位画家的新风格。

examples.en: Some economists contend that higher taxes would slow the growth of small businesses.
examples.zh: 一些经济学家主张,提高税收会减缓小企业的发展。

examples.en: Young trees must contend with larger plants for light and water.
examples.zh: 小树必须与较大的植物争夺阳光和水分。

examples.en: I'm pretty content with my life at the moment, to be honest.
examples.zh: 说实话,我对现在的生活挺满足的。

examples.en: She won first prize in a poetry contest at her local library.
examples.zh: 她在当地图书馆举办的诗歌比赛中获得了一等奖。

examples.en: Words can have very different meanings depending on the context.
examples.zh: 根据语境不同,词语的含义可能大不相同。

examples.en: Africa is the second largest continent in the world by area.
examples.zh: 按面积计算,非洲是世界第二大洲。

examples.en: Governments need a contingency plan in case the water supply fails.
examples.zh: 政府需要制定应急预案,以防供水中断。

examples.en: Older buildings give a town a sense of continuity with its past.
examples.zh: 老建筑让一座城镇与过去之间有一种延续感。

examples.en: The contour lines on the map show how steeply the land rises.
examples.zh: 从地图上的等高线可以看出地势升得有多陡。

examples.en: Read your contract carefully before you agree to start work.
examples.zh: 同意开始工作之前,请仔细阅读你的合同。

examples.en: The second survey seems to contradict the results of the first one.
examples.zh: 第二次调查似乎与第一次的结果相矛盾。

examples.en: Contrary to popular belief, camels do not store water in their humps.
examples.zh: 与普遍看法相反,骆驼的驼峰并不储水。

examples.en: There is no evidence to the contrary, so the theory is still accepted.
examples.zh: 没有相反的证据,所以这一理论仍被接受。

examples.en: The author contrasts life in the village with life in the modern city.
examples.zh: 作者把乡村生活和现代城市生活作了对比。

examples.en: There is a sharp contrast between the wet east and the dry west.
examples.zh: 潮湿的东部和干燥的西部形成鲜明对比。

examples.en: Local people contributed money and labour to build the new school.
examples.zh: 当地人为建造新学校贡献了资金和劳力。

examples.en: Several factors contribute to the decline of bee populations.
examples.zh: 有几个因素促成了蜜蜂数量的减少。

examples.en: The use of animals in medical research remains a controversial issue.
examples.zh: 在医学研究中使用动物仍然是一个有争议的问题。

examples.en: For your convenience, we've put a map of the area in every room.
examples.zh: 为了方便您,我们在每个房间都放了一张周边地图。

examples.en: There's a convenience store near the flat that stays open until midnight.
examples.zh: 公寓附近有一家开到午夜的便利店。

examples.en: Online shopping is convenient, but it may harm local businesses.
examples.zh: 网购很方便,但可能损害本地商家。

examples.en: Social conventions about marriage have changed greatly in the last fifty years.
examples.zh: 过去五十年,有关婚姻的社会惯例发生了很大变化。

examples.en: Teachers from around the world will attend the annual convention in Paris.
examples.zh: 来自世界各地的教师将参加在巴黎举行的年度大会。

examples.en: Warm air rises; conversely, cold air tends to sink towards the ground.
examples.zh: 热空气上升,相反地,冷空气往往下沉到地面。

examples.en: The solar panels convert sunlight into electricity for the building.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池板把阳光转换成电力,供建筑使用。

examples.en: The old warehouses were converted into flats during the 1990s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代,这些旧仓库被改造成公寓。

examples.en: Facial expressions can convey emotions that words cannot express.
examples.zh: 面部表情可以传达言语无法表达的情感。

examples.en: Long stone channels were built to convey water to the city.
examples.zh: 人们修建了长长的石渠,把水运送到城市。

examples.en: The court needs clear evidence to convict someone of a serious crime.
examples.zh: 法院需要明确的证据才能判定某人犯有重罪。

examples.en: It took years to convince other scientists that the theory was correct.
examples.zh: 花了多年时间才让其他科学家相信这一理论是正确的。

examples.en: The glass is then cooled slowly to prevent it from breaking.
examples.zh: 然后把玻璃慢慢冷却,防止破裂。

examples.en: Wolves cooperate with each other when hunting large animals.
examples.zh: 狼在捕猎大型动物时互相合作。

examples.en: A central office coordinates the work of all the local health teams.
examples.zh: 中央办公室协调各地卫生团队的工作。

examples.en: Playing a musical instrument requires good coordination between the hands and eyes.
examples.zh: 演奏乐器需要手眼之间良好的协调。

examples.en: Older cities were not designed to cope with so many cars.
examples.zh: 老城市在设计时并没有考虑如何应对这么多汽车。

examples.en: Copper is widely used in electrical wires because it conducts electricity well.
examples.zh: 铜导电性好,因此被广泛用于电线。

examples.en: Rising temperatures have caused large areas of coral to turn white and die.
examples.zh: 气温上升导致大片珊瑚变白死亡。

examples.en: The coral reef provides food and shelter for thousands of species.
examples.zh: 珊瑚礁为数千个物种提供食物和庇护。

examples.en: I keep tripping over the cord from the lamp in my bedroom.
examples.zh: 我老是被卧室台灯的电线绊倒。

examples.en: Scientists believe that the Earth's core is made mainly of iron.
examples.zh: 科学家认为地核主要由铁构成。

examples.en: Trust lies at the core of any healthy community.
examples.zh: 信任是任何健康社区的核心。

examples.en: The Sun's corona can be seen clearly during a total eclipse.
examples.zh: 日全食时可以清楚地看到太阳的日冕。

examples.en: The corporation has offices in more than forty countries.
examples.zh: 这家公司在四十多个国家设有办事处。

examples.en: Researchers used a large corpus of newspaper texts to study word frequency.
examples.zh: 研究者利用大型报纸语料库研究词频。

examples.en: The teacher made several corrections to my essay in red ink.
examples.zh: 老师用红笔在我的论文上做了几处修改。

examples.en: Only a third of participants answered all the questions correctly.
examples.zh: 只有三分之一的参与者答对了所有问题。

examples.en: Levels of education tend to correlate with income in later life.
examples.zh: 教育水平往往与日后的收入相关联。

examples.en: The study found a strong correlation between exercise and improved mood.
examples.zh: 研究发现,锻炼与情绪改善之间有很强的相关性。

examples.en: The dates in the diary correspond closely with those in official records.
examples.zh: 日记中的日期与官方记录基本相符。

examples.en: The newspaper's foreign correspondent reported directly from the war zone.
examples.zh: 这家报纸的驻外通讯记者从战区直接发回报道。

examples.en: As incomes rise, spending on leisure tends to increase correspondingly.
examples.zh: 随着收入增加,休闲支出往往也相应增长。

examples.en: The kitchen is at the end of the corridor, on your left.
examples.zh: 厨房在走廊尽头,在你的左手边。

examples.en: Salt in the air can corrode metal structures near the sea.
examples.zh: 空气中的盐分会腐蚀海边的金属结构。

examples.en: Corruption takes money away from schools, hospitals and other public services.
examples.zh: 腐败使学校、医院和其他公共服务失去资金。

examples.en: The outer layer of the brain, called the cortex, controls thinking and language.
examples.zh: 大脑外层被称为皮层,控制思维和语言。

examples.en: Cosmic rays from deep space constantly strike the Earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 来自深空的宇宙射线不断撞击地球大气层。

examples.en: Modern cosmology tries to explain how the universe began.
examples.zh: 现代宇宙学试图解释宇宙是如何起源的。

examples.en: It's a very cosmopolitan city, with people from all over the world.
examples.zh: 这是一座非常国际化的城市,有来自世界各地的人。

examples.en: Early philosophers believed that the Earth was the centre of the cosmos.
examples.zh: 早期哲学家认为地球是宇宙的中心。

examples.en: The cost of solar power has fallen sharply in the last decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年,太阳能的成本急剧下降。

examples.en: She made her own costume for the school play about the Romans.
examples.zh: 她为学校那部关于罗马人的戏剧亲手做了戏服。

examples.en: It's only a small room, but it feels warm and cosy in winter.
examples.zh: 房间虽小,但冬天感觉温暖又舒适。

examples.en: We rented a small cottage in the countryside for the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 暑假期间我们在乡下租了一间小屋。

examples.en: I usually wear cotton shirts in summer because they feel so comfortable.
examples.zh: 我夏天通常穿棉衬衫,因为穿着很舒服。

examples.en: The city council voted to create more bicycle lanes in the centre.
examples.zh: 市议会投票决定在市中心增设更多自行车道。

examples.en: The college counsellor helped me deal with the stress before my exams.
examples.zh: 学院的心理咨询师帮我缓解了考前压力。

examples.en: Counterfeit medicines are a serious danger to people in many poor countries.
examples.zh: 伪造药品对许多贫穷国家的人构成严重危险。

examples.en: I'd love to live in the countryside when I'm older.
examples.zh: 我年纪大了以后很想住在乡村。

examples.en: The county is known for its farming and its old market towns.
examples.zh: 这个郡以农业和古老的集镇闻名。

examples.en: Use this coupon to get free coffee with any sandwich.
examples.zh: 用这张优惠券,买任意三明治都送一杯免费咖啡。

examples.en: I think it was courageous of her to move abroad on her own.
examples.zh: 我觉得她独自出国很勇敢。

examples.en: I'm taking a one-year course in business management.
examples.zh: 我正在修一门为期一年的商业管理课程。

examples.en: Coursework counts for forty percent of your final mark.
examples.zh: 课程作业占你最终成绩的百分之四十。

examples.en: The case will be heard in court at the end of next month.
examples.zh: 这个案件将于下月底在法院审理。

examples.en: All the flats look onto a courtyard with benches and a few trees.
examples.zh: 所有公寓都朝向一个庭院,里面有长椅和几棵树。

examples.en: A good cover letter explains why you want to work for that company.
examples.zh: 一封好的求职信要说明你为什么想在那家公司工作。

examples.en: News coverage of crime can make people feel less safe than they are.
examples.zh: 关于犯罪的新闻报道可能让人们感觉比实际情况更不安全。

examples.en: I felt cowardly for not telling my friend the truth.
examples.zh: 我没有告诉朋友真相,觉得自己很胆小。

examples.en: The crab carries its eggs under its body until they are ready to hatch.
examples.zh: 螃蟹把卵带在身体下面,直到它们快要孵化。

examples.en: The market sells local crafts such as baskets and handmade jewellery.
examples.zh: 这个集市出售篮子和手工首饰等当地手工艺品。

examples.en: Machine-made goods rarely show the same craftsmanship as those made by hand.
examples.zh: 机器制造的商品很少能展现手工制品的手艺。

examples.en: I had to cram for three days because I'd missed so many classes.
examples.zh: 我缺了很多课,只好突击学习了三天。

examples.en: The crane performs an elaborate dance during the breeding season.
examples.zh: 鹤在繁殖季节会跳一种精心编排的舞蹈。

examples.en: A large crane lifted the sections of the bridge into position.
examples.zh: 一台大型起重机把桥的各部分吊到了位。

examples.en: The plane crash led to important changes in airline safety rules.
examples.zh: 这次飞机坠毁促使航空安全规则作出重要修改。

examples.en: Share prices crashed in 1929, and many investors lost everything.
examples.zh: 1929 年股价暴跌,许多投资者倾家荡产。

examples.en: The lake was formed when rain filled the crater of an old volcano.
examples.zh: 雨水注满一座古火山的火山口,形成了这个湖。

examples.en: Newly hatched turtles crawl across the sand towards the sea.
examples.zh: 刚孵化的小海龟爬过沙滩奔向大海。

examples.en: Art and music lessons encourage children to be more creative.
examples.zh: 美术和音乐课鼓励孩子更有创造力。

examples.en: Schools can encourage creativity by allowing more time for art and play.
examples.zh: 学校可以留出更多时间给艺术和游戏,以鼓励创造力。

examples.en: Many deep-sea creatures produce their own light in the dark water.
examples.zh: 许多深海生物在黑暗的水中自己发光。

examples.en: The newspaper lost its credibility after publishing several false stories.
examples.zh: 这家报纸刊登了几篇虚假报道后失去了可信度。

examples.en: There is no credible evidence that the ancient city ever existed.
examples.zh: 没有可信的证据表明这座古城曾经存在。

examples.en: You need sixty credits to complete the first year of the degree.
examples.zh: 你需要修满六十个学分才能完成学位的第一年。

examples.en: Buying a car on credit can cost you more in the long run.
examples.zh: 从长远看,用信用贷款买车可能花费更多。

examples.en: You can pay by credit card or in cash at the front desk.
examples.zh: 你可以在前台用信用卡或现金付款。

examples.en: My credit limit is £1,000, so I can't pay for the whole trip.
examples.zh: 我的信用额度是 1000 英镑,所以付不起全部旅费。

examples.en: People of every race and creed were welcome in the port city.
examples.zh: 这座港口城市欢迎各个种族和信条的人。

examples.en: Viewed from Earth, the Moon appears as a thin crescent at this time.
examples.zh: 从地球上看,此时的月亮呈细细的新月形。

examples.en: The climbers used ladders to cross a deep crevasse in the glacier.
examples.zh: 登山者用梯子越过冰川上一道深深的冰隙。

examples.en: Small lizards hide in the crevices between the rocks during the day.
examples.zh: 小蜥蜴白天躲在岩石之间的裂缝里。

examples.en: We watched a game of cricket on the village green on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日我们在村里的草地上看了一场板球赛。

examples.en: A convicted criminal may find it very difficult to get a job.
examples.zh: 被定罪的罪犯可能很难找到工作。

examples.en: Criminal behaviour among young people is often linked to poverty.
examples.zh: 年轻人的犯罪行为常常与贫困有关。

examples.en: I love the crisp apples that we pick at my uncle's farm.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在叔叔农场摘的脆苹果。

examples.en: Cost should not be the only criterion for choosing a treatment.
examples.zh: 成本不应是选择治疗方案的唯一标准。

examples.en: Schools should place more emphasis on developing critical thinking.
examples.zh: 学校应该更加重视培养批判性思维。

examples.en: Her latest book offers a sharp critique of modern consumer society.
examples.zh: 她的新书对现代消费社会提出了尖锐的评论。

examples.en: The female crocodile carries her newly hatched young to the water in her mouth.
examples.zh: 雌鳄鱼用嘴把刚孵化的幼崽衔到水里。

examples.en: Rice is the main crop grown in the flooded fields of the south.
examples.zh: 水稻是南方水田种植的主要农作物。

examples.en: A poor crop can leave small farmers with too little to eat.
examples.zh: 歉收可能让小农户没有足够的食物。

examples.en: Cross-cultural experiences can help young people to become more tolerant.
examples.zh: 跨文化经历能帮助年轻人变得更加宽容。

examples.en: Turn left at the crossroads, just after the petrol station.
examples.zh: 过了加油站,在十字路口左转。

examples.en: Always use the crosswalk when you get across this busy street.
examples.zh: 过这条繁忙的街道时,一定要走人行横道。

examples.en: Crows have been seen using tools to reach food in narrow spaces.
examples.zh: 有人观察到乌鸦使用工具获取狭窄空间里的食物。

examples.en: I try to avoid the crowded shops in the city centre at weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我尽量避开市中心拥挤的商店。

examples.en: The crown passed to the king's younger brother after his death.
examples.zh: 国王死后,王权传给了他的弟弟。

examples.en: Bees play a crucial role in the production of many food crops.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在许多粮食作物的生产中起着关键作用。

examples.en: Crude oil must be refined before it can be used as fuel.
examples.zh: 原油必须经过提炼才能用作燃料。

examples.en: Early astronomers could make only crude estimates of the distance to the Moon.
examples.zh: 早期的天文学家只能粗略估算到月球的距离。

examples.en: The price of crude oil rose sharply during the 1970s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代,原油价格急剧上涨。

examples.en: They went on a two-week cruise around the Mediterranean last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天他们坐游轮环游了地中海,为期两周。

examples.en: The rocks are crushed into small pieces before being transported.
examples.zh: 岩石先被压碎成小块,然后运走。

examples.en: The Earth's crust is thinnest beneath the oceans.
examples.zh: 地壳在海洋下面最薄。

examples.en: Crabs and lobsters belong to a group of animals called crustaceans.
examples.zh: 螃蟹和龙虾属于一类被称为甲壳动物的动物。

examples.en: Salt forms small crystals as the water around it evaporates.
examples.zh: 周围的水蒸发时,盐形成小晶体。

examples.en: A lion cub stays with its mother for about two years.
examples.zh: 狮子幼崽和母亲一起生活大约两年。

examples.en: Salt crystals naturally form in the shape of a tiny cube.
examples.zh: 盐的晶体天然呈微小的立方体。

examples.en: Babies use visual cues to work out what adults are feeling.
examples.zh: 婴儿利用视觉提示来判断成年人的感受。

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its traditional Thai cuisine and friendly service.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以传统泰国菜和友好的服务闻名。

examples.en: Years of protest culminated in a change in the law in 1928.
examples.zh: 多年的抗议最终以 1928 年法律的修改告终。

examples.en: The sun was the centre of an important religious cult in ancient Egypt.
examples.zh: 太阳是古埃及一种重要宗教崇拜的中心。

examples.en: Schools should cultivate curiosity as well as teach basic skills.
examples.zh: 学校既要传授基本技能,也要培养好奇心。

examples.en: Local farmers cultivate rice on narrow steps cut into the hillside.
examples.zh: 当地农民在山坡上开凿的狭窄梯田里种植水稻。

examples.en: Immigration has increased the cultural diversity of many large cities.
examples.zh: 移民增加了许多大城市的文化多样性。

examples.en: Cultural exchange programmes allow students to experience life in another country.
examples.zh: 文化交流项目让学生能体验另一个国家的生活。

examples.en: Governments should spend money on protecting the nation's cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 政府应该投入资金保护国家的文化遗产。

examples.en: Language is a central part of a nation's cultural identity.
examples.zh: 语言是一个民族文化认同的核心部分。

examples.en: The cumulative effect of small changes may be very large.
examples.zh: 小变化的累积效应可能非常大。

examples.en: The main character in the book is a cunning young man who tricks everyone.
examples.zh: 书里的主人公是个狡猾的年轻人,谁都骗。

examples.en: The plates and glasses are in the cupboard above the sink.
examples.zh: 盘子和杯子在水槽上方的橱柜里。

examples.en: There is still no cure for the common cold.
examples.zh: 普通感冒仍然没有治愈的方法。

examples.en: Doctors can now cure most people who develop this type of cancer.
examples.zh: 现在医生能够治愈大多数患这类癌症的人。

examples.en: I've always been curious about how people live in other countries.
examples.zh: 我一直对其他国家的人怎样生活感到好奇。

examples.en: I've got curly hair, which is really hard to control in wet weather.
examples.zh: 我的头发是卷的,潮湿的天气里特别难打理。

examples.en: You can change your money into local currency at the airport.
examples.zh: 你可以在机场把钱换成当地货币。

examples.en: Warm ocean currents keep the coast free of ice during winter.
examples.zh: 温暖的洋流使海岸在冬季不结冰。

examples.en: Current methods of farming may not be able to feed the future population.
examples.zh: 目前的耕作方法可能无法养活未来的人口。

examples.en: A current account lets you pay bills and take out money at any time.
examples.zh: 活期账户可以让你随时支付账单和取钱。

examples.en: The school has added computer programming to its curriculum this year.
examples.zh: 学校今年把计算机编程加入了课程体系。

examples.en: According to popular stories, a curse protected the tomb from thieves.
examples.zh: 根据民间传说,诅咒保护着这座陵墓免遭盗窃。

examples.en: The new curtains keep out the light from the street lamps.
examples.zh: 新窗帘能挡住路灯的光。

examples.en: The curve for France rises much more steeply than the others.
examples.zh: 法国的曲线比其他国家上升得陡峭得多。

examples.en: We bought some bright cushions to make the old sofa look better.
examples.zh: 我们买了一些鲜艳的靠垫,让旧沙发好看一点。

examples.en: Visitors should learn about local customs before travelling to another country.
examples.zh: 游客去其他国家之前应了解当地习俗。

examples.en: We had to open our suitcases when we went through customs.
examples.zh: 过海关时,我们不得不打开行李箱。

examples.en: Individuals can cut down on waste by avoiding single-use plastic products.
examples.zh: 个人可以通过不使用一次性塑料制品来减少浪费。

examples.en: The cutlery and plates are on the table by the door.
examples.zh: 刀叉和盘子在门边的桌子上。

examples.en: The laboratory uses cutting-edge equipment to study the structure of cells.
examples.zh: 实验室使用尖端设备研究细胞结构。

examples.en: Please send your CV and a covering letter by the end of this week.
examples.zh: 请在本周末前发送你的简历和求职信。

examples.en: Cybercrime costs businesses billions of pounds in lost money each year.
examples.zh: 网络犯罪每年使企业损失数十亿英镑。

examples.en: Governments find it hard to enforce their laws in cyberspace.
examples.zh: 政府发现很难在网络空间执法。

examples.en: The diagram illustrates the life cycle of a salmon from egg to adult.
examples.zh: 该图展示了鲑鱼从卵到成鱼的生命循环。

examples.en: A new cycle lane now runs from the station to the university.
examples.zh: 现在有一条新的自行车道从车站通到大学。

examples.en: The climate has gone through cyclic changes over thousands of years.
examples.zh: 数千年来,气候经历了周期性的变化。

examples.en: Cycling is the cheapest and easiest way to get around the city.
examples.zh: 骑行是在城里出行最便宜、最方便的方式。

examples.en: Each cyclist in the city benefits from the new network of separate lanes.
examples.zh: 城里的每位骑车人都受益于新的独立车道网络。

examples.en: The cyclone brought strong winds and heavy rain to the islands.
examples.zh: 气旋给这些岛屿带来了强风和暴雨。

examples.en: The grain was stored in a tall metal cylinder beside the farm.
examples.zh: 谷物储存在农场旁一个高大的金属圆柱体中。

examples.en: My pencil case is a small cylindrical tin that I've had for years.
examples.zh: 我的铅笔盒是一个用了多年的小圆柱形铁盒。

examples.en: I've become a bit cynical about what politicians promise.
examples.zh: 我对政客的承诺变得有点愤世嫉俗了。

examples.en: She can't eat dairy, so we'll need a cake made without butter.
examples.zh: 她不能吃乳制品,所以我们需要一个不含黄油的蛋糕。

examples.en: Most dairy farms in the area produce milk for local cheese makers.
examples.zh: 该地区的大多数奶牛场为当地奶酪生产商供奶。

examples.en: The dam provides electricity for millions of people but has damaged river life.
examples.zh: 这座水坝为数百万人供电,却破坏了河流生态。

examples.en: Damp conditions in the cave caused the old paintings to fade.
examples.zh: 洞穴里的潮湿环境使古老的壁画褪色了。

examples.en: Darwinism was fiercely debated by scientists and religious leaders in the 1860s.
examples.zh: 19 世纪 60 年代,科学家和宗教领袖就达尔文学说展开了激烈争论。

examples.en: We'll collect the data first and then look for any patterns.
examples.zh: 我们先收集数据,再寻找其中的规律。

examples.en: The library's online database gives you access to thousands of articles.
examples.zh: 图书馆的在线数据库能让你查阅数千篇文章。

examples.en: The deadline for the essay is five o'clock on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 论文的截止时间是周五下午五点。

examples.en: Some schools have trained staff to deal with students' mental health problems.
examples.zh: 一些学校培训了教职工来处理学生的心理健康问题。

examples.en: You'll need a letter from the dean to change your course.
examples.zh: 更换课程需要院长的一封信。

examples.en: Many countries have abolished the death penalty in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来,许多国家废除了死刑。

examples.en: The death rate from the disease fell after the vaccine was introduced.
examples.zh: 疫苗推出后,这种疾病的死亡率下降了。

examples.en: The court's death sentence caused anger among human rights groups.
examples.zh: 法院的死刑判决引起了人权组织的愤怒。

examples.en: A debit card takes the money directly from your bank account.
examples.zh: 借记卡会直接从你的银行账户扣款。

examples.en: Plastic debris in the ocean kills large numbers of sea animals.
examples.zh: 海洋中的塑料碎片杀死了大量海洋动物。

examples.en: Many students leave university with a large amount of debt.
examples.zh: 许多学生大学毕业时背负着大量债务。

examples.en: The number of cyclists increased steadily during the following decade.
examples.zh: 在接下来的十年里,骑自行车的人数持续增加。

examples.en: Deceitful advertising can persuade people to buy things they do not need.
examples.zh: 欺骗性广告可能诱使人们购买不需要的东西。

examples.en: Economic growth began to decelerate towards the end of the decade.
examples.zh: 到这十年的末期,经济增长开始放缓。

examples.en: Every worker deserves a decent wage and safe working conditions.
examples.zh: 每个工人都应该获得体面的工资和安全的工作条件。

examples.en: Noise above eighty-five decibels can damage people's hearing over time.
examples.zh: 超过八十五分贝的噪音长期下来会损害听力。

examples.en: Deciduous trees lose all of their leaves during the autumn.
examples.zh: 落叶树在秋季会落光所有树叶。

examples.en: The answer should be given to two decimal places.
examples.zh: 答案应保留两位小数。

examples.en: Lack of sleep has a negative effect on decision-making.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足对决策有负面影响。

examples.en: A good leader needs to be decisive when things go wrong.
examples.zh: 出问题时,好的领导者需要果断。

examples.en: We sat on the top deck and watched the sun go down.
examples.zh: 我们坐在顶层甲板上看日落。

examples.en: The declaration of independence marked the beginning of a new nation.
examples.zh: 独立宣言标志着一个新国家的诞生。

examples.en: The government declared a national emergency after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震后,政府宣布全国进入紧急状态。

examples.en: The chart shows a gradual decline in newspaper sales since 2000.
examples.zh: 图表显示,自 2000 年以来报纸销量逐渐下降。

examples.en: The number of farmers declined rapidly throughout the second half of the century.
examples.zh: 在二十世纪下半叶,农民数量迅速下降。

examples.en: Bacteria play a key role in the decomposition of dead plants.
examples.zh: 细菌在枯死植物的分解中起着关键作用。

examples.en: The children made all the decorations for the hall themselves.
examples.zh: 大厅里所有的装饰都是孩子们自己做的。

examples.en: These plates are just decorative, so we never actually eat off them.
examples.zh: 这些盘子只是装饰用的,我们从不真正用来吃饭。

examples.en: We hired a decorator to paint the walls of the new office.
examples.zh: 我们雇了一名室内装修工来粉刷新办公室的墙。

examples.en: The chart shows a decrease in the use of coal over the period.
examples.zh: 图表显示,在此期间煤炭使用量有所减少。

examples.en: The number of cinema visits decreased slightly during the following decade.
examples.zh: 在随后的十年里,观影人次略有减少。

examples.en: The president issued a decree banning all public meetings.
examples.zh: 总统颁布法令,禁止一切公开集会。

examples.en: The institute will dedicate most of its budget to cancer research.
examples.zh: 该研究所将把大部分预算投入癌症研究。

examples.en: Scientists can deduce the age of a tree by counting its rings.
examples.zh: 科学家可以通过数年轮推算出树的年龄。

examples.en: By careful deduction, the scientist worked out where the signal came from.
examples.zh: 通过仔细推论,这位科学家确定了信号的来源。

examples.en: The water in the lake was deemed unsafe for swimming.
examples.zh: 这个湖的水被认为不适合游泳。

examples.en: The defeat of the army led to the end of the empire.
examples.zh: 军队的失败导致了帝国的终结。

examples.en: The small kingdom managed to defeat a much larger invading force.
examples.zh: 这个小王国成功击败了规模大得多的入侵军队。

examples.en: A small defect in the lens made the early telescope less useful.
examples.zh: 镜片的一个小缺陷使这台早期望远镜不太好用。

examples.en: Spending on defence takes money away from education and health.
examples.zh: 国防开支占用了教育和医疗的资金。

examples.en: The lawyer agreed to defend the young man in court for free.
examples.zh: 律师同意在法庭上免费为这名年轻人辩护。

examples.en: The defendant said that he had been at home when the crime took place.
examples.zh: 被告称案发时他在家。

examples.en: A deficiency of vitamin C can cause serious problems with the gums.
examples.zh: 缺乏维生素 C 可能导致严重的牙龈问题。

examples.en: The government plans to reduce its budget deficit by cutting spending.
examples.zh: 政府计划通过削减开支来减少预算赤字。

examples.en: It is surprisingly difficult to define exactly what intelligence means.
examples.zh: 要准确定义智力的含义,出乎意料地困难。

examples.en: During a period of deflation, consumers often delay buying expensive goods.
examples.zh: 在通货紧缩时期,消费者常常推迟购买昂贵商品。

examples.en: The deflection of light by gravity was first measured in 1919.
examples.zh: 引力使光线偏转的现象于 1919 年首次被测量到。

examples.en: Deforestation has increased the risk of flooding in many tropical countries.
examples.zh: 森林砍伐增加了许多热带国家的洪水风险。

examples.en: The behaviour of these tiny particles seems to defy explanation.
examples.zh: 这些微小粒子的行为似乎无法解释。

examples.en: Environmental degradation can have serious effects on human health.
examples.zh: 环境退化可能严重影响人类健康。

examples.en: Some desert animals can survive for weeks without water and rarely dehydrate.
examples.zh: 一些沙漠动物可以数周不喝水,也很少脱水。

examples.en: There's a two-hour delay because of heavy snow at the airport.
examples.zh: 由于机场大雪,航班延误了两小时。

examples.en: Bad weather may delay the ferry, so please check before you leave.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气可能导致渡轮延误,所以出发前请查询。

examples.en: Good managers delegate routine tasks so they can focus on planning.
examples.zh: 优秀的管理者会把日常工作委派出去,以便专注于规划。

examples.en: Each country sent a delegate to the conference on climate change.
examples.zh: 每个国家都派了一名代表参加气候变化会议。

examples.en: Users can delete their personal data from the website at any time.
examples.zh: 用户可以随时从网站上删除个人数据。

examples.en: Researchers believe the fire was a deliberate attempt to clear the land.
examples.zh: 研究者认为这场大火是有意开垦土地的尝试。

examples.en: The committee will deliberate for several weeks before making its decision.
examples.zh: 委员会将仔细考虑几周,然后作出决定。

examples.en: Some early farmers deliberately burned forests to clear land for crops.
examples.zh: 一些早期农民故意焚烧森林,开垦土地种庄稼。

examples.en: This spicy fish soup is a local delicacy in my part of the country.
examples.zh: 这种辣鱼汤是我们这个地区的当地美味佳肴。

examples.en: I have to be careful with this delicate old necklace.
examples.zh: 我得小心对待这条精致的旧项链。

examples.en: I was delighted when I found out I had got the job.
examples.zh: 得知自己得到这份工作时,我非常高兴。

examples.en: Delivery is free on all orders over fifty pounds.
examples.zh: 订单满五十英镑一律免运费。

examples.en: The river deposits rich soil as it reaches the delta.
examples.zh: 河流到达三角洲时沉积下肥沃的土壤。

examples.en: Local residents demanded better protection from the floods.
examples.zh: 当地居民要求加强防洪保护。

examples.en: Demand for electricity is highest in the early evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚时分的电力需求最高。

examples.en: Older people with dementia may forget the names of close family members.
examples.zh: 患痴呆的老人可能会忘记亲人的名字。

examples.en: In a democracy, people have the right to choose their own leaders.
examples.zh: 在民主国家,人民有权选择自己的领导人。

examples.en: Free elections are the foundation of any democratic system.
examples.zh: 自由选举是任何民主制度的基础。

examples.en: Changes in demography will affect the demand for schools and hospitals.
examples.zh: 人口结构的变化将影响对学校和医院的需求。

examples.en: The old houses were demolished to make way for a shopping centre.
examples.zh: 老房子被拆除,为购物中心腾出地方。

examples.en: The experiment demonstrated that plants can respond to sound.
examples.zh: 这项实验证明了植物能够对声音作出反应。

examples.en: The female bear gives birth in a den during the winter months.
examples.zh: 母熊在冬季的兽穴中产崽。

examples.en: The company's denial of any wrongdoing was not accepted by the court.
examples.zh: 该公司否认有任何不当行为,但法院不予采信。

examples.en: The machine only gives out notes in a denomination of twenty pounds.
examples.zh: 这台机器只吐面额二十英镑的钞票。

examples.en: Different colours on the map denote different language families.
examples.zh: 地图上不同的颜色表示不同的语系。

examples.en: Human rights groups denounced the arrest of the journalists.
examples.zh: 人权组织公开谴责了逮捕记者的行为。

examples.en: Ice floats on water because it has a lower density.
examples.zh: 冰能浮在水面上,是因为它的密度较低。

examples.en: I'm going to the dentist tomorrow because one of my teeth hurts.
examples.zh: 我明天要去看牙医,因为有颗牙疼。

examples.en: She works in the sales department of a large furniture company.
examples.zh: 她在一家大型家具公司的销售部工作。

examples.en: The department store has clothes on the first floor and furniture on the top.
examples.zh: 百货商店二楼卖衣服,顶楼卖家具。

examples.en: Please arrive at the airport two hours before your departure.
examples.zh: 请在出发前两小时到达机场。

examples.en: The health of the forest will depend on the amount of rain it receives.
examples.zh: 森林的健康将取决于它获得的雨量。

examples.en: He's a really dependable friend who always turns up when he says he will.
examples.zh: 他是个非常可靠的朋友,说来就一定会来。

examples.en: Our growing dependence on technology may reduce our basic skills.
examples.zh: 我们对技术日益增长的依赖可能削弱基本技能。

examples.en: More elderly people are becoming dependent on their children for support.
examples.zh: 越来越多的老年人依赖子女的支持。

examples.en: The paintings depict scenes from everyday life in ancient Rome.
examples.zh: 这些画描绘了古罗马日常生活的场景。

examples.en: Modern farming methods can deplete the soil of its natural nutrients.
examples.zh: 现代耕作方法可能耗尽土壤的天然养分。

examples.en: The depletion of fish stocks threatens the jobs of many coastal communities.
examples.zh: 鱼类资源的枯竭威胁着许多沿海社区的就业。

examples.en: The government has the power to deport foreign criminals after they serve their sentences.
examples.zh: 政府有权在外国罪犯服刑后将其驱逐出境。

examples.en: You need to pay a deposit of £50 to hold the room.
examples.zh: 你需要付 50 英镑定金来保留这个房间。

examples.en: You can deposit cash at the machines inside the bank until eight.
examples.zh: 你可以在八点前用银行内的机器存入现金。

examples.en: New cars begin to depreciate as soon as they leave the factory.
examples.zh: 新车一出厂就开始贬值。

examples.en: People who feel lonely are more likely to become depressed.
examples.zh: 感到孤独的人更容易变得抑郁。

examples.en: I find the weather in November quite depressing, because it's so dark.
examples.zh: 我觉得十一月的天气挺让人沮丧的,因为天太暗了。

examples.en: Regular exercise can reduce the symptoms of mild depression.
examples.zh: 经常运动可以减轻轻度抑郁症的症状。

examples.en: Millions of people lost their jobs during the economic depression of the 1930s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 30 年代的经济萧条期间,数百万人失业。

examples.en: Water is pumped up from a depth of about thirty metres.
examples.zh: 水从约三十米的深度被抽上来。

examples.en: The deputy manager will be in charge while I'm away next week.
examples.zh: 我下周不在时,由副经理负责。

examples.en: The word 'happiness' is a derivative of the adjective 'happy'.
examples.zh: “happiness” 一词是形容词 “happy” 的派生词。

examples.en: Plants derive most of their energy from sunlight.
examples.zh: 植物的大部分能量来自阳光。

examples.en: Many English words derive from Latin or from ancient Greek.
examples.zh: 许多英语单词来源于拉丁语或古希腊语。

examples.en: Modern English is thought to descend from a language spoken in northern Germany.
examples.zh: 人们认为现代英语传自德国北部使用的一种语言。

examples.en: Today's dogs are all descendants of ancient wolves.
examples.zh: 如今的狗都是古代狼的后裔。

examples.en: The descent into the valley took the explorers more than two days.
examples.zh: 探险家们下到山谷花了两天多时间。

examples.en: Many people in the town are of Italian descent.
examples.zh: 镇上许多人是意大利血统。

examples.en: The test uses a clear descriptor for each level of ability.
examples.zh: 这项测试对每个能力水平都有明确的描述词。

examples.en: The desert receives less than ten centimetres of rain each year.
examples.zh: 这片沙漠每年的降雨量不到十厘米。

examples.en: Overgrazing and climate change are the main causes of desertification.
examples.zh: 过度放牧和气候变化是荒漠化的主要原因。

examples.en: Many believe that the scientist deserves more credit for this discovery.
examples.zh: 许多人认为,这位科学家应该因这一发现得到更多赞誉。

examples.en: The building was designed to use as little energy as possible.
examples.zh: 这座建筑的设计目的是尽量少用能源。

examples.en: The desire for social approval influences much of our behaviour.
examples.zh: 渴望得到社会认可影响着我们的许多行为。

examples.en: I almost gave up in despair when I couldn't find a job.
examples.zh: 找不到工作时,我几乎绝望得要放弃了。

examples.en: I was desperate for a coffee after getting up at five that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上五点就起床,我特别想喝杯咖啡。

examples.en: Despite years of research, the origin of the language remains unknown.
examples.zh: 尽管经过多年研究,这种语言的起源仍然不明。

examples.en: Would you like to see the dessert menu after your main meal?
examples.zh: 用完正餐后,您想看看甜点菜单吗?

examples.en: Spain is still the most popular destination for our summer tours.
examples.zh: 西班牙仍然是我们夏季旅行团最受欢迎的目的地。

examples.en: Many ancient people believed that the stars controlled human destiny.
examples.zh: 许多古人相信星辰掌控着人类的命运。

examples.en: Floods can be highly destructive in areas where trees have been removed.
examples.zh: 在树木被砍伐的地区,洪水的破坏性可能很大。

examples.en: Part of the glacier may detach and fall into the sea.
examples.zh: 部分冰川可能脱离并坠入海中。

examples.en: A detached house costs a lot more than a flat in this area.
examples.zh: 在这一带,独栋房屋比公寓贵得多。

examples.en: Police can detain a suspect for up to twenty-four hours without charge.
examples.zh: 警方可以在不起诉的情况下拘留嫌疑人最多二十四小时。

examples.en: Some sharks can detect a tiny amount of blood in the water.
examples.zh: 有些鲨鱼能在水中检测到极少量的血液。

examples.en: The detective spent months collecting evidence against the company.
examples.zh: 这名侦探花了几个月时间收集对这家公司不利的证据。

examples.en: Tougher punishments may deter young people from committing crime.
examples.zh: 更严厉的惩罚可能阻止年轻人犯罪。

examples.en: The deterioration of air quality is a serious concern in many large cities.
examples.zh: 空气质量恶化是许多大城市严重关切的问题。

examples.en: I was determined to pass my driving test, even after failing it twice.
examples.zh: 即使考了两次都没过,我还是下定决心要通过驾照考试。

examples.en: Some people believe that long prison sentences act as a deterrent.
examples.zh: 有些人认为长期徒刑能起到威慑作用。

examples.en: The bridge is closed, so we had to make a long detour.
examples.zh: 桥封闭了,所以我们只好绕了很长一段路。

examples.en: Too much noise can be detrimental to children's ability to concentrate.
examples.zh: 过多噪音可能损害儿童的注意力。

examples.en: Rising sea levels could devastate low-lying countries such as Bangladesh.
examples.zh: 海平面上升可能摧毁孟加拉国等低洼国家。

examples.en: The storm had a devastating effect on the island's fishing industry.
examples.zh: 这场风暴对岛上的渔业造成了毁灭性的影响。

examples.en: Children develop their reading skills at different speeds.
examples.zh: 孩子们阅读能力的发展速度各不相同。

examples.en: The small device measures the level of oxygen in the blood.
examples.zh: 这个小装置测量血液中的氧含量。

examples.en: Engineers have devised a way of removing salt from seawater more cheaply.
examples.zh: 工程师想出了一种更便宜的海水淡化方法。

examples.en: She devoted her whole career to the study of African birds.
examples.zh: 她把整个职业生涯都投入到非洲鸟类的研究之中。

examples.en: The king was a devout man who built many churches during his reign.
examples.zh: 这位国王很虔诚,在位期间建造了许多教堂。

examples.en: Some desert insects collect dew from their bodies to drink.
examples.zh: 一些沙漠昆虫收集身上的露水来饮用。

examples.en: Being overweight greatly increases the risk of developing diabetes.
examples.zh: 超重会大大增加患糖尿病的风险。

examples.en: It took doctors several weeks to diagnose the cause of the pain.
examples.zh: 医生花了好几周才诊断出疼痛的原因。

examples.en: The doctor can't give a diagnosis until the test results come back.
examples.zh: 检查结果出来之前,医生无法作出诊断。

examples.en: The café is diagonally across from the library, on the corner of the square.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在图书馆的斜对面,位于广场的一角。

examples.en: Label each part of the machine on the diagram in your notes.
examples.zh: 在笔记的示意图上标出机器的各个部分。

examples.en: Each valley in the region once had its own distinct dialect.
examples.zh: 该地区的每个山谷都曾有自己独特的方言。

examples.en: The trunk of the old tree measures more than three metres in diameter.
examples.zh: 这棵老树的树干直径超过三米。

examples.en: A dictatorial government does not allow people to criticise its decisions.
examples.zh: 独裁政府不允许人们批评它的决定。

examples.en: Young readers often dislike stories that are too didactic.
examples.zh: 年轻读者常常不喜欢过于说教的故事。

examples.en: Many cities plan to ban diesel cars in order to improve air quality.
examples.zh: 许多城市计划禁止柴油车,以改善空气质量。

examples.en: A diet rich in fruit and vegetables may help to prevent heart disease.
examples.zh: 富含水果和蔬菜的饮食可能有助于预防心脏病。

examples.en: My doctor sent me to a dietitian for advice on losing weight.
examples.zh: 医生让我去找营养师咨询减肥的建议。

examples.en: This feature helps scientists to differentiate between the two species.
examples.zh: 这一特征有助于科学家区分这两个物种。

examples.en: Waves diffract as they pass through a narrow opening in a sea wall.
examples.zh: 波浪穿过海堤的狭窄开口时会发生衍射。

examples.en: Gases spread through a room by the process of diffusion.
examples.zh: 气体通过扩散过程充满房间。

examples.en: Fibre in the diet plays an important part in healthy digestion.
examples.zh: 饮食中的纤维对健康的消化起着重要作用。

examples.en: The digestive system breaks food down into substances the body can use.
examples.zh: 消化系统把食物分解成身体可以利用的物质。

examples.en: Telephone numbers in the country now have eleven digits.
examples.zh: 该国的电话号码现在有十一位数字。

examples.en: Digital technology has made it easy to store and share photographs.
examples.zh: 数字技术让存储和分享照片变得很容易。

examples.en: The digital divide leaves poorer families without the same access to information.
examples.zh: 数字鸿沟使较贫困家庭无法同样获取信息。

examples.en: Good care allows elderly patients to live with dignity and independence.
examples.zh: 良好的护理让老年患者能够有尊严、独立地生活。

examples.en: Doctors face a dilemma when a treatment could both help and harm a patient.
examples.zh: 当一种疗法对患者既有益又有害时,医生就面临两难。

examples.en: My classmate is so diligent that she checks every homework question twice.
examples.zh: 我的同学特别认真,每道作业题都检查两遍。

examples.en: Chemical waste is sometimes diluted with water before it is released.
examples.zh: 化学废物有时在排放前用水稀释。

examples.en: Music adds an emotional dimension that a written text cannot provide.
examples.zh: 音乐增添了文字无法提供的情感维度。

examples.en: The fear of flying tends to diminish with more experience.
examples.zh: 随着经验增加,对飞行的恐惧往往会减弱。

examples.en: The hotel's dining room is open from seven until ten every evening.
examples.zh: 酒店餐厅每晚七点到十点营业。

examples.en: The dinosaur fossils were found in rocks about seventy million years old.
examples.zh: 这些恐龙化石是在约七千万年前的岩石中发现的。

examples.en: Sulphur dioxide from factories was a major cause of acid rain.
examples.zh: 工厂排放的二氧化硫是酸雨的主要成因。

examples.en: After a slight dip in 2008, the figures began to rise again.
examples.zh: 2008 年略有下降之后,这些数字又开始上升。

examples.en: Sales dipped slightly in March before recovering in the following month.
examples.zh: 销售额在三月小幅下降,随后在下个月回升。

examples.en: She has a diploma in hotel management from a college in Dublin.
examples.zh: 她持有都柏林一所学院颁发的酒店管理文凭。

examples.en: Diplomacy is always better than military action in solving international conflicts.
examples.zh: 解决国际冲突时,外交总是好于军事行动。

examples.en: A new directive requires all member states to reduce their waste.
examples.zh: 一项新指令要求所有成员国减少废物。

examples.en: You can find the tutor's phone number in the staff directory.
examples.zh: 你可以在员工名录里找到导师的电话号码。

examples.en: People with a disability should have equal access to public buildings.
examples.zh: 残疾人应该能平等地使用公共建筑。

examples.en: Disadvantaged students often need extra help from teachers.
examples.zh: 处于劣势的学生往往需要老师的额外帮助。

examples.en: There is still some disagreement about how the ancient city was destroyed.
examples.zh: 关于这座古城如何被毁,目前仍存在一些分歧。

examples.en: I was really disappointed when the concert was cancelled at the last minute.
examples.zh: 音乐会在最后一刻取消时,我非常失望。

examples.en: Many countries have agreed to disarm in order to reduce the risk of war.
examples.zh: 许多国家同意裁军,以减少战争风险。

examples.en: The oil spill was an environmental disaster for the whole coast.
examples.zh: 这次石油泄漏对整个海岸来说是一场环境灾难。

examples.en: The fund will disburse money to farmers affected by the floods.
examples.zh: 这个基金将向受洪灾影响的农民拨款。

examples.en: Most of the fish caught by the boats are discarded as unwanted.
examples.zh: 船只捕捞的大部分鱼都被当作不需要的东西丢弃了。

examples.en: It is difficult to discern any pattern in such a small set of data.
examples.zh: 在这么小的数据集中,很难察觉出任何规律。

examples.en: Factories must not discharge untreated waste into local rivers.
examples.zh: 工厂不得向当地河流排放未经处理的废物。

examples.en: Psychology is a discipline that draws on both science and social studies.
examples.zh: 心理学是一门兼具科学和社会研究的学科。

examples.en: Good teachers can maintain discipline in class without raising their voices.
examples.zh: 好老师不用提高嗓门就能维持课堂纪律。

examples.en: You have to be very disciplined to study on your own at home.
examples.zh: 要在家自学,你得非常自律。

examples.en: Companies are now required to disclose how much carbon they produce.
examples.zh: 现在公司被要求披露自己的碳排放量。

examples.en: Companies should be required to make a full disclosure of their finances.
examples.zh: 公司应被要求全面披露财务状况。

examples.en: Students can get a ten percent discount if they show their cards.
examples.zh: 学生出示证件可以享受九折优惠。

examples.en: Scientific discourse has become increasingly dominated by the English language.
examples.zh: 科学话语越来越被英语主导。

examples.en: Marie Curie discovered two new elements during her research in Paris.
examples.zh: 玛丽·居里在巴黎进行研究时发现了两种新元素。

examples.en: I can tell her any secret because she's always very discreet.
examples.zh: 我什么秘密都可以告诉她,因为她总是很谨慎。

examples.en: There is a large discrepancy between the figures for the two regions.
examples.zh: 这两个地区的数字之间存在很大差异。

examples.en: The process can be divided into four discrete stages.
examples.zh: 这个过程可以分为四个独立的阶段。

examples.en: Laws against discrimination have improved opportunities for women at work.
examples.zh: 反歧视法律改善了女性的工作机会。

examples.en: I looked at the dirty kitchen in the hostel with disgust.
examples.zh: 我厌恶地看着旅舍里脏兮兮的厨房。

examples.en: The dishwasher isn't working, so we'll have to wash everything by hand.
examples.zh: 洗碗机坏了,所以我们只能全部手洗。

examples.en: To my dismay, I realised that I had left my passport at home.
examples.zh: 让我沮丧的是,我发现把护照忘在家里了。

examples.en: Employers should not be able to dismiss workers without a good reason.
examples.zh: 雇主不应在没有充分理由的情况下解雇员工。

examples.en: It would be wrong to dismiss these concerns as unimportant.
examples.zh: 把这些担忧视为不重要是错误的。

examples.en: Disobedient children often need clear rules rather than harsh punishment.
examples.zh: 不听话的孩子往往需要明确的规则,而不是严厉的惩罚。

examples.en: Sleep disorders can have a serious effect on everyday life.
examples.zh: 睡眠障碍可能严重影响日常生活。

examples.en: The table reveals a great disparity in income between men and women.
examples.zh: 表格显示男女收入存在巨大悬殊。

examples.en: The finished goods are dispatched to customers within two working days.
examples.zh: 成品在两个工作日内发送给顾客。

examples.en: The new dam will displace thousands of people living along the river.
examples.zh: 新大坝将迫使沿河的数千人离开家园。

examples.en: The building of the dam led to the displacement of thousands of villagers.
examples.zh: 大坝的修建导致数千名村民流离失所。

examples.en: Students' paintings are on display in the hall this week.
examples.zh: 本周学生们的画作在大厅展出。

examples.en: The screen will display your exam results when you enter your number.
examples.zh: 输入学号后,屏幕会显示你的考试成绩。

examples.en: Disposable products create huge amounts of waste that do not break down.
examples.zh: 一次性产品产生大量无法分解的废物。

examples.en: Factories must dispose of their waste in a safe and legal way.
examples.zh: 工厂必须以安全合法的方式处理废物。

examples.en: Children with a calm disposition tend to adapt more easily to new schools.
examples.zh: 性情平和的孩子往往更容易适应新学校。

examples.en: There is an ongoing dispute among scholars over who wrote the text.
examples.zh: 学者们对这篇文本的作者一直存在争论。

examples.en: Few experts now dispute the link between smoking and heart disease.
examples.zh: 现在很少有专家质疑吸烟与心脏病之间的联系。

examples.en: Some factories continued to disregard the rules on waste disposal.
examples.zh: 一些工厂继续无视废物处理的规定。

examples.en: Even small changes in temperature can disrupt the life cycle of insects.
examples.zh: 即使温度的微小变化,也可能扰乱昆虫的生命周期。

examples.en: Medical students learn to dissect bodies in order to understand anatomy.
examples.zh: 医学生学习解剖遗体,以了解人体结构。

examples.en: I'm writing my dissertation on how tourism affects small islands.
examples.zh: 我正在写学位论文,研究旅游业如何影响小岛。

examples.en: The salt is dissolved in warm water before being added to the tank.
examples.zh: 盐先溶解在温水中,然后加入水箱。

examples.en: Cognitive dissonance occurs when people's actions conflict with their beliefs.
examples.zh: 当人们的行为与信念冲突时,就会出现认知失调。

examples.en: Distance learning allows people in remote areas to study for a degree.
examples.zh: 远程教育让偏远地区的人也能攻读学位。

examples.en: The light from distant stars can take millions of years to reach us.
examples.zh: 来自遥远恒星的光可能要数百万年才能到达我们这里。

examples.en: Fresh water can be produced from seawater by distillation.
examples.zh: 淡水可以通过蒸馏从海水中制取。

examples.en: The study identified three distinct stages in the development of speech.
examples.zh: 这项研究确定了语言发展的三个不同阶段。

examples.en: The bird is easily recognised by its distinctive red tail feathers.
examples.zh: 这种鸟很容易凭借独特的红色尾羽辨认出来。

examples.en: Babies can distinguish their mother's voice from those of other people.
examples.zh: 婴儿能把母亲的声音和其他人的声音区分开。

examples.en: The curved surface of the Earth tends to distort flat maps.
examples.zh: 地球的曲面往往会使平面地图变形。

examples.en: Mobile phones are a major distraction for students during lessons.
examples.zh: 手机是学生上课时的主要分心来源。

examples.en: The charity distributes food to families in the areas worst affected.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构向受灾最严重地区的家庭分发食物。

examples.en: The chart shows the distribution of wealth across the five regions.
examples.zh: 图表显示了财富在五个地区的分布。

examples.en: The old financial district is now full of shops and restaurants.
examples.zh: 老金融区现在到处是商店和餐馆。

examples.en: There is a disturbing rise in the amount of violence on television.
examples.zh: 电视上的暴力内容令人不安地增多了。

examples.en: The region has a diverse population speaking more than twenty languages.
examples.zh: 该地区人口多样,使用二十多种语言。

examples.en: Cultural diversity makes a society richer and more interesting.
examples.zh: 文化多样性让社会更丰富、更有趣。

examples.en: Engineers built a channel to divert water away from the town.
examples.zh: 工程师修建了一条水渠,把水从镇上引开。

examples.en: Divide the total distance by the time to calculate the average speed.
examples.zh: 用总距离除以时间可以算出平均速度。

examples.en: The mountains divide the country into two very different regions.
examples.zh: 山脉把这个国家分成两个截然不同的地区。

examples.en: Shareholders received a higher dividend after a very profitable year.
examples.zh: 在利润丰厚的一年之后,股东们获得了更高的股息。

examples.en: Kings once claimed that their power had a divine origin.
examples.zh: 国王们曾声称他们的权力来自神。

examples.en: A clear division of labour meant that each of us knew what to do.
examples.zh: 明确的分工让我们每个人都清楚自己该做什么。

examples.en: Children of parents who divorce may need extra support at school.
examples.zh: 父母离婚的孩子在学校可能需要额外支持。

examples.en: Scientists extracted DNA from the ancient bones found in the cave.
examples.zh: 科学家从洞穴中发现的古代骨骼里提取了 DNA。

examples.en: We walked down to the dock to watch the fishing boats come in.
examples.zh: 我们走到码头,看渔船进港。

examples.en: The ship will dock at eight, so you'll have all day to explore.
examples.zh: 船八点靠岸,所以你有一整天时间游览。

examples.en: He spent five years working on his doctorate in chemistry.
examples.zh: 他花了五年时间攻读化学博士学位。

examples.en: The church's doctrine had a strong influence on medieval science.
examples.zh: 教会的教义对中世纪科学产生了强烈影响。

examples.en: A good documentary can make young people care about the environment.
examples.zh: 一部好的纪录片能让年轻人关心环境。

examples.en: You must bring the correct documentation when you apply for a bank account.
examples.zh: 申请银行账户时必须带齐相关证明文件。

examples.en: Scientists should be careful not to treat a popular theory as dogma.
examples.zh: 科学家应小心不要把流行的理论当成教条。

examples.en: Dolphins use a range of sounds to communicate within their groups.
examples.zh: 海豚用多种声音在群体内交流。

examples.en: Until recently, this area of research was the domain of a few specialists.
examples.zh: 直到最近,这一研究领域还只属于少数专家。

examples.en: The great dome of the cathedral took more than sixteen years to build.
examples.zh: 大教堂的巨大穹顶花了十六年多才建成。

examples.en: Domestic tasks should be shared equally between men and women.
examples.zh: 家务应该由男女平等分担。

examples.en: The domestic economy has been badly affected by the fall in exports.
examples.zh: 国内经济受到出口下降的严重影响。

examples.en: Victims of domestic violence need safe places to go and legal support.
examples.zh: 家庭暴力的受害者需要安全的去处和法律支持。
