examples.en: You must wear a helmet when you ride a bike on this trail.
examples.zh: 在这条小路上骑车必须戴头盔。

examples.en: Summer in one hemisphere occurs at the same time as winter in the other.
examples.zh: 一个半球的夏季与另一个半球的冬季同时出现。

examples.en: The soil here is very poor; hence the small number of farms.
examples.zh: 这里的土壤非常贫瘠,因此农场很少。

examples.en: Hepatitis is an illness that causes serious damage to the liver.
examples.zh: 肝炎是一种严重损害肝脏的疾病。

examples.en: Many traditional medicines are made from wild herbs.
examples.zh: 许多传统药物由野生草本植物制成。

examples.en: The herbicide kills unwanted plants without harming the wheat.
examples.zh: 这种除草剂能杀死杂草,但不会伤害小麦。

examples.en: Elephants are herbivores that eat up to 150 kilos of plants a day.
examples.zh: 大象是食草动物,每天吃多达 150 公斤的植物。

examples.en: Herbivorous dinosaurs needed huge amounts of plants to stay alive.
examples.zh: 食草恐龙需要大量植物才能存活。

examples.en: A herd of elephants can travel long distances in search of water.
examples.zh: 一群大象可以长途跋涉寻找水源。

examples.en: Some forms of the disease are hereditary and pass from parent to child.
examples.zh: 这种疾病的某些类型是遗传的,由父母传给孩子。

examples.en: In the past, people could be punished severely for heresy.
examples.zh: 过去,人们可能因异端而受到严厉惩罚。

examples.en: The old town is an important part of the country's cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 这座老城是该国文化遗产的重要组成部分。

examples.en: Developers are not allowed to change the outside of a heritage building.
examples.zh: 开发商不得改变历史建筑的外观。

examples.en: Bees build hexagonal cells because this shape uses the least wax.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂建造六边形的巢室,因为这种形状用蜡最少。

examples.en: Some bears hibernate for up to seven months in very cold regions.
examples.zh: 在非常寒冷的地区,有些熊冬眠长达七个月。

examples.en: During hibernation, the animal's heart rate drops to a fraction of its normal level.
examples.zh: 冬眠期间,这种动物的心率会远低于正常水平。

examples.en: Early people used animal hide to make warm clothes and shelters.
examples.zh: 早期的人们用兽皮制作保暖的衣物和住所。

examples.en: Wolves live in groups with a strict social hierarchy.
examples.zh: 狼生活在群体中,有严格的社会等级制度。

examples.en: Each hieroglyph could represent either a sound or a complete idea.
examples.zh: 每个象形文字既可以表示一个音,也可以表示一个完整的概念。

examples.en: High-rise flats were built quickly to replace homes destroyed in the war.
examples.zh: 人们迅速建起高层公寓,以取代在战争中被毁的房屋。

examples.en: High-speed rail has greatly reduced journey times between the major cities.
examples.zh: 高铁大大缩短了主要城市之间的行程时间。

examples.en: More young people than ever now have access to higher education.
examples.zh: 现在能接受高等教育的年轻人比以往任何时候都多。

examples.en: Sheep farming has long been the main activity in the highland areas.
examples.zh: 长期以来,养羊一直是高地地区的主要活动。

examples.en: The report highlights the need for more investment in public transport.
examples.zh: 这份报告强调了增加公共交通投资的必要性。

examples.en: The highlight of the exhibition is a collection of early maps.
examples.zh: 这次展览最精彩的部分是一批早期地图。

examples.en: A new highway has reduced the journey between the two cities by an hour.
examples.zh: 一条新公路使两座城市之间的路程缩短了一小时。

examples.en: We went for a long hike in the hills on our last day.
examples.zh: 最后一天,我们去山里长途徒步了一次。

examples.en: Bring strong boots and warm clothes if you're going hiking in the mountains.
examples.zh: 如果去山里徒步,请带上结实的靴子和保暖衣物。

examples.en: Poor roads continue to hinder the development of the region's economy.
examples.zh: 糟糕的道路继续阻碍该地区的经济发展。

examples.en: The hippopotamus spends most of the day in water to keep cool.
examples.zh: 河马白天大部分时间待在水中以保持凉爽。

examples.en: My hometown has a historic bridge that was built about 500 years ago.
examples.zh: 我的家乡有一座约五百年前建造的历史古桥。

examples.en: I enjoy reading historical novels, especially those set in ancient China.
examples.zh: 我喜欢读历史小说,尤其是以中国古代为背景的。

examples.en: The cave contained hitherto unknown species of insects and spiders.
examples.zh: 洞穴里有迄今未知的昆虫和蜘蛛物种。

examples.en: Bees return to the hive and use a special dance to share information.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂回到蜂巢后,用一种特殊的舞蹈传递信息。

examples.en: The government should do more to help homeless people find housing.
examples.zh: 政府应该做更多的事,帮助无家可归的人找到住房。

examples.en: Homeschooling allows parents to choose what and how their children learn.
examples.zh: 在家教育让父母能选择孩子学什么和怎么学。

examples.en: I felt homesick during my first few weeks at university.
examples.zh: 上大学的头几周,我很想家。

examples.en: A homestay is a good way to practise English with a local family.
examples.zh: 家庭寄宿是和当地家庭一起练习英语的好方式。

examples.en: My hometown is a small city in the south, famous for its tea.
examples.zh: 我的家乡是南方的一座小城,以茶闻名。

examples.en: The bones belong to an early hominid that lived about three million years ago.
examples.zh: 这些骨头属于约三百万年前的一种早期原始人类。

examples.en: The sample was fairly homogeneous, with most participants coming from one city.
examples.zh: 样本相当同质,大多数参与者来自同一座城市。

examples.en: Some people fear the homogenisation of culture around the world.
examples.zh: 有些人担心全球文化趋于同质化。

examples.en: To me, the most important thing in a friend is being honest.
examples.zh: 对我来说,朋友最重要的品质是诚实。

examples.en: Sailors watched the land slowly disappear below the horizon.
examples.zh: 水手们看着陆地慢慢消失在地平线下。

examples.en: The rock layers are horizontal, showing that they have not been disturbed.
examples.zh: 岩层是水平的,说明它们没有受到扰动。

examples.en: Stress causes the body to release a hormone called cortisol.
examples.zh: 压力使身体释放一种叫皮质醇的激素。

examples.en: Both male and female animals of this species have long curved horns.
examples.zh: 这个物种的雄性和雌性都长有弯曲的长角。

examples.en: We had horrible weather on holiday, and it rained for a week.
examples.zh: 我们度假时天气很差,下了一周的雨。

examples.en: Students of horticulture learn how to grow fruit, vegetables and flowers.
examples.zh: 学习园艺的学生学习如何种植水果、蔬菜和花卉。

examples.en: People in the region are hospitable and often invite visitors into their homes.
examples.zh: 该地区的人们很好客,经常邀请游客到家里做客。

examples.en: Visitors are often surprised by the warm hospitality of local people.
examples.zh: 游客常常对当地人的热情好客感到惊讶。

examples.en: The hospitality industry provides millions of jobs for young people.
examples.zh: 酒店业为年轻人提供了数百万个就业机会。

examples.en: Our town will host the regional athletics competition next spring.
examples.zh: 明年春天,我们镇将主办地区田径比赛。

examples.en: As the host of the party, he welcomed each guest at the door.
examples.zh: 作为派对的主人,他在门口迎接每位客人。

examples.en: My host family picked me up from the airport and cooked me dinner.
examples.zh: 我的寄宿家庭到机场接我,还给我做了晚饭。

examples.en: The police managed to free the hostage after several hours of discussions.
examples.zh: 经过几小时的谈判,警方成功解救了人质。

examples.en: We stayed in a cheap hostel with shared rooms near the bus station.
examples.zh: 我们住在汽车站附近一家便宜的旅舍,房间是合住的。

examples.en: Immigrants may face hostility in areas with high unemployment.
examples.zh: 在失业率高的地区,移民可能面临敌意。

examples.en: The average household now produces more waste than ever before.
examples.zh: 现在普通家庭产生的垃圾比以往任何时候都多。

examples.en: Men today do much more housework than their fathers did.
examples.zh: 如今的男性比他们的父辈做更多家务。

examples.en: The shortage of cheap housing is a serious problem for young workers.
examples.zh: 廉价住房短缺对年轻工人来说是个严重问题。

examples.en: Contact human resources if you have any questions about your pay.
examples.zh: 如果对工资有疑问,请联系人力资源部。

examples.en: Humanitarian organisations provide food and medicine in areas affected by war.
examples.zh: 人道主义组织在受战争影响的地区提供食物和药品。

examples.en: Students in the humanities often have fewer class hours than those in science.
examples.zh: 人文学科的学生课时通常比理科生少。

examples.en: He's a famous doctor, but he's really humble and friendly with everybody.
examples.zh: 他是一位名医,但待人特别谦逊友好。

examples.en: The humid conditions in the forest are ideal for the growth of fungi.
examples.zh: 森林里潮湿闷热的环境非常适合真菌生长。

examples.en: High humidity makes hot weather feel even more uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 高湿度让炎热的天气感觉更不舒服。

examples.en: My favourite teacher was very humorous, so her lessons were never boring.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的老师很幽默,所以她的课从不无聊。

examples.en: A camel stores fat in its hump to use when food is scarce.
examples.zh: 骆驼把脂肪储存在驼峰里,供食物短缺时使用。

examples.en: A hunter-gatherer society depends on wild animals and plants for food.
examples.zh: 狩猎采集社会依靠野生动植物获取食物。

examples.en: The hurricane caused severe damage along the Atlantic coast.
examples.zh: 飓风在大西洋沿岸造成了严重破坏。

examples.en: Good animal husbandry helps to keep farm animals healthy.
examples.zh: 良好的畜牧管理有助于保持家畜健康。

examples.en: The outer husk of the rice is removed before it is eaten.
examples.zh: 稻米的外壳要去掉才能食用。

examples.en: A hybrid uses both a petrol engine and an electric motor.
examples.zh: 混合动力汽车同时使用汽油发动机和电动马达。

examples.en: Oil and natural gas are both types of hydrocarbon found underground.
examples.zh: 石油和天然气都是地下的碳氢化合物。

examples.en: The hydroelectric dam provides most of the power used in the valley.
examples.zh: 这座水力发电站大坝提供了山谷大部分的用电。

examples.en: Hydrogen could become an important clean fuel for trucks and ships.
examples.zh: 氢可能成为卡车和船舶的重要清洁燃料。

examples.en: Hydroponics allows vegetables to be grown in water without any soil.
examples.zh: 水培法使蔬菜可以在水中生长,完全不需要土壤。

examples.en: Better hygiene in hospitals has greatly reduced the risk of infection.
examples.zh: 医院卫生条件的改善大大降低了感染风险。

examples.en: Too much salt in the diet is one cause of hypertension.
examples.zh: 饮食中盐分过多是高血压的成因之一。

examples.en: It seems hypocritical for rich countries to criticise the emissions of poorer ones.
examples.zh: 富国批评穷国的排放,似乎很虚伪。

examples.en: The researchers designed a simple test to check their hypothesis about bird migration.
examples.zh: 研究者设计了一项简单的测试,来检验他们关于鸟类迁徙的假设。

examples.en: Sea levels were much lower during the last ice age.
examples.zh: 上一个冰河时代的海平面要低得多。

examples.en: If the ice sheet melted completely, sea levels would rise dramatically.
examples.zh: 如果冰盖完全融化,海平面将急剧上升。

examples.en: Most of an iceberg's mass lies hidden beneath the surface of the water.
examples.zh: 冰山的大部分质量隐藏在水面以下。

examples.en: The warm, shallow water provides ideal conditions for young fish.
examples.zh: 温暖的浅水为幼鱼提供了理想的环境。

examples.en: You'll need some form of identification to open an account here.
examples.zh: 在这里开户需要提供某种身份证明。

examples.en: The test helps doctors to identify the disease at an early stage.
examples.zh: 这项检测帮助医生在早期发现这种疾病。

examples.en: Please show your identity card at the door when you arrive.
examples.zh: 到达时请在门口出示你的身份证。

examples.en: Political ideology should not influence what is taught in schools.
examples.zh: 政治意识形态不应影响学校教授的内容。

examples.en: Learners often find it difficult to understand an idiom such as 'break the ice'.
examples.zh: 学习者常常觉得 “break the ice” 这样的习语很难理解。

examples.en: Much of the farm equipment lies idle for most of the year.
examples.zh: 大部分农业设备一年中多数时间都闲置着。

examples.en: Teenagers often copy the clothes and behaviour of their favourite idol.
examples.zh: 青少年常常模仿他们最喜欢的偶像的衣着和行为。

examples.en: Dry leaves can easily ignite during the hot summer months.
examples.zh: 在炎热的夏季,干枯的树叶很容易点燃。

examples.en: Early reports of the disease were largely ignored by the authorities.
examples.zh: 关于这种疾病的早期报告大多被当局忽略了。

examples.en: It is illegal to sell cigarettes to children in most countries.
examples.zh: 在大多数国家,向儿童出售香烟是非法的。

examples.en: Protesters claimed that the new government was illegitimate after a false election.
examples.zh: 抗议者称,虚假选举后产生的新政府是非法的。

examples.en: The illicit trade in wild animals threatens many rare species.
examples.zh: 非法的野生动物贸易威胁着许多珍稀物种。

examples.en: Illiteracy remains a serious barrier to economic progress in some countries.
examples.zh: 文盲仍然是一些国家经济发展的严重障碍。

examples.en: In the Middle Ages, most ordinary people in Europe were illiterate.
examples.zh: 中世纪时,欧洲大多数普通人都是文盲。

examples.en: The study helps to illuminate how memories are stored in the brain.
examples.zh: 这项研究有助于阐明记忆是如何储存在大脑中的。

examples.en: The story of the island illustrates how quickly a species can disappear.
examples.zh: 这座岛的故事说明了一个物种消失得有多快。

examples.en: Reading stories helps to develop the imagination of young children.
examples.zh: 读故事有助于培养幼儿的想象力。

examples.en: My son is very imaginative and loves making up his own stories.
examples.zh: 我儿子很有想象力,喜欢自己编故事。

examples.en: Young birds learn to sing by imitating the songs of adult males.
examples.zh: 幼鸟通过模仿成年雄鸟的歌声来学习鸣叫。

examples.en: Teenagers may be too immature to make such important decisions by themselves.
examples.zh: 青少年可能还太不成熟,无法独自作出如此重要的决定。

examples.en: The dam has brought immense benefits to farmers along the river.
examples.zh: 这座大坝给沿河农民带来了巨大的好处。

examples.en: Each immigrant brings new skills and ideas to the receiving country.
examples.zh: 每位移民都为接收国带来新的技能和想法。

examples.en: Thousands of young professionals immigrate to the country each year.
examples.zh: 每年有数千名年轻专业人士移入这个国家。

examples.en: There was a long queue at immigration when we landed in Sydney.
examples.zh: 我们在悉尼降落后,入境检查处排着长队。

examples.en: Local people had no warning that the eruption was imminent.
examples.zh: 当地人事先没有得到火山即将喷发的警告。

examples.en: Lack of sleep can weaken the immune system over time.
examples.zh: 长期睡眠不足会削弱免疫系统。

examples.en: Vaccines provide immunity against a number of dangerous diseases.
examples.zh: 疫苗能提供针对多种危险疾病的免疫力。

examples.en: Researchers are still measuring the impact of noise on young children's learning.
examples.zh: 研究者仍在衡量噪音对幼儿学习的影响。

examples.en: Rising sea temperatures have impacted coral reefs across the region.
examples.zh: 不断上升的海水温度已经影响到整个地区的珊瑚礁。

examples.en: Too little sleep can impair judgement as much as alcohol.
examples.zh: 睡眠过少对判断力的损害与酒精一样大。

examples.en: The committee must remain impartial when judging the competing proposals.
examples.zh: 评审相互竞争的提案时,委员会必须保持公正。

examples.en: Parliament voted to impeach the president after the corruption scandal.
examples.zh: 腐败丑闻发生后,议会投票决定弹劾总统。

examples.en: Fallen trees can impede the flow of water along the river.
examples.zh: 倒下的树木可能妨碍河水流动。

examples.en: The imperial court employed thousands of officials and servants.
examples.zh: 皇室朝廷雇用了数千名官员和仆人。

examples.en: The oil crisis gave new impetus to research on solar energy.
examples.zh: 石油危机为太阳能研究提供了新的推动力。

examples.en: The government plans to implement the new policy over the next five years.
examples.zh: 政府计划在未来五年内实施这项新政策。

examples.en: The findings have important implications for how we treat young patients.
examples.zh: 这些发现对我们如何治疗年轻患者有重要影响。

examples.en: There is an implicit assumption in the theory that people always act rationally.
examples.zh: 这个理论隐含着一个假定:人总是理性行事。

examples.en: The results imply that diet may play a larger role than exercise.
examples.zh: 结果暗示,饮食的作用可能比运动更大。

examples.en: Imports of cheap clothing have damaged the local textile industry.
examples.zh: 廉价服装的进口损害了当地纺织业。

examples.en: The country has to import most of its food and energy.
examples.zh: 这个国家的大部分食物和能源都要进口。

examples.en: The government could impose a tax on foods with a high sugar content.
examples.zh: 政府可以对高糖食品征税。

examples.en: Aid should be directed towards the most impoverished regions of the world.
examples.zh: 援助应该投向世界上最贫困的地区。

examples.en: I was really impressed by the service at that little restaurant.
examples.zh: 那家小餐馆的服务给我留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: Impressionism changed the way that painters thought about light and colour.
examples.zh: 印象派改变了画家对光和色彩的看法。

examples.en: The new library in my city is a very impressive building.
examples.zh: 我们城市的新图书馆是一座令人印象深刻的建筑。

examples.en: Long periods of imprisonment do not always reduce the rate of crime.
examples.zh: 长期监禁并不总能降低犯罪率。

examples.en: Planting trees can improve air quality in crowded city centres.
examples.zh: 植树可以改善拥挤市中心的空气质量。

examples.en: Teenagers can be more impulsive than adults because their brains are still developing.
examples.zh: 青少年可能比成年人更冲动,因为他们的大脑仍在发育。

examples.en: Large companies should not be able to pollute rivers with impunity.
examples.zh: 大公司不应污染河流而不受惩罚。

examples.en: The filter removes almost every impurity from the drinking water.
examples.zh: 过滤器几乎能除去饮用水中的所有杂质。

examples.en: Companies must treat their employees in accordance with the law.
examples.zh: 公司必须依照法律对待员工。

examples.en: In addition to food, the forest provides local people with medicine.
examples.zh: 除了食物,森林还为当地人提供药物。

examples.en: In conclusion, governments should spend more money on public health.
examples.zh: 总之,政府应该在公共卫生上投入更多资金。

examples.en: In contrast, the northern part of the country receives very little rain.
examples.zh: 相比之下,该国北部的降雨量很少。

examples.en: Many people are in favour of banning cars from city centres.
examples.zh: 许多人支持禁止汽车进入市中心。

examples.en: Most jobs now require a degree; in other words, school alone is not enough.
examples.zh: 现在大多数工作都要求学位;换句话说,只读完中学是不够的。

examples.en: Young people in particular are affected by the rising cost of housing.
examples.zh: 年轻人尤其受到住房成本上升的影响。

examples.en: The two languages differ in respect of their grammar and their sound systems.
examples.zh: 这两种语言在语法和语音系统方面有所不同。

examples.en: The government lowered the speed limit in response to public concern.
examples.zh: 针对公众的担忧,政府降低了限速。

examples.en: In spite of the high cost, many families choose to send their children abroad.
examples.zh: 尽管费用很高,许多家庭还是选择送孩子出国。

examples.en: Is this jacket still in stock in a larger size?
examples.zh: 这件夹克还有大一点的尺码吗?

examples.en: In terms of cost, solar power is now cheaper than coal in many countries.
examples.zh: 就成本而言,在许多国家太阳能现在比煤炭便宜。

examples.en: In the case of young children, too much screen time can harm sleep.
examples.zh: 就幼儿而言,过多的屏幕时间可能影响睡眠。

examples.en: Investing in public transport will save money in the long run.
examples.zh: 从长远来看,投资公共交通可以省钱。

examples.en: Higher taxes may reduce spending in the short term.
examples.zh: 短期内,提高税收可能减少支出。

examples.en: An inability to sleep can seriously affect memory and concentration.
examples.zh: 无法入睡会严重影响记忆力和注意力。

examples.en: Inadequate lighting in the classroom may affect students' eyesight.
examples.zh: 教室照明不足可能影响学生的视力。

examples.en: Lower taxes provide an incentive for companies to invest in clean energy.
examples.zh: 减税激励公司投资清洁能源。

examples.en: The incidence of skin cancer is higher in sunny countries.
examples.zh: 阳光充足的国家皮肤癌的发病率更高。

examples.en: Incineration reduces the amount of waste but can release harmful gases.
examples.zh: 焚化能减少废物量,但可能释放有害气体。

examples.en: Few young people have the time or the inclination to learn these old crafts.
examples.zh: 很少有年轻人有时间或意愿学习这些传统手艺。

examples.en: The tracks follow a gentle incline up the side of the valley.
examples.zh: 铁轨沿着山谷一侧的缓坡向上延伸。

examples.en: Most experts incline to the view that the climate was the main cause.
examples.zh: 大多数专家倾向于认为气候是主要原因。

examples.en: The rent is £150 a week, inclusive of gas and water.
examples.zh: 租金每周 150 英镑,包含煤气费和水费。

examples.en: Average income has risen, but so has the cost of housing.
examples.zh: 平均收入有所上升,但住房成本也上升了。

examples.en: A century ago, instant global communication would have seemed inconceivable to most people.
examples.zh: 一个世纪前,大多数人会觉得全球即时通信难以想象。

examples.en: Modern buildings often incorporate features that reduce their use of energy.
examples.zh: 现代建筑常常融入一些减少能耗的设计。

examples.en: There was a steady increase in the number of tourists after 2010.
examples.zh: 2010 年后,游客数量稳步增加。

examples.en: Spending on healthcare increased by ten percent between 2000 and 2010.
examples.zh: 2000 年至 2010 年间,医疗支出增加了百分之十。

examples.en: Young people are increasingly choosing to live in smaller homes.
examples.zh: 年轻人越来越多地选择住小户型。

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely incredible.
examples.zh: 从山顶看到的景色真是太棒了。

examples.en: Spider silk is incredibly strong for such a light material.
examples.zh: 作为如此轻的材料,蛛丝极其坚韧。

examples.en: The incumbent lost the election because of rising unemployment.
examples.zh: 由于失业率上升,现任者输掉了选举。

examples.en: Countries that break the agreement may incur heavy financial penalties.
examples.zh: 违反协议的国家可能招致高额罚款。

examples.en: The company paid an indemnity to the workers who were injured.
examples.zh: 公司向受伤工人支付了赔偿。

examples.en: Living away from home at university made me a lot more independent.
examples.zh: 上大学离家生活让我独立多了。

examples.en: Look in the index at the back to find the page you need.
examples.zh: 查看书后的索引,找到你需要的页码。

examples.en: These figures indicate that fewer young people are moving to rural areas.
examples.zh: 这些数字表明,搬到农村的年轻人减少了。

examples.en: The high rate of youth unemployment is an indictment of government policy.
examples.zh: 青年失业率高是对政府政策的控诉。

examples.en: I'm pretty indifferent to fashion and just wear whatever is clean.
examples.zh: 我对时尚挺无所谓的,有什么干净的就穿什么。

examples.en: Indigenous peoples have lived on this land for thousands of years.
examples.zh: 本土民族在这片土地上生活了数千年。

examples.en: Pollution has an indirect effect on birds by reducing their supply of food.
examples.zh: 污染通过减少食物来源,对鸟类产生间接影响。

examples.en: Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of modern life.
examples.zh: 手机已成为现代生活中不可或缺的一部分。

examples.en: Western societies tend to place greater value on individualism.
examples.zh: 西方社会往往更重视个人主义。

examples.en: I can get a bit indolent on holiday and just lie around all day.
examples.zh: 度假时我会有点懒,整天就躺着。

examples.en: When it rains, I usually go to an indoor swimming pool near my flat.
examples.zh: 下雨时,我通常去公寓附近的室内游泳池。

examples.en: The drug was used to induce sleep in patients before an operation.
examples.zh: 这种药曾用于在手术前诱导患者入睡。

examples.en: Induction involves forming a general rule from a number of specific examples.
examples.zh: 归纳是指从若干具体例子中得出一般规律。

examples.en: All new employees attend a one-week induction before starting work.
examples.zh: 所有新员工在开始工作前都要参加为期一周的入职培训。

examples.en: Parents who indulge their children may make it harder for them to cope later.
examples.zh: 纵容孩子的父母可能让孩子日后更难应对问题。

examples.en: Many industrial cities declined when the factories closed down.
examples.zh: 工厂关闭后,许多工业城市衰落了。

examples.en: The Industrial Revolution brought millions of people from the country to the cities.
examples.zh: 工业革命使数百万人从乡村来到城市。

examples.en: My grandparents were industrious farmers who got up before sunrise every day.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母是勤劳的农民,每天日出前就起床。

examples.en: The car industry employs thousands of people in the north of the country.
examples.zh: 汽车行业在该国北部雇用了数千人。

examples.en: Inequality between rich and poor has grown in many developed countries.
examples.zh: 在许多发达国家,贫富之间的不平等加剧了。

examples.en: Rapid growth inevitably puts pressure on housing and public transport.
examples.zh: 快速增长不可避免地给住房和公共交通带来压力。

examples.en: An infant can recognise its mother's voice within days of birth.
examples.zh: 婴儿出生几天内就能辨认出母亲的声音。

examples.en: The virus can infect people of all ages, but children suffer most.
examples.zh: 这种病毒能感染所有年龄段的人,但儿童受害最重。

examples.en: Keep the cut clean, or it could easily lead to an infection.
examples.zh: 保持伤口清洁,否则很容易引起感染。

examples.en: Vaccines have greatly reduced deaths from infectious diseases.
examples.zh: 疫苗大大减少了传染病造成的死亡。

examples.en: From the tools they left behind, we can infer how these people lived.
examples.zh: 从他们留下的工具中,我们可以推断出这些人的生活方式。

examples.en: The researchers drew an inference about diet from the marks on the teeth.
examples.zh: 研究者根据牙齿上的痕迹对饮食作出了推断。

examples.en: Much of the land is infertile and can support only a few sheep.
examples.zh: 大部分土地贫瘠,只能养少量的羊。

examples.en: Some philosophers believed that the universe was infinite in size.
examples.zh: 一些哲学家认为宇宙的大小是无限的。

examples.en: Ancient mathematicians struggled with the idea of infinity.
examples.zh: 古代数学家曾苦苦思索无穷大的概念。

examples.en: High inflation reduces the value of people's savings.
examples.zh: 高通货膨胀会降低人们储蓄的价值。

examples.en: Strong winds can inflict serious damage on buildings along the coast.
examples.zh: 强风可能给沿海建筑造成严重破坏。

examples.en: Parents have a strong influence on the eating habits of their children.
examples.zh: 父母对孩子的饮食习惯有很大影响。

examples.en: Advertising can influence what people choose to buy without their realising it.
examples.zh: 广告可以在不知不觉中影响人们的购买选择。

examples.en: Many teenagers buy products simply because an influencer recommends them.
examples.zh: 许多青少年买东西只是因为网红推荐。

examples.en: My mum has been the most influential person in my life so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止,我妈妈是对我人生最有影响力的人。

examples.en: Information overload makes it harder for people to concentrate on one task.
examples.zh: 信息过载使人们更难专注于一项任务。

examples.en: Informative programmes can be just as entertaining as other types of television.
examples.zh: 信息丰富的节目可以和其他类型的电视节目一样有趣。

examples.en: Infrared cameras can detect animals by the heat of their bodies.
examples.zh: 红外线相机能通过动物的体温探测到它们。

examples.en: Poor infrastructure is holding back economic growth in rural areas.
examples.zh: 基础设施落后阻碍了农村地区的经济增长。

examples.en: All the ingredients in our soups come from farms in the area.
examples.zh: 我们汤里的所有原料都来自本地农场。

examples.en: The island's first inhabitants arrived by boat about three thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 这座岛最早的居民大约三千年前乘船来到这里。

examples.en: There are risks inherent in any form of deep-sea exploration.
examples.zh: 任何形式的深海探索都有固有的风险。

examples.en: Children inherit half of their genes from each parent.
examples.zh: 孩子从父母双方各继承一半的基因。

examples.en: Certain chemicals in the leaves inhibit the growth of nearby plants.
examples.zh: 叶子中的某些化学物质会抑制附近植物的生长。

examples.en: The project was initially planned to last just two years.
examples.zh: 这个项目最初计划只持续两年。

examples.en: The government initiated a programme to bring clean water to rural areas.
examples.zh: 政府发起了一项计划,为农村地区提供清洁用水。

examples.en: The new initiative aims to reduce the amount of plastic used in schools.
examples.zh: 这项新举措旨在减少学校的塑料用量。

examples.en: Doctors inject the vaccine into the upper part of the arm.
examples.zh: 医生把疫苗注射到上臂。

examples.en: He missed the whole season because of a serious knee injury.
examples.zh: 他因膝盖重伤错过了整个赛季。

examples.en: Rain clouds rarely reach the dry inland areas of the continent.
examples.zh: 雨云很少能到达这片大陆干燥的内陆地区。

examples.en: The town now lies ten kilometres inland because the coast has moved.
examples.zh: 由于海岸线变化,这个小镇现在位于内陆十公里处。

examples.en: Each inmate in the prison is offered basic education and job training.
examples.zh: 监狱里的每个囚犯都能接受基础教育和职业培训。

examples.en: We had lunch at an old inn in the middle of the village.
examples.zh: 我们在村子中央的一家老旅馆吃了午饭。

examples.en: Some psychologists argue that the ability to learn language is innate.
examples.zh: 一些心理学家认为,学习语言的能力是天生的。

examples.en: Some innocent people have spent years in prison for crimes they did not commit.
examples.zh: 一些无辜的人因未曾犯下的罪行在狱中度过多年。

examples.en: Innovation is essential if small companies are to survive.
examples.zh: 小公司要想生存,创新至关重要。

examples.en: The company is known for its innovative approach to reducing waste.
examples.zh: 这家公司以创新的减废方法闻名。

examples.en: Plants absorb inorganic substances from the soil and turn them into food.
examples.zh: 植物从土壤中吸收无机物,并把它们转化为养分。

examples.en: The main input of the process is fresh water from the river.
examples.zh: 这一过程的主要投入是河里的淡水。

examples.en: An inscription on the stone records the name of the local ruler.
examples.zh: 石头上的铭文记录了当地统治者的名字。

examples.en: Without insects to carry pollen, many plants could not reproduce.
examples.zh: 如果没有昆虫传粉,许多植物将无法繁殖。

examples.en: Spraying insecticide can also harm birds that feed on the insects.
examples.zh: 喷洒杀虫剂也会伤害以这些昆虫为食的鸟类。

examples.en: The sheets of paper are inserted into the machine one at a time.
examples.zh: 纸张被一张一张地插入机器。

examples.en: The letters give us a valuable insight into daily life in the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 这些信件让我们得以深入了解十八世纪的日常生活。

examples.en: Too much coffee late in the day can cause insomnia.
examples.zh: 下午晚些时候喝太多咖啡可能导致失眠。

examples.en: Officials inspect the factory twice a year to check the air quality.
examples.zh: 官员每年两次检查工厂的空气质量。

examples.en: The landlord will carry out an inspection of the flat every six months.
examples.zh: 房东每六个月会检查一次公寓。

examples.en: The ticket inspector fined me because I had forgotten my student card.
examples.zh: 查票员罚了我的款,因为我忘了带学生证。

examples.en: Nature has long been a source of inspiration for artists and writers.
examples.zh: 大自然一直是艺术家和作家的灵感来源。

examples.en: I find her story really inspiring because she started with almost nothing.
examples.zh: 我觉得她的故事很鼓舞人心,因为她几乎是白手起家。

examples.en: Political instability in the region has discouraged foreign investment.
examples.zh: 该地区的政治不稳定阻碍了外国投资。

examples.en: You can pay for the course in three monthly instalments.
examples.zh: 你可以分三个月分期支付课程费用。

examples.en: Instant messaging has reduced the amount of time people spend talking face to face.
examples.zh: 即时通讯减少了人们当面交谈的时间。

examples.en: More people should use public transport instead of driving to work.
examples.zh: 更多人应该乘坐公共交通,而不是开车上班。

examples.en: Some social media users try to instigate violence during public protests.
examples.zh: 一些社交媒体用户试图在公众抗议期间煽动暴力。

examples.en: Parents can instil good reading habits in children from an early age.
examples.zh: 父母可以从小给孩子灌输良好的阅读习惯。

examples.en: Young turtles move towards the sea by instinct as soon as they hatch.
examples.zh: 小海龟一孵化出来,就凭本能爬向大海。

examples.en: She's now working at a research institute in the north of the city.
examples.zh: 她现在在城北的一家研究所工作。

examples.en: The college has instituted a new system for handing in coursework.
examples.zh: 学院设立了一套新的提交作业制度。

examples.en: Teachers should instruct children in how to use the internet safely.
examples.zh: 老师应该教导孩子如何安全地使用互联网。

examples.en: Students receive instruction in both English and their native language.
examples.zh: 学生接受英语和母语两种语言的教学。

examples.en: The instructor will show you how to use the machines safely.
examples.zh: 教练会教你如何安全使用这些器械。

examples.en: I've always wanted to learn a musical instrument, maybe the guitar.
examples.zh: 我一直想学一门乐器,也许是吉他。

examples.en: Insufficient funding forced the museum to close two of its galleries.
examples.zh: 资金不足迫使博物馆关闭了两个展厅。

examples.en: The island's insular position protected it from many of the mainland's diseases.
examples.zh: 这座岛的海岛位置使它免受大陆上许多疾病的侵袭。

examples.en: Good insulation keeps heat inside the building during cold winters.
examples.zh: 良好的隔热层能在寒冬把热量留在建筑内。

examples.en: Rubber is a good insulator and is used to cover electrical wires.
examples.zh: 橡胶是良好的绝缘体,被用来包裹电线。

examples.en: Don't forget to buy travel insurance before you go skiing.
examples.zh: 去滑雪之前别忘了买旅行保险。

examples.en: The ship was found almost intact on the bottom of the lake.
examples.zh: 这艘船在湖底被发现时几乎完好无损。

examples.en: Intangible benefits of the arts are often difficult to measure in money.
examples.zh: 艺术无形的益处往往很难用金钱衡量。

examples.en: The new system integrates information from several different sources.
examples.zh: 新系统整合了来自多个不同来源的信息。

examples.en: Language classes can help with the integration of new immigrants.
examples.zh: 语言课程有助于新移民融入社会。

examples.en: The author believed that a good education could develop the intellect of any child.
examples.zh: 作者认为,良好的教育能发展任何孩子的才智。

examples.en: Puzzles and games can support the intellectual development of young children.
examples.zh: 拼图和游戏可以促进幼儿的智力发展。

examples.en: Intellectuals have often played an important part in political change.
examples.zh: 知识分子常常在政治变革中发挥重要作用。

examples.en: Stronger laws are needed to protect intellectual property on the internet.
examples.zh: 需要更严格的法律来保护互联网上的知识产权。

examples.en: Early tests of intelligence were criticised for being unfair to certain groups.
examples.zh: 早期的智力测试因对某些群体不公平而受到批评。

examples.en: The intense heat of the fire melted the metal parts of the building.
examples.zh: 大火的高温熔化了建筑的金属部件。

examples.en: Competition for water intensified as the population of the valley grew.
examples.zh: 随着山谷人口增长,对水资源的争夺加剧了。

examples.en: The intensity of the storm surprised even the weather forecasters.
examples.zh: 这场风暴的强度甚至让天气预报员都感到意外。

examples.en: Intensive farming produces more food but can damage the soil.
examples.zh: 集约化耕作产量更高,但可能损害土壤。

examples.en: This intensive course covers a full year of Spanish in just eight weeks.
examples.zh: 这门强化课程只用八周就学完一整年的西班牙语内容。

examples.en: The original intent of the law was to protect small farmers.
examples.zh: 这项法律的初衷是保护小农户。

examples.en: Babies learn language by interacting with the people around them.
examples.zh: 婴儿通过与周围的人互动来学习语言。

examples.en: Modern trade has led to greater interdependence between nations.
examples.zh: 现代贸易使国家之间更加相互依赖。

examples.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to small businesses.
examples.zh: 银行对小企业贷款收取更高的利息。

examples.en: Public interest in the subject has grown in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来,公众对这个问题的兴趣有所增长。

examples.en: The bank offers a low interest rate on loans for students.
examples.zh: 银行为学生贷款提供较低的利率。

examples.en: The simple interface of the program makes it easy for older people to use.
examples.zh: 这个程序简单的界面让老年人也能轻松使用。

examples.en: Bright lights can interfere with the sleep patterns of city residents.
examples.zh: 明亮的灯光可能妨碍城市居民的睡眠规律。

examples.en: Intergalactic distances are so huge that they are hard to imagine.
examples.zh: 星系际距离如此巨大,很难想象。

examples.en: An interim report will be published before the end of the project.
examples.zh: 项目结束前将发布一份中期报告。

examples.en: The interior of the building has been completely modernised.
examples.zh: 建筑内部已经完全现代化了。

examples.en: I've moved up to the intermediate group now that I can swim well.
examples.zh: 我现在游得不错,已经升到中级组了。

examples.en: International cooperation is essential to solve the problem of climate change.
examples.zh: 要解决气候变化问题,国际合作至关重要。

examples.en: The support office helps each international student to settle in during the first month.
examples.zh: 支持办公室在第一个月帮助每位留学生适应环境。

examples.en: I did a three-month internship at a newspaper during the summer.
examples.zh: 暑假期间我在一家报社实习了三个月。

examples.en: Too much time on phones may weaken children's interpersonal skills.
examples.zh: 花太多时间在手机上可能削弱孩子的人际交往能力。

examples.en: Interplanetary missions take years of planning and huge amounts of money.
examples.zh: 行星际任务需要多年规划和巨额资金。

examples.en: Historians interpret the meaning of these ancient paintings in different ways.
examples.zh: 历史学家对这些古代绘画的含义有不同的解读。

examples.en: An interpreter was needed for the meeting between the two leaders.
examples.zh: 两国领导人会晤时需要一名口译员。

examples.en: Officers are not allowed to interrogate children without an adult present.
examples.zh: 没有成年人在场,警察不得审问儿童。

examples.en: Sorry to interrupt, but could you repeat the last point, please?
examples.zh: 抱歉打断一下,您能再说一遍最后一点吗?

examples.en: The two roads intersect near the centre of the ancient town.
examples.zh: 这两条路在古镇中心附近相交。

examples.en: Turn left at the next intersection and look for a blue building.
examples.zh: 在下一个十字路口左转,找一栋蓝色的建筑。

examples.en: Interstellar travel is still far beyond our present technology.
examples.zh: 星际旅行仍然远远超出我们目前的技术水平。

examples.en: Measurements were taken at regular intervals throughout the day.
examples.zh: 全天每隔一定时间进行一次测量。

examples.en: Governments should intervene when companies charge unfair prices.
examples.zh: 当公司收取不公平的价格时,政府应该干预。

examples.en: Early intervention can prevent small problems from becoming much more serious.
examples.zh: 早期干预可以防止小问题发展得更严重。

examples.en: I've got an interview for a job at the hospital on Monday.
examples.zh: 我周一要去医院面试一份工作。

examples.en: The manager will interview all five candidates over the next two days.
examples.zh: 经理将在接下来两天面试全部五位候选人。

examples.en: Each interviewee was asked the same ten questions about their diet.
examples.zh: 每位受访者都被问了同样十个关于饮食的问题。

examples.en: Technology may reduce the intimacy of family relationships.
examples.zh: 技术可能减少家庭关系的亲密。

examples.en: Language has an intimate connection with a people's sense of identity.
examples.zh: 语言与一个民族的身份认同有着密切的联系。

examples.en: Larger males use loud calls to intimidate their rivals.
examples.zh: 体型较大的雄性用响亮的叫声恐吓对手。

examples.en: The temple walls are covered with intricate carvings of animals and plants.
examples.zh: 寺庙的墙壁上布满了精细的动植物雕刻。

examples.en: The unusual shape of the bones continues to intrigue scientists.
examples.zh: 这些骨头不同寻常的形状一直引起科学家的兴趣。

examples.en: Students learn better when they find an intrinsic interest in the subject.
examples.zh: 学生对学科有内在兴趣时学得更好。

examples.en: An introvert usually prefers quiet activities to large social events.
examples.zh: 内向者通常更喜欢安静的活动,而不是大型社交活动。

examples.en: Publishing private photographs is a serious intrusion into a person's life.
examples.zh: 发布私人照片是对个人生活的严重侵扰。

examples.en: Experienced doctors often rely on intuition when making quick decisions.
examples.zh: 有经验的医生在快速决策时常常依靠直觉。

examples.en: The Vikings began to invade the coast of Britain in the eighth century.
examples.zh: 维京人从八世纪起开始入侵不列颠海岸。

examples.en: Any change to the document may invalidate the entire agreement.
examples.zh: 对文件的任何改动都可能使整个协议无效。

examples.en: These old diaries are an invaluable source of information for historians.
examples.zh: 这些旧日记对历史学家来说是极其宝贵的信息来源。

examples.en: In these conditions, the experiment invariably produced the same result.
examples.zh: 在这些条件下,实验总是产生相同的结果。

examples.en: The invasion of 1066 changed the course of English history.
examples.zh: 1066 年的入侵改变了英国历史的进程。

examples.en: No one knows exactly who invented the first wheel.
examples.zh: 没有人确切知道最早的轮子是谁发明的。

examples.en: The invention of the telephone transformed the way people communicate.
examples.zh: 电话的发明彻底改变了人们的交流方式。

examples.en: The inventor of the machine died before he could see its success.
examples.zh: 这台机器的发明者没能看到它的成功就去世了。

examples.en: A temperature inversion can trap pollution close to the ground for days.
examples.zh: 逆温现象可能把污染物困在近地面达数日之久。

examples.en: Invertebrates such as worms and insects make up most animal species.
examples.zh: 蠕虫和昆虫等无脊椎动物占动物物种的大多数。

examples.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy rather than coal and oil.
examples.zh: 政府应该投资于可再生能源,而不是煤炭和石油。

examples.en: The team set out to investigate why the fish had disappeared from the lake.
examples.zh: 研究团队着手调查湖中的鱼为什么消失了。

examples.en: A police investigation found that the fire had been started deliberately.
examples.zh: 警方调查发现这场火灾是人为纵火。

examples.en: Foreign investment has helped to create jobs in the region.
examples.zh: 外国投资帮助该地区创造了就业机会。

examples.en: A wise investor spreads risk across several different types of business.
examples.zh: 明智的投资者把风险分散到几种不同类型的企业。

examples.en: Air pollution is often invisible, but it can seriously damage health.
examples.zh: 空气污染往往看不见,但会严重损害健康。

examples.en: I received an invitation to the opening of the new art gallery.
examples.zh: 我收到了新美术馆开幕的邀请。

examples.en: We'll send you an invoice when the work has been finished.
examples.zh: 工作完成后,我们会把发票寄给你。

examples.en: Learning to read involves several different areas of the brain.
examples.zh: 学习阅读涉及大脑的多个不同区域。

examples.en: A lack of iodine in the diet can cause serious health problems.
examples.zh: 饮食中缺碘可能引起严重的健康问题。

examples.en: An ion is an atom that has gained or lost an electron.
examples.zh: 离子是得到或失去电子的原子。

examples.en: A high IQ does not guarantee success in later life.
examples.zh: 高智商并不能保证日后的成功。

examples.en: Iron tools gradually replaced those made of softer metals.
examples.zh: 铁制工具逐渐取代了较软金属制成的工具。

examples.en: Iron Age farmers built round houses from wood and dried mud.
examples.zh: 铁器时代的农民用木头和干泥建造圆屋。

examples.en: The stars in this group vary in brightness at irregular intervals.
examples.zh: 这组恒星的亮度以不规则的间隔变化。

examples.en: Much of the information in the report is irrelevant to the main question.
examples.zh: 报告中的许多信息与主要问题无关。

examples.en: Advertising can make unhealthy snacks seem irresistible to young children.
examples.zh: 广告能让不健康的零食对幼儿来说显得无法抗拒。

examples.en: The damage to the world's coral reefs may already be irreversible.
examples.zh: 世界珊瑚礁所受的损害可能已经不可逆转。

examples.en: Farmers use water from the river to irrigate their fields in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天,农民用河水灌溉田地。

examples.en: Irrigation has allowed crops to be grown in very dry parts of the country.
examples.zh: 灌溉使该国非常干旱的地区也能种植庄稼。

examples.en: Seals rest on a small rocky islet just off the coast.
examples.zh: 海豹在离岸不远的一个多岩石的小岛上休息。

examples.en: I'd feel too isolated living on a farm far from other people.
examples.zh: 住在远离人群的农场,我会觉得太与世隔绝了。

examples.en: Spending too much time online can lead to social isolation.
examples.zh: 上网时间过长可能导致社交孤立。

examples.en: The travel agent will email you a full itinerary before you leave.
examples.zh: 旅行社会在你出发前把完整的行程表发邮件给你。

examples.en: I've got an old piano with yellowed ivory keys that belonged to my grandfather.
examples.zh: 我有一架老钢琴,琴键是泛黄的象牙,是爷爷留下的。

examples.en: He spent five years in jail for stealing from the company.
examples.zh: 他因盗窃公司财物坐了五年牢。

examples.en: I started listening to jazz when I went to a small club in New York.
examples.zh: 我去纽约一家小俱乐部后开始听爵士乐。

examples.en: I was a bit jealous when my friend got a much better job.
examples.zh: 朋友找到一份好得多的工作时,我有点嫉妒。

examples.en: Warmer seas have led to a large increase in the number of jellyfish.
examples.zh: 海水变暖导致水母数量大幅增加。

examples.en: Thousands of jobs were put in jeopardy when the factory lost its main customer.
examples.zh: 工厂失去主要客户后,数千个工作岗位陷入危险境地。

examples.en: I don't wear much jewellery, just a watch and a simple ring.
examples.zh: 我不戴什么首饰,只有一块手表和一枚简单的戒指。

examples.en: Job displacement caused by automation is a serious concern for many workers.
examples.zh: 自动化造成的工作岗位被替代是许多工人严重担忧的问题。

examples.en: Graduates need practical skills to compete in today's job market.
examples.zh: 毕业生需要实用技能才能在当今的就业市场竞争。

examples.en: Each new hotel creates a job opportunity for people living nearby.
examples.zh: 每家新酒店都为附近居民创造就业机会。

examples.en: Job satisfaction is often more important than a high salary.
examples.zh: 工作满意度往往比高薪更重要。

examples.en: Many young workers today have little job security or regular income.
examples.zh: 如今许多年轻工人几乎没有工作保障或固定收入。

examples.en: Each jobseeker should receive advice on how to write a good CV.
examples.zh: 每位求职者都应该得到关于如何写好简历的建议。

examples.en: I go jogging in the park near my home three times a week.
examples.zh: 我每周三次去家附近的公园慢跑。

examples.en: My partner and I opened a joint account to pay the rent and bills.
examples.zh: 我和伴侣开了一个联名账户,用来付房租和账单。

examples.en: The two companies formed a joint venture to build the new power station.
examples.zh: 这两家公司成立了一家合资企业来建造新发电站。

examples.en: You'll find that article in a psychology journal in the library.
examples.zh: 你可以在图书馆的一本心理学期刊上找到那篇文章。

examples.en: I keep a journal of everything I read for my research.
examples.zh: 我把为研究读过的所有内容都记在日志里。

examples.en: Good journalism helps people to understand complex social problems.
examples.zh: 好的新闻业帮助人们理解复杂的社会问题。

examples.en: A journalist should check the facts carefully before publishing a story.
examples.zh: 记者在发表报道前应仔细核实事实。

examples.en: The judge decided that the company had broken the law.
examples.zh: 法官判定这家公司违反了法律。

examples.en: Tiredness affects judgement and increases the risk of road accidents.
examples.zh: 疲劳影响判断力,增加交通事故风险。

examples.en: An independent judicial system is essential for a fair society.
examples.zh: 独立的司法体系对公平的社会至关重要。

examples.en: The street performer can juggle five balls while riding a bicycle.
examples.zh: 这位街头艺人能一边骑自行车一边抛接五个球。

examples.en: I have to juggle my part-time job and my course work every week.
examples.zh: 我每周都要兼顾兼职和课程作业。

examples.en: Turn right at the next junction and the hotel is straight ahead.
examples.zh: 在下一个路口右转,酒店就在正前方。

examples.en: The ruins of the ancient city were hidden in the jungle for centuries.
examples.zh: 这座古城的遗迹在丛林中隐藏了几个世纪。

examples.en: He's a junior now and has to choose a topic for his final project.
examples.zh: 他现在大三了,必须为毕业设计选题。

examples.en: I started as a junior engineer and worked my way up over ten years.
examples.zh: 我从初级工程师做起,用十年时间一步步晋升。

examples.en: Advertising of junk food to children should be banned on television.
examples.zh: 应该禁止在电视上向儿童宣传垃圾食品。

examples.en: Jupiter has a huge storm that has lasted for hundreds of years.
examples.zh: 木星上有一场持续了数百年的巨大风暴。

examples.en: The jury found the man guilty after three days of discussion.
examples.zh: 陪审团经过三天讨论,认定该男子有罪。

examples.en: Everyone should have equal access to justice, whatever their income.
examples.zh: 无论收入如何,每个人都应平等地获得司法保障。

examples.en: The results do not justify the high cost of the treatment.
examples.zh: 这样的结果不足以证明高昂的治疗费用是合理的。

examples.en: Lack of parental guidance is often seen as a cause of juvenile delinquency.
examples.zh: 缺乏父母指导常被视为青少年犯罪的一个原因。

examples.en: A young kangaroo stays in its mother's pouch for about six months.
examples.zh: 小袋鼠在母亲的育儿袋中待大约六个月。

examples.en: We often go to karaoke after work, even though none of us can sing.
examples.zh: 我们下班后常去唱卡拉OK,虽然谁都不会唱。

examples.en: Older workers may find it difficult to keep up with new technology.
examples.zh: 年长的工人可能觉得很难跟上新技术。

examples.en: Type a keyword into the search box to find articles on your topic.
examples.zh: 在搜索框中输入关键词,查找与你的主题相关的文章。

examples.en: I usually wear khaki trousers and a plain shirt when I go hiking.
examples.zh: 我去徒步时通常穿卡其色裤子和素色衬衫。

examples.en: The gang tried to kidnap the businessman for a large sum of money.
examples.zh: 这个团伙试图绑架这名商人,以索取巨款。

examples.en: The kidneys remove waste from the blood and control the body's water.
examples.zh: 肾脏清除血液中的废物,并调节体内水分。

examples.en: Heart disease remains the biggest killer in most developed countries.
examples.zh: 在大多数发达国家,心脏病仍然是头号杀手。

examples.en: Children who attend kindergarten often settle more easily into primary school.
examples.zh: 上过幼儿园的孩子往往更容易适应小学。

examples.en: The small kingdom grew wealthy by controlling trade on the river.
examples.zh: 这个小王国通过控制河上贸易而富裕起来。

examples.en: Please remember to bring your football kit to the training session.
examples.zh: 请记得带上你的足球装备来参加训练。

examples.en: My mum finds knitting very relaxing, especially on cold winter evenings.
examples.zh: 我妈妈觉得编织很放松,尤其是在寒冷的冬夜。

examples.en: I'm hopeless at tying a tie, and the knot always looks terrible.
examples.zh: 我特别不会打领带,结总是打得很难看。

examples.en: Practical skills are often as valuable as knowledge gained from books.
examples.zh: 实践技能往往和书本知识一样宝贵。

examples.en: My history teacher is really knowledgeable and can answer almost any question.
examples.zh: 我的历史老师知识渊博,几乎什么问题都能回答。

examples.en: The koala feeds almost entirely on the leaves of eucalyptus trees.
examples.zh: 考拉几乎完全以桉树叶为食。

examples.en: The shortage of cheap labour forced farmers to buy machines.
examples.zh: 廉价劳动力的短缺迫使农民购买机器。

examples.en: Older workers may find it hard to compete in the modern labour market.
examples.zh: 年长的工人可能很难在现代劳动力市场上竞争。

examples.en: My wedding dress had beautiful lace on the sleeves and around the neck.
examples.zh: 我的婚纱袖子和领口都有漂亮的蕾丝。

examples.en: People in my hometown are pretty laid-back and never seem to hurry.
examples.zh: 我家乡的人都挺悠闲的,好像从来不着急。

examples.en: Most of the city's rubbish still goes to landfill outside the town.
examples.zh: 这座城市的大部分垃圾仍被送往城外的垃圾填埋场。

examples.en: The plane made a smooth landing in spite of the strong wind.
examples.zh: 尽管风很大,飞机还是平稳着陆了。

examples.en: The bathroom is on the first-floor landing, right next to the stairs.
examples.zh: 浴室在二楼的楼梯平台上,就在楼梯旁边。

examples.en: My landlady lives downstairs and doesn't allow pets in the house.
examples.zh: 我的女房东住在楼下,她不允许在房子里养宠物。

examples.en: The landlord has agreed to replace the broken cooker by next Monday.
examples.zh: 房东已经同意在下周一前换掉坏了的灶具。

examples.en: The clock tower is the town's best-known landmark and is easy to find.
examples.zh: 钟楼是这个小镇最著名的地标,很容易找到。

examples.en: Ice sheets shaped much of the landscape of northern Europe.
examples.zh: 冰盖塑造了北欧的大部分地貌。

examples.en: Keep to the left lane when you reach the end of the bridge.
examples.zh: 到桥尽头时,请靠左侧车道行驶。

examples.en: The farm is at the end of a narrow lane behind the church.
examples.zh: 农场在教堂后面一条窄巷的尽头。

examples.en: The success of the project was largely due to local support.
examples.zh: 这个项目的成功在很大程度上归功于当地人的支持。

examples.en: The larva feeds on leaves until it is ready to change into an adult.
examples.zh: 幼虫以树叶为食,直到准备好变为成虫。

examples.en: Surgeons now use a laser to correct many common eye problems.
examples.zh: 外科医生现在用激光矫正许多常见的眼部问题。

examples.en: The virus can remain latent in the body for many years.
examples.zh: 这种病毒可以在体内潜伏多年。

examples.en: The tree has strong lateral roots that spread close to the surface.
examples.zh: 这种树有粗壮的侧根,贴近地表生长。

examples.en: Temperatures generally fall as latitude increases, although mountains can alter this pattern.
examples.zh: 气温通常随纬度升高而下降,不过山脉可能改变这一规律。

examples.en: The agency plans to launch a new satellite to study the oceans.
examples.zh: 该机构计划发射一颗新卫星来研究海洋。

examples.en: The launch of the campaign attracted wide attention from the national press.
examples.zh: 这项运动的启动引起了全国媒体的广泛关注。

examples.en: The laundry is in the basement and is open until ten at night.
examples.zh: 洗衣房在地下室,开放到晚上十点。

examples.en: I usually do my laundry on Sunday mornings when the machines are free.
examples.zh: 我通常周日上午洗衣服,那时洗衣机都空着。

examples.en: Hot lava flowed down the mountain and destroyed several small villages.
examples.zh: 炽热的熔岩从山上流下,摧毁了几个小村庄。

examples.en: The only lavatory is on the ground floor, next to the back door.
examples.zh: 唯一的厕所在一楼,就在后门旁边。

examples.en: Most law-abiding citizens support stronger action against serious crime.
examples.zh: 大多数守法公民支持加强打击严重犯罪。

examples.en: Law enforcement agencies are working together to stop online crime.
examples.zh: 执法机构正在合作打击网络犯罪。

examples.en: Tenants are responsible for cutting the lawn during the summer months.
examples.zh: 夏季由租户负责修剪草坪。

examples.en: Several families filed a lawsuit against the company over the polluted water.
examples.zh: 几个家庭就水污染问题对该公司提起诉讼。

examples.en: Everyone accused of a crime should have the right to a lawyer.
examples.zh: 每个被指控犯罪的人都应有权聘请律师。

examples.en: Falling sales forced the company to lay off a third of its workers.
examples.zh: 销量下滑迫使公司裁掉三分之一的员工。

examples.en: A thick layer of ash covered the town after the volcano erupted.
examples.zh: 火山喷发后,厚厚一层火山灰覆盖了小镇。

examples.en: The layout of the museum is confusing, so take a map with you.
examples.zh: 博物馆的布局容易让人迷路,所以带上一张地图。

examples.en: Too much screen time may lead to poor sleep among teenagers.
examples.zh: 过多使用电子屏幕可能导致青少年睡眠不佳。

examples.en: Take a leaflet from the desk for details of the summer courses.
examples.zh: 从服务台取一张传单,了解暑期课程的详情。

examples.en: Our college team finished second in the league last season.
examples.zh: 我们学院的球队上赛季在联赛中获得第二名。

examples.en: There's a leak under the sink, so the floor is always wet.
examples.zh: 水槽下面漏水,所以地板总是湿的。

examples.en: The roof leaks whenever it rains, so we've put a bucket upstairs.
examples.zh: 一下雨屋顶就漏水,所以我们在楼上放了个桶。

examples.en: The invention of the telescope was a great leap forward for astronomy.
examples.zh: 望远镜的发明是天文学的一次巨大飞跃。

examples.en: We signed a one-year lease, so we can't move out before June.
examples.zh: 我们签了一年的租约,所以六月之前不能搬走。

examples.en: The company leases three flats near the station to its new staff.
examples.zh: 公司把车站附近的三套公寓租给新员工。

examples.en: I've got an old leather bag that I bought in Italy years ago.
examples.zh: 我有一个多年前在意大利买的旧皮包。

examples.en: Today's lecture will look at the causes of the French Revolution.
examples.zh: 今天的讲座将探讨法国大革命的起因。

examples.en: Our lecturer has put all the slides on the university website.
examples.zh: 我们的讲师把所有幻灯片都放到了大学网站上。

examples.en: The birds lay their eggs on a narrow ledge high on the cliff.
examples.zh: 这些鸟把蛋产在悬崖高处狭窄的岩架上。

examples.en: The roads built by the Romans are a lasting legacy of their empire.
examples.zh: 罗马人修建的道路是其帝国留下的长久遗产。

examples.en: People under the legal age should not be allowed to buy alcohol.
examples.zh: 未达到合法年龄的人不应被允许购买酒精饮料。

examples.en: Some countries have decided to legalise the use of cannabis for medical purposes.
examples.zh: 一些国家决定把医用大麻合法化。

examples.en: According to legend, the city was founded by two brothers.
examples.zh: 据传说,这座城市是由两兄弟建立的。

examples.en: Governments should legislate against the sale of unhealthy food in schools.
examples.zh: 政府应该立法禁止在学校出售不健康食品。

examples.en: New legislation is needed to protect workers in the digital economy.
examples.zh: 需要新的立法来保护数字经济中的工人。

examples.en: Each legislator must balance the needs of different groups in society.
examples.zh: 每位立法者都必须平衡社会不同群体的需求。

examples.en: Criticising the government is a legitimate right in a free society.
examples.zh: 在自由社会,批评政府是一项合法的权利。

examples.en: I don't have much leisure time at the moment because of my job.
examples.zh: 由于工作的原因,我目前没有多少闲暇时间。

examples.en: The leisure centre offers swimming lessons for adults on Monday evenings.
examples.zh: 休闲中心周一晚上有成人游泳课。

examples.en: Most lenders will want to see proof of your income first.
examples.zh: 大多数贷款方都会先要求查看你的收入证明。

examples.en: A lens bends light so that a telescope can show distant stars clearly.
examples.zh: 透镜使光线弯曲,让望远镜能清晰地显示遥远的恒星。

examples.en: The leopard often drags its food up into a tree for safety.
examples.zh: 豹常把食物拖到树上以保安全。

examples.en: Even a small amount of this poison can be lethal to humans.
examples.zh: 即使少量这种毒药也可能对人类致命。

examples.en: My tutor agreed to write me a letter of recommendation for the job.
examples.zh: 我的导师同意为这份工作给我写一封推荐信。

examples.en: I found this flat through a letting agency near the university.
examples.zh: 我是通过大学附近的一家租房中介找到这套公寓的。

examples.en: Car ownership rose quickly and then began to level off after 2010.
examples.zh: 汽车拥有量迅速上升,2010 年后开始趋于平稳。

examples.en: A long lever allows a person to lift a very heavy stone.
examples.zh: 长杠杆让人能抬起很重的石头。

examples.en: The new levy on plastic bags has greatly reduced their use.
examples.zh: 新的塑料袋税大大减少了它们的使用。

examples.en: The king tried to levy a new tax to pay for the war.
examples.zh: 国王试图征收一种新税来支付战争费用。

examples.en: The study compared lexical differences between British and American English.
examples.zh: 这项研究比较了英式英语和美式英语的词汇差异。

examples.en: The firm's liabilities were much greater than the value of its property.
examples.zh: 这家公司的负债远高于其财产的价值。

examples.en: Companies are liable for any injuries caused by their faulty products.
examples.zh: 公司要为其缺陷产品造成的任何伤害负法律责任。

examples.en: Education can liberate people from poverty and limited opportunities.
examples.zh: 教育能把人们从贫困和有限的机会中解放出来。

examples.en: Ask the librarian if you can't find what you're looking for.
examples.zh: 如果找不到需要的资料,可以问图书管理员。

examples.en: You'll need your library card to borrow books or use the computers.
examples.zh: 借书或使用电脑都需要借书卡。

examples.en: Only licensed doctors should be allowed to prescribe these drugs.
examples.zh: 只有获得许可的医生才能开这些药。

examples.en: Life expectancy has risen steadily in most countries over the last century.
examples.zh: 过去一个世纪,大多数国家的预期寿命持续上升。

examples.en: The average life-span of a wild fox is only about three years.
examples.zh: 野生狐狸的平均寿命只有大约三年。

examples.en: Lifelong learning has become essential because skills change so quickly.
examples.zh: 由于技能变化太快,终身学习已变得至关重要。

examples.en: A healthy lifestyle can reduce the risk of many serious diseases.
examples.zh: 健康的生活方式可以降低许多严重疾病的风险。

examples.en: An average person will spend about a third of their lifetime asleep.
examples.zh: 普通人一生中大约有三分之一的时间在睡觉。

examples.en: The lift is out of order, so you'll have to use the stairs.
examples.zh: 电梯坏了,所以你只能走楼梯。

examples.en: Light pollution in cities makes it difficult to see the stars at night.
examples.zh: 城市的光污染使人们夜间很难看到星星。

examples.en: The nearest star to the Sun is just over four light-years away.
examples.zh: 距太阳最近的恒星只有四光年多。

examples.en: The old lighthouse is now a small museum about life at sea.
examples.zh: 这座旧灯塔现在是一座介绍海上生活的小博物馆。

examples.en: Forest fires are sometimes started by lightning during the dry season.
examples.zh: 旱季时,森林火灾有时是由闪电引发的。

examples.en: This laptop is very lightweight, which is great because I travel a lot.
examples.zh: 这台笔记本很轻便,对我这个经常出差的人来说太好了。

examples.en: Regular exercise reduces the likelihood of developing heart disease.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼可以降低患心脏病的可能性。

examples.en: Children copy the speech of their parents, and they likewise copy their behaviour.
examples.zh: 孩子模仿父母说话,同样也模仿他们的行为。

examples.en: We painted our daughter's bedroom a lovely shade of lilac.
examples.zh: 我们把女儿的卧室刷成了可爱的淡紫色。

examples.en: Some lizards can grow a new limb if one is lost.
examples.zh: 有些蜥蜴失去肢体后能再长出新的。

examples.en: Rainwater slowly dissolves limestone, creating large underground caves.
examples.zh: 雨水慢慢溶解石灰岩,形成巨大的地下洞穴。

examples.en: Many cities now limit the use of cars in their historic centres.
examples.zh: 现在许多城市限制在历史城区使用汽车。

examples.en: There is a limit to how much information the brain can process.
examples.zh: 大脑能处理的信息量是有限度的。

examples.en: One limitation of the study is that all the participants were university students.
examples.zh: 这项研究的一个局限是所有参与者都是大学生。

examples.en: The results show a linear relationship between age and body weight.
examples.zh: 结果显示年龄与体重之间存在线性关系。

examples.en: Linen trousers are perfect for hot weather, but they crease easily.
examples.zh: 亚麻裤子很适合热天穿,但容易起皱。

examples.en: Latin served as a lingua franca for educated people across Europe.
examples.zh: 拉丁语曾是欧洲各地受教育者的通用语。

examples.en: The linguist spent ten years recording the speech of older villagers.
examples.zh: 这位语言学家花了十年时间记录老年村民的话语。

examples.en: Linguistic differences between the two regions have grown over the past century.
examples.zh: 过去一个世纪,这两个地区的语言差异越来越大。

examples.en: Students of linguistics examine how languages change over long periods of time.
examples.zh: 学习语言学的学生研究语言如何长期演变。

examples.en: Rates of literacy rose quickly after free schools were introduced.
examples.zh: 免费学校推行后,识字率迅速上升。

examples.en: The name of the town literally means 'place by the river'.
examples.zh: 这个城镇的名字字面意思是“河边的地方”。

examples.en: Studying literature helps young people to understand different points of view.
examples.zh: 学习文学有助于年轻人理解不同的观点。

examples.en: I've almost finished the literature review, but I still need to read two articles.
examples.zh: 我的文献综述快写完了,但还要读两篇文章。

examples.en: The lithosphere is broken into large plates that move very slowly.
examples.zh: 岩石圈分裂成几大板块,这些板块移动得非常缓慢。

examples.en: Litter in the streets makes a city look dirty and uncared for.
examples.zh: 街道上的垃圾使城市看起来又脏又没人管。

examples.en: People who litter in public parks should be made to pay a fine.
examples.zh: 在公园乱扔垃圾的人应该被罚款。

examples.en: There's a little bar near my flat that has live music on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我公寓附近有一家小酒吧,周五有现场音乐。

examples.en: The old town is really lively in the evenings, with music everywhere.
examples.zh: 老城的晚上非常热闹,到处都是音乐。

examples.en: The liver removes harmful substances from the blood.
examples.zh: 肝脏清除血液中的有害物质。

examples.en: Most of the land is used for raising livestock such as cows and sheep.
examples.zh: 大部分土地用于饲养牛羊等家畜。

examples.en: Some lizards can lose their tails to escape from an attacker.
examples.zh: 有些蜥蜴能断尾逃脱攻击者。

examples.en: The finished bricks are loaded onto trucks and delivered to customers.
examples.zh: 成品砖被装上卡车,送到顾客手中。

examples.en: Could you pick up a loaf of bread on your way home?
examples.zh: 你回家路上能买一条面包吗?

examples.en: I took out a loan to pay for my car.
examples.zh: 我贷了一笔款来买车。

examples.en: The loan period for this book is two weeks, or one if it's in demand.
examples.zh: 这本书的借期是两周,如果需求量大则是一周。

examples.en: Let's meet in the hotel lobby at nine and walk from there.
examples.zh: 我们九点在酒店大堂见面,然后从那里走过去。

examples.en: Farmers are trying to lobby the government for more financial support.
examples.zh: 农民正在游说政府提供更多资金支持。

examples.en: A lobster sheds its hard shell several times as it grows larger.
examples.zh: 龙虾在长大过程中会多次蜕去坚硬的外壳。

examples.en: Spending by visitors can give a valuable boost to the local economy.
examples.zh: 游客的消费能大大推动当地经济。

examples.en: Tourism should bring real benefits to local residents as well as to companies.
examples.zh: 旅游业应该给当地居民以及公司都带来实际好处。

examples.en: You really should try the local speciality when you visit my hometown.
examples.zh: 来我家乡时,你真应该尝尝当地特产。

examples.en: Each locality has its own traditions and style of cooking.
examples.zh: 每个地区都有自己的传统和烹饪风格。

examples.en: The restaurant uses only vegetables that are grown locally.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅只用当地种植的蔬菜。

examples.en: You'll need a pound coin to use the lockers by the pool.
examples.zh: 使用泳池边的储物柜需要一枚一英镑硬币。

examples.en: The first steam locomotive could pull only a few small wagons.
examples.zh: 第一台蒸汽机车只能拉几节小车厢。

examples.en: A locust can eat its own weight in food every day.
examples.zh: 蝗虫每天能吃下相当于自身体重的食物。

examples.en: The ski lodge is only a short walk from the slopes.
examples.zh: 这家滑雪旅舍离雪道只有几步路。

examples.en: The heavy logs were floated down the river to the sawmill.
examples.zh: 沉重的原木顺河漂到锯木厂。

examples.en: The logic of the argument is clear, but its conclusion is hard to accept.
examples.zh: 这个论点的逻辑很清楚,但结论很难接受。

examples.en: Reducing car use seems a logical step towards cleaner air.
examples.zh: 减少用车似乎是改善空气质量的合理一步。

examples.en: Online shopping has created new challenges for logistics companies.
examples.zh: 网购给物流公司带来了新的挑战。

examples.en: A simple logo helps customers to recognise a company's products.
examples.zh: 简单的标志有助于顾客识别公司的产品。

examples.en: Many elderly people feel lonely because their children live far away.
examples.zh: 许多老人感到孤独,因为他们的孩子住得很远。

examples.en: Little is known about the long-term effects of this chemical on humans.
examples.zh: 人们对这种化学物质对人体的长期影响知之甚少。

examples.en: Diet and regular exercise appear to be linked to longevity.
examples.zh: 饮食和经常运动似乎与长寿有关。

examples.en: Accurate clocks allowed sailors to calculate their longitude while at sea.
examples.zh: 精确的时钟让水手能够在海上计算所处的经度。

examples.en: Many people look forward to retirement, but some find it hard to adapt.
examples.zh: 许多人期待退休,但有些人很难适应。

examples.en: The government should look into the causes of rising youth crime.
examples.zh: 政府应该调查青少年犯罪率上升的原因。

examples.en: A feedback loop can make global warming happen more quickly.
examples.zh: 反馈循环可能使全球变暖加快。

examples.en: The airline reported a heavy loss for the third year in a row.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司连续第三年报告巨额亏损。

examples.en: He spent the money he won on the lottery on a new house.
examples.zh: 他用彩票中奖的钱买了一栋新房子。

examples.en: The results were announced over a loudspeaker at the end of the day.
examples.zh: 当天结束时,成绩通过扬声器宣布。

examples.en: Residents can watch television or relax in the lounge on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 住户可以在一楼的休息室看电视或放松。

examples.en: Governments should encourage a low-carbon economy through taxes and subsidies.
examples.zh: 政府应该通过税收和补贴鼓励低碳经济。

examples.en: Rice grows best in lowland areas that flood during the wet season.
examples.zh: 水稻最适合生长在雨季会被淹没的低地。

examples.en: She's been a loyal friend to me for more than twenty years.
examples.zh: 二十多年来,她一直是我忠诚的朋友。

examples.en: The trade in spices was extremely lucrative for European merchants.
examples.zh: 香料贸易对欧洲商人来说利润极高。

examples.en: You can leave your luggage in this room until your bus arrives.
examples.zh: 在你的巴士到来之前,可以把行李放在这个房间。

examples.en: Companies cut down trees in the northern forests to produce lumber.
examples.zh: 公司砍伐北部森林的树木来生产木材。

examples.en: Doctors check any new lump carefully to see if it is dangerous.
examples.zh: 医生会仔细检查任何新出现的肿块,看看是否危险。

examples.en: Lunar rocks brought back to Earth have helped scientists understand its history.
examples.zh: 带回地球的月球岩石帮助科学家了解它的历史。

examples.en: Smoking is the main cause of lung cancer in most countries.
examples.zh: 在大多数国家,吸烟是肺癌的主要成因。

examples.en: Criminals use false job offers to lure young people abroad.
examples.zh: 犯罪分子用虚假的工作机会诱骗年轻人出国。

examples.en: The hotel was far more luxurious than anything I had stayed in before.
examples.zh: 那家酒店比我以前住过的任何地方都奢华得多。

examples.en: I can never remember the lyrics, so I just sing along badly.
examples.zh: 我总记不住歌词,所以只能胡乱跟着唱。

examples.en: Machine-made furniture is cheaper, but it doesn't last as long.
examples.zh: 机器制造的家具更便宜,但没那么耐用。

examples.en: New farm machinery reduced the number of workers needed on the land.
examples.zh: 新的农业机器减少了田间所需的工人数量。

examples.en: I read an interesting article about sleep in a science magazine.
examples.zh: 我在一本科学杂志上读到一篇关于睡眠的有趣文章。

examples.en: The magistrate ordered the young man to pay a small fine.
examples.zh: 地方法官判令这名年轻人支付一小笔罚款。

examples.en: Volcanoes form when magma rises through cracks in the Earth's surface.
examples.zh: 岩浆穿过地表裂缝上升时就形成了火山。

examples.en: A compass needle is a small magnet that points to the north.
examples.zh: 指南针的指针是一块指向北方的小磁铁。

examples.en: Some birds use the Earth's magnetic field to find their way.
examples.zh: 有些鸟利用地球磁场辨别方向。

examples.en: Early sailors used magnetism to find their direction at sea.
examples.zh: 早期的水手利用磁性在海上辨别方向。

examples.en: The palace was magnificent, with huge rooms and beautiful gardens.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿宏伟壮观,有巨大的房间和美丽的花园。

examples.en: An earthquake of this magnitude can destroy buildings within seconds.
examples.zh: 这种震级的地震能在几秒钟内摧毁建筑物。

examples.en: The main course comes with rice or potatoes and a small salad.
examples.zh: 主菜配米饭或土豆,还有一份小沙拉。

examples.en: Critics maintain that the study was too small to be reliable.
examples.zh: 批评者坚持认为,这项研究规模太小,不可靠。

examples.en: Sleep helps the brain to maintain its ability to store new information.
examples.zh: 睡眠有助于大脑维持储存新信息的能力。

examples.en: Please report any maintenance problems to the office as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 如有任何需要维修的问题,请尽快告知办公室。

examples.en: Maize was first grown in Central America thousands of years ago.
examples.zh: 玉米最早于数千年前在中美洲种植。

examples.en: My major is economics, but I'm also taking a course in history.
examples.zh: 我主修经济学,但也在修一门历史课。

examples.en: I decided to major in biology after a great teacher inspired me.
examples.zh: 一位很棒的老师激励了我,于是我决定主修生物学。

examples.en: The majority of students preferred to live in shared flats.
examples.zh: 大多数学生更愿意住在合租公寓里。

examples.en: Women make up nearly half of the workforce in many developed countries.
examples.zh: 在许多发达国家,女性占劳动力的近一半。

examples.en: Cities should make use of empty buildings instead of building on farmland.
examples.zh: 城市应该利用空置的建筑,而不是在农田上建房。

examples.en: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes and remains a serious threat in Africa.
examples.zh: 疟疾由蚊子传播,在非洲仍是严重威胁。

examples.en: We spent the afternoon at the mall looking for a birthday present.
examples.zh: 我们下午在购物中心找生日礼物。

examples.en: Many of the children in the camp were seriously malnourished.
examples.zh: 营地里的许多孩子严重营养不良。

examples.en: Malnutrition affects the physical and mental development of young children.
examples.zh: 营养不良影响幼儿的身心发育。

examples.en: Bats are the only mammals capable of true flight.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠是唯一能够真正飞行的哺乳动物。

examples.en: The restaurant manager will show you around on your first day.
examples.zh: 第一天餐厅经理会带你四处看看。

examples.en: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory for all passengers in the car.
examples.zh: 车内所有乘客都必须系安全带。

examples.en: The disease may not manifest itself until many years after infection.
examples.zh: 这种疾病可能在感染多年后才显现出来。

examples.en: Octopuses can manipulate objects with great skill using their long arms.
examples.zh: 章鱼能用长长的腕灵巧地操纵物体。

examples.en: The photographs showed clear signs of manipulation by computer.
examples.zh: 这些照片有明显的计算机操纵痕迹。

examples.en: The old mansion on the hill has over twenty bedrooms and its own lake.
examples.zh: 山上那座老豪宅有二十多间卧室,还有自己的湖。

examples.en: Heat from the mantle slowly moves the plates on the Earth's surface.
examples.zh: 来自地幔的热量缓慢推动地球表面的板块移动。

examples.en: Machines have replaced much of the manual labour once done in factories.
examples.zh: 机器已经取代了工厂里过去的许多体力劳动。

examples.en: The factory began to manufacture bicycles at the end of the war.
examples.zh: 这家工厂在战争结束时开始制造自行车。

examples.en: The manufacturer has recalled thousands of cars because of a brake problem.
examples.zh: 由于刹车问题,制造商召回了数千辆汽车。

examples.en: Farmers spread animal manure on the fields to improve the soil.
examples.zh: 农民把动物粪肥撒在田里来改良土壤。

examples.en: The museum has an original manuscript of one of his early novels.
examples.zh: 博物馆藏有他早期一部小说的手稿原件。

examples.en: The ancient Greeks used white marble for many of their finest buildings.
examples.zh: 古希腊人用白色大理石建造了许多最精美的建筑。

examples.en: The opposition party won by a narrow margin in the 2015 election.
examples.zh: 反对党在 2015 年选举中以微弱差额获胜。

examples.en: The difference between the two figures in 2005 was only marginal.
examples.zh: 2005 年这两个数字之间的差异很小。

examples.en: Plastic waste poses a growing danger to marine animals of all sizes.
examples.zh: 塑料垃圾对各种大小的海洋动物构成日益严重的威胁。

examples.en: Financial problems are a common cause of marital difficulties.
examples.zh: 财务问题是婚姻困难的常见原因。

examples.en: You need a mark of at least sixty percent to pass the module.
examples.zh: 这门课程模块至少要得百分之六十的分数才算通过。

examples.en: It takes the lecturers about two weeks to mark all the exam papers.
examples.zh: 讲师们大约需要两周才能批改完所有试卷。

examples.en: The market for electric cars has grown rapidly in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来,电动汽车市场迅速增长。

examples.en: Market research showed that young people preferred the cheaper model.
examples.zh: 市场调研显示年轻人更喜欢较便宜的型号。

examples.en: Successful marketing depends on understanding what customers really want.
examples.zh: 成功的市场营销取决于了解顾客真正想要什么。

examples.en: New blood cells are constantly produced in the bone marrow.
examples.zh: 骨髓不断产生新的血细胞。

examples.en: Water once flowed across the surface of Mars, according to recent studies.
examples.zh: 最近的研究表明,火星表面曾有水流动。

examples.en: Reeds and tall grasses grow thickly in the marsh beside the river.
examples.zh: 河边的沼泽里长满了芦苇和高草。

examples.en: A marsupial carries its young in a pouch on the front of its body.
examples.zh: 有袋动物把幼崽放在身体前部的育儿袋中。

examples.en: We had marvellous weather for the whole of our trip to Greece.
examples.zh: 我们去希腊的整个旅程天气都好极了。

examples.en: Some people think that cooking isn't masculine, but I completely disagree.
examples.zh: 有些人认为做饭没有男子气概,但我完全不同意。

examples.en: We wore masks and funny costumes to the party at the end of term.
examples.zh: 我们戴着面具、穿着搞笑的服装参加了期末派对。

examples.en: The Sun contains almost all the mass of the solar system.
examples.zh: 太阳几乎占了太阳系的全部质量。

examples.en: Mass production made cars affordable for ordinary families.
examples.zh: 大规模生产让普通家庭也买得起汽车。

examples.en: The mass media has a strong influence on public opinion about politics.
examples.zh: 大众媒体对公众的政治看法有很大影响。

examples.en: Mass tourism can destroy the natural beauty that attracts visitors in the first place.
examples.zh: 大众旅游可能破坏最初吸引游客的自然美景。

examples.en: The massacre of the villagers caused anger across the whole country.
examples.zh: 对村民的大屠杀引起了全国的愤怒。

examples.en: Every child should have the chance to see a great masterpiece in person.
examples.zh: 每个孩子都应该有机会亲眼看到伟大的杰作。

examples.en: She's doing a master's degree in engineering at a university in Glasgow.
examples.zh: 她正在格拉斯哥一所大学攻读工程硕士学位。

examples.en: Male peacocks display their bright feathers to attract a mate.
examples.zh: 雄孔雀展示鲜艳的羽毛来吸引配偶。

examples.en: Some birds mate for life and return to the same nest each year.
examples.zh: 有些鸟终生配对,每年回到同一个巢。

examples.en: Bamboo is a popular building material in many parts of Asia.
examples.zh: 竹子在亚洲许多地区都是很受欢迎的建筑材料。

examples.en: Modern advertising strongly encourages materialism among young people.
examples.zh: 现代广告大大助长了年轻人的物质主义。

examples.en: Critics say that modern society has become too materialistic.
examples.zh: 批评者说现代社会变得过于物质主义。

examples.en: Maternal health has improved greatly in many developing countries.
examples.zh: 在许多发展中国家,母亲的健康状况大大改善。

examples.en: Our company gives six months of maternity leave on full pay.
examples.zh: 我们公司提供六个月全薪产假。

examples.en: Every mathematician knows how difficult this ancient problem has been.
examples.zh: 每位数学家都知道这个古老的问题有多难。

examples.en: Ancient Babylonians used advanced mathematics to predict the movement of planets.
examples.zh: 古巴比伦人运用高等数学预测行星的运动。

examples.en: The data was arranged in a matrix of rows and columns.
examples.zh: 数据被排列成由行和列组成的矩阵。

examples.en: Scientists believe that most matter in the universe cannot be seen directly.
examples.zh: 科学家认为,宇宙中的大部分物质无法直接观测。

examples.en: Small differences in temperature matter a great deal to these insects.
examples.zh: 微小的温差对这些昆虫来说很要紧。

examples.en: The old mattress was so hard that I asked for a new one.
examples.zh: 旧床垫太硬了,所以我要求换一张新的。

examples.en: My friend is very mature for her age and gives really good advice.
examples.zh: 我朋友比同龄人成熟得多,总能给出很好的建议。

examples.en: As a mature student, I find it hard to balance work and family.
examples.zh: 作为大龄学生,我觉得很难平衡工作和家庭。

examples.en: The old maxim that practice makes perfect has some scientific support.
examples.zh: “熟能生巧”这句老格言有一定的科学依据。

examples.en: Farmers plant crops in rows to maximise the amount of sunlight they get.
examples.zh: 农民成行种植作物,以最大限度地获得阳光。

examples.en: Plants reach their maximum height after about three months of growth.
examples.zh: 植物生长约三个月后达到最大高度。

examples.en: Wild flowers cover the mountain meadows in early summer.
examples.zh: 初夏时节,野花开满了高山草地。

examples.en: The mean of the five results was thirty-two points.
examples.zh: 这五个结果的平均值是三十二分。

examples.en: I think it's more meaningful to give a handmade present than an expensive one.
examples.zh: 我觉得送手工礼物比送昂贵的礼物更有意义。

examples.en: The device can measure small changes in the temperature of the water.
examples.zh: 这种设备能测量水温的微小变化。

examples.en: The government has introduced measures to reduce air pollution in large cities.
examples.zh: 政府已出台措施,减少大城市的空气污染。

examples.en: Mechanical clocks were first built in European churches in the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 机械钟最早是中世纪在欧洲教堂建造的。

examples.en: The laws of mechanics explain how forces affect moving objects.
examples.zh: 力学定律解释了力如何影响运动的物体。

examples.en: Sweating is the body's main mechanism for controlling its temperature.
examples.zh: 出汗是人体调节体温的主要机制。

examples.en: Every child who finishes the race will receive a medal.
examples.zh: 每个跑完全程的孩子都会得到一枚奖牌。

examples.en: The media should be free to criticise those in power.
examples.zh: 媒体应该可以自由批评当权者。

examples.en: The median age of the population was thirty-five in 2010.
examples.zh: 2010 年,人口年龄的中位数是三十五岁。

examples.en: The new doctor will need to see your medical records from home.
examples.zh: 新医生需要查看你在家乡的病历。

examples.en: Patients must take this medication every day for at least three months.
examples.zh: 患者必须每天服用这种药物,至少三个月。

examples.en: The medieval town still has its original walls and narrow streets.
examples.zh: 这座中世纪小镇仍保留着原有的城墙和狭窄的街道。

examples.en: Olives and grapes grow well in a Mediterranean climate with dry summers.
examples.zh: 橄榄和葡萄在夏季干燥的地中海气候中长得很好。

examples.en: He's of medium height, with short black hair and glasses.
examples.zh: 他中等身高,留着黑色短发,戴着眼镜。

examples.en: That song has such a simple melody that I can't get it out of my head.
examples.zh: 那首歌的旋律很简单,我总忘不掉。

examples.en: Rising temperatures are causing mountain glaciers to melt more quickly.
examples.zh: 气温上升导致山地冰川融化得更快。

examples.en: Your membership includes free use of the pool and the tennis courts.
examples.zh: 你的会员资格包括免费使用游泳池和网球场。

examples.en: The annual membership fee is £40, or £25 for students.
examples.zh: 年度会费是 40 英镑,学生 25 英镑。

examples.en: A thin membrane controls what enters and leaves each cell.
examples.zh: 一层薄膜控制着物质进出每个细胞。

examples.en: Her memoir describes her childhood in a small fishing village.
examples.zh: 她的回忆录描述了她在一个小渔村的童年。

examples.en: The most memorable meal I've ever had was at a tiny place in Italy.
examples.zh: 我吃过最难忘的一餐是在意大利的一家小店。

examples.en: Students should do more than simply memorise facts for an exam.
examples.zh: 学生不应该只是为了考试而记住事实。

examples.en: Regular sleep helps to strengthen long-term memory in adults.
examples.zh: 规律睡眠有助于增强成年人的长期记忆。

examples.en: Too much time on social media may damage the mental health of teenagers.
examples.zh: 花太多时间在社交媒体上可能损害青少年的心理健康。

examples.en: Changing the mentality of a whole industry can take many years.
examples.zh: 改变整个行业的思维方式可能需要很多年。

examples.en: An experienced mentor can help young workers to develop their careers.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的导师能帮助年轻员工发展事业。

examples.en: Some companies have a mercenary attitude towards their customers.
examples.zh: 一些公司对待顾客的态度唯利是图。

examples.en: The band sells T-shirts and other merchandise at the back of the hall.
examples.zh: 乐队在大厅后面出售 T 恤和其他商品。

examples.en: A wealthy merchant paid for the construction of the town's first hospital.
examples.zh: 一位富商出资修建了镇上第一家医院。

examples.en: Mercury is the smallest planet and the one closest to the Sun.
examples.zh: 水星是最小的行星,也是离太阳最近的行星。

examples.en: These figures are merely estimates and may not reflect the real situation.
examples.zh: 这些数字仅仅是估算,可能不反映真实情况。

examples.en: Two small colleges merged to form the new university in 1965.
examples.zh: 两所小学院于 1965 年合并,组成了这所新大学。

examples.en: The merger of the two banks created one of the largest in Asia.
examples.zh: 两家银行合并后组成了亚洲最大的银行之一。

examples.en: The meridian passing through Greenwich marks zero degrees of longitude.
examples.zh: 穿过格林尼治的子午线标志着零度经线。

examples.en: Each of these approaches has its own merit, depending on the situation.
examples.zh: 根据情况不同,这些方法各有优点。

examples.en: Before the telephone, important news was carried by a messenger on horseback.
examples.zh: 电话出现之前,重要消息由骑马的信使传递。

examples.en: Metabolism tends to slow down as people get older.
examples.zh: 随着年龄增长,新陈代谢往往会减慢。

examples.en: The author uses the metaphor of a journey to describe language learning.
examples.zh: 作者用旅程这一隐喻来描述语言学习。

examples.en: A meteor burns up as it enters the atmosphere at high speed.
examples.zh: 流星高速进入大气层时会燃烧殆尽。

examples.en: A meteor shower happens when the Earth passes through a trail of dust.
examples.zh: 地球穿过尘埃带时,就会出现流星雨。

examples.en: The meteorite that landed in the desert contained small amounts of rare metals.
examples.zh: 落在沙漠中的陨石含有少量稀有金属。

examples.en: Advances in meteorology have made it possible to warn people about storms.
examples.zh: 气象学的进步使人们能够提前预警风暴。

examples.en: Cattle release large quantities of methane into the atmosphere each year.
examples.zh: 牛每年向大气释放大量甲烷。

examples.en: This method of dating ancient objects is accurate but very expensive.
examples.zh: 这种测定古物年代的方法准确但非常昂贵。

examples.en: In this section, you should explain the methodology of your study.
examples.zh: 在这一部分,你应该说明你研究的方法论。

examples.en: The metro runs until midnight and is the cheapest way to get around.
examples.zh: 地铁运行到午夜,是最便宜的出行方式。

examples.en: The small port grew into a huge metropolis within a hundred years.
examples.zh: 这个小港口在一百年内发展成了一座大都市。

examples.en: The metropolitan area now has a population of nearly ten million.
examples.zh: 这一大都市地区现在的人口接近一千万。

examples.en: A single spoonful of soil may contain millions of microbes.
examples.zh: 一小勺土壤可能含有数百万个微生物。

examples.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone at the back can hear you.
examples.zh: 请对着麦克风讲话,让后面的人都能听到。

examples.en: The invention of the microscope allowed scientists to see bacteria for the first time.
examples.zh: 显微镜的发明使科学家第一次看到了细菌。

examples.en: There's a microwave in the kitchen, but students must bring their own plates.
examples.zh: 厨房里有微波炉,但学生要自带盘子。

examples.en: Sales began to fall in the mid-1990s and never fully recovered.
examples.zh: 销售额从 20 世纪 90 年代中期开始下降,一直没有完全恢复。

examples.en: The mighty river once carried goods far into the centre of the continent.
examples.zh: 这条大河曾把货物运到大陆腹地。

examples.en: A migrant worker may send most of their income back home.
examples.zh: 外来务工人员可能把大部分收入寄回家。

examples.en: Many birds migrate south to avoid the cold winter months.
examples.zh: 许多鸟南迁以躲避寒冷的冬季。

examples.en: The long migration of these birds takes them across the Sahara Desert.
examples.zh: 这些鸟的长途迁徙要飞越撒哈拉沙漠。

examples.en: My dad is a mild man who hardly ever raises his voice.
examples.zh: 我爸爸性情温和,几乎从不提高嗓门。

examples.en: I only had a mild cold, so I still went to work.
examples.zh: 我只是轻微感冒,所以还是去上班了。

examples.en: Militant groups have attacked government buildings in the north of the country.
examples.zh: 好战团体袭击了该国北部的政府建筑。

examples.en: Some countries require young people to complete a period of military service.
examples.zh: 有些国家要求年轻人服一段时间的兵役。

examples.en: The old flour mill on the river is now a small museum.
examples.zh: 河边的老面粉厂现在是一座小博物馆。

examples.en: Thousands of people came to the city to work in the cotton mills.
examples.zh: 成千上万的人来到这座城市,在棉纺厂工作。

examples.en: The town has been a centre of trade for more than a millennium.
examples.zh: 一千多年来,这座城镇一直是贸易中心。

examples.en: Average rainfall reached 200 millimetres in the wettest month.
examples.zh: 最潮湿的月份平均降雨量达到 200 毫米。

examples.en: The actors told the whole story through mime, without saying a word.
examples.zh: 演员们用哑剧讲述了整个故事,一句话也没说。

examples.en: Mimicry allows some harmless snakes to look like dangerous ones.
examples.zh: 拟态使一些无害的蛇看起来像危险的蛇。

examples.en: Plants take up water and minerals from the soil through their roots.
examples.zh: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收水分和矿物质。

examples.en: The new design causes minimal disturbance to the surrounding environment.
examples.zh: 新设计对周围环境的干扰极小。
