examples.en: Engineers tried to minimise the effect of the dam on local wildlife.
examples.zh: 工程师努力把大坝对当地野生动物的影响降到最低。

examples.en: Raising the minimum wage could help the lowest-paid workers in society.
examples.zh: 提高最低工资可以帮助社会上收入最低的工人。

examples.en: Only a small minority of people cycled to work in 2010.
examples.zh: 2010 年,只有少数人骑车上班。

examples.en: Every minority group should have the right to use its own language.
examples.zh: 每个少数群体都应有权使用自己的语言。

examples.en: Temperatures at the research station can fall to minus sixty degrees.
examples.zh: 研究站的气温可能降到零下六十度。

examples.en: Local people considered the survival of the whole crew a miracle.
examples.zh: 当地人认为全体船员幸存下来是个奇迹。

examples.en: I felt miserable for days after failing that important exam.
examples.zh: 那场重要的考试没通过后,我难受了好几天。

examples.en: Being stuck in traffic every morning was pure misery for me.
examples.zh: 每天早上堵在路上对我来说简直是痛苦。

examples.en: Misinformation spreads quickly on the internet and can be hard to correct.
examples.zh: 错误信息在互联网上传播很快,而且很难纠正。

examples.en: Averages can be misleading when a few very high values are included.
examples.zh: 包含少数极高数值时,平均数可能具有误导性。

examples.en: The development of a single missile can cost hundreds of millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 研发一枚导弹可能花费数亿美元。

examples.en: Care homes that mistreat older people should be closed down immediately.
examples.zh: 虐待老人的护理院应该立即关闭。

examples.en: Planting trees along rivers can mitigate the effects of flooding.
examples.zh: 沿河植树可以减轻洪水的影响。

examples.en: The sand is mixed with water and small stones to form concrete.
examples.zh: 沙子与水和小石子混合,形成混凝土。

examples.en: Air is a mixture of nitrogen, oxygen and several other gases.
examples.zh: 空气是氮气、氧气和其他几种气体的混合物。

examples.en: You have to cross a wooden bridge over the moat to enter the castle.
examples.zh: 要进入城堡,得走过护城河上的一座木桥。

examples.en: Mobile phones have made banking possible in many remote areas.
examples.zh: 手机让许多偏远地区也能使用银行服务。

examples.en: The government mobilised thousands of volunteers to help after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水过后,政府动员了数千名志愿者提供帮助。

examples.en: Regular exercise helps older people to maintain their mobility.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼有助于老年人保持行动能力。

examples.en: The middle group showed only a moderate change over the twenty years.
examples.zh: 中间组在这二十年里只出现了适度的变化。

examples.en: Even though she's won lots of prizes, my friend is very modest about it.
examples.zh: 虽然我朋友得过很多奖,但她对此很谦虚。

examples.en: We live in a modest flat, but it's enough for the two of us.
examples.zh: 我们住在一套不大的公寓里,但对我们两人来说够了。

examples.en: Scientists have modified the crop so that it needs less water.
examples.zh: 科学家对这种作物进行了改良,使它需要的水更少。

examples.en: Each module lasts ten weeks and ends with a short written test.
examples.zh: 每个课程模块持续十周,最后有一次简短的笔试。

examples.en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。

examples.en: Snails and octopuses both belong to the group known as molluscs.
examples.zh: 蜗牛和章鱼都属于软体动物这一类群。

examples.en: A heavy ship has so much momentum that it takes a long time to stop.
examples.zh: 大船的动量很大,需要很长时间才能停下来。

examples.en: The campaign for cleaner air has gained momentum in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来,争取清洁空气的运动势头越来越强。

examples.en: Queen Victoria was one of the longest-reigning monarchs in British history.
examples.zh: 维多利亚女王是英国历史上在位时间最长的君主之一。

examples.en: The monarchy lost most of its political power during the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 十九世纪,君主制失去了大部分政治权力。

examples.en: The central bank controls the country's monetary policy.
examples.zh: 中央银行控制着国家的货币政策。

examples.en: Satellites are used to monitor changes in the size of the ice sheets.
examples.zh: 卫星被用来监控冰盖面积的变化。

examples.en: Only a small number of mammals are thought to be monogamous.
examples.zh: 人们认为只有少数哺乳动物是一夫一妻的。

examples.en: He spent years writing a monograph on the birds of South America.
examples.zh: 他花了多年时间撰写一部关于南美鸟类的专著。

examples.en: For many years, the state had a monopoly on the sale of salt.
examples.zh: 多年来,国家垄断了盐的销售。

examples.en: My first job was quite monotonous, doing the same thing every day.
examples.zh: 我的第一份工作挺单调的,每天都做同样的事。

examples.en: Farmers in the region depend on the summer monsoon for their water.
examples.zh: 该地区的农民依靠夏季季风带来的水。

examples.en: The monument in the square was built to remember the city's founder.
examples.zh: 广场上的纪念碑是为纪念这座城市的创建者而建的。

examples.en: Bright sunlight has a positive effect on mood for most people.
examples.zh: 对大多数人来说,明媚的阳光对心情有积极影响。

examples.en: Low pay and long hours have damaged morale among nurses.
examples.zh: 低工资和长工时损害了护士的士气。

examples.en: The new bridge is cheaper to build; moreover, it requires little maintenance.
examples.zh: 新桥造价更低,此外,它几乎不需要维护。

examples.en: I'm definitely a morning person and do my best work before lunch.
examples.zh: 我绝对是个早起的人,午饭前工作效率最高。

examples.en: The morphology of the bones suggests that the animal walked on two legs.
examples.zh: 骨骼的形态表明这种动物用两条腿行走。

examples.en: Infant mortality fell sharply after clean water was introduced to the city.
examples.zh: 城市引入清洁水后,婴儿死亡率急剧下降。

examples.en: They had to take out a large mortgage to buy their first home.
examples.zh: 他们不得不申请一大笔按揭贷款来买第一套房。

examples.en: A beautiful Roman mosaic was discovered beneath the floor of the old church.
examples.zh: 在老教堂的地板下发现了一幅精美的罗马马赛克镶嵌画。

examples.en: Only the female mosquito bites people, as it needs blood for its eggs.
examples.zh: 只有雌蚊才叮人,因为它需要血液来产卵。

examples.en: Moss grows well on wet rocks in the shade of the forest.
examples.zh: 苔藓在森林树荫下的湿石上长得很好。

examples.en: We stopped at a roadside motel because we were too tired to drive.
examples.zh: 我们太累开不动了,就在路边的汽车旅馆停了下来。

examples.en: Unlike butterflies, most moths are active during the night.
examples.zh: 与蝴蝶不同,大多数飞蛾在夜间活动。

examples.en: Children usually learn to read more easily in their mother tongue.
examples.zh: 孩子通常用母语学习阅读更容易。

examples.en: A common motif in local art is the bird, which represents freedom.
examples.zh: 当地艺术中常见的图案是鸟,它象征自由。

examples.en: Praise can motivate students more effectively than the threat of punishment.
examples.zh: 表扬比惩罚的威胁更能有效地激励学生。

examples.en: Students with strong motivation tend to perform better at school.
examples.zh: 动机强的学生往往在学校表现更好。

examples.en: The small electric motor turns the wheels at a constant speed.
examples.zh: 这台小型电动马达以恒定的速度驱动车轮。

examples.en: Stay on the motorway until you see the sign for the airport.
examples.zh: 沿高速公路一直开,直到看到机场的指示牌。

examples.en: There's mould on the bathroom ceiling because the room has no window.
examples.zh: 浴室没有窗户,所以天花板上长了霉。

examples.en: The workers pour the hot metal into a mould and leave it to cool.
examples.zh: 工人把热金属倒入模具,然后让它冷却。

examples.en: Mountaineering is too dangerous for me, but I enjoy walking in the hills.
examples.zh: 登山对我来说太危险了,但我喜欢在山丘上散步。

examples.en: My grandfather wore a small moustache for most of his life.
examples.zh: 我爷爷一生大部分时间都留着小胡子。

examples.en: Living in a multicultural society teaches people to respect different customs.
examples.zh: 生活在多元文化社会中,人们学会尊重不同的习俗。

examples.en: In this multilingual society, most people use at least three languages daily.
examples.zh: 在这个多语社会中,大多数人每天至少使用三种语言。

examples.en: Multinational companies can move production to wherever costs are lowest.
examples.zh: 跨国公司可以把生产转移到成本最低的地方。

examples.en: To find the area, multiply the length of the field by its width.
examples.zh: 要求面积,就用田地的长度乘以宽度。

examples.en: Bacteria can multiply very quickly in warm food.
examples.zh: 细菌在温热的食物中能很快成倍增加。

examples.en: Research suggests that multitasking reduces the quality of people's work.
examples.zh: 研究表明,多任务处理会降低工作质量。

examples.en: Municipal authorities are responsible for collecting rubbish and repairing local roads.
examples.zh: 市政当局负责收集垃圾和维修当地道路。

examples.en: Each municipality is responsible for running its own schools.
examples.zh: 每个自治市负责管理自己的学校。

examples.en: Some people believe that murder should be punished with life in prison.
examples.zh: 有些人认为谋杀应被判处终身监禁。

examples.en: Regular training helps to build muscle and improve general health.
examples.zh: 经常训练有助于增强肌肉、改善整体健康。

examples.en: My neighbour goes to the gym every day and is very muscular.
examples.zh: 我的邻居每天去健身房,肌肉很发达。

examples.en: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous and can be fatal if eaten.
examples.zh: 有些野生蘑菇有毒,吃了可能致命。

examples.en: Tourists to London often go to see a musical during their stay.
examples.zh: 到伦敦的游客在逗留期间常常去看音乐剧。

examples.en: Mussels attach themselves firmly to rocks to avoid being washed away.
examples.zh: 贻贝牢牢附着在岩石上,以免被冲走。

examples.en: A random mutation may give an animal a small advantage over others.
examples.zh: 随机突变可能让某只动物比其他个体略占优势。

examples.en: International student exchanges can promote mutual understanding between young people.
examples.zh: 国际学生交流可以促进年轻人之间的相互理解。

examples.en: Mutualism occurs when two species both benefit from living closely together.
examples.zh: 当两个物种紧密生活在一起并都受益时,就形成了互利共生。

examples.en: The coral reef is home to a myriad of colourful fish.
examples.zh: 珊瑚礁是无数色彩斑斓的鱼类的家园。

examples.en: The internet offers myriad ways of learning a new language.
examples.zh: 互联网提供了无数种学习新语言的方法。

examples.en: The myth tells how the first people came to live on the island.
examples.zh: 这个神话讲述了最早的人类如何来到岛上生活。

examples.en: It is naive to believe everything that appears on the internet.
examples.zh: 相信网上的一切是很天真的。

examples.en: Many of these stars cannot be seen with the naked eye.
examples.zh: 这些恒星中有许多用肉眼是看不见的。

examples.en: The study focused on two groups, namely farmers and factory workers.
examples.zh: 这项研究聚焦于两个群体,即农民和工厂工人。

examples.en: Nanotechnology may one day allow doctors to deliver drugs directly to cells.
examples.zh: 有朝一日,纳米技术可能让医生把药物直接送到细胞。

examples.en: I usually have a short nap after lunch on Sundays.
examples.zh: 周日午饭后我通常小睡一会儿。

examples.en: The early chapters provide a clear narrative of the voyage.
examples.zh: 开头几章对这次航行作了清晰的叙述。

examples.en: The narrator of the novel is a young girl living in the countryside.
examples.zh: 这部小说的叙述者是住在乡下的小女孩。

examples.en: I think it's narrow-minded to judge people by the way they dress.
examples.zh: 我觉得以衣着评判别人是心胸狭窄的表现。

examples.en: I had a nasty cold last winter and stayed in bed for a week.
examples.zh: 去年冬天我得了重感冒,在床上躺了一周。

examples.en: Visitor numbers to the national park should be limited to protect wildlife.
examples.zh: 应该限制国家公园的游客数量,以保护野生动物。

examples.en: Governments sometimes limit personal freedom for reasons of national security.
examples.zh: 政府有时出于国家安全的原因限制个人自由。

examples.en: Discrimination based on nationality should not be allowed in the workplace.
examples.zh: 工作场所不应允许基于国籍的歧视。

examples.en: Even a native speaker may find this ancient text hard to understand.
examples.zh: 即使是母语者,也可能觉得这篇古文难以理解。

examples.en: Poor countries are often the worst affected by a natural disaster.
examples.zh: 贫穷国家往往受自然灾害的影响最严重。

examples.en: Natural gas produces less carbon dioxide than coal when burned.
examples.zh: 天然气燃烧时产生的二氧化碳比煤少。

examples.en: Zoos cannot fully recreate the natural habitat of these large animals.
examples.zh: 动物园无法完全重现这些大型动物的自然栖息地。

examples.en: Developed countries consume far more than their fair share of natural resources.
examples.zh: 发达国家消耗的自然资源远远超过了它们应得的份额。

examples.en: Through natural selection, the fish developed colours that matched the sea floor.
examples.zh: 通过自然选择,这些鱼进化出了与海底相近的颜色。

examples.en: The debate on nature versus nurture has continued for more than a century.
examples.zh: 关于先天与后天的争论已持续了一个多世纪。

examples.en: Portuguese sailors produced some of the most accurate nautical charts of the time.
examples.zh: 葡萄牙水手绘制了当时最精确的一些航海图。

examples.en: The country's naval forces protect ships from attack in international waters.
examples.zh: 该国海军力量保护船只在国际水域免受袭击。

examples.en: Satellites have made navigation far easier for ships and aircraft.
examples.zh: 卫星使船舶和飞机的导航容易多了。

examples.en: I usually wear a navy jacket to work, because it looks smart.
examples.zh: 我上班通常穿一件藏青色夹克,因为看起来很精神。

examples.en: Nearly seventy percent of households owned a car in 2010.
examples.zh: 2010 年,近百分之七十的家庭拥有汽车。

examples.en: I like to keep my desk neat, or I can't concentrate at all.
examples.zh: 我喜欢保持书桌整洁,否则根本无法集中精力。

examples.en: New stars are formed in a nebula, a huge cloud of gas and dust.
examples.zh: 新恒星在星云中形成,星云是由气体和尘埃组成的巨大云团。

examples.en: The growth of the city will necessitate a new water supply.
examples.zh: 城市的发展使得新的供水系统成为必要。

examples.en: The drought made careful use of water an absolute necessity for farmers.
examples.zh: 干旱使节约用水成为农民的绝对必要之事。

examples.en: Hummingbirds feed on nectar from flowers using their long, thin beaks.
examples.zh: 蜂鸟用又长又细的喙吸食花蜜。

examples.en: Charities provide food and clothing for needy families in the area.
examples.zh: 慈善机构为该地区的贫困家庭提供食物和衣物。

examples.en: The new road had a negative effect on the local bird population.
examples.zh: 新公路对当地鸟类数量产生了负面影响。

examples.en: For many years, governments tended to neglect the needs of rural areas.
examples.zh: 多年来,政府往往忽视农村地区的需求。

examples.en: The hospital was found guilty of negligence after the patient's death.
examples.zh: 患者死亡后,医院被判定有疏忽之责。

examples.en: The two countries negotiated a treaty to share water from the river.
examples.zh: 两国通过谈判达成了一项共享河水的条约。

examples.en: It's a friendly neighbourhood with plenty of shops and a small park.
examples.zh: 这是一个氛围友好的社区,有很多商店和一个小公园。

examples.en: People from neighbouring villages came to trade at the weekly market.
examples.zh: 邻近村庄的人来每周一次的集市上做买卖。

examples.en: Neolithic farmers cleared the forests and began to grow crops here.
examples.zh: 新石器时代的农民在这里清除森林,开始种植庄稼。

examples.en: Neptune takes about 165 Earth years to travel around the Sun.
examples.zh: 海王星绕太阳运行一周大约需要 165 个地球年。

examples.en: A damaged nerve may take many months to grow back.
examples.zh: 受损的神经可能需要数月才能长回来。

examples.en: I always feel nervous before speaking in front of a large group.
examples.zh: 在一大群人面前讲话前,我总是很紧张。

examples.en: Both parents help to build the nest and feed the young birds.
examples.zh: 父母双方都帮忙筑巢和喂养幼鸟。

examples.en: The company has built a network of charging points across the country.
examples.zh: 这家公司在全国建立了充电站网络。

examples.en: Each neuron in the brain can connect with thousands of others.
examples.zh: 大脑中的每个神经元都能与数千个其他神经元相连。

examples.en: Farmers add lime to neutralise the acid in their soil.
examples.zh: 农民加入石灰来中和土壤中的酸。

examples.en: A neutron has about the same mass as a proton but carries no charge.
examples.zh: 中子的质量与质子大致相同,但不带电荷。

examples.en: The evidence is limited; nevertheless, it points in a clear direction.
examples.zh: 证据有限,然而它指向了一个明确的方向。

examples.en: Editors tend to think that bad news is more newsworthy than good news.
examples.zh: 编辑往往认为坏消息比好消息更有新闻价值。

examples.en: The findings fit nicely with what we already know about memory.
examples.zh: 这些发现与我们已知的记忆知识很好地吻合。

examples.en: Each species in the forest occupies its own ecological niche.
examples.zh: 森林中的每个物种都占据着自己的生态位。

examples.en: Nickel is added to steel to make it stronger and harder.
examples.zh: 钢中加入镍可以使它更坚固、更硬。

examples.en: Children may feel hurt if they are given an unkind nickname at school.
examples.zh: 如果在学校被起了难听的绰号,孩子可能会感到受伤。

examples.en: I'm a real night owl, and I rarely go to bed before one o'clock.
examples.zh: 我是个十足的夜猫子,很少在一点前睡觉。

examples.en: Nurses on the night shift start at eight and finish at seven.
examples.zh: 上夜班的护士八点上班,七点下班。

examples.en: The nightlife in my city is great, with lots of bars and live music.
examples.zh: 我们城市的夜生活很棒,有很多酒吧和现场音乐。

examples.en: Stress and anxiety can increase the frequency of a person's nightmares.
examples.zh: 压力和焦虑可能增加一个人做噩梦的频率。

examples.en: Certain plants add nitrogen to the soil and so improve its quality.
examples.zh: 某些植物能给土壤增加氮,从而改善土质。

examples.en: Members of the nobility paid almost no taxes before the revolution.
examples.zh: 革命前,贵族成员几乎不用缴税。

examples.en: Our local museum has a huge painting of a noble family from the past.
examples.zh: 我们当地的博物馆有一幅巨大的画,画的是过去的一个高贵家族。

examples.en: Most bats are nocturnal and sleep in caves during the day.
examples.zh: 大多数蝙蝠是夜行性的,白天在洞穴里睡觉。

examples.en: Each node in the network passes information on to the next.
examples.zh: 网络中的每个节点把信息传递给下一个节点。

examples.en: Noise pollution from aircraft can damage the health of nearby residents.
examples.zh: 飞机造成的噪音污染可能损害附近居民的健康。

examples.en: Each nomad family moved its animals to new grass with the seasons.
examples.zh: 每个游牧家庭都随季节把牲畜迁到新的草场。

examples.en: Nomadic people often travelled long distances in search of food for their animals.
examples.zh: 游牧民族常常长途跋涉,为牲畜寻找食物。

examples.en: Visitors pay only a nominal charge to enter the small museum.
examples.zh: 参观这座小博物馆只需支付象征性的费用。

examples.en: Each party will nominate one candidate to stand for election.
examples.zh: 每个政党将提名一名候选人参加竞选。

examples.en: The president's nominee for the highest court was approved last week.
examples.zh: 总统提名的最高法院人选上周获得批准。

examples.en: Most of the non-fiction section is on the third floor of the library.
examples.zh: 非虚构类图书大多在图书馆四楼。

examples.en: A non-governmental organisation can often respond quickly in an emergency.
examples.zh: 非政府组织在紧急情况下往往能迅速作出反应。

examples.en: Population growth often follows a non-linear pattern over long periods.
examples.zh: 长期来看,人口增长往往呈非线性模式。

examples.en: Non-verbal communication includes facial expressions and the way people stand.
examples.zh: 非言语交流包括面部表情和人们的站姿。

examples.en: The journey was dangerous, but many people chose to make it nonetheless.
examples.zh: 这段旅程很危险,尽管如此,许多人还是选择了出发。

examples.en: Living alone has become the norm for older people in many countries.
examples.zh: 在许多国家,老年人独居已成为一种规范。

examples.en: The new sports hall is in the north-east of the campus.
examples.zh: 新体育馆在校园的东北部。

examples.en: Most of the world's land lies in the northern hemisphere.
examples.zh: 世界上大部分陆地位于北半球。

examples.en: Old songs from my school days always make me feel nostalgic.
examples.zh: 上学时的老歌总让我感到怀旧。

examples.en: One notable feature of this building is its unusual roof.
examples.zh: 这座建筑值得注意的一个特点是不同寻常的屋顶。

examples.en: Some countries, notably Denmark, now produce most of their power from wind.
examples.zh: 一些国家,尤其是丹麦,现在大部分电力来自风能。

examples.en: Modern mathematical notation makes calculations far easier than the older systems.
examples.zh: 现代数学符号让计算比旧系统简单得多。

examples.en: The exam timetable will be put on the notice board outside the office.
examples.zh: 考试时间表会贴在办公室外的布告栏上。

examples.en: Hospitals must notify the authorities of any new cases of the disease.
examples.zh: 医院必须把任何新病例通知有关部门。

examples.en: The notion that intelligence is fixed at birth is no longer widely accepted.
examples.zh: 智力天生固定这一观念已不再被广泛接受。

examples.en: This stretch of coast is notorious for its dangerous rocks and strong currents.
examples.zh: 这段海岸因危险的礁石和湍急的水流而臭名昭著。

examples.en: Notwithstanding these difficulties, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 尽管有这些困难,项目还是提前完成了。

examples.en: Good soup can nourish you when you're getting over a cold.
examples.zh: 感冒快好时,喝点好汤能补充营养。

examples.en: The last novel I read was about a family living on a small island.
examples.zh: 我最近读的一本小说讲的是住在小岛上的一家人。

examples.en: A successful novelist may spend years writing a single book.
examples.zh: 成功的小说家可能花费数年时间写一本书。

examples.en: Even a complete novice can learn to ride a horse in a few lessons.
examples.zh: 即使是完全的新手,上几节课也能学会骑马。

examples.en: Noxious gases from the factory have damaged the health of local people.
examples.zh: 工厂排出的有害气体损害了当地人的健康。

examples.en: Nuclear power produces little carbon dioxide but creates dangerous waste.
examples.zh: 核能产生的二氧化碳很少,但会产生危险的废物。

examples.en: The nuclear family has replaced larger households in most modern cities.
examples.zh: 在大多数现代城市,核心家庭已取代较大的家庭。

examples.en: The nucleus contains most of the mass of an atom.
examples.zh: 原子核包含了原子的大部分质量。

examples.en: The null hypothesis states that the two groups show no real difference.
examples.zh: 零假设认为这两组之间没有真正的差异。

examples.en: My fingers went numb after an hour in the freezing water.
examples.zh: 在冰水里泡了一小时后,我的手指都麻木了。

examples.en: Basic numeracy is essential for managing money in everyday life.
examples.zh: 基本计算能力对日常生活中的理财至关重要。

examples.en: Roman numerals are still used on some clocks and old buildings.
examples.zh: 罗马数字仍用于一些时钟和老建筑上。

examples.en: Government funding for nursery places would help working parents.
examples.zh: 政府资助托儿所名额将帮助在职父母。

examples.en: Some older people feel lonely after moving into a nursing home.
examples.zh: 一些老人搬进养老院后感到孤独。

examples.en: Good teachers nurture the natural abilities of every child in the class.
examples.zh: 好老师会培育班上每个孩子的天赋。

examples.en: Soil loses important nutrients when the same crop is grown every year.
examples.zh: 每年种同一种作物,土壤就会流失重要的营养物。

examples.en: The talk on nutrition will explain how to plan a healthy weekly menu.
examples.zh: 营养讲座会讲解如何规划一周的健康菜单。

examples.en: I've got a light nylon jacket that's great for walking in the rain.
examples.zh: 我有一件轻便的尼龙夹克,很适合雨中行走。

examples.en: Travellers crossing the desert stopped at the oasis for water and shade.
examples.zh: 穿越沙漠的旅行者在绿洲停下来取水和乘凉。

examples.en: Doctors take an oath to protect the health of their patients.
examples.zh: 医生宣誓保护患者的健康。

examples.en: A famous experiment on obedience shocked the public in the 1960s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代,一项著名的服从实验震惊了公众。

examples.en: Traditional schools often valued obedient students more than creative ones.
examples.zh: 传统学校往往更看重顺从的学生,而不是有创造力的学生。

examples.en: Rates of obesity among children have risen sharply in many countries.
examples.zh: 在许多国家,儿童肥胖率急剧上升。

examples.en: Children who learn to obey rules at home tend to behave better at school.
examples.zh: 在家学会遵守规矩的孩子在学校往往表现更好。

examples.en: Many residents object to paying higher taxes for the new stadium.
examples.zh: 许多居民反对为新体育场缴纳更高的税。

examples.en: The main objective of the study is to measure noise levels near schools.
examples.zh: 这项研究的主要目标是测量学校附近的噪音水平。

examples.en: It's hard to stay objective when you're writing about your own family.
examples.zh: 写自己的家人时,很难保持客观。

examples.en: Objective reporting is difficult when journalists have strong political views.
examples.zh: 当记者有强烈的政治观点时,很难做到客观报道。

examples.en: The objectivity of the report was questioned because of who paid for it.
examples.zh: 由于资助方的身份,这份报告的客观性受到质疑。

examples.en: Military service is no longer obligatory in many European countries.
examples.zh: 在许多欧洲国家,服兵役已不再是义务。

examples.en: The word comes from an obscure dialect spoken in the far north.
examples.zh: 这个词来自远北地区一种鲜为人知的方言。

examples.en: Thick clouds often obscure the top of the mountain from view.
examples.zh: 厚厚的云层常常遮住山顶。

examples.en: Our conclusions are based on careful observation of the children at play.
examples.zh: 我们的结论基于对孩子们玩耍时的仔细观察。

examples.en: The new observatory was built on a high mountain with clear skies.
examples.zh: 新天文台建在一座晴空万里的高山上。

examples.en: Researchers observed the behaviour of the monkeys for over ten years.
examples.zh: 研究者观察这些猴子的行为长达十多年。

examples.en: All ships must observe the rules that protect the marine park.
examples.zh: 所有船只都必须遵守保护海洋公园的规定。

examples.en: The modern obsession with thinness can damage young people's health.
examples.zh: 现代人对瘦的痴迷可能损害年轻人的健康。

examples.en: Many skills have become obsolete because of developments in technology.
examples.zh: 由于技术发展,许多技能已被淘汰。

examples.en: Researchers obtained the data from hospitals in three different countries.
examples.zh: 研究者从三个不同国家的医院获得了这些数据。

examples.en: An obtuse angle measures more than ninety degrees.
examples.zh: 钝角大于九十度。

examples.en: The benefits of the new system were not immediately obvious to farmers.
examples.zh: 新系统的好处对农民来说并非立刻就能看出来。

examples.en: People in this occupation often have to work long hours at night.
examples.zh: 从事这种职业的人常常要夜间长时间工作。

examples.en: Farmland occupies the largest area of the town on both maps.
examples.zh: 在两张地图上,农田都占据了该镇最大的面积。

examples.en: Most earthquakes occur along the edges of the Earth's major plates.
examples.zh: 大多数地震发生在地球主要板块的边缘。

examples.en: The old tower has an unusual octagonal base made of local stone.
examples.zh: 这座古塔有一个不寻常的八边形基座,由当地石料砌成。

examples.en: An octopus can change its colour to hide from its enemies.
examples.zh: 章鱼能改变体色来躲避天敌。

examples.en: An odd number cannot be divided into two equal whole numbers.
examples.zh: 奇数不能被分成两个相等的整数。

examples.en: There's a strange odour in the kitchen, so I think something has gone bad.
examples.zh: 厨房里有一股奇怪的气味,我想是有什么东西坏了。

examples.en: Driving while using a mobile phone is a serious offence.
examples.zh: 开车时使用手机是一种严重的违法行为。

examples.en: A young offender should receive education as well as punishment.
examples.zh: 青少年罪犯在接受惩罚的同时也应接受教育。

examples.en: Comments that are offensive to others should be removed from social media.
examples.zh: 冒犯他人的评论应从社交媒体上删除。

examples.en: Planting trees may partly offset the carbon released by air travel.
examples.zh: 植树也许能部分抵消航空旅行排放的碳。

examples.en: Offshore wind farms can produce more power than those built on land.
examples.zh: 近海风电场的发电量可能超过陆上风电场。

examples.en: Sea turtles do not care for their offspring after laying their eggs.
examples.zh: 海龟产卵后不照顾后代。

examples.en: Put this ointment on the burn twice a day until it heals.
examples.zh: 每天在烧伤处涂两次这种药膏,直到痊愈。

examples.en: The early maps omit many of the smaller islands in the region.
examples.zh: 早期地图遗漏了该地区的许多小岛。

examples.en: As an omnivore, the bear eats both meat and a wide range of plants.
examples.zh: 作为杂食动物,熊既吃肉,也吃各种植物。

examples.en: Pigs are omnivorous and will eat almost anything they can find.
examples.zh: 猪是杂食的,几乎什么都吃。

examples.en: Unions negotiate with employers on behalf of their members.
examples.zh: 工会代表成员与雇主谈判。

examples.en: The noise did not harm the birds; on the contrary, they seemed unaffected.
examples.zh: 噪音并没有伤害这些鸟,恰恰相反,它们似乎完全不受影响。

examples.en: Tourism creates jobs; on the other hand, it can damage the environment.
examples.zh: 旅游业创造就业机会;另一方面,它也可能破坏环境。

examples.en: On the whole, I believe that the benefits of technology outweigh its drawbacks.
examples.zh: 总的来说,我认为技术的好处大于坏处。

examples.en: Ongoing research suggests that the drug may also help with memory loss.
examples.zh: 正在进行的研究表明,这种药也可能有助于改善记忆减退。

examples.en: More than half of all purchases in the country are now made online.
examples.zh: 该国现在有一半以上的购买是在网上进行的。

examples.en: With online banking, you can pay your bills from your phone at any time.
examples.zh: 有了网上银行,你可以随时用手机支付账单。

examples.en: Exercise may delay the onset of memory problems in later life.
examples.zh: 运动可能推迟晚年记忆问题的发生。

examples.en: From 2010 onwards, the number of cyclists increased every single year.
examples.zh: 从 2010 年起,骑自行车的人数逐年增加。

examples.en: The water became opaque because of the mud carried by the river.
examples.zh: 由于河水带来的泥沙,水变得不透明了。

examples.en: Travelling abroad has made me much more open-minded about other cultures.
examples.zh: 出国旅行让我对其他文化的态度开明多了。

examples.en: Tickets for the opera are too expensive for many ordinary people.
examples.zh: 歌剧票对许多普通人来说太贵了。

examples.en: My opponent in the final was much taller and had a stronger serve.
examples.zh: 我决赛的对手比我高得多,发球也更有力。

examples.en: Local farmers strongly oppose the plan to build an airport on their land.
examples.zh: 当地农民强烈反对在他们的土地上建机场的计划。

examples.en: The ticket office is directly opposite the main entrance of the park.
examples.zh: 售票处就在公园正门的正对面。

examples.en: Cross the road and wait for the bus on the opposite side.
examples.zh: 过马路,在对面等公交车。

examples.en: Optical fibres carry information around the world at very high speed.
examples.zh: 光纤以极高的速度在全球传输信息。

examples.en: The optician said I needed stronger glasses for reading.
examples.zh: 验光师说我需要度数更高的阅读眼镜。

examples.en: Advances in optics led to the development of better microscopes.
examples.zh: 光学的进步促成了更好的显微镜的发明。

examples.en: The optimal temperature for growing this crop is about twenty-five degrees.
examples.zh: 种植这种作物的最佳温度约为二十五度。

examples.en: I'm an optimist, so I always think that things will get better.
examples.zh: 我是个乐观主义者,总觉得事情会好起来。

examples.en: I'm generally optimistic and try to see the good side of things.
examples.zh: 我总体上很乐观,尽量看到事情好的一面。

examples.en: The field trip is optional, but most students choose to go.
examples.zh: 实地考察是选修的,但大多数学生都会去。

examples.en: These stories were passed down through oral tradition for many generations.
examples.zh: 这些故事通过口头传统流传了许多代。

examples.en: Cicero was a famous Roman orator whose speeches are still studied today.
examples.zh: 西塞罗是著名的罗马演说家,他的演讲至今仍有人研究。

examples.en: The new telescope was placed in orbit high above the Earth.
examples.zh: 新望远镜被送入地球上空的高轨道。

examples.en: The Earth takes about 365 days to orbit the Sun.
examples.zh: 地球绕太阳运行一周大约需要 365 天。

examples.en: Visitors can pick their own apples in the orchard during September.
examples.zh: 九月游客可以在果园里自己摘苹果。

examples.en: The city's orchestra offers free concerts for local school children.
examples.zh: 这座城市的管弦乐队为当地学童提供免费音乐会。

examples.en: Each type of orchid depends on a particular insect for pollination.
examples.zh: 每一种兰花都依赖特定的昆虫授粉。

examples.en: The explorers described their long journey across the ice as a terrible ordeal.
examples.zh: 探险家们把穿越冰原的漫长旅程形容为一场可怕的磨难。

examples.en: The iron ore is transported by train to the port for export.
examples.zh: 铁矿石用火车运到港口出口。

examples.en: The liver is one of the largest organs in the human body.
examples.zh: 肝脏是人体最大的器官之一。

examples.en: The shop sells organic vegetables grown without any chemicals.
examples.zh: 这家店出售不使用任何化学品种植的有机蔬菜。

examples.en: Organised crime often grows in places where the government is weak.
examples.zh: 有组织犯罪往往在政府薄弱的地方滋生。

examples.en: The organisers have moved the race to Sunday because of the weather.
examples.zh: 由于天气原因,组织者把比赛改到了周日。

examples.en: Tiny organisms in the soil help to break down dead plants.
examples.zh: 土壤中的微小生物体有助于分解枯死的植物。

examples.en: New students will get a campus map during orientation week.
examples.zh: 新生会在迎新周拿到校园地图。

examples.en: The origin of the custom is still a matter of debate among historians.
examples.zh: 这个习俗的起源至今仍是历史学家争论的问题。

examples.en: The custom is thought to originate from an ancient harvest festival.
examples.zh: 这一习俗被认为起源于一个古老的丰收节。

examples.en: I keep a little glass ornament from Venice on my bedroom shelf.
examples.zh: 我卧室架子上放着一件来自威尼斯的小玻璃装饰品。

examples.en: His ideas went against the orthodox view of how the disease spread.
examples.zh: 他的想法与这种疾病传播方式的正统观点相悖。

examples.en: The regular oscillation of a pendulum was once used to keep time.
examples.zh: 钟摆有规律的摆动曾被用来计时。

examples.en: Ostentatious displays of wealth can increase envy among poorer people.
examples.zh: 炫耀财富可能加剧较贫穷人群的嫉妒。

examples.en: The ostrich cannot fly, but it can run at very high speed.
examples.zh: 鸵鸟不会飞,但能高速奔跑。

examples.en: The otter uses stones as tools to open shellfish.
examples.zh: 水獭用石头作工具打开贝类。

examples.en: I'm afraid that model is out of stock until next month.
examples.zh: 恐怕那个型号要到下个月才有货。

examples.en: An outbreak of food poisoning closed several restaurants in the town.
examples.zh: 一场食物中毒事件的爆发导致镇上几家餐厅关闭。

examples.en: The outcome of the experiment surprised even the researchers themselves.
examples.zh: 实验结果甚至让研究者本人都感到意外。

examples.en: Much of the country's railway system is now outdated and slow.
examples.zh: 该国大部分铁路系统现在已经过时,而且速度缓慢。

examples.en: I prefer outdoor activities like hiking to going to the gym.
examples.zh: 比起去健身房,我更喜欢徒步这样的户外活动。

examples.en: The outer layer of the skin protects the body from infection.
examples.zh: 皮肤的外层保护身体免受感染。

examples.en: I bought a new outfit for my best friend's wedding last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天,我为最好朋友的婚礼买了一套新衣服。

examples.en: My best friend is really outgoing and can talk to anyone at a party.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友特别外向,在派对上能和任何人聊天。

examples.en: The factory outlet on Mill Road sells last year's coats at half price.
examples.zh: 磨坊路上的工厂直销店半价出售去年款的大衣。

examples.en: There is a power outlet under each desk in the study room.
examples.zh: 自习室每张书桌下面都有一个电源插座。

examples.en: Please show me an outline of your essay before you start writing.
examples.zh: 开始写之前,请给我看一下你的论文大纲。

examples.en: Some people believe that the idea of arranged marriage is outmoded.
examples.zh: 有些人认为包办婚姻的观念已经过时了。

examples.en: Women outnumber men in most university courses in this country.
examples.zh: 在这个国家的大多数大学课程中,女性人数超过男性。

examples.en: The factory's output doubled after the new machines were installed.
examples.zh: 安装新机器后,工厂的产出翻了一番。

examples.en: Local people thought the price charged for water was outrageous.
examples.zh: 当地人认为水价高得令人愤慨。

examples.en: It was clear from the outset that the project would be expensive.
examples.zh: 从一开始就很清楚,这个项目花费会很高。

examples.en: The new hospital is on the outskirts of town, near the motorway.
examples.zh: 新医院在市郊,靠近高速公路。

examples.en: Many companies outsource production to countries where labour is cheaper.
examples.zh: 许多公司把生产外包给劳动力更便宜的国家。

examples.en: My aunt is very outspoken and always says exactly what she thinks.
examples.zh: 我阿姨说话直言不讳,总是想什么就说什么。

examples.en: My favourite mirror is an old oval one that belonged to my grandmother.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的镜子是一面老式椭圆镜,是我奶奶留下的。

examples.en: Overall, the proportion of people living in cities increased over the period.
examples.zh: 总体而言,在此期间城市人口比例有所上升。

examples.en: Engineers had to overcome many difficulties to build the tunnel.
examples.zh: 工程师必须克服许多困难才能建成这条隧道。

examples.en: Overcrowding at historic sites spoils the experience for many visitors.
examples.zh: 历史遗迹的过度拥挤破坏了许多游客的体验。

examples.en: The bank charges a small fee if you go over your overdraft limit.
examples.zh: 如果超出透支额度,银行会收取一小笔费用。

examples.en: You'll have to pay a small charge for any overdue books.
examples.zh: 过期未还的书要交一小笔费用。

examples.en: Drivers tend to overestimate their own ability behind the wheel.
examples.zh: 司机往往高估自己的驾驶能力。

examples.en: Overfishing has greatly reduced the number of cod in the North Sea.
examples.zh: 过度捕捞使北海的鳕鱼数量大幅减少。

examples.en: Lower overheads allow online shops to sell goods at cheaper prices.
examples.zh: 较低的经常性开支让网店能以更便宜的价格销售商品。

examples.en: Overhead power lines are being replaced by underground cables.
examples.zh: 头顶上的电线正在被地下电缆取代。

examples.en: The ranges of the two species overlap in the north of the country.
examples.zh: 这两个物种的分布范围在该国北部重叠。

examples.en: Researchers often overlook the role that women played in early farming.
examples.zh: 研究者常常忽视女性在早期农业中的作用。

examples.en: The ancient fort overlooks the river from the top of a steep hill.
examples.zh: 这座古堡位于陡峭的山顶,俯瞰着河流。

examples.en: More of our customers are now choosing overseas holidays in winter.
examples.zh: 现在越来越多的顾客在冬天选择去海外度假。

examples.en: I'd like to work overseas for a year after I graduate.
examples.zh: 我想毕业后去海外工作一年。

examples.en: A small committee was set up to oversee the work of the project.
examples.zh: 成立了一个小型委员会来监督这个项目的工作。

examples.en: Spain overtook Italy as the most popular destination in 2012.
examples.zh: 2012 年,西班牙超过意大利,成为最受欢迎的目的地。

examples.en: Staff are paid extra for any overtime they do at weekends.
examples.zh: 员工周末加班可获得额外报酬。

examples.en: The first lecture will give you an overview of the whole course.
examples.zh: 第一次讲座将为你概述整门课程。

examples.en: Overweight children are more likely to have health problems as adults.
examples.zh: 超重儿童成年后更容易出现健康问题。

examples.en: There is overwhelming evidence that smoking damages the lungs.
examples.zh: 有压倒性的证据表明吸烟会损害肺部。

examples.en: Owing to the dry climate, very few plants can grow in this region.
examples.zh: 由于气候干燥,这一地区几乎没有植物能够生长。

examples.en: Soft feathers allow the owl to fly almost silently at night.
examples.zh: 柔软的羽毛让猫头鹰夜间飞行时几乎悄无声息。

examples.en: Car ownership has fallen among young people in many large cities.
examples.zh: 在许多大城市,年轻人的汽车拥有率有所下降。

examples.en: Oxidation causes iron to rust when it is exposed to air and water.
examples.zh: 氧化使铁暴露在空气和水中时生锈。

examples.en: Iron will oxidise quickly if it is left in wet conditions.
examples.zh: 铁放在潮湿环境中会很快氧化。

examples.en: Almost all animals need oxygen in order to produce energy.
examples.zh: 几乎所有动物都需要氧气来产生能量。

examples.en: Oysters help to keep the water clean by filtering out small particles.
examples.zh: 牡蛎通过滤除微小颗粒来帮助保持水质清洁。

examples.en: The ozone layer protects life on Earth from harmful radiation from the sun.
examples.zh: 臭氧层保护地球上的生命免受太阳有害辐射的伤害。

examples.en: The pace of technological change has increased dramatically since the 1990s.
examples.zh: 自 20 世纪 90 年代以来,技术变革的速度急剧加快。

examples.en: Once dried, the tea leaves are packaged and transported to shops.
examples.zh: 茶叶干燥后被包装并运往商店。

examples.en: A package tour usually includes your flights, hotel and some meals.
examples.zh: 跟团游通常包含机票、酒店和部分餐食。

examples.en: Supermarkets should reduce the amount of packaging used on their food.
examples.zh: 超市应该减少食品的包装用量。

examples.en: Painting helps me to relax after a long and busy week at work.
examples.zh: 忙碌工作一周后,绘画能帮助我放松。

examples.en: The palace was built with marble brought from far across the empire.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿用从帝国遥远地区运来的大理石建造。

examples.en: The walls in my bedroom are painted a pale shade of green.
examples.zh: 我卧室的墙刷成了浅绿色。

examples.en: Paleolithic people lived in small groups and made tools from stone.
examples.zh: 旧石器时代的人小群体生活,用石头制作工具。

examples.en: The painter used a limited palette of blues and greys.
examples.zh: 这位画家使用了以蓝色和灰色为主的有限调色板。

examples.en: Local people use the leaves of the palm to make baskets and roofs.
examples.zh: 当地人用棕榈叶编篮子和盖屋顶。

examples.en: Parents who pamper their children may make them less independent.
examples.zh: 娇惯孩子的父母可能让孩子变得不那么独立。

examples.en: The health department sent a pamphlet to every home in the region.
examples.zh: 卫生部门向该地区每户家庭发送了一本小册子。

examples.en: A pandemic affects people across many countries at the same time.
examples.zh: 大流行病会同时影响许多国家的人。

examples.en: A panel of three experts will judge the students' projects.
examples.zh: 由三位专家组成的专家组将评审学生的项目。

examples.en: News of the disease caused panic across the country.
examples.zh: 这种疾病的消息引起了全国恐慌。

examples.en: People tend to panic when they do not have clear information.
examples.zh: 人们在没有明确信息时容易恐慌。

examples.en: The paparazzi follow famous people everywhere in search of photographs.
examples.zh: 狗仔队到处跟踪名人,想要拍照。

examples.en: The parade will start at the bridge and finish in the main square.
examples.zh: 游行将从桥边开始,到中心广场结束。

examples.en: The discovery led to a paradigm shift in the way scientists viewed disease.
examples.zh: 这一发现使科学家看待疾病的范式发生了转变。

examples.en: The two rivers run parallel to each other for almost fifty kilometres.
examples.zh: 这两条河平行流淌了近五十公里。

examples.en: There are clear parallels between the fall of Rome and modern events.
examples.zh: 罗马的衰落与现代事件之间有明显的相似之处。

examples.en: A parallelogram has two pairs of sides of equal length.
examples.zh: 平行四边形有两组等长的边。

examples.en: He was left partly paralysed after the accident damaged his spine.
examples.zh: 事故损伤了他的脊柱,使他部分瘫痪。

examples.en: The computer model allows researchers to change each parameter in turn.
examples.zh: 这个计算机模型让研究者可以依次改变每个参数。

examples.en: Safety is of paramount importance in the design of nuclear power stations.
examples.zh: 在核电站设计中,安全是最重要的。

examples.en: Try to paraphrase the author's ideas instead of copying the exact words.
examples.zh: 尽量改述作者的观点,不要照抄原文。

examples.en: The parasite lives inside the fish and slowly weakens it.
examples.zh: 这种寄生虫生活在鱼体内,使它慢慢变得虚弱。

examples.en: A parcel came for you this morning, so I left it in your room.
examples.zh: 今天早上有你的包裹,我放在你房间了。

examples.en: Good parenting involves setting clear limits as well as showing love.
examples.zh: 好的育儿既要有爱,也要设定明确的界限。

examples.en: Each flat comes with one parking space behind the building.
examples.zh: 每套公寓都配有一个位于楼后的停车位。

examples.en: Parliament will vote on the proposed changes to the tax system next week.
examples.zh: 议会下周将就税收制度的修改提案进行投票。

examples.en: He was released on parole after serving half of his sentence.
examples.zh: 他服完一半刑期后获得假释。

examples.en: I have a part-time job in a café at weekends.
examples.zh: 我周末在一家咖啡馆做兼职。

examples.en: The ancient wall has been partially destroyed by centuries of wind and rain.
examples.zh: 几个世纪的风雨已使这堵古墙部分毁坏。

examples.en: All participants must fill in a form before the walk begins.
examples.zh: 所有参与者必须在徒步开始前填写表格。

examples.en: More than two thousand volunteers agreed to participate in the study.
examples.zh: 两千多名志愿者同意参与这项研究。

examples.en: Tiny particles of dust in the air can damage the lungs.
examples.zh: 空气中的微小尘埃颗粒会损害肺部。

examples.en: The city's air quality is particularly poor during the winter months.
examples.zh: 这座城市的空气质量在冬季特别差。

examples.en: Partisan debate makes it difficult to reach agreement on important issues.
examples.zh: 党派争论使重要问题难以达成一致。

examples.en: Thin partitions divide the large office into smaller working areas.
examples.zh: 薄隔断把大办公室分成了较小的工作区。

examples.en: Her passion for science began when she was given a telescope as a child.
examples.zh: 她对科学的激情始于童年时得到的一架望远镜。

examples.en: She's passionate about teaching and spends her weekends preparing lessons.
examples.zh: 她对教学充满激情,周末都在备课。

examples.en: I used to be quite passive in class and never asked any questions.
examples.zh: 我以前上课挺被动的,从不提问。

examples.en: Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months.
examples.zh: 请确保你的护照至少还有六个月有效期。

examples.en: Reading has always been my favourite pastime, especially on rainy days.
examples.zh: 阅读一直是我最喜欢的消遣,尤其是下雨天。

examples.en: The farmer moves the cows to fresh pasture every few days.
examples.zh: 农民每隔几天把牛转移到新的牧场。

examples.en: My jeans have a big patch on one knee, but I still love them.
examples.zh: 我的牛仔裤一条膝盖上有个大补丁,但我还是很喜欢它们。

examples.en: The inventor applied for a patent to protect his new design.
examples.zh: 这位发明家申请了专利,以保护他的新设计。

examples.en: Longer paternity leave would allow fathers to spend more time with their babies.
examples.zh: 更长的陪产假能让父亲有更多时间陪伴婴儿。

examples.en: I felt a bit pathetic crying at the end of that silly film.
examples.zh: 看那部傻乎乎的电影看到结尾哭了,我觉得自己有点可悲。

examples.en: A pathogen may pass from animals to humans through contact or food.
examples.zh: 病原体可能通过接触或食物从动物传给人类。

examples.en: Scientists have identified the pathway by which the virus enters the cell.
examples.zh: 科学家已经确定了病毒进入细胞的途径。

examples.en: My piano teacher is incredibly patient and never gets tired of helping me.
examples.zh: 我的钢琴老师特别有耐心,从不厌烦帮助我。

examples.en: In patriarchal societies, property usually passes from father to son.
examples.zh: 在父权制社会中,财产通常由父亲传给儿子。

examples.en: More officers should patrol the streets on foot to make residents feel safe.
examples.zh: 应该有更多警察步行巡逻街道,让居民感到安全。

examples.en: Wealthy families provided patronage for artists during the Renaissance.
examples.zh: 文艺复兴时期,富裕家族赞助了艺术家。

examples.en: A similar pattern can be seen in the figures for the other two countries.
examples.zh: 另外两个国家的数字也呈现类似的模式。

examples.en: Please don't leave your bike on the pavement outside the shop.
examples.zh: 请不要把自行车停在商店外的人行道上。

examples.en: There's a small pavilion by the lake where you can sit in the shade.
examples.zh: 湖边有一座小亭子,你可以坐在里面乘凉。

examples.en: Governments should pay attention to the problems faced by the elderly.
examples.zh: 政府应该关注老年人面临的问题。

examples.en: Your pay slip shows how much tax you've paid this month.
examples.zh: 你的工资单显示了你这个月缴了多少税。

examples.en: The full amount is payable when you collect the car.
examples.zh: 全部款项在提车时支付。

examples.en: My grandparents live in a peaceful village surrounded by rice fields.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在一个被稻田环绕的宁静村庄。

examples.en: The number of students reached a peak of 5,000 in 2012.
examples.zh: 学生人数在 2012 年达到 5000 人的顶峰。

examples.en: Electricity use peaked at around seven o'clock in the evening.
examples.zh: 用电量在晚上七点左右达到峰值。

examples.en: A pearl forms when an oyster covers a small object with layers of shell.
examples.zh: 牡蛎用一层层贝壳物质包裹小物体时,就形成了珍珠。

examples.en: The average peasant worked long hours and owned very little land.
examples.zh: 普通农民工作时间很长,拥有的土地却很少。

examples.en: The young chicks peck at the shell until it breaks open.
examples.zh: 小鸡不停地啄蛋壳,直到把它啄破。

examples.en: The peculiar shape of the rocks was caused by the wind.
examples.zh: 这些岩石奇特的形状是风造成的。

examples.en: Good pedagogy matters more than expensive equipment in the classroom.
examples.zh: 在课堂上,好的教学法比昂贵的设备更重要。

examples.en: This part of the town centre is open to pedestrians only.
examples.zh: 市中心的这一部分只允许行人通行。

examples.en: Stop at the pedestrian crossing and let people get across the road.
examples.zh: 在人行横道前停车,让行人过马路。

examples.en: The main street was pedestrianised, and cars are no longer allowed.
examples.zh: 主街被改为步行区,不再允许汽车通行。

examples.en: The peel of the fruit contains oils that keep insects away.
examples.zh: 这种水果的果皮含有能驱赶昆虫的油脂。

examples.en: Workers peel the bark from the trees by hand.
examples.zh: 工人们用手剥下树皮。

examples.en: Young children often learn new skills by watching their peers.
examples.zh: 幼儿常常通过观察同龄人学习新技能。

examples.en: Peer pressure is one of the main reasons why teenagers start smoking.
examples.zh: 同伴压力是青少年开始吸烟的主要原因之一。

examples.en: The pelican catches fish in the large pouch under its beak.
examples.zh: 鹈鹕用喙下的大囊袋捕鱼。

examples.en: The country's penal system should focus more on education and training.
examples.zh: 该国的刑罚制度应该更加注重教育和培训。

examples.en: There should be a heavier penalty for driving after drinking alcohol.
examples.zh: 酒后驾车应受到更重的惩罚。

examples.en: Very little sunlight can penetrate to the bottom of the deep ocean.
examples.zh: 很少有阳光能穿透到深海底部。

examples.en: Male emperor penguins keep the eggs warm during the long Antarctic winter.
examples.zh: 在漫长的南极冬季,雄帝企鹅负责为蛋保暖。

examples.en: The peninsula is surrounded by the sea on three sides.
examples.zh: 这个半岛三面环海。

examples.en: The company pays part of your salary into a pension every month.
examples.zh: 公司每月把你工资的一部分存入养老金。

examples.en: Companies should offer every worker a good pension scheme.
examples.zh: 公司应该为每位员工提供良好的养老金计划。

examples.en: Many pensioners struggle to pay for heating during the winter.
examples.zh: 许多领养老金的人在冬天难以负担取暖费。

examples.en: Water use per capita was highest in the United States.
examples.zh: 美国的人均用水量最高。

examples.en: Humans perceive colour through special cells at the back of the eye.
examples.zh: 人类通过眼睛后部的特殊细胞感知颜色。

examples.en: The percentage of households with a computer doubled in only five years.
examples.zh: 拥有电脑的家庭百分比在短短五年内翻了一番。

examples.en: The colour of food can change our perception of its taste.
examples.zh: 食物的颜色会改变我们对味道的感知。

examples.en: Public perception of the risk has changed since the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后,公众对这一风险的看法有所改变。

examples.en: Children enjoy playing percussion in school music lessons.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢在学校音乐课上演奏打击乐器。

examples.en: The students will perform two short plays at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学生们将在期末表演两部短剧。

examples.en: Nurses perform many important tasks that doctors don't have time for.
examples.zh: 护士执行许多医生无暇顾及的重要任务。

examples.en: Tonight's performance begins at half past seven and ends at ten.
examples.zh: 今晚的演出七点半开始,十点结束。

examples.en: I can always tell when my mum has been in a room from her perfume.
examples.zh: 凭香水味,我总能知道妈妈是否来过这个房间。

examples.en: Sailors of that period faced great peril on every long voyage.
examples.zh: 那个时期的水手每次远航都面临巨大的危险。

examples.en: A high wall runs around the entire perimeter of the old city.
examples.zh: 一道高墙环绕着老城的整个周边。

examples.en: Sales rose steadily over the period from 2000 to 2010.
examples.zh: 2000 年到 2010 年期间,销售额稳步上升。

examples.en: Recent periodicals are on the shelves near the main entrance.
examples.zh: 最近几期的期刊放在正门附近的书架上。

examples.en: The issue was once considered peripheral to the main concerns of economists.
examples.zh: 这个问题曾被认为对经济学家的主要关注点而言只是次要的。

examples.en: One of the perks of the job is free lunch in the canteen.
examples.zh: 这份工作的福利之一是在食堂免费吃午饭。

examples.en: Exposure to very loud noise can cause permanent damage to hearing.
examples.zh: 暴露在极大的噪音中可能造成永久性听力损伤。

examples.en: Local laws do not permit building within a hundred metres of the shore.
examples.zh: 当地法律不允许在距海岸一百米以内建房。

examples.en: Visitors must obtain a permit before they enter the protected area.
examples.zh: 游客进入保护区前必须获得许可证。

examples.en: You have to be persistent if you want to learn a musical instrument.
examples.zh: 想学乐器就得坚持不懈。

examples.en: Twin studies suggest that genes play a role in shaping personality.
examples.zh: 双胞胎研究表明,基因在塑造个性方面起着作用。

examples.en: Please hand your forms in to personnel on the second floor.
examples.zh: 请把表格交到三楼的人事部。

examples.en: The book looks at the Industrial Revolution from the perspective of ordinary workers.
examples.zh: 这本书从普通工人的视角审视工业革命。

examples.en: Campaigns have failed to persuade many young people to stop smoking.
examples.zh: 宣传活动未能说服许多年轻人戒烟。

examples.en: The speaker gave a persuasive account of the benefits of learning languages.
examples.zh: 演讲者很有说服力地阐述了学习语言的好处。

examples.en: My friend is a real pessimist who always expects the worst.
examples.zh: 我的朋友是个十足的悲观主义者,总是往最坏处想。

examples.en: I try not to be pessimistic, even when things aren't going very well.
examples.zh: 即使事情不太顺利,我也尽量不悲观。

examples.en: Birds help farmers by eating insect pests that damage crops.
examples.zh: 鸟类吃掉危害庄稼的害虫,从而帮助农民。

examples.en: Some pesticides kill helpful insects as well as those that damage crops.
examples.zh: 有些农药不仅杀死危害庄稼的昆虫,也杀死益虫。

examples.en: Bright petals attract insects to the centre of the flower.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的花瓣把昆虫吸引到花朵中心。

examples.en: More than ten thousand people signed a petition against the new airport.
examples.zh: 一万多人在反对新机场的请愿书上签了名。

examples.en: Over millions of years, minerals can petrify the wood of fallen trees.
examples.zh: 数百万年间,矿物质能使倒下的树木石化。

examples.en: The price of petrol has a direct effect on the cost of transport.
examples.zh: 汽油价格直接影响运输成本。

examples.en: Plastic and many other everyday materials are made from petroleum.
examples.zh: 塑料和许多其他日常材料都是由石油制成的。

examples.en: Most of the crimes in the town were petty thefts of food.
examples.zh: 镇上的大多数犯罪都是偷窃食物这样的小事。

examples.en: Ask the pharmacist if you aren't sure how to take this medicine.
examples.zh: 如果不确定这种药怎么吃,就问问药剂师。

examples.en: The pharmacy next to the station stays open until ten at night.
examples.zh: 车站旁边的药房营业到晚上十点。

examples.en: In the final phase, the finished products are sent to the shops.
examples.zh: 在最后阶段,成品被送往商店。

examples.en: Many governments plan to phase out petrol cars within twenty years.
examples.zh: 许多国家的政府计划在二十年内逐步淘汰汽油车。

examples.en: She's doing a PhD on the history of medicine in Asia.
examples.zh: 她正在攻读亚洲医学史方向的博士学位。

examples.en: Scientists still cannot fully explain this unusual weather phenomenon.
examples.zh: 科学家仍然无法完全解释这种不寻常的天气现象。

examples.en: The Greek philosopher argued that education should develop good citizens.
examples.zh: 这位希腊哲学家认为,教育应该培养好公民。

examples.en: A phobia of spiders can be treated through gradual exposure.
examples.zh: 蜘蛛恐惧症可以通过逐步接触来治疗。

examples.en: Phonetics is the study of how the sounds of speech are produced.
examples.zh: 语音学研究语音是如何发出的。

examples.en: The phonology of the language includes several sounds not found in English.
examples.zh: 这种语言的音系包括几种英语中没有的音。

examples.en: Phosphate from farms can cause harmful changes in lakes and rivers.
examples.zh: 农场流出的磷酸盐可能对湖泊和河流造成有害影响。

examples.en: The photocopier near the entrance only takes coins, not cards.
examples.zh: 入口附近的复印机只收硬币,不能刷卡。

examples.en: You can get a photocopy of the article from the desk upstairs.
examples.zh: 你可以到楼上的服务台复印这篇文章。

examples.en: Please photocopy this chapter and give it to the rest of the group.
examples.zh: 请复印这一章,发给小组其他成员。

examples.en: The photography club meets on Thursdays and often goes out at weekends.
examples.zh: 摄影俱乐部每周四聚会,周末也常外出拍摄。

examples.en: Plants use photosynthesis to turn sunlight and water into energy.
examples.zh: 植物通过光合作用把阳光和水转化为能量。

examples.en: Regular physical exercise can reduce the risk of many serious diseases.
examples.zh: 经常进行体育锻炼可以降低许多严重疾病的风险。

examples.en: Regular walking benefits both physical health and general well-being.
examples.zh: 经常散步对身体健康和整体幸福都有好处。

examples.en: The physician asked about my diet and sent me for a blood test.
examples.zh: 内科医生询问了我的饮食,并让我去验血。

examples.en: The young physicist won an international prize for her work on light.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的物理学家因光学研究获得了一项国际奖项。

examples.en: The laws of physics explain why objects fall towards the ground.
examples.zh: 物理定律解释了物体为什么会向地面坠落。

examples.en: The study of physiology explains how different parts of the body work.
examples.zh: 生理学研究解释了身体各部分如何运作。

examples.en: You'll need physiotherapy twice a week until your knee gets stronger.
examples.zh: 在膝盖恢复力量之前,你每周需要做两次理疗。

examples.en: A pickpocket can quickly steal a wallet in a crowded tourist area.
examples.zh: 在拥挤的旅游区,扒手能迅速偷走钱包。

examples.en: There's a picnic area with tables beside the pond.
examples.zh: 池塘边有一个摆着桌子的野餐区。

examples.en: A pictograph uses a simple picture to represent an object or an idea.
examples.zh: 象形文字用简单的图画表示物体或概念。

examples.en: We stayed in a picturesque village with old stone houses by a river.
examples.zh: 我们住在一个风景如画的村庄,河边都是古老的石屋。

examples.en: You can catch the boat from the end of the pier.
examples.zh: 你可以在栈桥尽头乘船。

examples.en: Pigeons were once used to carry messages over long distances during wars.
examples.zh: 鸽子曾在战争中被用来远距离传递消息。

examples.en: Early painters made pigment from coloured rocks and plants.
examples.zh: 早期的画家用彩色岩石和植物制作颜料。

examples.en: Huge stone pillars support the roof of the ancient temple.
examples.zh: 巨大的石柱支撑着古庙的屋顶。

examples.en: Clean sheets and pillowcases are provided once a week.
examples.zh: 每周提供一次干净的床单和枕套。

examples.en: Never tell anyone your PIN, even if they say they work for the bank.
examples.zh: 绝不要把银行卡密码告诉任何人,即使对方自称是银行员工。

examples.en: Tall pine forests cover the mountains in the north of the country.
examples.zh: 该国北部的山上覆盖着高大的松树林。

examples.en: The guidebook lists every place of interest within an hour of the city.
examples.zh: 指南列出了距离这座城市一小时车程内的所有名胜。

examples.en: Half of the patients were given a placebo instead of the real drug.
examples.zh: 一半的患者服用的是安慰剂,而不是真正的药物。

examples.en: The placebo effect shows that people's beliefs can influence their recovery.
examples.zh: 安慰剂效应表明,人的信念能影响康复。

examples.en: Plagiarism is taken very seriously, and you could be asked to leave the course.
examples.zh: 抄袭的处理非常严肃,你可能会被要求退出课程。

examples.en: The plague killed about a third of the population of Europe in the 1300s.
examples.zh: 14 世纪的瘟疫造成欧洲约三分之一人口死亡。

examples.en: Rising costs continue to plague the national health service.
examples.zh: 不断上升的成本继续困扰着国家医疗服务体系。

examples.en: Huge herds of animals once moved across the open plains of North America.
examples.zh: 曾有大群动物在北美开阔的平原上迁徙。

examples.en: It is plain from the records that the river has changed course several times.
examples.zh: 从记录中可以清楚地看出,这条河曾多次改道。

examples.en: The plaintiff claimed that the company had failed to protect its workers.
examples.zh: 原告称公司未能保护其员工。

examples.en: Two lines on the same flat plane either cross or run side by side.
examples.zh: 同一平面上的两条线要么相交,要么平行。

examples.en: Thousands of commercial planes cross the Atlantic every day.
examples.zh: 每天有数千架商用飞机飞越大西洋。

examples.en: Scientists have found thousands of planets orbiting other stars.
examples.zh: 科学家已经发现了数千颗围绕其他恒星运行的行星。

examples.en: Many whales feed on tiny plankton that float near the surface.
examples.zh: 许多鲸以漂浮在海面附近的微小浮游生物为食。

examples.en: Every planner must think about the long-term effects of new roads.
examples.zh: 每位规划者都必须考虑新道路的长期影响。

examples.en: The company needs planning permission before it can build on the land.
examples.zh: 公司要在这块土地上建房,必须先获得规划许可。

examples.en: Many workers on the sugar plantation lived in very poor conditions.
examples.zh: 糖料种植园的许多工人生活条件非常差。

examples.en: I try not to buy drinks in plastic bottles these days.
examples.zh: 现在我尽量不买塑料瓶装的饮料。

examples.en: A single plastic bag can take hundreds of years to break down.
examples.zh: 一个塑料袋可能需要数百年才能分解。

examples.en: Sales reached a plateau in 2015 and stayed unchanged for three years.
examples.zh: 销售额在 2015 年进入平稳期,此后三年保持不变。

examples.en: Most of the country's people live on a high plateau in the centre.
examples.zh: 该国大部分人口居住在中部的高原上。

examples.en: The train to Manchester will now leave from platform six.
examples.zh: 开往曼彻斯特的列车现在改从六号站台发车。

examples.en: Platinum is a rare metal used in car engines and jewellery.
examples.zh: 铂是一种稀有金属,用于汽车发动机和珠宝。

examples.en: It seems plausible that climate change forced these people to move south.
examples.zh: 气候变化迫使这些人南迁,这种说法似乎有道理。

examples.en: Parents play a role in shaping their children's attitudes towards education.
examples.zh: 父母在塑造孩子对教育的态度方面起着作用。

examples.en: The playwright's works are still performed in theatres around the world.
examples.zh: 这位剧作家的作品至今仍在世界各地的剧院上演。

examples.en: The man decided to plead guilty in the hope of a shorter sentence.
examples.zh: 该男子决定认罪,希望获得较短的刑期。

examples.en: The government made a pledge to reduce carbon emissions by half.
examples.zh: 政府承诺把碳排放量减少一半。

examples.en: The article drew attention to the plight of workers in the textile industry.
examples.zh: 这篇文章使人们开始关注纺织业工人的困境。

examples.en: The plot of the film was so confusing that I got lost halfway through.
examples.zh: 这部电影的情节太混乱了,我看到一半就看不懂了。

examples.en: The invention of the iron plough made it easier to farm heavy soil.
examples.zh: 铁犁的发明使耕种黏重的土壤变得更容易。

examples.en: Farmers used oxen to plough their fields before tractors were invented.
examples.zh: 拖拉机发明之前,农民用牛犁地。

examples.en: My laptop charger has a different plug, so I need an adapter.
examples.zh: 我的笔记本充电器插头不一样,所以需要一个转换器。

examples.en: Just plug the fridge in and wait an hour before using it.
examples.zh: 给冰箱接通电源后,等一小时再用。

examples.en: We called a plumber because water was coming through the kitchen ceiling.
examples.zh: 水从厨房天花板渗下来,所以我们叫了水管工。

examples.en: The value of exports plummeted from 50 million to 10 million dollars.
examples.zh: 出口额从五千万美元暴跌到一千万美元。

examples.en: My grandmother was a plump, smiling woman who loved to cook for us.
examples.zh: 我奶奶是个丰满爱笑的人,很喜欢给我们做饭。

examples.en: The temperature plunges to below zero in the winter months.
examples.zh: 冬季气温骤降到零度以下。

examples.en: In some languages, the plural is shown by repeating the word.
examples.zh: 在一些语言中,复数通过重复单词来表示。

examples.en: Pluto is no longer classed as a full planet by most astronomers.
examples.zh: 大多数天文学家不再把冥王星归为完整的行星。

examples.en: Poaching remains a serious problem for elephants in parts of Africa.
examples.zh: 在非洲部分地区,偷猎仍然是大象面临的严重问题。

examples.en: Children today read far less poetry than previous generations did.
examples.zh: 如今的孩子读的诗歌比前几代人少得多。

examples.en: Critics point out that the policy could harm people on low incomes.
examples.zh: 批评者指出,这项政策可能损害低收入人群。

examples.en: Many workers felt that the new rules were pointless and a waste of time.
examples.zh: 许多工人觉得新规定毫无意义,纯属浪费时间。

examples.en: Burning plastic releases poisonous gases into the air.
examples.zh: 焚烧塑料会向空气中释放有毒气体。

examples.en: Polar bears depend on sea ice for hunting seals.
examples.zh: 北极熊依靠海冰来捕猎海豹。

examples.en: A policy of free public transport could reduce traffic in city centres.
examples.zh: 免费公共交通政策可以减少市中心的交通流量。

examples.en: Every policymaker should consider the long-term effects of new laws.
examples.zh: 每位决策者都应该考虑新法律的长期影响。

examples.en: Young people should take more interest in political issues.
examples.zh: 年轻人应该更关注政治问题。

examples.en: A politician should be judged on actions rather than promises.
examples.zh: 评价政治家应该看行动,而不是承诺。

examples.en: Bees carry pollen from one flower to another as they feed.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂采食时把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花。

examples.en: Many fruit trees depend on bees to pollinate their flowers.
examples.zh: 许多果树依靠蜜蜂为花朵授粉。

examples.en: Without pollination by insects, many fruit crops would produce far less food.
examples.zh: 如果没有昆虫授粉,许多果树的产量会大幅减少。

examples.en: Factories should be required to reduce the pollutants they release into rivers.
examples.zh: 应要求工厂减少排入河流的污染物。

examples.en: Factories that pollute rivers should have to pay for the clean-up.
examples.zh: 污染河流的工厂应该支付清理费用。

examples.en: Children living in polluted cities are more likely to suffer from asthma.
examples.zh: 生活在污染城市的孩子更容易患哮喘。

examples.en: Pollution from factories is damaging rivers and lakes across the region.
examples.zh: 工厂造成的污染正在破坏该地区的河流和湖泊。

examples.en: A polygon is a flat shape with three or more straight sides.
examples.zh: 多边形是有三条或更多直边的平面图形。

examples.en: Plastic is a polymer made up of long chains of smaller molecules.
examples.zh: 塑料是由较小分子形成的长链构成的聚合物。

examples.en: There are ducks on the pond in front of the old farmhouse.
examples.zh: 老农舍前的池塘里有鸭子。

examples.en: She usually ties her hair back in a ponytail when she goes running.
examples.zh: 她跑步时通常把头发扎成马尾辫。

examples.en: I mostly listened to pop music when I was a teenager.
examples.zh: 我十几岁时主要听流行音乐。

examples.en: Television programmes helped to popularise science among ordinary people.
examples.zh: 电视节目帮助在普通人中普及科学。

examples.en: Tokyo has a very high population density compared with most other cities.
examples.zh: 与大多数其他城市相比,东京的人口密度非常高。

examples.en: Rapid population growth puts pressure on food and water supplies.
examples.zh: 人口快速增长给食物和水的供应带来压力。

examples.en: My grandmother has a set of fine porcelain cups she never uses.
examples.zh: 我奶奶有一套精美的瓷杯,她从来不用。

examples.en: You can leave the parcel in the porch if nobody answers the door.
examples.zh: 如果没人应门,可以把包裹放在门廊里。

examples.en: Parents worry about their children finding pornography on the internet.
examples.zh: 父母担心孩子在互联网上看到色情内容。

examples.en: The porpoise is smaller than most dolphins and has a shorter nose.
examples.zh: 鼠海豚比大多数海豚小,吻部也更短。

examples.en: I bought a portable speaker to take to the beach with my friends.
examples.zh: 我买了一个便携音箱,和朋友带去海滩用。

examples.en: Art students must hand in a portfolio of their work by Friday.
examples.zh: 艺术专业的学生必须在周五前提交作品集。

examples.en: Her investment portfolio includes shares in several large companies.
examples.zh: 她的投资组合包括几家大公司的股票。

examples.en: The portions here are huge, so one dish is enough for two people.
examples.zh: 这里的分量很大,一道菜够两个人吃。

examples.en: A portrait of the queen hangs in the main hall of the museum.
examples.zh: 博物馆大厅里挂着一幅女王的肖像。

examples.en: Television programmes often portray older people in a negative way.
examples.zh: 电视节目常常以负面的方式描绘老年人。

examples.en: Plastic waste poses a serious danger to sea birds and turtles.
examples.zh: 塑料垃圾对海鸟和海龟构成严重危险。

examples.en: We're looking to fill the position of sales assistant by next month.
examples.zh: 我们希望在下个月前招到销售助理这个职位的人选。

examples.en: From this position on the hill, you can see the whole town.
examples.zh: 从山上这个位置,你能看到整个小镇。

examples.en: Regular contact with nature has a positive effect on mental health.
examples.zh: 经常接触大自然对心理健康有积极影响。

examples.en: Possession of land was the main source of power in medieval society.
examples.zh: 在中世纪社会,拥有土地是权力的主要来源。

examples.en: Could you give me your postcode so I can find the address?
examples.zh: 能告诉我你的邮编吗?这样我好查地址。

examples.en: These recordings were made to preserve the language for posterity.
examples.zh: 这些录音是为了给后代保存这种语言。

examples.en: Postgraduate students have their own study room on the fourth floor.
examples.zh: 研究生在五楼有自己的自习室。

examples.en: We've had to postpone the meeting until next Thursday.
examples.zh: 我们不得不把会议推迟到下周四。

examples.en: Sitting at a computer all day can give you bad posture.
examples.zh: 整天坐在电脑前会让你姿势不良。

examples.en: Bananas are a good source of potassium, which is important for the heart.
examples.zh: 香蕉是钾的良好来源,而钾对心脏很重要。

examples.en: The potential benefits of the new treatment are still being studied.
examples.zh: 这种新疗法的潜在益处仍在研究之中。

examples.en: Tidal energy has great potential as a clean source of electricity.
examples.zh: 潮汐能作为清洁电力来源具有巨大潜力。

examples.en: In the pottery class, you'll learn to make your own bowls and cups.
examples.zh: 在陶艺课上,你将学习制作自己的碗和杯子。

examples.en: The butcher sells beef and lamb as well as poultry from local farms.
examples.zh: 这家肉店卖牛羊肉,也卖来自当地农场的禽肉。

examples.en: Education is one of the most effective ways of reducing poverty.
examples.zh: 教育是减少贫穷最有效的方法之一。

examples.en: The rock is crushed into a fine powder and mixed with water.
examples.zh: 岩石被碾成细粉,然后与水混合。

examples.en: The old power station burned coal brought in by train.
examples.zh: 这座旧发电站燃烧由火车运来的煤。

examples.en: The method works well in theory but has few practical uses.
examples.zh: 这种方法理论上很好,但实际用途很少。

examples.en: Local leaders took a pragmatic approach and worked with both sides.
examples.zh: 当地领导人采取了务实的做法,与双方都展开合作。

examples.en: Much of the original prairie has now been turned into wheat fields.
examples.zh: 大部分原始草原如今已变成麦田。

examples.en: Coastal forests have been cleared to make way for prawn farms.
examples.zh: 沿海森林被砍伐,为对虾养殖场腾出空间。

examples.en: Travelling monks would preach to people in towns along the road.
examples.zh: 云游的修道士会向沿途城镇的人布道。

examples.en: Hospitals take every precaution to prevent infections from spreading between patients.
examples.zh: 医院采取一切预防措施,防止感染在病人之间传播。

examples.en: Changes in animal behaviour may precede a major earthquake by several days.
examples.zh: 动物行为的变化可能先于大地震几天出现。

examples.en: The court's decision set an important precedent for future cases.
examples.zh: 法院的这项裁决为今后的案件树立了重要先例。

examples.en: Precipitation in the mountains falls mainly as snow in winter.
examples.zh: 山区的降水在冬季主要以雪的形式出现。

examples.en: Modern clocks allow scientists to make extremely precise measurements of time.
examples.zh: 现代时钟让科学家能够极其精确地测量时间。

examples.en: My niece is a precocious child who could read before she started school.
examples.zh: 我的侄女是个早熟的孩子,上学前就会读书了。

examples.en: Sharp eyesight helps the bird to escape from its main predators.
examples.zh: 敏锐的视力帮助这种鸟逃避主要的捕食者。

examples.en: Some predatory fish hunt in groups to catch larger animals.
examples.zh: 一些捕食性鱼类成群捕猎,以捕捉较大的动物。

examples.en: The new model uses far less fuel than its predecessor.
examples.zh: 新型号比它的前身省油得多。

examples.en: It is still impossible to predict exactly when an earthquake will occur.
examples.zh: 目前仍然无法准确预测地震发生的时间。

examples.en: Rice is the predominant crop in the wet southern part of the country.
examples.zh: 水稻是该国潮湿南部的主要作物。

examples.en: The workforce in the factory was predominantly female until the 1950s.
examples.zh: 直到 20 世纪 50 年代,这家工厂的工人主要是女性。

examples.en: Babies show a clear preference for faces over other objects.
examples.zh: 婴儿明显更喜欢看人脸,而不是其他物体。

examples.en: Pregnant women shouldn't take this medicine without asking a doctor.
examples.zh: 孕妇未经医生同意不应服用这种药。

examples.en: Prehistoric people painted animals on the walls of the caves.
examples.zh: 史前人类在洞穴的墙壁上画动物。

examples.en: Education is one of the best ways to fight prejudice against other groups.
examples.zh: 教育是消除对其他群体偏见的最好方法之一。

examples.en: Preliminary results suggest that the treatment may be effective in most patients.
examples.zh: 初步结果表明,这种疗法可能对大多数患者有效。

examples.en: The film's premiere attracted a large crowd of fans to the city.
examples.zh: 这部电影的首映吸引了大批影迷来到这座城市。

examples.en: The theory rests on the premise that all languages share a basic structure.
examples.zh: 这一理论有一个前提:所有语言都有相同的基本结构。

examples.en: The insurance premium goes up each year as you get older.
examples.zh: 保险费会随着年龄增长逐年上涨。

examples.en: Premium seats cost more, but they have a much better view of the stage.
examples.zh: 优质座位更贵,但看舞台的视野好得多。

examples.en: Basic statistics is a prerequisite for this research methods course.
examples.zh: 基础统计学是这门研究方法课的先修课程。

examples.en: Preschool education helps young children to develop social and language skills.
examples.zh: 学龄前教育帮助幼儿发展社交和语言能力。

examples.en: You can't buy this medicine without a prescription from your doctor.
examples.zh: 没有医生的处方,你买不到这种药。

examples.en: Each group will give a ten-minute presentation at the end of the course.
examples.zh: 每个小组将在课程结束时做十分钟的展示。

examples.en: The preservation of old forests should be a priority for every government.
examples.zh: 保护古老森林应该是每个政府的优先事项。

examples.en: Some people avoid any food containing a chemical preservative.
examples.zh: 有些人避免吃含有化学防腐剂的任何食品。

examples.en: The cold, dry air of the cave helped to preserve the paintings.
examples.zh: 洞穴寒冷干燥的空气有助于保存这些壁画。

examples.en: A free press is essential to any healthy democracy.
examples.zh: 自由的新闻界对任何健康的民主国家都必不可少。

examples.en: Simply press the button to speak to a member of staff.
examples.zh: 只需按下按钮,就能和工作人员通话。

examples.en: The minister announced the new policy at a press conference this morning.
examples.zh: 部长今天上午在新闻发布会上宣布了新政策。

examples.en: Water pressure increases rapidly as you go deeper into the ocean.
examples.zh: 越往海洋深处,水压增加得越快。

examples.en: Many people choose medicine because of the prestige of the profession.
examples.zh: 许多人选择学医是因为这个职业的声望。

examples.en: She won a place at one of the country's most prestigious universities.
examples.zh: 她考上了全国最有声望的大学之一。

examples.en: The tools were found by the river, presumably because people fished there.
examples.zh: 这些工具是在河边发现的,大概是因为人们在那里捕鱼。

examples.en: Without written records, we can only presume that the building had a religious purpose.
examples.zh: 由于没有文字记录,我们只能推测这座建筑有宗教用途。

examples.en: Some people find modern art pretentious and difficult to understand.
examples.zh: 有些人觉得现代艺术自命不凡,难以理解。

examples.en: The prevailing view at the time was that bad air caused the illness.
examples.zh: 当时盛行的观点是这种疾病由污浊的空气引起。

examples.en: The prevalence of mobile phones has changed how young people spend their time.
examples.zh: 手机的盛行改变了年轻人度过时间的方式。

examples.en: This disease is more prevalent in hot and humid parts of the world.
examples.zh: 这种疾病在世界上炎热潮湿的地区更普遍。

examples.en: Washing hands regularly helps to prevent the spread of infection.
examples.zh: 经常洗手有助于防止感染传播。

examples.en: Preventive medicine is cheaper than treating diseases at a later stage.
examples.zh: 预防性医疗比在后期治疗疾病更便宜。

examples.en: The fossils belong to a species that was previously unknown to science.
examples.zh: 这些化石属于一个此前科学界未知的物种。

examples.en: Owls can locate their prey by sound alone, even in total darkness.
examples.zh: 即使在完全黑暗中,猫头鹰也能仅凭声音确定猎物的位置。

examples.en: These large cats prey mainly on deer and wild pigs.
examples.zh: 这些大型猫科动物主要捕食鹿和野猪。

examples.en: My childhood photos are priceless to me, so I keep them safe.
examples.zh: 童年的照片对我来说是无价的,所以我小心保管。

examples.en: That café is a bit pricey, but the coffee is really good.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡馆有点贵,但咖啡确实很好喝。

examples.en: This species feeds primarily on insects found under the bark of trees.
examples.zh: 这种动物主要以树皮下的昆虫为食。

examples.en: Foreign languages should be taught from the first year of primary school.
examples.zh: 外语应该从小学一年级开始教。

examples.en: Humans share many social behaviours with other primates, such as chimpanzees.
examples.zh: 人类与黑猩猩等其他灵长类动物有许多相同的社会行为。

examples.en: Advertisements during prime time reach the largest number of viewers.
examples.zh: 黄金时段的广告能触达最多的观众。

examples.en: The first boats were primitive structures made from hollow logs.
examples.zh: 最早的船是用空心原木做成的简陋结构。

examples.en: The principal of the college will welcome new students on Monday.
examples.zh: 学院院长周一将欢迎新生。

examples.en: The principal reason for the delay was a shortage of staff.
examples.zh: 延误的主要原因是人手不足。

examples.en: The experiment is based on a simple principle of physics.
examples.zh: 这个实验基于一条简单的物理学原理。

examples.en: Fairness is a basic principle of any good legal system.
examples.zh: 公平是任何良好法律体系的基本原则。

examples.en: The printer on the second floor has run out of paper again.
examples.zh: 三楼的打印机又没纸了。

examples.en: Few people in the area could read prior to the opening of the school.
examples.zh: 学校开办之前,当地很少有人识字。

examples.en: Governments should prioritise education and health over military spending.
examples.zh: 政府应该优先考虑教育和医疗,而不是军费开支。

examples.en: Improving public health should be the top priority of any government.
examples.zh: 改善公共卫生应该是任何政府的首要事项。

examples.en: Sending young people to prison may make them more likely to reoffend.
examples.zh: 把年轻人送进监狱可能使他们更容易再次犯罪。

examples.en: Every prisoner should have the chance to learn new skills for life after release.
examples.zh: 每个囚犯都应有机会学习新技能,为出狱后的生活做准备。

examples.en: Many people worry about their privacy when they use social media.
examples.zh: 许多人使用社交媒体时担心隐私问题。

examples.en: Families who choose a private school often pay very high fees.
examples.zh: 选择私立学校的家庭往往要支付很高的费用。

examples.en: The private sector can often provide these services more efficiently.
examples.zh: 私营部门往往能更高效地提供这些服务。

examples.en: Education should be a basic right rather than a privilege of the rich.
examples.zh: 教育应该是基本权利,而不是富人的特权。

examples.en: The probability of a major earthquake in the next decade is quite high.
examples.zh: 未来十年发生大地震的概率相当高。

examples.en: All new staff are on probation for their first three months.
examples.zh: 所有新员工前三个月都处于试用期。

examples.en: The space probe sent back the first close-up pictures of the planet.
examples.zh: 这个太空探测器传回了这颗行星的第一批近距离照片。

examples.en: Researchers used sound waves to probe the structure of the ocean floor.
examples.zh: 研究者用声波探查海底的结构。

examples.en: Group projects are an excellent way of teaching problem-solving skills.
examples.zh: 小组项目是培养解决问题能力的极好方法。

examples.en: Comparing data from different countries can be problematic for researchers.
examples.zh: 比较不同国家的数据对研究者来说可能有问题。

examples.en: The researchers followed the same procedure for every participant in the study.
examples.zh: 研究者对每位参与者都采用了相同的程序。

examples.en: Learning a language is a slow process that requires regular practice.
examples.zh: 学习语言是一个缓慢的过程,需要经常练习。

examples.en: The brain can process images far more quickly than written words.
examples.zh: 大脑处理图像的速度远远快于处理文字。

examples.en: A diet high in processed food can lead to serious health problems.
examples.zh: 大量食用加工食品可能导致严重的健康问题。

examples.en: A faster processor allows the phone to run several programs at once.
examples.zh: 更快的处理器让手机能同时运行多个程序。

examples.en: The new government was quick to proclaim the country's independence.
examples.zh: 新政府很快就宣告了国家独立。

examples.en: I tend to procrastinate when I have a big piece of work to do.
examples.zh: 有一大堆工作要做时,我往往会拖延。

examples.en: The country is the world's largest producer of coffee.
examples.zh: 这个国家是世界上最大的咖啡生产国。

examples.en: New technology has greatly increased productivity in the farming sector.
examples.zh: 新技术大大提高了农业部门的生产率。

examples.en: Teaching is a profession that requires both knowledge and patience.
examples.zh: 教学是一种既需要知识又需要耐心的职业。

examples.en: Professional training should be available to workers throughout their lives.
examples.zh: 工人应该终身都能接受专业培训。

examples.en: Health professionals have warned about the dangers of too much sugar.
examples.zh: 医疗专业人士警告过量摄入糖的危害。

examples.en: Professor Lee will give the opening talk at the conference.
examples.zh: 李教授将在会议上作开场发言。

examples.en: A high level of proficiency in English can open many doors.
examples.zh: 高水平的英语熟练度能打开许多大门。

examples.en: Update your online profile so that employers can see your experience.
examples.zh: 更新你的网上简介,让雇主能看到你的经历。

examples.en: The company made a large profit from selling its products overseas.
examples.zh: 这家公司在海外销售产品获得了巨额利润。

examples.en: The new product line has proved highly profitable for the company.
examples.zh: 事实证明,新产品线为公司带来了丰厚的利润。

examples.en: The invention of writing had a profound effect on human society.
examples.zh: 文字的发明对人类社会产生了深远影响。

examples.en: The evening's programme is printed on the back of your ticket.
examples.zh: 当晚的节目单印在你的门票背面。

examples.en: A good programmer can find well-paid work almost anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 优秀的程序员几乎可以在世界任何地方找到高薪工作。

examples.en: Regular exercise may slow the progression of the disease in older patients.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼可能减缓老年患者的病情发展。

examples.en: The city was known for its progressive attitude towards women's education.
examples.zh: 这座城市以对女性教育的进步态度而闻名。

examples.en: The illness causes a progressive loss of memory over many years.
examples.zh: 这种疾病会在多年间造成记忆力的渐进性衰退。

examples.en: The law prohibits the sale of these birds and their eggs.
examples.zh: 法律禁止出售这些鸟及其蛋。

examples.en: Our group project is about recycling in the local community.
examples.zh: 我们的小组项目是关于当地社区的垃圾回收。

examples.en: According to projections, the population will reach ten million by 2050.
examples.zh: 据预测,到 2050 年人口将达到一千万。

examples.en: Bacteria can proliferate quickly in warm and wet conditions.
examples.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中能迅速繁殖。

examples.en: Rabbits are prolific breeders and can quickly take over new areas.
examples.zh: 兔子繁殖力极强,能迅速占领新地区。

examples.en: Women played a prominent role in the early history of the movement.
examples.zh: 女性在这场运动的早期历史中发挥了突出的作用。

examples.en: Regular walking can promote better sleep and a healthier heart.
examples.zh: 经常散步可以促进睡眠,让心脏更健康。

examples.en: She was promoted to head of the department after only three years.
examples.zh: 仅仅三年后,她就被提拔为部门负责人。

examples.en: He got a promotion after only two years with the company.
examples.zh: 他进公司才两年就升职了。

examples.en: The shop is running a special promotion on sports shoes this week.
examples.zh: 这家店本周正在做运动鞋的特别促销。

examples.en: Women often have worse promotion prospects than men in the same jobs.
examples.zh: 女性的晋升机会常常比同岗位的男性差。

examples.en: The pronunciation of many English words has changed since Shakespeare's time.
examples.zh: 自莎士比亚时代以来,许多英语单词的发音都发生了变化。

examples.en: So far, scientists have found no proof of life on other planets.
examples.zh: 到目前为止,科学家还没有找到其他星球存在生命的证明。

examples.en: A recent gas bill can be used as proof of address.
examples.zh: 最近的煤气费账单可以用作地址证明。

examples.en: Governments have often used propaganda to win support during wars.
examples.zh: 政府经常在战争期间利用宣传赢得支持。

examples.en: Gardeners often propagate this plant by cutting and replanting its stems.
examples.zh: 园丁常通过扦插茎来繁殖这种植物。

examples.en: The ship's large propeller is driven by a powerful diesel engine.
examples.zh: 这艘船的大螺旋桨由强力柴油发动机驱动。

examples.en: The prophet is said to have warned the people about the coming flood.
examples.zh: 据说这位先知曾警告人们洪水即将来临。

examples.en: The proportion of women in the workforce rose from 30 to 45 percent.
examples.zh: 劳动力中女性的比例从百分之三十上升到百分之四十五。

examples.en: You must hand in your research proposal to your tutor by March.
examples.zh: 你必须在三月前把研究开题报告交给导师。

examples.en: The author proposes a new way of measuring happiness across different countries.
examples.zh: 作者提出了一种衡量不同国家幸福感的新方法。

examples.en: The police decided not to prosecute the driver because of a lack of evidence.
examples.zh: 由于证据不足,警方决定不起诉这名司机。

examples.en: You can order a free prospectus from the college's website.
examples.zh: 你可以在学院网站上免费索取招生简章。

examples.en: The new railway brought prosperity to towns along the coast.
examples.zh: 新铁路给沿海城镇带来了繁荣。

examples.en: The town became prosperous through its trade in wool.
examples.zh: 这座城镇通过羊毛贸易变得繁荣起来。

examples.en: The protagonist of the book is a young girl who runs away from home.
examples.zh: 这本书的主人公是一个离家出走的小女孩。

examples.en: Thick fur protects the animal from the extreme cold of the Arctic.
examples.zh: 厚厚的皮毛保护这种动物免受北极的严寒。

examples.en: Beans are a cheap source of protein for people who don't eat meat.
examples.zh: 对不吃肉的人来说,豆类是便宜的蛋白质来源。

examples.en: Thousands of students joined the protest against higher university fees.
examples.zh: 数千名学生参加了反对提高大学学费的抗议。

examples.en: Local people protested against the plan to close the village school.
examples.zh: 当地人抗议关闭村校的计划。

examples.en: Every doctor must follow a strict safety protocol when handling the virus.
examples.zh: 每位医生处理这种病毒时都必须遵守严格的安全规程。

examples.en: A proton carries a positive charge and is found in the centre of an atom.
examples.zh: 质子带正电荷,位于原子中心。

examples.en: Engineers tested the prototype for several months before starting production.
examples.zh: 工程师对原型测试了几个月才开始生产。

examples.en: I felt so proud when my son won a prize at school.
examples.zh: 我儿子在学校获奖时,我感到非常自豪。

examples.en: The species can survive, provided that its habitat is protected.
examples.zh: 只要栖息地得到保护,这个物种就能存活下来。

examples.en: Provincial governments have been given more control over health spending.
examples.zh: 省级政府获得了对医疗支出更大的控制权。

examples.en: These figures are provisional and may be changed when more data arrives.
examples.zh: 这些数字是临时的,更多数据到来后可能会更改。

examples.en: The plan to close the hospital provoked angry protests from local residents.
examples.zh: 关闭医院的计划引起了当地居民的愤怒抗议。

examples.en: Many early towns grew up because of their proximity to rivers.
examples.zh: 许多早期城镇因靠近河流而发展起来。

examples.en: Scientists dismissed the claims about crystal healing as pseudoscience.
examples.zh: 科学家把水晶疗法的说法斥为伪科学。

examples.en: Many patients with psychiatric problems also suffer from poor physical health.
examples.zh: 许多有精神问题的患者身体健康状况也较差。

examples.en: The psychologist asked children to wait alone before eating a sweet.
