examples.zh: 这位心理学家让孩子们独自等待一段时间再吃糖。

examples.en: Studies in psychology show that people often copy those around them.
examples.zh: 心理学研究表明,人们常常模仿周围的人。

examples.en: Governments should raise public awareness of the dangers of a poor diet.
examples.zh: 政府应该提高公众对不良饮食危害的认识。

examples.en: Improving public health should be a priority for every government.
examples.zh: 改善公共卫生应该是每个政府的优先事项。

examples.en: Public money should not be spent on art when hospitals need more staff.
examples.zh: 医院还需要更多人手时,公共资金不应该花在艺术上。

examples.en: Pay in the public sector is often lower than in private companies.
examples.zh: 公共部门的工资通常低于私营公司。

examples.en: Higher taxes are needed to pay for better public services.
examples.zh: 需要提高税收来支付更好的公共服务。

examples.en: Good public space encourages people to spend more time outdoors.
examples.zh: 良好的公共空间鼓励人们更多地待在户外。

examples.en: Cheap public transport can reduce the number of cars on the road.
examples.zh: 便宜的公共交通可以减少路上的汽车数量。

examples.en: The publication of the report led to a public debate on school meals.
examples.zh: 这份报告的发表引发了关于学校午餐的公众讨论。

examples.en: The company gained a great deal of publicity from the charity event.
examples.zh: 这家公司通过这次慈善活动获得了大量宣传。

examples.en: The publisher has agreed to print a cheaper version for students.
examples.zh: 出版商同意为学生印刷更便宜的版本。

examples.en: With a pulley, workers could raise heavy stones to the top of the wall.
examples.zh: 利用滑轮,工人能把沉重的石头吊到墙顶。

examples.en: The nurse took my pulse and told me to sit down for a while.
examples.zh: 护士给我量了脉搏,让我坐下休息一会儿。

examples.en: Water is pumped from the river to a large tank on the hill.
examples.zh: 水从河里被抽送到山上的大水箱。

examples.en: A small electric pump moves the water through the pipes.
examples.zh: 一台小型电泵把水输送到管道中。

examples.en: He was sent off for trying to punch another player during the game.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中试图拳击另一名球员,被罚下场。

examples.en: The driver will punch your ticket when you get on the bus.
examples.zh: 上车时司机会给你的车票打孔。

examples.en: I try to be punctual, because I hate keeping other people waiting.
examples.zh: 我尽量守时,因为我讨厌让别人等。

examples.en: Experts believe that physical punishment does little to improve behaviour.
examples.zh: 专家认为体罚对改善行为几乎没有帮助。

examples.en: The insect stays inside the pupa for about two weeks before it appears.
examples.zh: 这种昆虫在蛹内待大约两周才出来。

examples.en: Each pupil should have the chance to take part in sports at school.
examples.zh: 每个学生都应该有机会在学校参加体育活动。

examples.en: The children loved the puppet show at the library on Saturday.
examples.zh: 孩子们很喜欢周六在图书馆看的木偶戏表演。

examples.en: Children can learn the art of puppetry at the Saturday workshop.
examples.zh: 孩子们可以在周六的工作坊学习木偶戏艺术。

examples.en: You can return any purchase within thirty days if you have the receipt.
examples.zh: 凭收据,任何购买的商品三十天内都可以退货。

examples.en: Customers can purchase tickets online or at the door on the night.
examples.zh: 顾客可以在网上购票,也可以当晚在门口购买。

examples.en: Rising prices have reduced the purchasing power of ordinary families.
examples.zh: 物价上涨降低了普通家庭的购买力。

examples.en: The cave contains pure water that has been filtered through the rock.
examples.zh: 洞穴里有经过岩石过滤的纯净水。

examples.en: The decision to close the school was made for purely financial reasons.
examples.zh: 关闭学校的决定完全是出于财务原因。

examples.en: The purity of the water is tested every day at the treatment plant.
examples.zh: 水处理厂每天检测水的纯净度。

examples.en: More women are now choosing to pursue careers in engineering.
examples.zh: 现在越来越多的女性选择从事工程类职业。

examples.en: Several solutions have been put forward to deal with the housing shortage.
examples.zh: 针对住房短缺,人们提出了几种解决办法。

examples.en: Many young couples put off having children for financial reasons.
examples.zh: 许多年轻夫妇因经济原因推迟生育。

examples.en: I do a crossword puzzle in the newspaper every morning on the train.
examples.zh: 我每天早上在火车上做报纸上的填字谜题。

examples.en: It puzzles me why people spend so much money on designer clothes.
examples.zh: 我不明白人们为什么花这么多钱买名牌衣服。

examples.en: Thousands of workers were needed to build each pyramid in Egypt.
examples.zh: 在埃及,建造每座金字塔都需要数千名工人。

examples.en: You don't need any special qualifications to work in our shop.
examples.zh: 在我们店工作不需要任何特殊的资格。

examples.en: Every school needs enough qualified teachers in science and mathematics.
examples.zh: 每所学校都需要足够的合格的科学和数学教师。

examples.en: The team collected qualitative data through long interviews with local farmers.
examples.zh: 研究团队通过与当地农民的长时间访谈收集了定性数据。

examples.en: It is hard to quantify the benefits of spending time in nature.
examples.zh: 亲近自然的益处很难量化。

examples.en: The quantity of goods moved by rail remained the same.
examples.zh: 铁路运输的货物数量保持不变。

examples.en: Stone for the cathedral was brought from a quarry about ten miles away.
examples.zh: 建造大教堂的石料来自约十英里外的一个采石场。

examples.en: Almost a quarter of the budget was spent on education.
examples.zh: 近四分之一的预算用于教育。

examples.en: Profits rose in the final quarter of the year after a difficult start.
examples.zh: 经历了艰难的开局后,利润在第四季度有所上升。

examples.en: Quartz is one of the most common minerals found in the Earth's crust.
examples.zh: 石英是地壳中最常见的矿物之一。

examples.en: A quasar can shine far more brightly than an entire galaxy.
examples.zh: 类星体的亮度可能远远超过整个星系。

examples.en: The company's claims about its environmental record are highly questionable.
examples.zh: 该公司关于其环保记录的说法非常可疑。

examples.en: We gave out a questionnaire to two hundred students in the canteen.
examples.zh: 我们在食堂向两百名学生发放了问卷。

examples.en: We have a short quiz at the start of every Monday class.
examples.zh: 每周一上课开始时我们都有一个小测验。

examples.en: The tutor will quiz you on the first three chapters tomorrow.
examples.zh: 导师明天会就前三章对你们进行测验。

examples.en: Fishing boats must not catch more than their annual quota of cod.
examples.zh: 渔船捕捞的鳕鱼不得超过年度配额。

examples.en: The article quotes a scientist who worked on the original project.
examples.zh: 这篇文章引用了一位参与原项目的科学家的话。

examples.en: Schools have an important role to play in the fight against racism.
examples.zh: 学校在反对种族主义的斗争中发挥着重要作用。

examples.en: You can hire a tennis racket from the desk for two pounds.
examples.zh: 你可以花两英镑在服务台租一只网球拍。

examples.en: Radar was developed to detect enemy aircraft during the war.
examples.zh: 雷达是在战争期间为探测敌机而研制的。

examples.en: Too much radiation from the sun can damage the skin.
examples.zh: 过多的太阳辐射会损伤皮肤。

examples.en: The radiator in my room isn't getting hot, even with the heating on.
examples.zh: 即使开了暖气,我房间的暖气片也不热。

examples.en: The new technology brought about a radical change in the way people work.
examples.zh: 新技术使人们的工作方式发生了根本的变化。

examples.en: Radioactive waste must be stored safely for thousands of years.
examples.zh: 放射性废物必须安全储存数千年。

examples.en: Bears may hunt within a radius of fifty kilometres from their home.
examples.zh: 熊可能在距家半径五十公里的范围内捕猎。

examples.en: You can win a free holiday in the raffle at tonight's dinner.
examples.zh: 在今晚晚宴的抽奖中,你有机会赢得一次免费度假。

examples.en: The children built a small raft and floated it across the pond.
examples.zh: 孩子们造了一只小木筏,划过了池塘。

examples.en: Police arrested three men during a raid on the warehouse.
examples.zh: 警方在突袭仓库时逮捕了三名男子。

examples.en: The railway brought rapid economic growth to the towns along its route.
examples.zh: 铁路给沿线城镇带来了快速的经济增长。

examples.en: Take a raincoat with you, because the forecast says it might rain.
examples.zh: 带上雨衣吧,天气预报说可能会下雨。

examples.en: Annual rainfall has dropped by nearly a third in the past fifty years.
examples.zh: 过去五十年,年降雨量下降了近三分之一。

examples.en: The rainforest is home to millions of species of plants and insects.
examples.zh: 雨林是数百万种植物和昆虫的家园。

examples.en: It is argued that parents should raise children to respect other cultures.
examples.zh: 有人认为,父母在抚养孩子时应教导他们尊重其他文化。

examples.en: The government could raise money for public transport by taxing private cars.
examples.zh: 政府可以通过对私家车征税来为公共交通筹集资金。

examples.en: The report raises serious questions about the safety of the food we eat.
examples.zh: 这份报告对我们所吃食物的安全提出了严肃的问题。

examples.en: Schools can raise awareness of healthy eating through practical cooking lessons.
examples.zh: 学校可以通过烹饪实践课提高学生对健康饮食的意识。

examples.en: Thousands of people attended a rally to support the striking workers.
examples.zh: 数千人参加集会,支持罢工工人。

examples.en: The family owns a large cattle ranch in the south of the state.
examples.zh: 这家人在该州南部拥有一个大牧场。

examples.en: Participants were chosen at random from a list of local residents.
examples.zh: 参与者是从当地居民名单中随机选出的。

examples.en: Researchers randomise the order of questions to prevent any pattern affecting the answers.
examples.zh: 研究者把问题的顺序随机化,以防某种规律影响答案。

examples.en: Patients were randomly assigned to one of the two treatment groups.
examples.zh: 患者被随机分配到两个治疗组之一。

examples.en: The prices cover a wide range, from two pounds to more than fifty.
examples.zh: 价格范围很广,从两英镑到五十多英镑不等。

examples.en: Ages in the group range from eighteen to sixty-five years old.
examples.zh: 这个群体的年龄在十八岁到六十五岁之间。

examples.en: Germany ranked first in terms of the number of cars produced.
examples.zh: 就汽车产量而言,德国排名第一。

examples.en: Hackers locked the hospital's computers and demanded a ransom.
examples.zh: 黑客锁定了医院的电脑,并索要赎金。

examples.en: Victims of rape often need long-term support as well as legal help.
examples.zh: 强奸受害者不仅需要法律帮助,往往还需要长期支持。

examples.en: The rapid growth of cities has led to a shortage of housing.
examples.zh: 城市的迅速发展导致了住房短缺。

examples.en: The rare plant grows only on a few mountains in the south.
examples.zh: 这种罕见的植物只生长在南部的几座山上。

examples.en: The unemployment rate remained below five percent for most of the decade.
examples.zh: 这十年的大部分时间里,失业率保持在百分之五以下。

examples.en: Schools should teach students to think for themselves rather than memorise facts.
examples.zh: 学校应该教学生独立思考,而不是死记事实。

examples.en: The ratio of teachers to students was highest in the smaller schools.
examples.zh: 较小学校的师生比最高。

examples.en: The weekly ration of meat was very small during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间,每周的肉类配给量很少。

examples.en: The government had to ration food for several years after the war.
examples.zh: 战后几年,政府不得不定量供应食品。

examples.en: Economists once assumed that consumers always made rational choices.
examples.zh: 经济学家曾假定消费者总会作出理性的选择。

examples.en: The factory imports raw materials and turns them into finished goods.
examples.zh: 这家工厂进口原材料,把它们加工成成品。

examples.en: Sand, the main raw material, is delivered to the factory by truck.
examples.zh: 主要原材料沙子由卡车运送到工厂。

examples.en: A ray of light bends as it passes from air into water.
examples.zh: 一束光从空气进入水中时会发生弯曲。

examples.en: The chemical reaction releases heat and produces a small amount of gas.
examples.zh: 这个化学反应释放热量,并产生少量气体。

examples.en: Short sentences can improve the readability of a report.
examples.zh: 短句可以提高报告的可读性。

examples.en: The metal reacts readily with water, so it must be stored in oil.
examples.zh: 这种金属容易与水发生反应,所以必须存放在油中。

examples.en: Foreign investors have been buying real estate in the capital.
examples.zh: 外国投资者一直在首都购买房地产。

examples.en: A real estate agency can help you find a house to buy.
examples.zh: 房地产中介可以帮你找到想买的房子。

examples.en: The film was praised for its realism in showing the life of ordinary people.
examples.zh: 这部电影以现实主义手法展现普通人的生活,因此受到赞扬。

examples.en: It is not realistic to expect all cars to be electric within ten years.
examples.zh: 指望十年内所有汽车都变成电动的,并不现实。

examples.en: I think that most reality shows on television are a bit silly.
examples.zh: 我觉得电视上的大多数真人秀都有点傻。

examples.en: Such ideas were once considered to belong to the realm of science fiction.
examples.zh: 这样的想法曾被认为属于科幻小说的领域。

examples.en: Farmers who invest in better soil will reap the benefits for years.
examples.zh: 投资改良土壤的农民多年都能从中获益。

examples.en: Children develop the ability to use logical reasoning at about the age of seven.
examples.zh: 儿童大约在七岁时发展出运用逻辑推理的能力。

examples.en: The government tried to reassure the public that the food was safe.
examples.zh: 政府试图让公众放心,告诉他们这些食品是安全的。

examples.en: You may be able to claim a tax rebate if you've paid too much.
examples.zh: 如果多缴了税,你也许可以申请部分退款。

examples.en: Teenagers can become rebellious if parents set too many strict rules.
examples.zh: 如果父母定下太多严格的规矩,青少年可能变得叛逆。

examples.en: Participants were asked to recall as many words as possible from the list.
examples.zh: 参与者被要求尽可能多地回忆起列表中的单词。

examples.en: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
examples.zh: 保留好收据,以防你需要退鞋。

examples.en: Please hand in your room key at reception when you leave.
examples.zh: 离开时请把房间钥匙交到前台。

examples.en: The wedding reception will be held in the hotel's main hall.
examples.zh: 婚礼招待会将在酒店的主厅举行。

examples.en: The receptionist gave us a map and showed us where to park.
examples.zh: 前台接待员给了我们一张地图,还告诉我们在哪里停车。

examples.en: Thousands of companies closed during the recession of the early 1990s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代初的经济衰退期间,数千家公司倒闭。

examples.en: I need a quiet weekend at home now and then to recharge.
examples.zh: 我偶尔需要在家安静地过个周末,恢复精力。

examples.en: Education in prison can greatly reduce recidivism among young offenders.
examples.zh: 狱中教育可以大大减少青少年罪犯的累犯率。

examples.en: A friend gave me her recipe for chocolate cake last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末,一位朋友把她的巧克力蛋糕食谱给了我。

examples.en: The Dutch have reclaimed large areas of land from the sea.
examples.zh: 荷兰人从海中开垦了大片土地。

examples.en: Her work was not recognised until many years after her death.
examples.zh: 她的成果直到她去世多年后才得到认可。

examples.en: The report ends with a recommendation to build more cycle paths.
examples.zh: 报告最后建议修建更多自行车道。

examples.en: It is difficult to reconcile economic growth with protecting the environment.
examples.zh: 很难调和经济增长与环境保护之间的矛盾。

examples.en: Scientists used the bones to reconstruct the appearance of the animal.
examples.zh: 科学家用这些骨头重构了这种动物的外貌。

examples.en: Most patients recover completely within two or three weeks.
examples.zh: 大多数患者在两三周内完全康复。

examples.en: Good sleep plays an important part in recovery after an illness.
examples.zh: 良好的睡眠对病后康复起着重要作用。

examples.en: For recreation, I usually go cycling along the river at weekends.
examples.zh: 周末休闲时,我通常沿着河边骑车。

examples.en: The museum is hoping to recruit ten volunteers for the summer.
examples.zh: 博物馆希望为暑期招募十名志愿者。

examples.en: The Roman town was laid out in the shape of a rectangle.
examples.zh: 这座罗马城镇布局呈长方形。

examples.en: We've got a big rectangular table in the kitchen where we all eat.
examples.zh: 我们厨房有一张大长方形餐桌,大家都在那儿吃饭。

examples.en: He went to stay with his parents to recuperate after the operation.
examples.zh: 手术后他去父母家住了一段时间休养。

examples.en: Glass bottles can be recycled again and again without any loss of quality.
examples.zh: 玻璃瓶可以反复回收利用,质量不会受损。

examples.en: Recycling should be compulsory for all homes and businesses.
examples.zh: 所有家庭和企业都应强制进行回收。

examples.en: The area around the port was redeveloped with shops and restaurants.
examples.zh: 港口周边地区被重新开发,建起了商店和餐馆。

examples.en: Insulating older homes could greatly reduce the amount of energy they use.
examples.zh: 给老房子加装隔热层可以大大减少能源消耗。

examples.en: Workers facing redundancy need help to find new types of employment.
examples.zh: 面临裁员的工人需要帮助,以找到新类型的工作。

examples.en: This word is redundant here, because you've already said the same thing.
examples.zh: 这个词在这里是多余的,因为你已经说过同样的意思了。

examples.en: Forty workers were made redundant when the factory closed last year.
examples.zh: 去年工厂关闭时,四十名工人被裁员。

examples.en: Ancient Egyptians made a type of paper from a tall water reed.
examples.zh: 古埃及人用一种高大的水生芦苇造纸。

examples.en: The term 'biodiversity' is used to refer to the variety of life on Earth.
examples.zh: “生物多样性”一词指的是地球上生命的多样性。

examples.en: The agency asked for a reference from my previous landlord.
examples.zh: 中介要求我提供前房东的推荐信。

examples.en: Please keep this guide for future reference during your stay here.
examples.zh: 住在这里期间,请保留这份指南以便日后参考。

examples.en: You can't take this reference book out of the library.
examples.zh: 这本参考书不能带出图书馆。

examples.en: The sugar is then refined to produce a fine white powder.
examples.zh: 然后把糖提炼成细白粉末。

examples.en: Snow and ice reflect most of the sunlight back into space.
examples.zh: 冰雪把大部分阳光反射回太空。

examples.en: The results reflect a general decline in the level of reading.
examples.zh: 这些结果反映出阅读水平的普遍下降。

examples.en: Pulling your hand away from something hot is a natural reflex.
examples.zh: 把手从烫的东西上缩回是一种自然反射。

examples.en: The education system is badly in need of reform.
examples.zh: 教育体系急需改革。

examples.en: Many people believe that the government must reform the prison system.
examples.zh: 许多人认为政府必须改革监狱制度。

examples.en: Water droplets refract sunlight, and that is how a rainbow forms.
examples.zh: 水滴折射阳光,彩虹就是这样形成的。

examples.en: I'm taking a refresher course because I haven't used French for years.
examples.zh: 我已经多年没用法语了,所以在上进修课程。

examples.en: It's refreshing to meet people who really listen to what you say.
examples.zh: 遇到真正倾听你说话的人,感觉令人耳目一新。

examples.en: Light refreshments will be served in the hall after the talk.
examples.zh: 讲座结束后,大厅将提供简单的茶点。

examples.en: Please label your food before you put it in the shared refrigerator.
examples.zh: 把食物放进公用冰箱前,请先贴上标签。

examples.en: Wealthy nations should do more to help each refugee build a new life.
examples.zh: 富裕国家应该做更多的事,帮助每位难民开始新生活。

examples.en: You can get a full refund if you cancel within seven days.
examples.zh: 七天内取消可以获得全额退款。

examples.en: The airline agreed to refund our tickets after the flight was cancelled.
examples.zh: 航班取消后,航空公司同意退还我们的机票钱。

examples.en: New data from the deep ocean appears to refute the earlier theory.
examples.zh: 来自深海的新数据似乎驳斥了早先的理论。

examples.en: Many historians regard this as the most important battle of the war.
examples.zh: 许多历史学家把这场战役看作这场战争中最重要的一场。

examples.en: Every child should have access to good education regardless of family income.
examples.zh: 不论家庭收入如何,每个孩子都应该能接受良好的教育。

examples.en: The old regime was replaced after years of protests by ordinary people.
examples.zh: 经过普通民众多年的抗议,旧政权被取代了。

examples.en: This region of the country produces most of its wine.
examples.zh: 该国这一地区出产该国大部分葡萄酒。

examples.en: Registration for the conference opens at eight in the main hall.
examples.zh: 会议登记八点在主厅开始。

examples.en: There's a one-off registration fee of £10 when you join the course.
examples.zh: 报名这门课程时要一次性交 10 英镑报名费。

examples.en: Researchers used regression to study the link between income and health.
examples.zh: 研究者使用回归方法研究收入与健康之间的关系。

examples.en: I regret not learning to play an instrument when I was younger.
examples.zh: 我后悔年轻时没有学一门乐器。

examples.en: The skin helps to regulate the temperature of the body.
examples.zh: 皮肤有助于调节体温。

examples.en: Stricter regulation of the banks could prevent another financial crisis.
examples.zh: 加强对银行的管理可以防止再次发生金融危机。

examples.en: Prisons should try to rehabilitate offenders rather than simply punish them.
examples.zh: 监狱应该努力改造罪犯,而不只是惩罚他们。

examples.en: Rehabilitation after a serious injury may take many months.
examples.zh: 重伤后的康复可能需要几个月。

examples.en: The final rehearsal is on Friday, and everyone needs to be there.
examples.zh: 最后一次排练在周五,大家都必须到场。

examples.en: The band will rehearse in the main hall from four until six.
examples.zh: 乐队四点到六点在主厅排练。

examples.en: Trade and the arts flourished during the reign of the young queen.
examples.zh: 在这位年轻女王统治期间,贸易和艺术蓬勃发展。

examples.en: The king reigned for over fifty years and left a stable country.
examples.zh: 这位国王统治了五十多年,留下了一个稳定的国家。

examples.en: The company will reimburse your travel costs if you keep the tickets.
examples.zh: 只要保留车票,公司就会报销你的差旅费。

examples.en: Repeating information at intervals helps to reinforce it in the memory.
examples.zh: 间隔重复信息有助于加深记忆。

examples.en: The rejection of the proposal surprised many members of the committee.
examples.zh: 提案被否决令委员会的许多成员感到意外。

examples.en: Rest for another week, or you might have a relapse.
examples.zh: 再休息一周,否则你可能会复发。

examples.en: Older people are increasingly being looked after by a professional rather than a relative.
examples.zh: 老年人越来越多地由专业人员而不是亲戚照顾。

examples.en: The relative cost of food has fallen over the past fifty years.
examples.zh: 过去五十年,食品的相对成本有所下降。

examples.en: The disease is relatively rare among people under the age of forty.
examples.zh: 这种疾病在四十岁以下人群中相对少见。

examples.en: Einstein's theory of relativity changed our understanding of space and time.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦的相对论改变了我们对空间和时间的理解。

examples.en: I always feel relaxed after a long walk in the countryside.
examples.zh: 在乡间走了很久之后,我总是感到很放松。

examples.en: Prisoners need support in finding work after their release.
examples.zh: 囚犯出狱后找工作需要帮助。

examples.en: The government will release the full results of the survey next month.
examples.zh: 政府将在下个月发布调查的全部结果。

examples.en: The relentless growth of the city has swallowed up nearby villages.
examples.zh: 城市持续不断的扩张吞并了附近的村庄。

examples.en: Critics have questioned the relevance of these old laws to modern life.
examples.zh: 批评者质疑这些旧法律与现代生活的相关性。

examples.en: Doubts have been raised about the reliability of data collected by telephone.
examples.zh: 电话收集的数据的可靠性受到了质疑。

examples.en: Self-reported data on diet is not always reliable, as people forget details.
examples.zh: 人们自述的饮食数据并不总是可靠,因为他们会忘记细节。

examples.en: The old stone bridge is a relic of the town's Roman past.
examples.zh: 这座古石桥是该镇罗马时代的遗物。

examples.en: Additional bus services were introduced to relieve pressure on the railway.
examples.zh: 增设公交线路是为了缓解铁路的压力。

examples.en: I was so relieved when I finally found my lost passport.
examples.zh: 我终于找到丢失的护照时,真是松了一口气。

examples.en: Religion played a central part in the daily life of medieval people.
examples.zh: 宗教在中世纪人们的日常生活中占据核心地位。

examples.en: The school was relocated to the north of the town in 2005.
examples.zh: 这所学校于 2005 年迁到了镇子北部。

examples.en: Many farmers were reluctant to change the methods they had always used.
examples.zh: 许多农民不愿改变一直使用的方法。

examples.en: Many of these communities rely heavily on fishing for their food.
examples.zh: 这些社区中有许多在食物上严重依赖捕鱼。

examples.en: Many small islands rely on tourism for most of their income.
examples.zh: 许多小岛的大部分收入依赖旅游业。

examples.en: The proportion of older workers is expected to remain stable until 2030.
examples.zh: 预计到 2030 年,老年工人的比例将保持稳定。

examples.en: The remains of an ancient ship were found beneath the river mud.
examples.zh: 在河底的淤泥下发现了一艘古船的遗骸。

examples.en: Some birds have a remarkable ability to find their way home.
examples.zh: 有些鸟具有非凡的认路回家的能力。

examples.en: Honey and lemon are a popular home remedy for a sore throat.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜加柠檬是治疗喉咙痛的常见家庭疗法。

examples.en: The hotel manager promised to remedy the problem with the hot water.
examples.zh: 酒店经理承诺解决热水的问题。

examples.en: The small forest is a remnant of the woodland that once covered the country.
examples.zh: 这片小森林是曾经覆盖全国的林地的残余。

examples.en: My uncle lives in a remote village, and it takes all day to get there.
examples.zh: 我叔叔住在一个偏远的村庄,要花一整天才能到。

examples.en: I've been doing remote work for two years and I really enjoy it.
examples.zh: 我已经远程工作两年了,我真的很喜欢。

examples.en: Remote working saves time and reduces traffic during the rush hour.
examples.zh: 远程办公节省时间,还能减少高峰期的交通流量。

examples.en: The removal of trees from the hillside increased the risk of flooding.
examples.zh: 山坡上的树木被清除后,洪水风险增加了。

examples.en: Remuneration for the job includes a basic salary plus a company car.
examples.zh: 这份工作的报酬包括基本工资和一辆公司配车。

examples.en: The Renaissance began in Italy and spread across much of Europe.
examples.zh: 文艺复兴始于意大利,并传播到欧洲大部分地区。

examples.en: Heavy flooding rendered the main road impossible to use.
examples.zh: 严重的洪水使主干道无法通行。

examples.en: You can renew your books online if nobody else has asked for them.
examples.zh: 如果没有其他人预约,你可以在线续借图书。

examples.en: Renewable sources now provide a third of the country's electricity.
examples.zh: 可再生能源现在提供该国三分之一的电力。

examples.en: The old museum was renovated and now has a much larger entrance.
examples.zh: 老博物馆翻新后,现在有了大得多的入口。

examples.en: The region is renowned for the quality of its olive oil.
examples.zh: 这一地区以优质橄榄油著称。

examples.en: The rent is due on the first day of every month.
examples.zh: 租金在每月第一天到期。

examples.en: We decided to rent a small house close to the beach.
examples.zh: 我们决定在海滩附近租一栋小房子。

examples.en: Prisoners who gain new skills are less likely to reoffend after release.
examples.zh: 掌握新技能的囚犯出狱后不太可能再次犯罪。

examples.en: The landlord must pay for any repairs to the roof.
examples.zh: 屋顶的任何修理费用都必须由房东支付。

examples.en: Someone will come to repair the washing machine on Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 周二上午会有人来修洗衣机。

examples.en: The theatre's repertoire includes both classic plays and modern works.
examples.zh: 这家剧院的全部节目既有经典戏剧,也有现代作品。

examples.en: Robots are well suited to repetitive tasks that humans find boring.
examples.zh: 机器人非常适合人类觉得无聊的重复性工作。

examples.en: The car park was replaced by a small garden and a playground.
examples.zh: 停车场被一个小花园和一个游乐场取代。

examples.en: Other researchers were unable to replicate the results of the original study.
examples.zh: 其他研究者未能重现最初那项研究的结果。

examples.en: The reporter spent a year investigating conditions in the country's prisons.
examples.zh: 这名记者花了一年时间调查该国监狱的状况。

examples.en: Students represent the largest group of people using the library.
examples.zh: 学生占图书馆使用者的最大比例。

examples.en: Some plants can reproduce without producing any seeds at all.
examples.zh: 有些植物完全不产生种子也能繁殖。

examples.en: Warm temperatures are needed for the successful reproduction of many reptiles.
examples.zh: 许多爬行动物要在温暖的气温下才能成功繁殖。

examples.en: Most reptiles lay eggs and rely on the sun to keep them warm.
examples.zh: 大多数爬行动物产卵,并依靠阳光保持体温。

examples.en: The country adopted a republican system after the end of the monarchy.
examples.zh: 君主制结束后,这个国家采用了共和制度。

examples.en: The university has an excellent reputation for research in engineering.
examples.zh: 这所大学在工程研究方面享有极高的声誉。

examples.en: Most tropical plants require high levels of light and water.
examples.zh: 大多数热带植物需要充足的光照和水分。

examples.en: Volunteers worked through the night to rescue birds caught in the oil.
examples.zh: 志愿者彻夜营救被石油困住的鸟类。

examples.en: Her research looks at how children learn a second language.
examples.zh: 她的研究关注儿童如何学习第二语言。

examples.en: I need to research the topic properly before I start writing.
examples.zh: 动笔之前,我需要好好研究这个课题。

examples.en: Some harmless insects have evolved to resemble more dangerous species.
examples.zh: 一些无害的昆虫进化得与更危险的物种相似。

examples.en: I'd like to make a reservation for two nights in early May.
examples.zh: 我想预订五月初的两晚住宿。

examples.en: You can reserve the book online and collect it at the front desk.
examples.zh: 你可以在网上预约这本书,然后到前台领取。

examples.en: We saw several rare birds at the nature reserve near the coast.
examples.zh: 我们在海岸附近的自然保护区看到了几种珍稀鸟类。

examples.en: My dad is a bit reserved, but he's very kind once you know him.
examples.zh: 我爸爸有点内敛,但熟悉之后你会发现他很和善。

examples.en: The reservoir supplies drinking water to more than a million people.
examples.zh: 这座水库为一百多万人提供饮用水。

examples.en: Local residents have complained about noise from the new airport.
examples.zh: 当地居民投诉新机场的噪音。

examples.en: The new road will run through a quiet residential part of the city.
examples.zh: 新路将穿过城市一处安静的住宅区。

examples.en: The new train line will connect the main residential area with the city centre.
examples.zh: 新铁路线将把主要住宅区与市中心连接起来。

examples.en: Residual heat in the ground warms the plants through the night.
examples.zh: 地面的余热整夜为植物保温。

examples.en: Pesticides can leave a harmful residue on fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 农药可能在水果和蔬菜上留下有害残留物。

examples.en: She decided to resign because the journey to work was too long.
examples.zh: 她决定辞职,因为上班路程太远。

examples.en: Some crops have been bred to resist common insects and diseases.
examples.zh: 一些作物经过培育,能够抵抗常见的虫害和疾病。

examples.en: The two countries are still seeking a peaceful resolution to the conflict.
examples.zh: 两国仍在寻求和平解决这场冲突。

examples.en: The new telescope produces images of much higher resolution than before.
examples.zh: 新望远镜拍出的图像分辨率比以前高得多。

examples.en: Scientists hope the new data will resolve the long debate about the fossils.
examples.zh: 科学家希望新数据能解决关于这些化石的长期争论。

examples.en: We spent a week at a ski resort in the mountains last winter.
examples.zh: 去年冬天,我们在山里的滑雪胜地待了一周。

examples.en: Water is a precious resource that should not be wasted.
examples.zh: 水是一种宝贵的资源,不应被浪费。

examples.en: My parents wanted me to have a respectable job like a doctor or teacher.
examples.zh: 我父母希望我有一份体面的工作,比如医生或老师。

examples.en: Sales in Japan and Korea rose by ten and fifteen percent respectively.
examples.zh: 日本和韩国的销售额分别增长了百分之十和百分之十五。

examples.en: Air pollution can lead to serious respiratory problems among children.
examples.zh: 空气污染可能导致儿童出现严重的呼吸问题。

examples.en: More than half the respondents said they used public transport every day.
examples.zh: 超过一半的调查对象表示他们每天乘坐公共交通。

examples.en: Participants' response to the images was measured using brain scans.
examples.zh: 参与者对图像的反应通过脑部扫描测量。

examples.en: My older cousin is very responsible and always looks after the younger kids.
examples.zh: 我的表哥很负责任,总是照顾年纪小的孩子。

examples.en: I feel restless if I have to sit in an office all day.
examples.zh: 如果得整天坐在办公室,我会焦躁不安。

examples.en: The restoration of the old theatre cost more than ten million pounds.
examples.zh: 这座老剧院的修复花费超过一千万英镑。

examples.en: Interest rates were raised to restrain the rapid growth in spending.
examples.zh: 提高利率是为了抑制支出的快速增长。

examples.en: The new rules restrict the number of boats allowed on the lake.
examples.zh: 新规定限制了湖上允许通行的船只数量。

examples.en: Many health problems result from a poor diet and too little exercise.
examples.zh: 许多健康问题是由不良饮食和缺乏运动导致的。

examples.en: A small rise in temperature could result in the loss of many species.
examples.zh: 气温小幅上升可能导致许多物种消失。

examples.en: Work on the bridge will resume once the river level has fallen.
examples.zh: 河水水位下降后,桥梁工程将重新开始。

examples.en: Keep your résumé to one page when you apply for jobs in America.
examples.zh: 在美国求职时,简历要控制在一页以内。

examples.en: Most large retailers now allow customers to order online and collect in store.
examples.zh: 现在大多数大型零售商都允许顾客网上下单、到店取货。

examples.en: Clay soils retain water far better than sandy ones.
examples.zh: 黏土的保水能力远远强于沙土。

examples.en: My father hopes to retire at sixty and move to the coast.
examples.zh: 我父亲希望六十岁退休,然后搬到海边。

examples.en: Many people find it difficult to adapt to life after retirement.
examples.zh: 许多人觉得很难适应退休后的生活。

examples.en: Many governments are raising the retirement age because people live longer.
examples.zh: 由于人们寿命延长,许多国家的政府正在提高退休年龄。

examples.en: Moving to a retirement home can be a difficult decision for older people.
examples.zh: 搬进养老院对老年人来说可能是个艰难的决定。

examples.en: The brain may find it harder to retrieve information as we age.
examples.zh: 随着年龄增长,大脑提取信息可能变得更难。

examples.en: A return ticket is usually cheaper than buying two singles.
examples.zh: 买往返票通常比买两张单程票便宜。

examples.en: Families should reuse glass bottles rather than throw them away.
examples.zh: 家庭应该重复使用玻璃瓶,而不是扔掉。

examples.en: Satellite images revealed a network of ancient roads beneath the forest.
examples.zh: 卫星图像揭示了森林下面的古代道路网。

examples.en: The revelation that the data had been changed damaged the scientist's career.
examples.zh: 数据被篡改一事曝光后,这位科学家的事业受到了损害。

examples.en: Tourism is an important source of revenue for the national government.
examples.zh: 旅游业是中央政府重要的收入来源。

examples.en: Scientists doubt whether the damage to the reef can be reversed.
examples.zh: 科学家怀疑珊瑚礁受到的损害能否逆转。

examples.en: The second study produced exactly the reverse result.
examples.zh: 第二项研究得出了完全相反的结果。

examples.en: Scientists had to revise their estimates after the new data arrived.
examples.zh: 新数据到来后,科学家不得不修订他们的估算。

examples.en: I've started my revision, but there's still a lot to cover.
examples.zh: 我已经开始复习了,但还有很多内容要看。

examples.en: The report needs some revision before we send it to the client.
examples.zh: 这份报告在发给客户之前还需要修改。

examples.en: Efforts are being made to revive the language among younger speakers.
examples.zh: 人们正在努力让这种语言在年轻人中复兴。

examples.en: Peasants rose in revolt against the high taxes demanded by the king.
examples.zh: 农民起义反抗国王征收的重税。

examples.en: The French Revolution changed the political map of Europe.
examples.zh: 法国大革命改变了欧洲的政治版图。

examples.en: Mobile phones have revolutionised the way people communicate with each other.
examples.zh: 手机彻底改变了人们相互交流的方式。

examples.en: The planets revolve around the Sun in almost circular paths.
examples.zh: 行星以近乎圆形的轨道绕太阳公转。

examples.en: Animals learn more quickly when they receive a reward for correct behaviour.
examples.zh: 动物因正确行为得到奖励时学得更快。

examples.en: Teaching young children can be tiring, but it's a really rewarding job.
examples.zh: 教幼儿可能很累,但这是一份很有回报的工作。

examples.en: I had to rewrite the introduction because my tutor found it unclear.
examples.zh: 导师觉得引言不清楚,所以我只好重写。

examples.en: Students in ancient Greece studied rhetoric to prepare for public life.
examples.zh: 古希腊的学生学习修辞,为公共生活做准备。

examples.en: The rhinoceros has been hunted almost to extinction for its horn.
examples.zh: 犀牛因其角遭到捕杀,几近灭绝。

examples.en: I have no sense of rhythm, so I'm a terrible dancer.
examples.zh: 我没有节奏感,所以跳舞很差劲。

examples.en: The mayor cut the ribbon to open the new sports hall.
examples.zh: 市长剪彩为新体育馆揭幕。

examples.en: A long ridge of hills separates the wet coast from the dry interior.
examples.zh: 一道绵长的山脊把潮湿的海岸和干燥的内陆隔开。

examples.en: It sounds ridiculous, but I still sleep with the same old pillow.
examples.zh: 听起来很可笑,但我现在还枕着那个旧枕头睡觉。

examples.en: The school's rigid rules left little room for creative teaching.
examples.zh: 学校僵化的规定几乎没有留下创造性教学的空间。

examples.en: All new medicines must pass rigorous tests before they can be sold.
examples.zh: 所有新药上市前都必须通过严格的测试。

examples.en: There's a small crack in the rim of my favourite coffee cup.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的咖啡杯边缘有一道小裂纹。

examples.en: Take the ring road if you want to avoid the traffic in town.
examples.zh: 如果想避开市内的拥堵,就走环路。

examples.en: A riot broke out in the city after the announcement of the new tax.
examples.zh: 新税公布后,这座城市爆发了暴乱。

examples.en: The fruit changes from green to red when it is ripe.
examples.zh: 这种水果成熟时由绿变红。

examples.en: There was a sharp rise in house prices between 2005 and 2007.
examples.zh: 2005 年至 2007 年间,房价急剧上升。

examples.en: Sales are expected to rise gradually over the next five years.
examples.zh: 预计未来五年销售额将逐步上升。

examples.en: The rite marks the moment when a young person becomes an adult.
examples.zh: 这一仪式标志着年轻人成年的时刻。

examples.en: The ritual is performed each spring to ensure a good harvest.
examples.zh: 每年春天都举行这种仪式,以祈求丰收。

examples.en: Our team plays its biggest rival from the next town on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六,我们队将迎战邻镇最大的竞争对手。

examples.en: Two rival companies are both trying to win the same contract.
examples.zh: 两家竞争公司都在争取同一份合同。

examples.en: Roast the chicken for about an hour until the skin is crisp.
examples.zh: 把鸡烤一小时左右,直到外皮酥脆。

examples.en: We usually have roast beef with vegetables for Sunday lunch.
examples.zh: 我们周日午餐通常吃烤牛肉配蔬菜。

examples.en: The man was sent to prison for his part in a bank robbery.
examples.zh: 这名男子因参与银行抢劫被送进监狱。

examples.en: A robot can now perform some kinds of surgery with great accuracy.
examples.zh: 现在机器人能高度精确地完成某些类型的手术。

examples.en: Advances in robotics have transformed the way cars are built.
examples.zh: 机器人学的进步改变了汽车的制造方式。

examples.en: The study was robust, with a large sample and careful controls.
examples.zh: 这项研究十分稳健,样本量大,对照也很严谨。

examples.en: The price of petrol rocketed in the first half of the year.
examples.zh: 汽油价格在上半年飞涨。

examples.en: Rats and other rodents can spread disease through their waste.
examples.zh: 老鼠和其他啮齿动物可以通过排泄物传播疾病。

examples.en: Teachers can be an important role model for young people.
examples.zh: 老师可以成为年轻人重要的榜样。

examples.en: My roommate goes to bed early, so I study in the library at night.
examples.zh: 我的室友睡得早,所以我晚上去图书馆学习。

examples.en: Wet conditions cause wooden buildings to rot within a few decades.
examples.zh: 潮湿的环境使木制建筑在几十年内腐烂。

examples.en: The Moon rotates once in the time it takes to orbit the Earth.
examples.zh: 月球自转一周的时间与绕地球一周的时间相同。

examples.en: The rotation of the Earth is the reason why we have day and night.
examples.zh: 地球的自转是昼夜交替的原因。

examples.en: Crop rotation helps to keep the soil rich in nutrients.
examples.zh: 作物轮作有助于保持土壤养分充足。

examples.en: Rote learning may help students pass exams but does not develop understanding.
examples.zh: 死记硬背也许能帮学生通过考试,但不能增进理解。

examples.en: The walls of the cottage are made of rough stone.
examples.zh: 这间小屋的墙是用粗糙的石头砌成的。

examples.en: I've got a rough idea of where I'd like to go next summer.
examples.zh: 我对明年夏天想去哪里有个大致的想法。

examples.en: Roughly a third of the students came from other countries.
examples.zh: 大致三分之一的学生来自其他国家。

examples.en: Go straight over the roundabout and take the second road on the left.
examples.zh: 直行穿过环岛,然后走左边第二条路。

examples.en: My morning routine is simple: I get up, have a coffee and go for a run.
examples.zh: 我的早晨日常很简单:起床、喝咖啡、去跑步。

examples.en: Natural rubber comes from a liquid produced by certain tropical trees.
examples.zh: 天然橡胶来自某些热带树木产生的液体。

examples.en: People should be fined for leaving rubbish on the beach.
examples.zh: 在海滩上留下垃圾的人应该被罚款。

examples.en: Tourists come from around the world to visit the ruins of the temple.
examples.zh: 游客从世界各地前来参观神庙的废墟。

examples.en: We cannot rule out the possibility that technology will replace most teachers.
examples.zh: 我们不能排除技术取代大多数教师的可能性。

examples.en: A false rumour can spread around the world within a few hours.
examples.zh: 虚假的谣言可能在几小时内传遍全球。

examples.en: My old neighbourhood has become a bit run-down over the last few years.
examples.zh: 过去几年,我以前住的社区变得有点破败了。

examples.en: The world may eventually run out of oil and natural gas.
examples.zh: 世界最终可能用完石油和天然气。

examples.en: A second runway would allow the airport to handle many more flights.
examples.zh: 第二条跑道将使机场能够处理更多航班。

examples.en: Young people are leaving rural areas to look for work in the cities.
examples.zh: 年轻人正在离开农村地区,去城市找工作。

examples.en: Buses are often overcrowded during the morning rush hour.
examples.zh: 早高峰期间,公交车经常超载。

examples.en: The hotel has a rustic charm, with stone walls and wooden furniture.
examples.zh: 这家酒店有一种乡村韵味,石墙配木制家具。

examples.en: The ruthless pursuit of profit caused great harm to the environment.
examples.zh: 对利润的无情追逐对环境造成了巨大危害。

examples.en: The mountain is sacred to the people who live around it.
examples.zh: 这座山对周围的居民来说是神圣的。

examples.en: Early settlers made great sacrifices to build a new life on the frontier.
examples.zh: 早期定居者为在边疆建立新生活作出了巨大牺牲。

examples.en: New laws were passed to safeguard the rights of workers.
examples.zh: 新法律的通过是为了保护工人的权利。

examples.en: The club offers sailing lessons at the lake during the summer.
examples.zh: 俱乐部夏天在湖上开设帆船课程。

examples.en: The starting salary for this job is about £28,000 a year.
examples.zh: 这份工作的起薪大约是每年 28000 英镑。

examples.en: Sales of printed books have fallen with the growth of digital reading.
examples.zh: 随着数字阅读的发展,纸质书的销售额下降了。

examples.en: The salinity of the sea varies with temperature and rainfall.
examples.zh: 海水的盐度随温度和降雨量变化。

examples.en: We used a sample of one hundred people from different age groups.
examples.zh: 我们使用了一个来自不同年龄段的一百人样本。

examples.en: The bird sanctuary provides a safe place for thousands of migrating geese.
examples.zh: 这个鸟类保护区为数千只迁徙的大雁提供了安全的地方。

examples.en: The red cliffs are made of sandstone laid down millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 这些红色悬崖由数百万年前沉积的砂岩构成。

examples.en: Poor sanitation is a major cause of disease in crowded urban areas.
examples.zh: 卫生设施差是拥挤城区疾病的主要成因。

examples.en: The satellite sends back detailed images of the Earth's surface.
examples.zh: 这颗卫星传回地球表面的详细图像。

examples.en: The novel is a clever satire on the politics of the period.
examples.zh: 这部小说是对当时政治的巧妙讽刺。

examples.en: Studies show that job satisfaction depends more on respect than on pay.
examples.zh: 研究表明,工作满意度更多取决于尊重,而不是薪水。

examples.en: I'm pretty satisfied with my life in the city at the moment.
examples.zh: 我目前对城市生活挺满意的。

examples.en: Saturn is famous for the bright rings of ice and rock around it.
examples.zh: 土星以环绕它的明亮冰岩环闻名。

examples.en: The early settlers wrongly described the local people as savage.
examples.zh: 早期定居者错误地把当地人描述为野蛮的。

examples.en: Large herds of grazing animals move across the savanna in search of fresh grass.
examples.zh: 大群食草动物穿越热带草原,寻找新鲜的青草。

examples.en: I used all my savings to pay for the trip to Canada.
examples.zh: 我把所有积蓄都用来支付去加拿大的旅行了。

examples.en: I put a little money into my savings account every month.
examples.zh: 我每个月往储蓄账户里存一点钱。

examples.en: Would you prefer something savoury, like cheese, or something sweet?
examples.zh: 您想吃点咸的,比如奶酪,还是甜的?

examples.en: The snake's skin is covered with small, dry scales.
examples.zh: 蛇的皮肤上覆盖着干燥的小鳞片。

examples.en: The scale of the damage only became clear several weeks later.
examples.zh: 损失的规模几周后才变得清晰。

examples.en: Scan the list quickly to see if your name is on it.
examples.zh: 快速扫一眼名单,看看上面有没有你的名字。

examples.en: You can scan the document and send it to me by email.
examples.zh: 你可以把文件扫描后通过邮件发给我。

examples.en: A political scandal can damage public trust in the entire government.
examples.zh: 政治丑闻可能损害公众对整个政府的信任。

examples.en: You can use the scanner in the library to copy old documents.
examples.zh: 你可以用图书馆的扫描仪复制旧文件。

examples.en: Water scarcity is likely to become a major cause of international conflict.
examples.zh: 缺水可能成为国际冲突的主要原因。

examples.en: She arrived at the party in a bright scarlet dress and silver shoes.
examples.zh: 她穿着鲜艳的猩红色连衣裙和银色鞋子来到派对。

examples.en: Birds help to scatter the seeds of many forest plants.
examples.zh: 鸟类帮助散布许多森林植物的种子。

examples.en: Vultures are scavengers that feed on animals already dead.
examples.zh: 秃鹫是以已死动物为食的食腐动物。

examples.en: In the worst scenario, sea levels could rise by more than one metre.
examples.zh: 在最坏的情景下,海平面可能上升超过一米。

examples.en: The region's beautiful scenery attracts thousands of walkers each summer.
examples.zh: 该地区美丽的风景每年夏天吸引数千名徒步者。

examples.en: We took the scenic route along the coast instead of the motorway.
examples.zh: 我们走了风景优美的海岸路线,而不是高速公路。

examples.en: The scent of fresh bread always reminds me of my childhood home.
examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味总让我想起童年的家。

examples.en: I'm sceptical about diets that promise quick results.
examples.zh: 我对那些承诺见效快的减肥法持怀疑态度。

examples.en: Please look at the schedule to see when each talk begins.
examples.zh: 请查看日程,了解每场讲座的开始时间。

examples.en: We've scheduled the meeting for nine, but it may start a little later.
examples.zh: 我们把会议安排在九点,但可能会稍晚开始。

examples.en: The library contains rare books used by scholars from all over the world.
examples.zh: 图书馆收藏着世界各地学者使用的珍本书。

examples.en: She won a scholarship that covers all her costs for three years.
examples.zh: 她获得了一笔奖学金,可以支付三年的全部费用。

examples.en: I've loved science fiction ever since I saw my first space film.
examples.zh: 自从看了第一部太空电影,我就爱上了科幻。

examples.en: The scope of the study was limited to schools in rural areas.
examples.zh: 这项研究的范围仅限于农村地区的学校。

examples.en: You need a score of at least 6.5 to get onto this course.
examples.zh: 你至少要考到 6.5 分才能上这门课。

examples.en: Students who score above ninety in the test don't need extra classes.
examples.zh: 测试得分在九十以上的学生不需要额外上课。

examples.en: Parents should limit the screen time of their young children.
examples.zh: 父母应该限制年幼孩子的屏幕使用时间。

examples.en: A tiny loose screw caused the entire machine to stop working.
examples.zh: 一颗松动的小螺丝导致整台机器停止工作。

examples.en: The ancient script has never been fully understood by modern scholars.
examples.zh: 现代学者从未完全读懂这种古代文字。

examples.en: The actor forgot part of the script during the first performance.
examples.zh: 首场演出时,这位演员忘了部分剧本。

examples.en: Ancient texts were often written on a long scroll of paper.
examples.zh: 古代文本常常写在长长的纸质卷轴上。

examples.en: The company's safety record has come under close scrutiny since the accident.
examples.zh: 事故发生后,该公司的安全记录受到了严格审查。

examples.en: You'll need a short training course before you can go scuba diving.
examples.zh: 去水肺潜水之前,你需要上一个短期培训班。

examples.en: Public art, such as a sculpture in a park, can improve a city's image.
examples.zh: 公园里的雕塑等公共艺术能提升城市形象。

examples.en: Large parts of the Netherlands lie below sea level and are protected by walls.
examples.zh: 荷兰大片地区低于海平面,靠堤坝保护。

examples.en: Large parts of the seabed have never been properly explored.
examples.zh: 大部分海床从未被好好探索过。

examples.en: The town is known for its fresh seafood, especially crab and oysters.
examples.zh: 这个小镇以新鲜海鲜闻名,尤其是螃蟹和牡蛎。

examples.en: Seals come onto the beaches here to give birth in the autumn.
examples.zh: 海豹秋天来到这里的海滩产崽。

examples.en: The jars were sealed with wax to keep the food fresh.
examples.zh: 这些罐子用蜡密封,以保持食物新鲜。

examples.en: The town grew rapidly into an important seaport during the 1700s.
examples.zh: 18 世纪,这座城镇迅速发展成重要的海港。

examples.en: We used to go to the seaside every summer when I was young.
examples.zh: 我小时候每年夏天都去海边。

examples.en: A monthly season ticket saves me quite a lot on my journey to work.
examples.zh: 买月票让我上班路费省了不少。

examples.en: The dish needs a little more seasoning, perhaps some salt and pepper.
examples.zh: 这道菜需要再加点调味料,比如一些盐和胡椒。

examples.en: In parts of Asia, seaweed has long been an important source of food.
examples.zh: 在亚洲部分地区,海藻长期以来一直是重要的食物来源。

examples.en: I bought a second-hand bike from a student who was leaving.
examples.zh: 我从一个要离校的学生那里买了一辆二手自行车。

examples.en: Many secondary school students feel under pressure to get high grades.
examples.zh: 许多中学生感到要取得高分的压力。

examples.en: The school secretary can give you a copy of the timetable.
examples.zh: 学校秘书可以给你一份课程表。

examples.en: Glands in the skin secrete a substance that protects against infection.
examples.zh: 皮肤中的腺体分泌一种防止感染的物质。

examples.en: The plant's sticky secretion traps insects that land on its leaves.
examples.zh: 这种植物的黏性分泌物能粘住落在叶子上的昆虫。

examples.en: The service sector now provides most of the jobs in large cities.
examples.zh: 现在大城市的大部分就业机会来自服务业。

examples.en: The country's schools became fully secular at the end of the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 这个国家的学校在十九世纪末完全世俗化了。

examples.en: The company secured funding to develop its new battery technology.
examples.zh: 该公司获得了资金,用于开发新电池技术。

examples.en: Most people want a secure job that offers a regular income.
examples.zh: 大多数人都想要一份收入稳定的安稳工作。

examples.en: Banks have spent large sums on improving the security of online payments.
examples.zh: 银行投入大量资金提高在线支付的安全。

examples.en: You'll get your security deposit back when you move out of the flat.
examples.zh: 你搬出公寓时,押金会退还给你。

examples.en: A sedentary lifestyle is linked to a higher risk of many diseases.
examples.zh: 久坐的生活方式与多种疾病的较高风险有关。

examples.en: Over time, layers of sediment collect at the bottom of the lake.
examples.zh: 随着时间推移,一层层沉积物堆积在湖底。

examples.en: Fossils are most commonly found in sedimentary rocks such as limestone.
examples.zh: 化石最常见于石灰岩等沉积岩中。

examples.en: Birds carry the seeds of many plants over long distances.
examples.zh: 鸟类把许多植物的种子带到很远的地方。

examples.en: The young seedlings need protection from frost during their first year.
examples.zh: 幼苗在第一年需要防霜保护。

examples.en: A seemingly simple task can involve many different parts of the brain.
examples.zh: 一项表面上简单的任务可能涉及大脑的许多不同区域。

examples.en: The line segment connecting the two points is three centimetres long.
examples.zh: 连接两点的线段长三厘米。

examples.en: Older people form a growing segment of the market for holidays.
examples.zh: 老年人在度假市场中所占的部分越来越大。

examples.en: Seismic activity in the area has increased over the past few months.
examples.zh: 过去几个月,该地区的地震活动有所增加。

examples.en: Advances in seismology have made it easier to locate the centre of an earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震学的进步使确定地震中心变得更容易。

examples.en: The selection of participants was based on age and level of education.
examples.zh: 参与者的选拔依据的是年龄和受教育程度。

examples.en: Bees are selective about which flowers they visit for food.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂对采食的花朵很挑剔。

examples.en: Self-employed workers enjoy more freedom but often have less financial security.
examples.zh: 个体经营者享有更多自由,但经济保障往往较少。

examples.en: Praise from teachers can help to build self-esteem in young children.
examples.zh: 老师的表扬有助于增强幼儿的自尊。

examples.en: There's a self-service machine where you can return books at any time.
examples.zh: 有一台自助机,你可以随时还书。

examples.en: I think it's a bit selfish to play loud music late at night.
examples.zh: 我觉得深夜大声放音乐有点自私。

examples.en: Semantic changes mean that some words now have the opposite of their original meaning.
examples.zh: 语义的变化意味着一些词现在的含义与原义相反。

examples.en: The second semester begins in February, after a three-week break.
examples.zh: 三周假期过后,第二学期在二月开始。

examples.en: They live in a semi-detached house with a small garden at the back.
examples.zh: 他们住在一栋半独立式房屋里,屋后有个小花园。

examples.en: The seats in the ancient theatre were arranged in a semicircle.
examples.zh: 古代剧场的座位排成半圆形。

examples.en: Every modern computer depends on the semiconductor chips inside it.
examples.zh: 每台现代计算机都依赖其内部的半导体芯片。

examples.en: Everyone must read the article before Thursday's seminar on climate policy.
examples.zh: 大家必须在周四的气候政策研讨会前读完这篇文章。

examples.en: The Senate rejected the proposal to raise the national minimum wage.
examples.zh: 参议院否决了提高全国最低工资的提案。

examples.en: As a senior, she spends most of her time on her final project.
examples.zh: 作为大四学生,她大部分时间都花在毕业设计上。

examples.en: A senior nurse showed me what to do on my first day.
examples.zh: 第一天,一位资深护士教我该做什么。

examples.en: Every senior citizen should have free access to public transport.
examples.zh: 每位老年人都应该可以免费乘坐公共交通。

examples.en: Some newspapers publish sensational stories simply to attract more readers.
examples.zh: 一些报纸刊登耸人听闻的报道,只是为了吸引更多读者。

examples.en: Team sports give young people a strong sense of belonging.
examples.zh: 团队运动给年轻人带来强烈的归属感。

examples.en: My dad is a very sensible person, so I always ask him for advice.
examples.zh: 我爸爸是个很明智的人,所以我总是向他请教。

examples.en: I'm quite sensitive, so I often get upset by what people say.
examples.zh: 我挺敏感的,所以常常因为别人的话而难过。

examples.en: A sensor in the soil tells the farmer when the plants need water.
examples.zh: 土壤中的传感器告诉农民植物何时需要浇水。

examples.en: Babies receive a great deal of sensory information from the world around them.
examples.zh: 婴儿从周围世界接收大量感官信息。

examples.en: The judge gave the man a sentence of three years in prison.
examples.zh: 法官判处该男子三年监禁。

examples.en: Young offenders should not be sentenced to long periods in adult prisons.
examples.zh: 青少年罪犯不应被判处在成人监狱长期服刑。

examples.en: I'm quite sentimental and keep all the cards that friends have given me.
examples.zh: 我挺多愁善感的,朋友送的卡片我都留着。

examples.en: This cheap old watch has great sentimental value because it was my father's.
examples.zh: 这块便宜的旧手表很有情感价值,因为它是我父亲的。

examples.en: The machine separates the seeds from the rest of the plant.
examples.zh: 这台机器把种子从植株的其他部分分离出来。

examples.en: The diagram shows the sequence of events in the making of paper.
examples.zh: 该图显示了造纸过程的先后顺序。

examples.en: The giant sequoia can grow to more than eighty metres in height.
examples.zh: 巨型红杉可以长到八十多米高。

examples.en: The temple garden is so serene that I always feel calm there.
examples.zh: 寺庙花园非常安详,我在那里总感到平静。

examples.en: I watched the whole series in just one weekend.
examples.zh: 我只用一个周末就看完了整部剧。

examples.en: Information is stored on a server that may be far from the user.
examples.zh: 信息存储在可能离用户很远的服务器上。

examples.en: The banking service has moved almost entirely online in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年来,银行服务几乎完全转到了线上。

examples.en: The government should set up more training centres for young people.
examples.zh: 政府应该为年轻人设立更多培训中心。

examples.en: The failure of the rocket was a major setback for the space programme.
examples.zh: 火箭发射失败是太空计划的一次重大挫折。

examples.en: The first settlement in the valley was founded around 4000 BC.
examples.zh: 山谷中最早的定居点约建于公元前 4000 年。

examples.en: The two countries reached a peaceful settlement of the border dispute.
examples.zh: 两国和平解决了边界争端。

examples.en: European settlers brought new crops and diseases to the continent.
examples.zh: 欧洲定居者把新作物和疾病带到了这片大陆。

examples.en: The region suffered a severe drought that lasted for almost three years.
examples.zh: 该地区遭受了持续近三年的严重干旱。

examples.en: Untreated sewage can pollute drinking water and spread serious diseases.
examples.zh: 未经处理的污水会污染饮用水,传播严重疾病。

examples.en: Many poor neighbourhoods still have no proper sewerage system.
examples.zh: 许多贫困社区仍然没有完善的排污系统。

examples.en: Attitudes towards sexuality have changed considerably over the last fifty years.
examples.zh: 过去五十年,人们对性取向的态度发生了很大变化。

examples.en: Many older people live in shabby flats they can barely afford to heat.
examples.zh: 许多老人住在破旧的公寓里,几乎付不起取暖费。

examples.en: Miners went down a deep shaft to reach the coal below.
examples.zh: 矿工们下到深深的竖井中采煤。

examples.en: Young fish stay in shallow water where they are safer from predators.
examples.zh: 幼鱼待在浅水区,那里更不容易受到捕食者的攻击。

examples.en: The company has been losing its share of the European market.
examples.zh: 这家公司在欧洲市场的份额一直在下降。

examples.en: Scientists around the world share their data to speed up research.
examples.zh: 世界各地的科学家分享数据,以加快研究。

examples.en: The cheaper rooms come with a shared bathroom at the end of the hall.
examples.zh: 便宜一些的房间使用走廊尽头的公用卫生间。

examples.en: Every shareholder has the right to vote at the annual meeting.
examples.zh: 每位股东都有权在年会上投票。

examples.en: Although people fear them, few species of shark are dangerous to humans.
examples.zh: 尽管人们害怕鲨鱼,但对人类有危险的鲨鱼种类很少。

examples.en: The table shows a sharp fall in the birth rate after 1960.
examples.zh: 表格显示,1960 年后出生率急剧下降。

examples.en: My grandmother always wore a warm woollen shawl around her shoulders.
examples.zh: 我奶奶肩上总披着一条暖和的羊毛披肩。

examples.en: The sheer size of the building impressed visitors from all over the world.
examples.zh: 这座建筑的庞大规模本身就令世界各地的游客赞叹。

examples.en: The birds nest on sheer cliffs high above the sea.
examples.zh: 这些鸟把巢筑在高高的海上峭壁上。

examples.en: The hard shell protects the soft body of the animal inside.
examples.zh: 坚硬的外壳保护着里面动物柔软的身体。

examples.en: Fishing for shellfish has been banned because of pollution in the bay.
examples.zh: 由于海湾受到污染,捕捞贝类已被禁止。

examples.en: The caves provided shelter for early people during the coldest months.
examples.zh: 这些洞穴在最冷的几个月为早期人类提供了庇护。

examples.en: Trees planted along the coast shelter the town from strong winds.
examples.zh: 沿海种植的树木为小镇挡住了强风。

examples.en: A shepherd moved the sheep up into the hills every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天,牧羊人把羊赶到山上。

examples.en: Each soldier carried a round shield made of wood and leather.
examples.zh: 每个士兵都拿着一面用木头和皮革制成的圆盾。

examples.en: Thick walls were designed to shield the town from attack.
examples.zh: 厚厚的城墙是为了保护小镇免受攻击。

examples.en: I'm working the early shift tomorrow, so I have to get up at five.
examples.zh: 我明天上早班,所以五点就得起床。

examples.en: I bought a shiny red bike with the money from my first job.
examples.zh: 我用第一份工作的钱买了一辆闪亮的红色自行车。

examples.en: Pandas feed mainly on the young shoots and leaves of bamboo.
examples.zh: 大熊猫主要以竹子的嫩枝和叶子为食。

examples.en: The new shopping mall has over a hundred shops and a cinema.
examples.zh: 新购物中心有一百多家商店和一家电影院。

examples.en: I went on a shopping spree after getting my first month's pay.
examples.zh: 拿到第一个月工资后,我去疯狂购物了一番。

examples.en: Many turtles return to the same shore each year to lay their eggs.
examples.zh: 许多海龟每年回到同一片海岸产卵。

examples.en: The drug provides short-term relief but does not cure the illness.
examples.zh: 这种药能短期缓解症状,但无法治愈疾病。

examples.en: A shortage of affordable housing is forcing young people out of the city.
examples.zh: 经济适用房的短缺正把年轻人赶出城市。

examples.en: Spring showers help the young crops to grow strongly.
examples.zh: 春季阵雨有助于幼苗茁壮成长。

examples.en: Tiny shrimp are an important part of the diet of many whales.
examples.zh: 小虾是许多鲸鱼食物的重要组成部分。

examples.en: The size of the glacier has continued to shrink in recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来,这条冰川的面积持续缩小。

examples.en: Low shrubs are the main form of plant life in the dry hills.
examples.zh: 矮小的灌木是干燥山丘上主要的植物类型。

examples.en: We close the shutters at night to keep out the noise.
examples.zh: 我们晚上会关上百叶窗,挡住外面的噪音。

examples.en: A free shuttle bus runs between the terminal and the car park.
examples.zh: 航站楼和停车场之间有免费的接驳巴士。

examples.en: I was quite shy as a kid, so I rarely spoke up in class.
examples.zh: 我小时候挺害羞的,所以在课堂上很少发言。

examples.en: Children without siblings may have fewer chances to learn how to share.
examples.zh: 没有兄弟姐妹的孩子学习分享的机会可能更少。

examples.en: You should call your manager before nine if you need sick leave.
examples.zh: 如果需要请病假,应在九点前打电话给经理。

examples.en: Take one of these tablets before the boat trip to avoid sickness.
examples.zh: 坐船前吃一片这种药,可以防止恶心。

examples.en: A common side effect of the medicine is feeling tired during the day.
examples.zh: 这种药的一个常见副作用是白天感到疲倦。

examples.en: The city survived a siege lasting more than two years.
examples.zh: 这座城市在长达两年多的围攻中幸存了下来。

examples.en: We spent the morning sightseeing and the afternoon relaxing on the beach.
examples.zh: 我们上午观光,下午在海滩上放松。

examples.en: Deaf children learn sign language as naturally as others learn to speak.
examples.zh: 聋儿学习手语就像其他孩子学说话一样自然。

examples.en: The satellite sends a signal back to Earth every few minutes.
examples.zh: 这颗卫星每隔几分钟向地球发回一次信号。

examples.en: We need your signature at the bottom of the second page.
examples.zh: 我们需要你在第二页底部签名。

examples.en: Few people understood the significance of the discovery at the time.
examples.zh: 当时很少有人理解这一发现的重要性。

examples.en: There was a significant difference between the salaries of men and women.
examples.zh: 男女工资之间存在显著差异。

examples.en: Most computer chips are made from silicon, which comes from sand.
examples.zh: 大多数计算机芯片由来自沙子的硅制成。

examples.en: I bought a beautiful silk scarf for my mother when I was in Thailand.
examples.zh: 在泰国时,我给妈妈买了一条漂亮的丝绸围巾。

examples.en: The Chinese kept the secret of the silkworm for many centuries.
examples.zh: 中国人把蚕的秘密保守了许多个世纪。

examples.en: Bats use sound to find food; similarly, dolphins hunt using echoes.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠利用声音寻找食物,类似地,海豚也靠回声捕猎。

examples.en: The new form was designed to simplify the process of applying for aid.
examples.zh: 新表格的设计是为了简化申请援助的流程。

examples.en: Computers can simulate how a building would behave in an earthquake.
examples.zh: 计算机可以模拟建筑物在地震中的表现。

examples.en: Bees can carry pollen and collect nectar simultaneously as they move between flowers.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花间穿行时,能够同时携带花粉并采集花蜜。

examples.en: She's a very sincere person, and I always believe what she says.
examples.zh: 她是一个非常真诚的人,我总是相信她说的话。

examples.en: Children from a single-parent family can do just as well at school.
examples.zh: 单亲家庭的孩子在学校同样可以表现得很好。

examples.en: A single room costs £60 a night, including breakfast.
examples.zh: 单人间每晚 60 英镑,含早餐。

examples.en: Some people argue that girls do better in a single-sex school.
examples.zh: 有些人认为女孩在单性别学校表现更好。

examples.en: A single ticket to the city centre costs two pounds fifty.
examples.zh: 到市中心的单程票是两英镑五十便士。

examples.en: Some nouns have the same form in the singular as in the plural.
examples.zh: 有些名词的单数和复数形式相同。

examples.en: I love watching an old American sitcom when I need a laugh.
examples.zh: 想笑的时候,我喜欢看一部老的美国情景喜剧。

examples.en: Archaeologists found thousands of stone tools at the site.
examples.zh: 考古学家在这处遗址发现了数千件石器。

examples.en: Planners decided to situate the new factory far from the river.
examples.zh: 规划者决定把新工厂建在远离河流的地方。

examples.en: The outdoor skating rink opens in December, when the weather gets colder.
examples.zh: 室外滑冰场十二月开放,那时天气更冷了。

examples.en: The complete skeleton of a young woman was found near the old wall.
examples.zh: 在古墙附近发现了一具完整的年轻女性骨骼。

examples.en: I usually carry a small notebook so that I can make a quick sketch.
examples.zh: 我通常带一个小本子,这样可以随手画张素描。

examples.en: Cars may skid on wet roads if their tyres are worn.
examples.zh: 如果轮胎磨损,汽车在湿滑路面上可能打滑。

examples.en: We go skiing in Austria every winter with our cousins.
examples.zh: 我们每年冬天都和表亲去奥地利滑雪。

examples.en: There is a serious shortage of skilled workers in the building trade.
examples.zh: 建筑行业严重缺乏熟练工人。

examples.en: Try to skim the chapter first, then go back and take notes.
examples.zh: 先试着略读这一章,然后再回头做笔记。

examples.en: I was really skinny as a teenager, no matter how much I ate.
examples.zh: 我十几岁时特别瘦,怎么吃都不胖。

examples.en: You can skip the second chapter, as it won't be in the exam.
examples.zh: 第二章你可以跳过,因为考试不考。

examples.en: The shape of the skull suggests that this person lived on a hard diet.
examples.zh: 头骨的形状表明此人的饮食较硬。

examples.en: The development of the steel frame made the first skyscraper possible.
examples.zh: 钢框架的发展使第一座摩天大楼成为可能。

examples.en: A huge stone slab covered the entrance to the ancient tomb.
examples.zh: 一块巨大的石板盖住了古墓的入口。

examples.en: The company had to slash its advertising budget during the crisis.
examples.zh: 危机期间,这家公司不得不大幅削减广告预算。

examples.en: Slavery was finally abolished in the British Empire in the 1830s.
examples.zh: 19 世纪 30 年代,大英帝国终于废除了奴隶制。

examples.en: We took the overnight sleeper from London and arrived in Scotland at dawn.
examples.zh: 我们从伦敦坐夜间卧铺列车,黎明时到达苏格兰。

examples.en: I usually roll up the sleeves of my shirt when it gets hot.
examples.zh: 天热时我通常把衬衫袖子卷起来。

examples.en: My friend has long, slender fingers, which are perfect for playing the piano.
examples.zh: 我朋友的手指又长又纤细,非常适合弹钢琴。

examples.en: Would you like another slice of cake before you go?
examples.zh: 你走之前要再来一片蛋糕吗?

examples.en: Slice the tomatoes thinly and put them on top of the cheese.
examples.zh: 把番茄切成薄片,放在奶酪上面。

examples.en: The company's share of the market continued to slide in 2015.
examples.zh: 2015 年,这家公司的市场份额继续下滑。

examples.en: There was a slight decrease in the number of people using buses.
examples.zh: 乘坐公交车的人数略有减少。

examples.en: She's tall and slim, with long dark hair and big brown eyes.
examples.zh: 她又高又苗条,一头乌黑的长发,棕色的大眼睛。

examples.en: The company's slogan was soon known by people across the country.
examples.zh: 这家公司的口号很快就为全国人民所知。

examples.en: Tea grows well on the steep slopes of the mountains in this region.
examples.zh: 茶树在这一地区陡峭的山坡上长得很好。

examples.en: We've got a free slot for a lesson at three on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我们周三三点有一个空的上课时段。

examples.en: Put a coin in the slot and the machine will give you a ticket.
examples.zh: 往投币口放一枚硬币,机器就会出票。

examples.en: Millions of people in the region live in a slum without clean water.
examples.zh: 该地区有数百万人住在没有清洁用水的贫民窟。

examples.en: The housing market experienced a slump at the beginning of the 1990s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代初,住房市场经历了暴跌。

examples.en: The smartphone has changed the way people find information and communicate.
examples.zh: 智能手机改变了人们获取信息和交流的方式。

examples.en: Thick smog forced the government to close schools for several days.
examples.zh: 浓重的雾霾迫使政府关闭学校数日。

examples.en: A smoker is far more likely to develop lung cancer than other people.
examples.zh: 吸烟者患肺癌的可能性远高于其他人。

examples.en: I love the smooth feel of this old wooden box.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这个旧木盒光滑的手感。

examples.en: Tighter border controls have reduced the smuggling of goods.
examples.zh: 更严格的边境管制减少了货物走私。

examples.en: You can buy a snack from the machine next to the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 你可以在报告厅旁边的售货机上买零食。

examples.en: I keep an old snapshot of my family on the wall above my desk.
examples.zh: 我书桌上方的墙上挂着一张家人的旧快照。

examples.en: I can't stop sneezing whenever there's a cat in the room.
examples.zh: 只要房间里有猫,我就打喷嚏打个不停。

examples.en: Dogs sniff the air to detect the smell of other animals.
examples.zh: 狗嗅空气以察觉其他动物的气味。

examples.en: The water around the island is clear, so it's ideal for snorkelling.
examples.zh: 岛周围的海水清澈,非常适合浮潜。

examples.en: The seeds are soaked in water overnight to make them softer.
examples.zh: 种子在水中浸泡一夜,使其变软。

examples.en: My mum watches the same soap opera every evening after dinner.
examples.zh: 我妈妈每天晚饭后都看同一部肥皂剧。

examples.en: The number of internet users soared from one million to ten million.
examples.zh: 互联网用户数量从一百万猛增到一千万。

examples.en: I'm quite sociable, so I enjoy meeting new people at work.
examples.zh: 我挺好交际的,所以喜欢在工作中结识新朋友。

examples.en: Shared public spaces can help to improve social cohesion in large cities.
examples.zh: 共享的公共空间有助于增强大城市的社会凝聚力。

examples.en: Babies need plenty of social interaction in order to develop normally.
examples.zh: 婴儿需要大量社会交往才能正常发育。

examples.en: My social life has improved a lot since I joined the hiking club.
examples.zh: 加入徒步俱乐部后,我的社交生活丰富了很多。

examples.en: Social media makes it easy to stay in touch with friends abroad.
examples.zh: 社交媒体让人们很容易与国外的朋友保持联系。

examples.en: Free higher education can increase social mobility for children from poor families.
examples.zh: 免费高等教育能提高贫困家庭孩子的社会流动性。

examples.en: An ageing population puts increasing pressure on the social security system.
examples.zh: 人口老龄化给社会保障体系带来越来越大的压力。

examples.en: Higher taxes are needed to pay for social welfare programmes.
examples.zh: 需要提高税收来支付社会福利项目。

examples.en: I like to socialise with my colleagues after work on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我喜欢周五下班后和同事们交往聚会。

examples.en: Children who spend too much time online may become socially isolated.
examples.zh: 上网时间过长的孩子可能在社交上变得孤立。

examples.en: I've joined the film society, and we meet on Tuesday nights.
examples.zh: 我加入了电影社团,我们每周二晚上聚会。

examples.en: Technology has changed the way people in modern society communicate.
examples.zh: 科技改变了现代社会人们的交流方式。

examples.en: In sociology, we study how families and social groups change over time.
examples.zh: 在社会学中,我们研究家庭和社会群体如何随时间变化。

examples.en: There's only one socket in the room, so I bought an extension lead.
examples.zh: 房间里只有一个插座,所以我买了一个接线板。

examples.en: Too much sodium in the diet can lead to high blood pressure.
examples.zh: 饮食中钠过多可能导致高血压。

examples.en: The new software can translate speech into text almost immediately.
examples.zh: 新软件几乎能立刻把语音转成文字。

examples.en: Rich soil holds both water and the nutrients that plants need.
examples.zh: 肥沃的土壤既能保水,也含有植物所需的养分。

examples.en: Cutting down trees on hillsides can lead to serious soil erosion.
examples.zh: 砍伐山坡上的树木可能导致严重的水土流失。

examples.en: Solar energy now provides power to many remote villages.
examples.zh: 太阳能现在为许多偏远村庄提供电力。

examples.en: Many homes now have a solar panel on the roof to reduce their bills.
examples.zh: 现在许多家庭在屋顶安装太阳能电池板来减少电费。

examples.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
examples.zh: 木星是太阳系中最大的行星。

examples.en: The decision should not be based solely on the cost of the project.
examples.zh: 这项决定不应只基于项目成本。

examples.en: You should ask a solicitor for advice before signing the contract.
examples.zh: 签合同之前,你应该咨询律师。

examples.en: The strike was a rare show of solidarity among workers in different industries.
examples.zh: 这次罢工罕见地展现了不同行业工人之间的团结。

examples.en: Unlike lions, most other big cats lead a solitary life.
examples.zh: 与狮子不同,大多数其他大型猫科动物独自生活。

examples.en: Her solo was the best part of the whole evening.
examples.zh: 她的独奏是整晚最精彩的部分。

examples.en: He completed a solo walk across the country to raise money.
examples.zh: 他独自徒步穿越全国,为慈善筹款。

examples.en: The solubility of salt increases as the water becomes warmer.
examples.zh: 盐的溶解度随水温升高而增加。

examples.en: Sugar is soluble in water, but sand is not.
examples.zh: 糖可溶于水,但沙子不能。

examples.en: The metal dissolves slowly when it is placed in a weak acid solution.
examples.zh: 把这种金属放入弱酸溶液中,它会慢慢溶解。

examples.en: Recycling alone is not a complete solution to the problem of waste.
examples.zh: 仅靠回收并不能彻底解决废物问题。

examples.en: Water is an excellent solvent and can dissolve many different substances.
examples.zh: 水是极好的溶剂,能溶解许多不同的物质。

examples.en: The city was abandoned sometime in the twelfth century, but nobody knows why.
examples.zh: 这座城市在十二世纪的某个时候被遗弃,但没人知道原因。

examples.en: The results of later surveys were somewhat different from those of the first.
examples.zh: 后来几次调查的结果与第一次略有不同。

examples.en: Ships use sonar to measure the depth of the water beneath them.
examples.zh: 船只用声呐测量船下的水深。

examples.en: The ancient Egyptians developed a sophisticated system for moving water to their fields.
examples.zh: 古埃及人发展出一套精密的系统,把水引到田地里。

examples.en: She's a sophomore at a college in Boston, studying computer science.
examples.zh: 她是波士顿一所大学的大二学生,学习计算机科学。

examples.en: My legs were sore for two days after the long walk.
examples.zh: 长途步行后,我的腿酸痛了两天。

examples.en: Sorghum can grow in hot, dry areas where other cereals fail.
examples.zh: 高粱能在其他谷物难以生长的炎热干旱地区生长。

examples.en: The soundtrack of that film is my favourite music to study to.
examples.zh: 那部电影的原声音乐是我学习时最喜欢听的。

examples.en: The lake is in the south-west of the park, near the café.
examples.zh: 湖在公园的西南部,靠近咖啡馆。

examples.en: Birds from Europe spend the winter months in the southern hemisphere.
examples.zh: 来自欧洲的鸟在南半球度过冬季。

examples.en: I bought a small painting as a souvenir of my trip to Peru.
examples.zh: 我买了一幅小画,作为秘鲁之行的纪念品。

examples.en: Some people fear that globalisation reduces the sovereignty of smaller nations.
examples.zh: 有些人担心全球化削弱小国的主权。

examples.en: Farmers sow the seeds in spring, just after the last frost.
examples.zh: 农民在春天最后一场霜过后播种。

examples.en: The soybean is grown mainly for animal feed and for cooking oil.
examples.zh: 大豆主要用作动物饲料和食用油原料。

examples.en: The hotel has a spa with a sauna and a small indoor pool.
examples.zh: 酒店有一个水疗中心,设有桑拿房和小型室内泳池。

examples.en: Scientists on the space station carry out experiments in very low gravity.
examples.zh: 空间站上的科学家在极低重力下进行实验。

examples.en: The spacecraft travelled for seven years before reaching the planet.
examples.zh: 这艘航天器飞行了七年才到达这颗行星。

examples.en: Living on a spaceship for years would be a great challenge for humans.
examples.zh: 在宇宙飞船上生活多年对人类来说是巨大的挑战。

examples.en: The living room is spacious enough for a large sofa and a dining table.
examples.zh: 客厅很宽敞,放得下一张大沙发和一张餐桌。

examples.en: The study covers a span of more than fifty years.
examples.zh: 这项研究的时间跨度超过五十年。

examples.en: The bird's migration routes span several continents and thousands of kilometres.
examples.zh: 这种鸟的迁徙路线横跨几个大洲,长达数千公里。

examples.en: In my spare time, I like to go swimming or read a good book.
examples.zh: 空闲时间我喜欢游泳或读一本好书。

examples.en: A single spark from a train set the dry grass on fire.
examples.zh: 火车上的一个火星点燃了干草。

examples.en: The court's decision could spark a wider debate about water rights.
examples.zh: 法院的裁决可能引发一场关于水权的更广泛讨论。

examples.en: The number of house sparrows has fallen sharply in many European cities.
examples.zh: 在许多欧洲城市,家麻雀的数量急剧下降。

examples.en: Playing with building blocks helps children to develop spatial skills.
examples.zh: 玩积木有助于儿童发展空间能力。

examples.en: Salmon swim back up the same river to spawn each year.
examples.zh: 鲑鱼每年逆流游回同一条河产卵。

examples.en: The work requires specialised equipment that few laboratories can afford.
examples.zh: 这项工作需要专门的设备,很少有实验室买得起。

examples.en: More than two hundred species of bird have been recorded on the island.
examples.zh: 这座岛上已记录到两百多种鸟类。

examples.en: The programme was designed specifically for children with reading difficulties.
examples.zh: 这个项目是专门为有阅读困难的儿童设计的。

examples.en: The rules specify how much waste each factory may release.
examples.zh: 规定具体说明了每家工厂可以排放多少废物。

examples.en: The migration of the birds across the lake is an amazing spectacle.
examples.zh: 鸟群飞越湖面的迁徙是一幅令人惊叹的壮观景象。

examples.en: We watched a spectacular sunset from the beach on our last night.
examples.zh: 最后一晚,我们在海滩上看了一场壮观的日落。

examples.en: Over two thousand spectators watched the final match of the tournament.
examples.zh: 两千多名观众观看了锦标赛的决赛。

examples.en: Rainbows show the full spectrum of colours found in sunlight.
examples.zh: 彩虹展现了阳光中完整的色彩光谱。

examples.en: Researchers can only speculate about why the city was abandoned.
examples.zh: 研究者只能推测这座城市被遗弃的原因。

examples.en: Lowering the speed limit has reduced serious accidents near schools.
examples.zh: 降低限速减少了学校附近的严重事故。

examples.en: A number of chemicals in the environment may reduce sperm counts in men.
examples.zh: 环境中的一些化学物质可能降低男性的精子数量。

examples.en: The Earth is not a perfect sphere but is slightly flat at the poles.
examples.zh: 地球不是完美的球体,两极略扁。

examples.en: Women were largely excluded from the political sphere at that time.
examples.zh: 当时女性基本被排除在政治领域之外。

examples.en: I bought a little spherical lamp that looks just like the Moon.
examples.zh: 我买了一盏小球形灯,看起来就像月亮。

examples.en: Most spiders catch their food in webs made of very strong silk.
examples.zh: 大多数蜘蛛用极其坚韧的丝织成的网捕捉食物。

examples.en: The oil spill killed thousands of sea birds along the coast.
examples.zh: 这次石油泄漏导致沿海数千只海鸟死亡。

examples.en: Tankers sometimes spill oil into the sea when they are damaged.
examples.zh: 油轮受损时有时会把石油泄漏到海里。

examples.en: The spinal cord carries messages between the brain and the rest of the body.
examples.zh: 脊髓在大脑和身体其他部位之间传递信息。

examples.en: The human spine supports the head and protects important nerves.
examples.zh: 人的脊柱支撑头部,并保护重要的神经。

examples.en: Hard spines on the plant prevent animals from eating its leaves.
examples.zh: 这种植物上坚硬的刺防止动物吃它的叶子。

examples.en: The shell grows in a spiral as the animal inside gets bigger.
examples.zh: 随着里面的动物长大,贝壳呈螺旋状生长。

examples.en: The cathedral's tall spire can be seen from anywhere in the city.
examples.zh: 从城里任何地方都能看到大教堂高耸的尖塔。

examples.en: Mountains had a deep spiritual meaning for many ancient cultures.
examples.zh: 高山对许多古代文化有着深刻的精神意义。

examples.en: The spleen helps to filter the blood and fight infection.
examples.zh: 脾有助于过滤血液和抵抗感染。

examples.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from our hotel window.
examples.zh: 从酒店窗户望出去,群山的景色壮丽极了。

examples.en: Scientists can now splice genes from one organism into another.
examples.zh: 科学家现在可以把一种生物的基因拼接到另一种生物中。

examples.en: The company split into two separate businesses in the early 1990s.
examples.zh: 这家公司在 20 世纪 90 年代初分裂成两家独立的企业。

examples.en: Parents who give their children too many toys may spoil them.
examples.zh: 给孩子太多玩具的父母可能会把他们宠坏。

examples.en: Large numbers of tourists can spoil the natural beauty of an area.
examples.zh: 大量游客可能破坏一个地区的自然美景。

examples.en: A government spokesman denied that the policy would be changed.
examples.zh: 一位政府发言人否认这项政策会改变。

examples.en: A sponge feeds by drawing water through small holes in its body.
examples.zh: 海绵通过身上的小孔吸水来获取食物。

examples.en: A local bank is the main sponsor of this year's marathon.
examples.zh: 当地一家银行是今年马拉松的主要赞助商。

examples.en: Several shops have agreed to sponsor the school's summer sports day.
examples.zh: 几家商店同意赞助学校的夏季运动会。

examples.en: Children's spontaneous play helps them to develop social skills.
examples.zh: 儿童自发的游戏有助于发展社交能力。

examples.en: Spoon-feeding students leaves them unable to solve problems by themselves.
examples.zh: 填鸭式教学使学生无法独立解决问题。

examples.en: The wind can carry spores a long way from the parent plant.
examples.zh: 风能把孢子带到离母株很远的地方。

examples.en: The only free slot at the sports centre is at ten on Thursday.
examples.zh: 体育中心唯一空着的时段是周四十点。

examples.en: The spotlight followed the dancer as she moved across the stage.
examples.zh: 聚光灯跟着舞者在舞台上移动。

examples.en: Working abroad can put pressure on the relationship between a person and their spouse.
examples.zh: 在国外工作可能给一个人与配偶的关系带来压力。

examples.en: It's only a sprain, but you should rest your ankle for a week.
examples.zh: 只是扭伤,但你的脚踝应该休息一周。

examples.en: Be careful not to sprain your wrist when you lift heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 搬重箱子时小心别扭伤手腕。

examples.en: Local people have drawn fresh water from this spring for centuries.
examples.zh: 几个世纪以来,当地人一直从这眼泉取用淡水。

examples.en: The first green leaves sprout from the seeds within a few days.
examples.zh: 几天之内,种子就发芽长出第一批绿叶。

examples.en: Giant squid live so deep that they are rarely seen by humans.
examples.zh: 巨型鱿鱼生活在极深的海域,人类很少见到。

examples.en: The number of visitors began to stabilise at around two million in 2018.
examples.zh: 2018 年,游客数量开始稳定在两百万左右。

examples.en: There's a stack of old exam papers on the table by the door.
examples.zh: 门边的桌子上有一堆旧试卷。

examples.en: Older books are kept in the stacks and must be requested at the desk.
examples.zh: 较旧的书放在书库里,要到服务台申请调阅。

examples.en: The new stadium holds forty thousand people and has a roof.
examples.zh: 新体育场能容纳四万人,还有屋顶。

examples.en: At the first stage of the process, the fruit is washed and sorted.
examples.zh: 在这一过程的第一阶段,水果被清洗和分拣。

examples.en: The government still holds a large stake in the national airline.
examples.zh: 政府仍持有这家国家航空公司的大量股份。

examples.en: Corn plants have tall stalks that can reach three metres in height.
examples.zh: 玉米植株的茎秆很高,可达三米。

examples.en: We bought some fresh cheese from a stall at the Saturday market.
examples.zh: 我们在周六集市的一个货摊上买了些新鲜奶酪。

examples.en: Running twice a week has really improved my stamina.
examples.zh: 每周跑两次步确实提高了我的耐力。

examples.en: Scientists have taken a more cautious stance on the use of the new drug.
examples.zh: 科学家对使用这种新药采取了更谨慎的立场。

examples.en: The government tried to standardise the spelling of the national language.
examples.zh: 政府试图统一这种国语的拼写。

examples.en: A standardised test cannot measure every skill that students need.
examples.zh: 标准化考试无法衡量学生需要的每一项技能。

examples.en: Rice is the staple food for many families in this part of Asia.
examples.zh: 在亚洲这一地区,大米是许多家庭的主食。

examples.en: Potatoes are rich in starch, which provides the body with energy.
examples.zh: 土豆富含淀粉,能为身体提供能量。

examples.en: A starfish can grow a new arm if one is damaged.
examples.zh: 海星的腕受损后能再长出一条新的。

examples.en: The start-up received funding from investors to develop its new app.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司获得了投资者的资金,用于开发新应用。

examples.en: I'll have the soup as a starter, followed by the grilled fish.
examples.zh: 我先点汤作为开胃菜,然后要烤鱼。

examples.en: Millions of people still face starvation because of war and drought.
examples.zh: 由于战争和干旱,数百万人仍然面临饥饿。

examples.en: The new hospital has state-of-the-art equipment for treating heart disease.
examples.zh: 新医院拥有治疗心脏病的最先进设备。

examples.en: Many parents believe that a state school can offer an equally good education.
examples.zh: 许多家长认为,公立学校同样能提供良好的教育。

examples.en: Your monthly statement shows every payment you've made from the account.
examples.zh: 你的月度对账单显示了从账户支出的每一笔款项。

examples.en: The bank issued a statement apologising for the problems with its website.
examples.zh: 这家银行发表声明,就网站出现的问题道歉。

examples.en: The figures remained static for ten years before beginning to rise.
examples.zh: 这些数字十年间保持不变,之后才开始上升。

examples.en: Rubbing a balloon on your hair produces static electricity.
examples.zh: 用气球摩擦头发会产生静电。

examples.en: A statistician checked the data to make sure that the results were reliable.
examples.zh: 一位统计学家检查了数据,确保结果可靠。

examples.en: Official statistics show that fewer people are buying newspapers.
examples.zh: 官方统计数据显示,买报纸的人越来越少。

examples.en: Statistics is the hardest part of my psychology course this year.
examples.zh: 统计学是我今年心理学课程中最难的部分。

examples.en: The statue at the entrance shows the man who started the school.
examples.zh: 入口处的雕像塑的是这所学校的创办人。

examples.en: The graph shows a steady rise in the use of public transport.
examples.zh: 图表显示,公共交通的使用量平稳上升。

examples.en: Early railways used steam to power their engines.
examples.zh: 早期的铁路用蒸汽为发动机提供动力。

examples.en: The use of steel allowed engineers to build much longer bridges.
examples.zh: 钢材的使用使工程师能够建造更长的桥梁。

examples.en: There was a steep rise in the number of cars during the 1980s.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 80 年代,汽车数量急剧上升。

examples.en: The new policy aims to steer young people towards careers in science.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在引导年轻人从事科学领域的职业。

examples.en: Water travels up the stem from the roots to the leaves.
examples.zh: 水沿着茎从根部输送到叶子。

examples.en: Many of the city's traffic problems stem from its narrow medieval streets.
examples.zh: 这座城市的许多交通问题源于狭窄的中世纪街道。

examples.en: The next step involves heating the mixture to a high temperature.
examples.zh: 下一步是把混合物加热到高温。

examples.en: Television often reinforces the stereotype of older people as weak and helpless.
examples.zh: 电视常常强化老年人虚弱无助的刻板印象。

examples.en: The hotel only accepts payment in sterling, not in euros.
examples.zh: 这家酒店只接受英镑付款,不收欧元。

examples.en: Sitting for long hours can leave the muscles of the back stiff.
examples.zh: 久坐会使背部肌肉僵硬。

examples.en: Small shops face stiff competition from large supermarkets and online stores.
examples.zh: 小商店面临大型超市和网店的激烈竞争。

examples.en: Lower taxes may stimulate investment in small businesses.
examples.zh: 减税可能刺激对小企业的投资。

examples.en: The rats quickly learned to respond to the new stimulus.
examples.zh: 老鼠很快学会了对新的刺激作出反应。

examples.en: The agreement stipulates that the land must be used only for farming.
examples.zh: 协议规定,这片土地只能用于耕作。

examples.en: The price of the company's stock fell sharply after the report.
examples.zh: 报告发表后,该公司的股票价格急剧下跌。

examples.en: Supermarkets now keep very little stock in their own warehouses.
