examples.zh: 现在超市自己的仓库里库存很少。

examples.en: My uncle is short and stocky, but he's really strong.
examples.zh: 我叔叔个子矮、身材壮实,但力气很大。

examples.en: People in the Stone Age made sharp tools from a type of hard rock.
examples.zh: 石器时代的人用一种坚硬的岩石制作锋利的工具。

examples.en: The kitchen has a narrow counter with two stools.
examples.zh: 厨房有一个窄窄的吧台,配了两张凳子。

examples.en: There's a three-hour stopover in Dubai on the way to Australia.
examples.zh: 去澳大利亚途中要在迪拜停留三小时。

examples.en: Cheap storage of electricity remains the main challenge for solar power.
examples.zh: 廉价储电仍是太阳能面临的主要挑战。

examples.en: Residents can leave their suitcases in the storeroom during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期里住户可以把行李箱放在储藏室。

examples.en: The new office building will be twenty storeys high.
examples.zh: 新办公楼将有二十层高。

examples.en: My best friend has long straight hair down to her waist.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友有一头齐腰的长直发。

examples.en: The answer to this question is not as straightforward as it seems.
examples.zh: 这个问题的答案并不像看起来那么简单。

examples.en: A new strain of the virus has spread rapidly through the region.
examples.zh: 这种病毒的一个新品种已在该地区迅速传播。

examples.en: Rapid population growth has put a great strain on the water supply.
examples.zh: 人口快速增长给供水带来了巨大压力。

examples.en: Thousands of ships pass through this narrow strait each year.
examples.zh: 每年有数千艘船只通过这条狭窄的海峡。

examples.en: A single strand of hair can provide a surprising amount of information.
examples.zh: 一根头发就能提供惊人的大量信息。

examples.en: The strap on my bag broke while I was running for the bus.
examples.zh: 我跑着赶公交时,包带断了。

examples.en: Hiding in tall grass is a common survival strategy among young deer.
examples.zh: 躲在高草丛中是幼鹿常见的生存策略。

examples.en: Each stratum of rock contains clues about conditions at a particular time.
examples.zh: 每一层岩层都包含着某一时期环境的线索。

examples.en: The best thing about visiting Bangkok was definitely the street food.
examples.zh: 去曼谷最棒的事情无疑是街头小吃。

examples.en: Regular exercise can strengthen the bones and reduce the risk of falls.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼可以强健骨骼,降低跌倒的风险。

examples.en: Long working hours are a major cause of stress among office staff.
examples.zh: 长时间工作是办公室员工压力的主要来源。

examples.en: I get really stressed when I have too many deadlines at once.
examples.zh: 同时有太多截止日期时,我会感到压力特别大。

examples.en: Living in a large city can be noisy and stressful.
examples.zh: 住在大城市可能既吵闹又有压力。

examples.en: Remember to stretch your legs before you start running.
examples.zh: 开始跑步前记得伸展腿部。

examples.en: My parents were quite strict with me when I was at school.
examples.zh: 我上学时,父母对我挺严格的。

examples.en: There is a striking similarity between the two languages.
examples.zh: 这两种语言有显著的相似之处。

examples.en: The law introduced stringent controls on the use of pesticides.
examples.zh: 这项法律对农药使用实施了严格的管控。

examples.en: My favourite shirt is an old blue and white striped one.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的衬衫是一件旧的蓝白条纹衫。

examples.en: Scientists continue to strive for a better understanding of the brain.
examples.zh: 科学家继续努力更好地理解大脑。

examples.en: A stroke happens when the supply of blood to the brain is blocked.
examples.zh: 当大脑的血液供应被阻断时,就会发生中风。

examples.en: The structure of the building allows it to move during an earthquake.
examples.zh: 这座建筑的结构使它能在地震时摆动。

examples.en: My grandfather is so stubborn that he refuses to use a mobile phone.
examples.zh: 我爷爷特别固执,就是不肯用手机。

examples.en: A student loan can take many years to pay back after graduation.
examples.zh: 学生贷款可能要在毕业后很多年才能还清。

examples.en: The student union organises parties and cheap trips throughout the year.
examples.zh: 学生会全年组织派对和便宜的旅行。

examples.en: I rented a studio near campus because it was cheaper than a shared house.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近租了一间单间公寓,因为比合租房子便宜。

examples.en: The radio studio is on the third floor, next to the lifts.
examples.zh: 广播演播室在三楼,就在电梯旁边。

examples.en: A studio apartment has just one main room for sleeping, cooking and relaxing.
examples.zh: 单间公寓只有一个主要房间,睡觉、做饭和休息都在里面。

examples.en: Students who study abroad often gain independence and new language skills.
examples.zh: 出国留学的学生常常变得更独立,并掌握新的语言技能。

examples.en: You can book a study room for up to three hours a day.
examples.zh: 自习室每天最多可预订三小时。

examples.en: We need a sturdy table, because the children are always climbing on it.
examples.zh: 我们需要一张结实的桌子,因为孩子们总爬上去。

examples.en: My aunt is always stylish, even though she doesn't spend much on clothes.
examples.zh: 我阿姨总是很有型,虽然她在衣服上花钱不多。

examples.en: Subconscious memories may influence the choices people make without their realising it.
examples.zh: 潜意识中的记忆可能在不知不觉中影响人们的选择。

examples.en: Each section of the report should have its own subheading.
examples.zh: 报告的每个部分都应有自己的副标题。

examples.en: Judgements about the quality of art are inevitably subjective.
examples.zh: 对艺术品质量的判断难免是主观的。

examples.en: Scientists used a small submarine to study life on the ocean floor.
examples.zh: 科学家用一艘小型潜艇研究海底生物。

examples.en: You must submit your assignment online before midnight on Sunday.
examples.zh: 你必须在周日午夜前在线提交作业。

examples.en: In the old system, the needs of workers were subordinate to those of owners.
examples.zh: 在旧制度下,工人的需求次于所有者的需求。

examples.en: A good manager listens carefully to the ideas of each subordinate.
examples.zh: 好的管理者会认真听取每位下属的想法。

examples.en: The disease first appeared in Asia and subsequently spread to Europe.
examples.zh: 这种疾病最早出现在亚洲,随后传到了欧洲。

examples.en: The researchers studied a small subset of the full data.
examples.zh: 研究者研究了全部数据中的一小部分子集。

examples.en: Governments should subsidise public transport so that fares remain low.
examples.zh: 政府应该补贴公共交通,使票价保持在低水平。

examples.en: A government subsidy keeps the price of bread low in many countries.
examples.zh: 在许多国家,政府补贴使面包价格保持在低水平。

examples.en: In winter, the deer subsist on bark and small branches.
examples.zh: 冬天,鹿靠树皮和小树枝维持生存。

examples.en: This substance becomes a liquid when it is heated above ninety degrees.
examples.zh: 这种物质加热到九十度以上就会变成液体。

examples.en: The chart shows a substantial increase in spending on online advertising.
examples.zh: 图表显示,网络广告支出大幅增长。

examples.en: There is little data to substantiate the claims made by the company.
examples.zh: 几乎没有数据能证实该公司的说法。

examples.en: Blind fish live in the dark waters of these subterranean lakes.
examples.zh: 失明的鱼生活在这些地下湖的黑暗水域中。

examples.en: Even subtle changes in temperature can affect how these insects behave.
examples.zh: 即使温度的细微变化,也会影响这些昆虫的行为。

examples.en: To find the difference, subtract the smaller number from the larger one.
examples.zh: 要求差值,就用较大的数减去较小的数。

examples.en: We moved to a quiet suburb about thirty minutes from the city centre.
examples.zh: 我们搬到了一个安静的郊区,距离市中心大约三十分钟。

examples.en: Suburban families tend to rely on private cars for almost every journey.
examples.zh: 郊区家庭几乎每次出行都依赖私家车。

examples.en: Take the subway to Central Park and then walk for five minutes.
examples.zh: 乘地铁到中央公园,然后步行五分钟。

examples.en: Use the subway under the road to reach the other side safely.
examples.zh: 走马路下面的地下通道可以安全到达对面。

examples.en: The region suffered a succession of poor harvests during the 1840s.
examples.zh: 19 世纪 40 年代,该地区接连遭遇歉收。

examples.en: The king's death led to a long dispute over the succession.
examples.zh: 国王去世后,围绕继承权发生了长期争端。

examples.en: Many of the settlers succumbed to disease during their first winter.
examples.zh: 许多定居者在第一个冬天死于疾病。

examples.en: Customers may sue a company if its products cause them harm.
examples.zh: 如果产品对顾客造成伤害,顾客可以起诉公司。

examples.en: There is not yet sufficient evidence to support this explanation.
examples.zh: 目前还没有充足的证据支持这一解释。

examples.en: Recent findings suggest that bees can recognise individual human faces.
examples.zh: 最新发现表明,蜜蜂能够识别人类的面孔。

examples.en: The report suggests building more cycle paths to reduce traffic in the city.
examples.zh: 报告建议修建更多自行车道,以减少城市交通流量。

examples.en: Mental health services can help to reduce the risk of suicide among teenagers.
examples.zh: 心理健康服务有助于降低青少年的自杀风险。

examples.en: Much of the land in the north is not suitable for growing crops.
examples.zh: 北部的许多土地不适合种植庄稼。

examples.en: My suitcase didn't arrive with me, so I reported it at the desk.
examples.zh: 我的手提箱没有和我一起到,所以我去服务台报告了。

examples.en: The hotel upgraded us to a suite with a separate living room.
examples.zh: 酒店把我们升级到了带独立客厅的套房。

examples.en: Burning coal releases sulphur, which can later fall as acid rain.
examples.zh: 燃煤释放硫,之后可能形成酸雨。

examples.en: The sum spent on advertising rose sharply in the final year.
examples.zh: 最后一年的广告支出总额急剧上升。

examples.en: The final chapter summarises the main findings of the research.
examples.zh: 最后一章总结了这项研究的主要发现。

examples.en: Write a brief summary of the article in your own words.
examples.zh: 用你自己的话写一篇这篇文章的简短摘要。

examples.en: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain just after sunrise.
examples.zh: 登山者在日出后不久到达了山顶。

examples.en: World leaders met at a summit to discuss the reduction of carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 世界各国领导人在峰会上讨论减少碳排放的问题。

examples.en: The king summoned his advisers to discuss the threat of invasion.
examples.zh: 国王召集大臣们商讨入侵的威胁。

examples.en: Bring a hat and some sunscreen, as there's little shade on the island.
examples.zh: 带上帽子和防晒霜,因为岛上没什么阴凉的地方。

examples.en: The similarities between the two species are only superficial.
examples.zh: 这两个物种之间的相似之处只是表面的。

examples.en: The new material proved superior to steel in almost every test.
examples.zh: 事实证明,这种新材料在几乎所有测试中都优于钢材。

examples.en: Employees often feel unable to disagree openly with their superiors.
examples.zh: 员工常常觉得无法公开反对上级。

examples.en: A supernova occurs when a very large star explodes at the end of its life.
examples.zh: 当一颗非常大的恒星在生命末期爆炸时,就形成了超新星。

examples.en: Experienced staff supervise the students during their first year of training.
examples.zh: 培训的第一年,由有经验的员工监督学生。

examples.en: You should tell your supervisor in advance if you need a day off.
examples.zh: 如果需要请假,你应该提前告诉主管。

examples.en: Supplementary classes were offered to children who had fallen behind.
examples.zh: 学校为落后的孩子提供了补充课程。

examples.en: A reliable water supply is essential for the growth of any city.
examples.zh: 可靠的供水对任何城市的发展都至关重要。

examples.en: Local farmers supply most of the vegetables sold in the town's markets.
examples.zh: 当地农民供应镇上市场出售的大部分蔬菜。

examples.en: My family has always been very supportive of my decision to study abroad.
examples.zh: 我的家人一直很支持我出国留学的决定。

examples.en: The treatment is supposedly safe, but few long-term studies have been done.
examples.zh: 据说这种疗法是安全的,但很少有长期研究。

examples.en: Some medicines suppress the body's natural response to infection.
examples.zh: 有些药物会抑制身体对感染的自然反应。

examples.en: The emperor held supreme power over all parts of the empire.
examples.zh: 皇帝对帝国各地拥有最高权力。

examples.en: The beach is popular for surfing because the waves are so big.
examples.zh: 这片海滩因海浪很大而成为冲浪胜地。

examples.en: There was a surge in demand for electric cars after 2020.
examples.zh: 2020 年后,电动汽车的需求激增。

examples.en: The surgeon explained how long the operation on my shoulder would take.
examples.zh: 外科医生解释了我的肩部手术需要多长时间。

examples.en: The doctor's surgery is closed on Saturday afternoons and all day Sunday.
examples.zh: 这家诊所周六下午和周日全天不开门。

examples.en: My father needed surgery on his knee after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故后,我父亲的膝盖需要动手术。

examples.en: In many countries, a woman no longer takes her husband's surname.
examples.zh: 在许多国家,女性不再随丈夫的姓。

examples.en: Sales of online books may surpass those of printed ones by 2030.
examples.zh: 到 2030 年,电子书销量可能超越纸质书。

examples.en: Countries with a food surplus can sell the extra to their neighbours.
examples.zh: 粮食过剩的国家可以把多余的卖给邻国。

examples.en: I work better in quiet surroundings, so I often go to the library.
examples.zh: 我在安静的环境中工作效率更高,所以常去图书馆。

examples.en: Increased surveillance may reduce crime, but it also threatens personal privacy.
examples.zh: 加强监控也许能减少犯罪,但也威胁个人隐私。

examples.en: The survey found that most students walk or cycle to college.
examples.zh: 调查发现,大多数学生步行或骑车上学。

examples.en: We plan to survey local shoppers about their use of plastic bags.
examples.zh: 我们计划调查当地购物者使用塑料袋的情况。

examples.en: The survival of many species depends on protecting their natural homes.
examples.zh: 许多物种的生存取决于保护它们的自然家园。

examples.en: Elderly people are more susceptible to infection during the winter months.
examples.zh: 老年人在冬季更容易受到感染。

examples.en: Police have questioned a suspect in connection with the robbery.
examples.zh: 警方已就这起抢劫案询问了一名嫌疑人。

examples.en: Many experts suspect that the real figures are far higher.
examples.zh: 许多专家怀疑实际数字要高得多。

examples.en: The trial of the drug was suspended after several patients became ill.
examples.zh: 几名患者生病后,这种药物的试验被暂停。

examples.en: A good suspension system makes the ride more comfortable on rough roads.
examples.zh: 良好的悬架系统使车辆在崎岖路面上行驶更舒适。

examples.en: The suspension of the train service caused long delays for commuters.
examples.zh: 火车停运给通勤者造成了长时间延误。

examples.en: My grandfather is a bit suspicious of anything he buys online.
examples.zh: 我爷爷对网上买的东西都有点疑心。

examples.en: I got a suspicious email last week, so I deleted it straight away.
examples.zh: 我上周收到一封可疑的邮件,就马上删掉了。

examples.en: The land could no longer sustain such a large population.
examples.zh: 这片土地再也无法维持这么多人口。

examples.en: Farmers are being encouraged to adopt more sustainable methods of fishing.
examples.zh: 人们鼓励渔民采用更可持续的捕鱼方法。

examples.en: Sustainable development meets present needs without harming future generations.
examples.zh: 可持续发展既满足当前需要,又不损害子孙后代。

examples.en: Older patients sometimes find it difficult to swallow large tablets.
examples.zh: 老年患者有时很难吞咽大药片。

examples.en: Crocodiles and many kinds of snakes live in the swamp.
examples.zh: 沼泽里生活着鳄鱼和多种蛇。

examples.en: Could I swap this shirt for a smaller one, please?
examples.zh: 我可以把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗?

examples.en: A swarm of locusts can destroy a whole field of crops in hours.
examples.zh: 一群蝗虫能在几小时内毁掉整片庄稼。

examples.en: Workers in the sweatshop sewed clothes for very low wages.
examples.zh: 血汗工厂的工人以极低的工资缝制衣服。

examples.en: Wood tends to swell when it becomes wet, so doors may stick.
examples.zh: 木头受潮后容易膨胀,所以门可能卡住。

examples.en: The swimming pool will be closed for cleaning all next week.
examples.zh: 游泳池下周全周关闭清洁。

examples.en: Only wealthy warriors could afford a sword made from good steel.
examples.zh: 只有富有的武士才买得起优质钢制成的剑。

examples.en: Japanese words are built from short units that are similar to a syllable.
examples.zh: 日语单词由类似音节的短单位构成。

examples.en: You can download the syllabus and reading list from the course website.
examples.zh: 你可以从课程网站下载教学大纲和阅读书目。

examples.en: Corals live in symbiosis with tiny plants that provide them with food.
examples.zh: 珊瑚与为其提供食物的微小植物共生。

examples.en: Early farmers used a simple symbol to represent each type of grain.
examples.zh: 早期农民用简单的符号表示每种谷物。

examples.en: Most animals have a natural symmetry in the shape of their bodies.
examples.zh: 大多数动物的身体形状具有天然的对称性。

examples.en: Local people were sympathetic to the workers and gave them food.
examples.zh: 当地人同情这些工人,给他们送去了食物。

examples.en: The composer wrote his final symphony when he was almost completely deaf.
examples.zh: 这位作曲家创作最后一部交响乐时几乎完全失聪。

examples.en: Common symptoms of the flu include a high temperature and sore muscles.
examples.zh: 流感的常见症状包括高烧和肌肉酸痛。

examples.en: The syndrome causes extreme tiredness that can last for several months.
examples.zh: 这种综合征会引起持续数月的极度疲劳。

examples.en: Write a short synopsis of the book in about two hundred words.
examples.zh: 用大约两百词写一份这本书的简短梗概。

examples.en: Syntactic rules determine the order of words in a sentence.
examples.zh: 句法规则决定句子中的词序。

examples.en: The syntax of English has changed relatively little in the past few centuries.
examples.zh: 过去几个世纪,英语的句法变化相对较小。

examples.en: The synthesis of new materials has become an important area of research.
examples.zh: 新材料的合成已成为一个重要的研究领域。

examples.en: Synthetic fibres such as nylon are made from chemicals found in oil.
examples.zh: 尼龙等合成纤维由石油中的化学物质制成。

examples.en: Children under six should take the cough syrup instead of tablets.
examples.zh: 六岁以下的儿童应该服用止咳糖浆,而不是药片。

examples.en: The team carried out a systematic review of all the earlier studies.
examples.zh: 研究团队对此前所有研究进行了系统性回顾。

examples.en: Go to the end of this road and turn right at the T-junction.
examples.zh: 走到这条路的尽头,在丁字路口右转。

examples.en: The table below compares the cost of living in three cities.
examples.zh: 下表比较了三个城市的生活成本。

examples.en: Take two tablets with water after every meal.
examples.zh: 每餐后用水送服两片药。

examples.en: I read most of my course books on a tablet these days.
examples.zh: 现在我的课本大多在平板电脑上看。

examples.en: Tabloid newspapers often focus on the private lives of famous people.
examples.zh: 小报常常关注名人的私生活。

examples.en: In some cultures, there is a strict taboo against eating certain animals.
examples.zh: 在一些文化中,吃某些动物有严格的禁忌。

examples.en: Governments must work together to tackle the problem of plastic waste.
examples.zh: 各国政府必须共同努力,解决塑料垃圾问题。

examples.en: The police changed their tactics after criticism of the way they treated protesters.
examples.zh: 警方因对待抗议者的方式受到批评,改变了策略。

examples.en: The number of people who train as a tailor has fallen sharply.
examples.zh: 接受裁缝培训的人数急剧下降。

examples.en: Students should take advantage of the opportunities offered by the internet.
examples.zh: 学生应该利用互联网提供的机会。

examples.en: Governments should take into account the needs of older people when planning transport.
examples.zh: 政府在规划交通时应考虑老年人的需求。

examples.en: Employers should take into consideration the experience of each candidate.
examples.zh: 雇主应考虑每位候选人的经验。

examples.en: Governments must take measures to reduce the level of air pollution.
examples.zh: 政府必须采取措施降低空气污染水平。

examples.en: It's a good idea to take notes during the lecture and read them later.
examples.zh: 听讲座时记笔记,之后再看一遍,是个好办法。

examples.en: Parents should take responsibility for teaching their children good manners.
examples.zh: 父母应该负责教孩子良好的礼貌。

examples.en: Doctors advise older people to take up gentle forms of exercise.
examples.zh: 医生建议老年人开始进行温和的运动。

examples.en: We were too tired to cook, so we ordered a Chinese takeaway.
examples.zh: 我们累得不想做饭,就点了中餐外卖。

examples.en: Please turn off your phones and fasten your seatbelts before takeoff.
examples.zh: 起飞前请关闭手机并系好安全带。

examples.en: Schools should help every child to discover their natural talent.
examples.zh: 学校应该帮助每个孩子发现自己的天赋。

examples.en: My friend is a really talented singer who has performed on television.
examples.zh: 我的朋友是一位很有才华的歌手,还上过电视。

examples.en: The programme has brought tangible benefits to people in the poorest areas.
examples.zh: 这个项目给最贫困地区的人们带来了切实的好处。

examples.en: My friend and I took a tango class, but we were both terrible.
examples.zh: 我和朋友上过一节探戈课,但我们俩都跳得很差。

examples.en: Taoism teaches that people should live in harmony with the natural world.
examples.zh: 道教主张人应与自然和谐相处。

examples.en: Engineers hope to tap the heat stored deep under the ground.
examples.zh: 工程师希望开发利用地下深处储存的热能。

examples.en: A high tariff on imported steel protected local producers from competition.
examples.zh: 进口钢材的高关税保护了本地生产商免受竞争。

examples.en: A higher tax on fuel could encourage people to drive less.
examples.zh: 提高燃油税可以鼓励人们少开车。

examples.en: The government decided to tax sugary drinks in order to improve public health.
examples.zh: 政府决定对含糖饮料征税,以改善公众健康。

examples.en: Tax evasion costs governments billions of pounds in lost money every year.
examples.zh: 逃税每年使各国政府损失数十亿英镑。

examples.en: Progressive taxation means that people with higher incomes pay a larger share.
examples.zh: 累进税收意味着收入较高的人缴纳更大比例的税。

examples.en: Every taxpayer has the right to know how public money is spent.
examples.zh: 每位纳税人都有权知道公共资金的使用情况。

examples.en: A low teacher-student ratio can make it hard for pupils to get help.
examples.zh: 师生比低会使学生很难得到帮助。

examples.en: My grandfather likes to meet his old friends at the local teahouse.
examples.zh: 我爷爷喜欢在当地的茶馆和老朋友见面。

examples.en: Team sports help children to develop a strong team spirit.
examples.zh: 团队运动帮助孩子培养强烈的团队精神。

examples.en: Good teamwork is essential if you want to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 想按时完成项目,良好的团队合作必不可少。

examples.en: A technician will come to fix the printer this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午技术员会来修打印机。

examples.en: Farmers developed a new technique for storing water during the dry season.
examples.zh: 农民发展出一种在旱季储水的新技术。

examples.en: Rapid technological change has made many traditional jobs disappear.
examples.zh: 快速的技术变革使许多传统工作消失了。

examples.en: New technology has changed the way that people work and study.
examples.zh: 新技术改变了人们的工作和学习方式。

examples.en: Mountains often form where one tectonic plate pushes against another.
examples.zh: 山脉常常在一个构造板块挤压另一个板块的地方形成。

examples.en: I find filling in forms really tedious, so I always leave it until last.
examples.zh: 我觉得填表特别乏味,所以总是留到最后。

examples.en: Telecommunication satellites allow people to make calls from remote areas.
examples.zh: 电信卫星让人们能在偏远地区打电话。

examples.en: With his telescope, Galileo discovered four moons around Jupiter.
examples.zh: 伽利略用望远镜发现了木星的四颗卫星。

examples.en: The teller asked to see my passport before giving me the money.
examples.zh: 银行出纳员要求先看我的护照才把钱给我。

examples.en: Babies show differences in temperament from the first weeks of life.
examples.zh: 婴儿从出生头几周起就表现出性情上的差异。

examples.en: My boss can be quite temperamental, so we're careful what we say.
examples.zh: 我的老板有时喜怒无常,所以我们说话很小心。

examples.en: Oak and beech trees are common in temperate forests.
examples.zh: 橡树和山毛榉在温带森林中很常见。

examples.en: The average temperature on the island is about twenty degrees.
examples.zh: 这座岛的平均气温约为二十度。

examples.en: The temple stands on a hill and can be seen from miles away.
examples.zh: 寺庙矗立在山上,几英里外都能看到。

examples.en: Workers lived in temporary housing while the new town was being built.
examples.zh: 新城建设期间,工人们住在临时住房里。

examples.en: It is tempting for young people to buy things they cannot afford.
examples.zh: 对年轻人来说,买自己负担不起的东西很诱人。

examples.en: The tenancy runs for twelve months and starts on the first of September.
examples.zh: 租期为十二个月,从九月一日开始。

examples.en: Read the tenancy agreement carefully before you sign it and pay the deposit.
examples.zh: 签字和付押金之前,请仔细阅读租赁合同。

examples.en: The tenant must report any repairs to the landlord within two days.
examples.zh: 租户必须在两天内向房东报修。

examples.en: People have a natural tendency to remember bad news better than good news.
examples.zh: 人们天生倾向于比好消息更容易记住坏消息。

examples.en: Companies were invited to submit a tender for building the new bridge.
examples.zh: 公司受邀就建造新桥提交投标。

examples.en: Some languages have no verb forms to show past or future tense.
examples.zh: 有些语言没有表示过去或将来时态的动词形式。

examples.en: Relations between the two countries remained tense for several years.
examples.zh: 两国关系多年来一直紧张。

examples.en: Put up your tent before dark, as there are no lights at the site.
examples.zh: 天黑前把帐篷搭好,因为营地没有灯。

examples.en: The jellyfish catches small fish with its long tentacles.
examples.zh: 水母用长长的触手捕捉小鱼。

examples.en: The team reached a tentative conclusion, which will need further testing.
examples.zh: 研究团队得出了一个初步结论,还需要进一步检验。

examples.en: The library stays open until midnight during the summer term.
examples.zh: 夏季学期图书馆开放到午夜。

examples.en: Your tutor will explain any technical terms you don't understand.
examples.zh: 导师会解释你不懂的专业术语。

examples.en: International flights leave from the new terminal on the other side of the airport.
examples.zh: 国际航班从机场另一侧的新航站楼出发。

examples.en: Termites build huge nests that stay at a constant temperature.
examples.zh: 白蚁建造巨大的巢穴,巢内温度保持恒定。

examples.en: We often eat outside on the terrace when the weather is warm.
examples.zh: 天气暖和时,我们常在露台上吃饭。

examples.en: Our house is in the middle of a long terrace of brick homes.
examples.zh: 我们家位于一长排砖砌排屋的中间。

examples.en: Our terraced house shares walls with the neighbours on both sides.
examples.zh: 我们的联排房屋与两边的邻居共用墙壁。

examples.en: The rocky terrain made it very difficult to build roads through the region.
examples.zh: 岩石嶙峋的地形使这一地区很难修路。

examples.en: Whales evolved from terrestrial animals that returned to the sea.
examples.zh: 鲸是由重返海洋的陆地动物进化而来的。

examples.en: The early flying machines were terribly difficult to control.
examples.zh: 早期的飞行器非常难操控。

examples.en: We had a terrific time at the beach with all my cousins.
examples.zh: 我们和所有表亲在海滩玩得开心极了。

examples.en: Male birds sing loudly to defend their territory against rivals.
examples.zh: 雄鸟大声鸣叫,保卫领地不受对手侵犯。

examples.en: Tertiary education should be free for students from poor families.
examples.zh: 贫困家庭的学生应该能免费接受高等教育。

examples.en: Witnesses must testify in court if they are asked to do so.
examples.zh: 如果被要求,证人必须出庭作证。

examples.en: Her testimony helped the jury to reach its final decision.
examples.zh: 她的证词帮助陪审团作出了最终决定。

examples.en: The textbook for this course is expensive, so try to buy a used copy.
examples.zh: 这门课的教科书很贵,所以尽量买二手的。

examples.en: The textile industry brought great wealth to northern England.
examples.zh: 纺织业给英格兰北部带来了巨大财富。

examples.en: I like the rough texture of this old wooden table in my kitchen.
examples.zh: 我喜欢厨房这张旧木桌粗糙的质地。

examples.en: Cottages with a roof of thatch are common in this part of England.
examples.zh: 茅草屋顶的小屋在英格兰这一地区很常见。

examples.en: The elderly should be respected for their experience and knowledge.
examples.zh: 老年人的经验和知识应该得到尊重。

examples.en: The Milky Way can be seen clearly from areas with no city lights.
examples.zh: 在没有城市灯光的地区,银河系清晰可见。

examples.en: Mobile phone theft has become a common problem in large cities.
examples.zh: 手机盗窃已成为大城市的常见问题。

examples.en: Loss and memory are the central themes of the novel.
examples.zh: 失去和记忆是这部小说的中心主题。

examples.en: I went on every ride at the theme park, even the scary ones.
examples.zh: 我在主题公园玩了每一个项目,连吓人的都玩了。

examples.en: The idea remains theoretical, as no one has yet tested it in practice.
examples.zh: 这个想法仍停留在理论层面,因为还没有人在实践中验证过。

examples.en: According to one theory, the stone circle was used to track the seasons.
examples.zh: 有一种理论认为,这个石圈曾被用来追踪季节变化。

examples.en: She had speech therapy for six months after the operation.
examples.zh: 手术后她接受了六个月的语言治疗。

examples.en: Trees provide shade for buildings, thereby reducing the need for air conditioning.
examples.zh: 树木为建筑遮阴,从而减少了对空调的需求。

examples.en: The sample was small, and therefore the results should be treated carefully.
examples.zh: 样本量较小,所以应谨慎看待这些结果。

examples.en: Iceland uses thermal energy from under the ground to heat many of its homes.
examples.zh: 冰岛利用地下热能为许多家庭供暖。

examples.en: The laws of thermodynamics describe how heat moves between objects.
examples.zh: 热力学定律描述了热量如何在物体之间传递。

examples.en: Use the thermometer in the first aid box to check her temperature.
examples.zh: 用急救箱里的温度计给她量体温。

examples.en: He finished his thesis on Roman trade and handed it in last week.
examples.zh: 他写完了关于罗马贸易的论文,上周交了上去。

examples.en: The main thesis of the book is that cities shape how we think.
examples.zh: 这本书的主要论点是城市塑造了我们的思维方式。

examples.en: The thickness of the ice is measured by satellites each year.
examples.zh: 每年都用卫星测量冰的厚度。

examples.en: The thief was caught after a camera recorded his face.
examples.zh: 摄像头拍到了小偷的脸,他随后被抓获。

examples.en: A thorough examination of the site revealed several unusual objects.
examples.zh: 对现场的彻底检查发现了几件不寻常的物品。

examples.en: It was really thoughtful of my friend to remember my mum's birthday.
examples.zh: 我的朋友记得我妈妈的生日,真是太体贴了。

examples.en: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to low-lying islands.
examples.zh: 海平面上升对低洼岛屿构成严重威胁。

examples.en: Many threatened birds have begun to recover since hunting was banned.
examples.zh: 自禁猎以来,许多受威胁的鸟类已开始恢复。

examples.en: Sounds above a certain threshold can cause permanent damage to hearing.
examples.zh: 超过一定阈值的声音会对听力造成永久损伤。

examples.en: My mum is very thrifty and always looks for the cheapest prices.
examples.zh: 我妈妈很节俭,总是找最便宜的价格。

examples.en: My parents were thrilled when I told them I was getting married.
examples.zh: 我告诉父母我要结婚时,他们非常激动。

examples.en: I love a good thriller, especially one with a surprise ending.
examples.zh: 我喜欢好看的惊悚片,特别是结局出人意料的那种。

examples.en: These plants thrive in warm conditions with plenty of water.
examples.zh: 这些植物在温暖、水分充足的环境中茁壮成长。

examples.en: I've had a sore throat and a cough for about three days.
examples.zh: 我喉咙痛、咳嗽已经大约三天了。

examples.en: The human thumb allows us to hold and use tools with great skill.
examples.zh: 人的拇指使我们能灵巧地握持和使用工具。

examples.en: A sudden thunderstorm can cause dangerous flooding in narrow valleys.
examples.zh: 突如其来的雷暴可能在狭窄的山谷中引发危险的洪水。

examples.en: The river changed course, and thus the town lost its main trade route.
examples.zh: 河流改道了,这座城镇因此失去了主要的贸易路线。

examples.en: You can collect your tickets from the ticket office before the show.
examples.zh: 你可以在演出前到售票处取票。

examples.en: Tidal power could provide a reliable source of clean electricity.
examples.zh: 潮汐能可以提供可靠的清洁电力来源。

examples.en: Twice a day, the rising tide covers the sand and the rocks.
examples.zh: 每天两次,上涨的潮水淹没沙滩和岩石。

examples.en: The government plans to tighten controls on the use of plastic bags.
examples.zh: 政府计划加强对塑料袋使用的管制。

examples.en: Several bathroom tiles are cracked and need replacing.
examples.zh: 浴室有几块瓷砖裂了,需要更换。

examples.en: Ships in the past were built almost entirely from timber.
examples.zh: 过去的船几乎完全用木材建造。

examples.en: Filling in these official forms is a slow and time-consuming process.
examples.zh: 填写这些官方表格是一个缓慢而耗时的过程。

examples.en: I'm not great at time management, so I often work late at night.
examples.zh: 我不太擅长时间管理,所以常常工作到深夜。

examples.en: Check the bus timetable because there are fewer services on Sundays.
examples.zh: 看看公交时刻表,因为周日的班次较少。

examples.en: Tin was traded across the ancient world because it was needed for bronze.
examples.zh: 锡在古代世界各地都有贸易,因为制造青铜需要它。

examples.en: Service isn't included, so people usually leave a tip of ten percent.
examples.zh: 服务费不含在内,所以人们通常留百分之十的小费。

examples.en: The guide gave us some useful tips on where to eat cheaply.
examples.zh: 导游告诉了我们一些去哪儿吃得便宜的实用建议。

examples.en: The drug is designed to repair damaged tissue in the muscles of the heart.
examples.zh: 这种药物旨在修复心肌中受损的组织。

examples.en: Success at school depends to a large extent on family support.
examples.zh: 在学校取得成功在很大程度上取决于家庭支持。

examples.en: To some extent, parents are responsible for their children's eating habits.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上,父母要对孩子的饮食习惯负责。

examples.en: Unlike frogs, a toad usually has dry skin covered in small lumps.
examples.zh: 与青蛙不同,蟾蜍的皮肤通常干燥,布满小疙瘩。

examples.en: Please don't use the toaster in your room because of the smoke alarm.
examples.zh: 房间里有烟雾报警器,请不要在房间里使用烤面包机。

examples.en: A toddler may learn several new words every single day.
examples.zh: 学步儿童每天可能学会几个新词。

examples.en: You'll need a token to use the washing machines in the basement.
examples.zh: 使用地下室的洗衣机需要一枚代币。

examples.en: Travel can encourage tolerance of people from different backgrounds.
examples.zh: 旅行可以促进对不同背景的人的宽容。

examples.en: My parents are quite tolerant and let me make my own choices.
examples.zh: 我父母很宽容,让我自己作选择。

examples.en: Few fish can tolerate such high levels of salt in the water.
examples.zh: 很少有鱼能忍受水中这么高的盐度。

examples.en: Drivers have to pay a small toll to cross the new bridge.
examples.zh: 司机过这座新桥要交一小笔通行费。

examples.en: The tomb contained gold jewellery and food for the next life.
examples.zh: 墓中有金首饰和为来世准备的食物。

examples.en: The tone of the letter suggests that the author was deeply worried.
examples.zh: 这封信的语气表明作者非常担忧。

examples.en: The topography of the area affects where rain falls and rivers flow.
examples.zh: 这一地区的地形影响着降雨的位置和河流的走向。

examples.en: You'll need a torch because the path to the beach has no lights.
examples.zh: 你需要带手电筒,因为去海滩的路上没有灯。

examples.en: Runners carried the Olympic torch through the city centre this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午,跑步者手持奥运火炬穿过市中心。

examples.en: A tornado can destroy a house in a matter of seconds.
examples.zh: 龙卷风能在几秒钟内摧毁一座房子。

examples.en: Torrential rain caused landslides that blocked the main road.
examples.zh: 暴雨引发滑坡,堵塞了主干道。

examples.en: Few people could work outside in the torrid heat of the summer.
examples.zh: 在夏季的酷热中,很少有人能在户外工作。

examples.en: The giant tortoise can live for well over a hundred years.
examples.zh: 巨型陆龟可以活一百多岁。

examples.en: Coal accounted for one third of the total energy used in that year.
examples.zh: 煤炭占当年能源使用总量的三分之一。

examples.en: The company employed a total of 500 people in the three factories.
examples.zh: 这家公司在三家工厂共雇用了 500 人。

examples.en: Tourism creates many jobs but can also damage historic sites.
examples.zh: 旅游业创造了许多就业机会,但也可能破坏历史遗迹。

examples.en: The old castle has become the region's most popular tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 这座古堡已成为该地区最受欢迎的旅游景点。

examples.en: Our team reached the semi-final of the tennis tournament last year.
examples.zh: 我们队去年打进了网球锦标赛的半决赛。

examples.en: Some factories have released toxic waste into nearby rivers.
examples.zh: 一些工厂把有毒废物排入附近的河流。

examples.en: Follow the track through the woods until you reach the river.
examples.zh: 沿着小道穿过树林,一直走到河边。

examples.en: Wide tyres give the vehicle better traction on soft sand.
examples.zh: 宽轮胎让车辆在软沙上有更好的牵引力。

examples.en: The arrival of the tractor reduced the number of farm workers needed.
examples.zh: 拖拉机的出现减少了所需的农场工人数量。

examples.en: Trade between the two regions grew rapidly after the road was built.
examples.zh: 道路修通后,两个地区之间的贸易迅速增长。

examples.en: Every society should try to keep its best traditions alive.
examples.zh: 每个社会都应该努力让最好的传统延续下去。

examples.en: Traditional skills may disappear unless young people are willing to learn them.
examples.zh: 除非年轻人愿意学习,否则传统技艺可能消失。

examples.en: Each traffic jam costs the economy a great deal in lost working time.
examples.zh: 每次交通堵塞都因工作时间损失给经济带来巨大代价。

examples.en: Go straight on at the traffic lights and the bank is on your right.
examples.zh: 在红绿灯处直行,银行就在你右边。

examples.en: Shakespeare's greatest tragedy is still performed in many languages.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚最伟大的悲剧至今仍以多种语言上演。

examples.en: The coastal trail takes about three hours and has wonderful views.
examples.zh: 这条海岸步道大约要走三小时,沿途风景很美。

examples.en: A good trailer can persuade millions of people to see a film.
examples.zh: 一部好的预告片能说服数百万人去看电影。

examples.en: As a trainee, you'll spend your first month working with an experienced chef.
examples.zh: 作为实习生,你第一个月将跟着一位经验丰富的厨师工作。

examples.en: Long necks are a useful trait for animals feeding on tall trees.
examples.zh: 对于以高大树木为食的动物来说,长脖子是一种有用的特征。

examples.en: Scientists can calculate the exact trajectory of the asteroid.
examples.zh: 科学家能计算出这颗小行星的准确轨迹。

examples.en: You can take the tram from the station directly to the seafront.
examples.zh: 你可以从车站直接乘有轨电车到海滨。

examples.en: I love sitting by the tranquil lake near my home after work.
examples.zh: 我喜欢下班后坐在家附近宁静的湖边。

examples.en: Every transaction you make will appear on your monthly statement.
examples.zh: 你的每笔交易都会显示在月度对账单上。

examples.en: Great music can transcend differences of language and culture.
examples.zh: 伟大的音乐能够超越语言和文化的差异。

examples.en: Monks spent years transcribing old books by hand in the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 中世纪时,修道士花费多年时间手抄古书。

examples.en: The university asked for an official transcript of my school results.
examples.zh: 大学要求我提供一份正式的学校成绩单。

examples.en: You can read a transcript of the radio programme on our website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我们网站上阅读这期广播节目的文字记录。

examples.en: The transcription of the interviews took the researchers several months.
examples.zh: 研究者花了几个月才把访谈转写完。

examples.en: The hotel offers a free transfer between the airport and the city centre.
examples.zh: 酒店提供机场和市中心之间的免费接送。

examples.en: You'll need to transfer to another train at the next station.
examples.zh: 你需要在下一站换乘另一趟火车。

examples.en: Heat from the sun transforms the water into vapour, which rises into the air.
examples.zh: 太阳的热量把水转化为水蒸气,升入空气中。

examples.en: The transistor made it possible to build much smaller radios.
examples.zh: 晶体管使制造小得多的收音机成为可能。

examples.en: Your bags may be delayed if you're in transit through a busy airport.
examples.zh: 如果你在繁忙的机场中转,行李可能会延误。

examples.en: The country is going through a slow transition from coal to renewable energy.
examples.zh: 这个国家正在经历从煤炭到可再生能源的缓慢转变。

examples.en: Some poems are almost impossible to translate into another language.
examples.zh: 有些诗歌几乎无法翻译成另一种语言。

examples.en: An English translation of the text appeared more than a century later.
examples.zh: 这篇文本的英译本在一个多世纪后才问世。

examples.en: Software may eventually replace the work of a human translator.
examples.zh: 软件最终可能取代人工译者的工作。

examples.en: The insect's translucent wings allow some light to pass through.
examples.zh: 这种昆虫半透明的翅膀能让部分光线透过。

examples.en: Rapid transmission of the virus occurs in crowded places.
examples.zh: 这种病毒在拥挤的地方传播迅速。

examples.en: Mosquitoes can transmit the disease from one person to another.
examples.zh: 蚊子能把这种疾病从一个人传给另一个人。

examples.en: Greater transparency would make the government more accountable to the public.
examples.zh: 提高透明度将使政府对公众更负责任。

examples.en: I keep my photos in a transparent box so that I can see them.
examples.zh: 我把照片放在透明的盒子里,这样就能看到它们。

examples.en: It later transpired that the data had been recorded incorrectly.
examples.zh: 后来得知,这些数据记录有误。

examples.en: Plants transpire more water on hot and windy days.
examples.zh: 植物在炎热多风的日子里蒸腾的水分更多。

examples.en: A heart transplant can give a seriously ill patient many more years of life.
examples.zh: 心脏移植能让重病患者多活很多年。

examples.en: Surgeons can now transplant organs from one person to another safely.
examples.zh: 现在外科医生能够安全地把器官从一个人移植到另一个人身上。

examples.en: The bottles are transported by lorry to the supermarkets.
examples.zh: 瓶子由卡车运输到超市。

examples.en: The field was shaped like a trapezoid, with one long side beside the river.
examples.zh: 这块田呈梯形,有一条长边靠着河。

examples.en: Survivors of the earthquake may suffer from trauma for many years.
examples.zh: 地震幸存者可能多年遭受心理创伤。

examples.en: This café is a favourite with travellers waiting for the morning ferry.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆很受等早班渡轮的旅行者喜爱。

examples.en: Treatment at this hospital is free for all full-time students.
examples.zh: 所有全日制学生在这家医院都可以免费治疗。

examples.en: We went trekking in Nepal for two weeks with a small group.
examples.zh: 我们和一个小团队在尼泊尔长途徒步了两周。

examples.en: The new technology has had a tremendous effect on the way we shop.
examples.zh: 新技术对我们的购物方式产生了巨大影响。

examples.en: Local people felt a slight tremor several hours before the main earthquake.
examples.zh: 主震发生前几小时,当地人感觉到了轻微的震动。

examples.en: The deepest known trench in the ocean is almost eleven kilometres deep.
examples.zh: 已知最深的海沟深度近十一公里。

examples.en: The overall trend shows that fewer people are buying printed books.
examples.zh: 总体趋势显示,购买纸质书的人越来越少。

examples.en: There are lots of trendy cafés and shops in that part of town.
examples.zh: 城里那一带有很多新潮的咖啡馆和商店。

examples.en: The trial of the new teaching method will run for six months.
examples.zh: 新教学方法的试验将持续六个月。

examples.en: The trial lasted two weeks, and the man was found not guilty.
examples.zh: 审判持续了两周,该男子被判无罪。

examples.en: Early builders knew that the triangle is a very strong shape.
examples.zh: 早期的建造者知道三角形是非常坚固的形状。

examples.en: We have a small triangular garden behind our house, full of flowers.
examples.zh: 我们屋后有个小小的三角形花园,种满了花。

examples.en: Each tribe in the region had its own customs and leaders.
examples.zh: 该地区的每个部落都有自己的习俗和首领。

examples.en: Several small tributaries join the main river before it reaches the plain.
examples.zh: 几条小支流在到达平原之前汇入干流。

examples.en: My uncle taught me a card trick that I still use at parties.
examples.zh: 我叔叔教了我一个纸牌戏法,我现在还在派对上用。

examples.en: Measuring happiness is a tricky task for any social scientist.
examples.zh: 对任何社会科学家来说,衡量幸福都是一项棘手的任务。

examples.en: Even a small earthquake can trigger a large landslide on steep slopes.
examples.zh: 即使是小地震,也可能在陡坡上引发大规模滑坡。

examples.en: Stress is a common trigger for headaches among office workers.
examples.zh: 压力是办公室职员头痛的常见诱因。

examples.en: The edges of the paper are trimmed before the book is bound.
examples.zh: 书籍装订前,要修剪纸张的边缘。

examples.en: The population of the city tripled in less than thirty years.
examples.zh: 这座城市的人口在不到三十年内增至三倍。

examples.en: I carry a small tripod when I take photos of the night sky.
examples.zh: 拍夜空时,我会带一个小三脚架。

examples.en: The opening of the canal was a triumph of nineteenth-century engineering.
examples.zh: 运河的开通是十九世纪工程学的一次胜利。

examples.en: Decisions that seem trivial can have large effects over a long period.
examples.zh: 看似琐碎的决定,长期来看可能产生很大影响。

examples.en: You can use a trolley to carry your bags to the car park.
examples.zh: 你可以用手推车把行李运到停车场。

examples.en: Tropical storms cause serious damage to crops along this coast.
examples.zh: 热带风暴给这段海岸的庄稼造成严重损害。

examples.en: Many diseases spread by insects are common in the tropics.
examples.zh: 许多由昆虫传播的疾病在热带地区很常见。

examples.en: Almost all of the Earth's weather occurs in the troposphere.
examples.zh: 地球上几乎所有的天气现象都发生在对流层。

examples.en: A persistent truant is more likely to become involved in crime.
examples.zh: 长期逃学者更有可能卷入犯罪。

examples.en: The age of a tree can be found by counting the rings in its trunk.
examples.zh: 通过数树干上的年轮可以知道树的年龄。

examples.en: I'd only lend money to someone I know is really trustworthy.
examples.zh: 我只会把钱借给确实值得信赖的人。

examples.en: Advertisements should be truthful about what a product can actually do.
examples.zh: 广告应该如实说明产品的实际功效。

examples.en: The tsunami was caused by a powerful earthquake under the ocean.
examples.zh: 这场海啸是由海底强烈地震引发的。

examples.en: We took the tube from Victoria Station to the British Museum.
examples.zh: 我们从维多利亚站坐地铁去了大英博物馆。

examples.en: The water passes through a thin plastic tube into the tank.
examples.zh: 水通过一根细塑料管流入水箱。

examples.en: The cost of university tuition has risen sharply in many countries.
examples.zh: 在许多国家,大学学费急剧上涨。

examples.en: The tuition fee for this course is higher for overseas students.
examples.zh: 这门课程对海外学生收取的学费更高。

examples.en: Surgeons removed the tumour, and the patient made a full recovery.
examples.zh: 外科医生切除了肿瘤,患者完全康复了。

examples.en: Only small plants and mosses can grow on the frozen tundra.
examples.zh: 冰冻的苔原上只能生长矮小的植物和苔藓。

examples.en: The new tunnel under the river will take five years to complete.
examples.zh: 河底的新隧道需要五年才能建成。

examples.en: The turbulent water at the foot of the falls is too dangerous for boats.
examples.zh: 瀑布脚下的湍急水流对船只来说太危险了。

examples.en: The country went through a turbulent period after the king's death.
examples.zh: 国王去世后,这个国家经历了一段动荡时期。

examples.en: The sudden fall in share prices caused turmoil in world markets.
examples.zh: 股价突然下跌造成了世界市场的混乱。

examples.en: The small firm had a turnover of two million pounds last year.
examples.zh: 这家小公司去年的营业额为两百万英镑。

examples.en: Low pay has led to a high turnover of staff in the industry.
examples.zh: 低工资导致这个行业的人员流动率很高。

examples.en: Each year the turtles return to lay their eggs on this beach.
examples.zh: 每年海龟都回到这片海滩产卵。

examples.en: Elephants use their tusks to dig for water and to strip bark from trees.
examples.zh: 大象用长牙挖水和剥树皮。

examples.en: My tutor suggested that I read more before starting the essay.
examples.zh: 我的导师建议我在动笔前多读些资料。

examples.en: We'll discuss your essay plan in next week's tutorial.
examples.zh: 我们会在下周的辅导课上讨论你的论文提纲。

examples.en: Birds gather twigs and dry grass to build their nests.
examples.zh: 鸟收集细枝和干草来筑巢。

examples.en: My friend and I asked for a twin room with separate beds.
examples.zh: 我和朋友要了一间有两张床的双人间。

examples.en: More than a million people were moved to safety before the typhoon arrived.
examples.zh: 台风来临之前,有一百多万人被转移到安全地带。

examples.en: A typical nest contains between three and five eggs.
examples.zh: 一个典型的巢里有三到五枚蛋。

examples.en: We got a flat tyre on the way and had to call for help.
examples.zh: 我们路上爆胎了,只好打电话求助。

examples.en: The choice of treatment is ultimately a matter for the patient to decide.
examples.zh: 治疗方案最终要由患者决定。

examples.en: The union gave the company an ultimatum over pay and working hours.
examples.zh: 工会就工资和工时向公司发出了最后通牒。

examples.en: Dolphins communicate using ultrasonic sounds that humans cannot hear.
examples.zh: 海豚用人类听不到的超声波交流。

examples.en: Ultraviolet light from the sun can cause skin cancer.
examples.zh: 来自太阳的紫外线可能导致皮肤癌。

examples.en: I feel uncomfortable talking about money with people I don't know well.
examples.zh: 和不太熟的人谈钱,我觉得不自在。

examples.en: People often underestimate how long it takes to form a new habit.
examples.zh: 人们常常低估养成新习惯所需的时间。

examples.en: Caterpillars undergo a complete change of form as they become butterflies.
examples.zh: 毛毛虫在变成蝴蝶的过程中要经历完全的形态变化。

examples.en: Undergraduates can borrow up to ten books from the library at a time.
examples.zh: 本科生一次最多可以从图书馆借十本书。

examples.en: The quickest way to get to the museum is by underground.
examples.zh: 去博物馆最快的方式是坐地铁。

examples.en: The latest figures underline the seriousness of the water shortage.
examples.zh: 最新数据凸显了水资源短缺的严重性。

examples.en: Doctors must treat the underlying cause rather than just the symptoms.
examples.zh: 医生必须治疗根本病因,而不只是症状。

examples.en: Rising costs could undermine the success of the entire programme.
examples.zh: 不断上升的成本可能削弱整个项目的成效。

examples.en: You'll find the toilets underneath the main stairs, next to the café.
examples.zh: 洗手间在主楼梯下面,紧挨着咖啡馆。

examples.en: Scholarships give underprivileged children the chance to attend good universities.
examples.zh: 奖学金让弱势儿童有机会上好大学。

examples.en: The museum has undertaken a major study of its early collections.
examples.zh: 博物馆对其早期藏品开展了一项大型研究。

examples.en: The railway undoubtedly helped the town's economy to grow.
examples.zh: 铁路无疑促进了这座城镇的经济增长。

examples.en: Farmers often unearth Roman coins while ploughing their fields.
examples.zh: 农民在犁田时经常挖出罗马硬币。

examples.en: Unemployed young people should receive training to help them find work.
examples.zh: 失业的年轻人应该接受培训,帮助他们找到工作。

examples.en: Unemployment rose sharply when the local coal mines closed.
examples.zh: 当地煤矿关闭后,失业率急剧上升。

examples.en: You may be able to claim unemployment benefit while you look for work.
examples.zh: 找工作期间,你也许可以申请失业救济金。

examples.en: The uneven distribution of rainfall makes farming difficult in some areas.
examples.zh: 降雨分布不均使一些地区难以耕作。

examples.en: Many people felt that the new tax was unfair to the poor.
examples.zh: 许多人觉得新税对穷人不公平。

examples.en: Events began to unfold quickly once the new king came to power.
examples.zh: 新国王掌权后,事态开始迅速发展。

examples.en: Our trip to the mountains last year was an unforgettable experience.
examples.zh: 去年的山区之旅是一次难忘的经历。

examples.en: It's cheaper because it's unfurnished, but you'll need to buy your own sofa.
examples.zh: 它不带家具,所以更便宜,但你得自己买沙发。

examples.en: I had to wear a dark blue uniform when I was at school.
examples.zh: 我上学时必须穿深蓝色的制服。

examples.en: Old English is now unintelligible to most modern speakers.
examples.zh: 现代大多数说英语的人已经无法理解古英语。

examples.en: The island is home to a unique species of lizard found nowhere else.
examples.zh: 这座岛上有一种独特的蜥蜴,在其他地方都找不到。

examples.en: National sporting events can create a strong sense of unity.
examples.zh: 全国性体育赛事能营造强烈的团结感。

examples.en: Scientists estimate that the universe is almost fourteen billion years old.
examples.zh: 科学家估计宇宙的年龄约为一百四十亿年。

examples.en: Many of these languages will disappear unless action is taken soon.
examples.zh: 除非尽快采取行动,否则这些语言中的许多将会消失。

examples.en: It is unlikely that this species will survive without human help.
examples.zh: 没有人类的帮助,这个物种不太可能存活。

examples.en: The city experienced unprecedented growth during the last century.
examples.zh: 上个世纪,这座城市经历了前所未有的增长。

examples.en: High unemployment among young people can lead to social unrest.
examples.zh: 年轻人失业率高可能导致社会动荡。

examples.en: She's the most unselfish person I know and always puts others first.
examples.zh: 她是我认识的最无私的人,总是把别人放在第一位。

examples.en: Unskilled workers are the most likely to lose their jobs to machines.
examples.zh: 非熟练工人最有可能因机器而失业。

examples.en: The food there is simple and unsophisticated, but it tastes really good.
examples.zh: 那里的食物简单淳朴,但味道很好。

examples.en: The cliffs along this coast are unstable and could fall at any time.
examples.zh: 这段海岸的悬崖不稳定,随时可能坍塌。

examples.en: It is unusual for this type of bird to build a nest on the ground.
examples.zh: 这种鸟在地面筑巢是不寻常的。

examples.en: I usually unwind after work by listening to music in the bath.
examples.zh: 下班后我通常一边泡澡一边听音乐来放松。

examples.en: A child's upbringing has a strong influence on their later behaviour.
examples.zh: 孩子的教养对其日后的行为有很大影响。

examples.en: The database is updated every week with information from local hospitals.
examples.zh: 数据库每周根据当地医院的信息更新一次。

examples.en: The city plans to upgrade its old water pipes over the next ten years.
examples.zh: 这座城市计划在未来十年升级老旧水管。

examples.en: Courts are expected to uphold the law regardless of public opinion.
examples.zh: 无论舆论如何,法院都应维护法律。

examples.en: The mountains were formed by the slow uplift of the land.
examples.zh: 这些山脉是由陆地的缓慢抬升形成的。

examples.en: My grandfather was an upright man who never told a single lie.
examples.zh: 我爷爷是个正直的人,从没说过一句谎话。

examples.en: The graph shows a clear upward trend in the use of renewable energy.
examples.zh: 图表显示可再生能源的使用量呈明显的上升趋势。

examples.en: Uranus was first identified as a planet by William Herschel in 1781.
examples.zh: 1781 年,威廉·赫歇尔首次确认天王星是一颗行星。

examples.en: More than half of the world's population now lives in urban areas.
examples.zh: 世界上一半以上的人口现在居住在城市地区。

examples.en: Urban sprawl has replaced large areas of farmland with low-density housing.
examples.zh: 城市扩张使大片农田变成了低密度住宅区。

examples.en: Rapid urbanisation has put heavy pressure on housing and water supplies.
examples.zh: 快速城市化给住房和供水带来了沉重压力。

examples.en: Doctors can test a patient's urine to check for signs of diabetes.
examples.zh: 医生可以检测患者的尿液,查找糖尿病的迹象。

examples.en: The usage of this word has changed greatly over the past fifty years.
examples.zh: 过去五十年,这个词的用法发生了很大变化。

examples.en: The designers have tried to make the system more user-friendly.
examples.zh: 设计者努力让这个系统更便于用户使用。

examples.en: Solar panels utilise energy from the sun to produce electricity.
examples.zh: 太阳能电池板利用太阳的能量发电。

examples.en: Does the monthly rent include utilities such as gas and electricity?
examples.zh: 月租包含煤气、电费这类费用吗?

examples.en: A child's first utterance usually consists of just a single word.
examples.zh: 孩子最初的话语通常只有一个词。

examples.en: The village was utterly destroyed by the eruption of the volcano.
examples.zh: 这个村庄被火山喷发完全摧毁了。

examples.en: Sorry, the hotel has no vacancies during the festival next week.
examples.zh: 抱歉,下周节日期间酒店没有空房。

examples.en: You should get a vaccination at least a month before you travel.
examples.zh: 你应该至少在出行前一个月接种疫苗。

examples.en: Researchers developed the new vaccine in less than a year.
examples.zh: 研究者用不到一年的时间研制出了这种新疫苗。

examples.en: You can borrow a vacuum cleaner from the office on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 你可以到一楼办公室借吸尘器。

examples.en: Early descriptions of the disease were too vague to be useful.
examples.zh: 早期对这种疾病的描述过于模糊,没有什么用处。

examples.en: The results are only valid if the sample represents the whole population.
examples.zh: 只有样本能代表总体,结果才有效。

examples.en: Further studies are needed to validate the findings of this small experiment.
examples.zh: 需要进一步研究来证实这个小型实验的结果。

examples.en: Early farmers settled in the valley because the soil there was rich.
examples.zh: 早期农民定居在这个山谷,因为那里土壤肥沃。

examples.en: My most valuable possession is a ring that belonged to my grandmother.
examples.zh: 我最贵重的东西是奶奶留下的一枚戒指。

examples.en: Parents should teach their children the value of hard work.
examples.zh: 父母应该教导孩子勤奋的价值。

examples.en: Modern societies tend to value wealth more than wisdom.
examples.zh: 现代社会往往重视财富胜过智慧。

examples.en: The set lunch at that restaurant is really good value for money.
examples.zh: 那家餐馆的午市套餐真是物有所值。

examples.en: The valve controls how much steam enters the engine.
examples.zh: 阀门控制进入发动机的蒸汽量。

examples.en: Young people with nothing to do may turn to vandalism.
examples.zh: 无所事事的年轻人可能转向故意破坏公物。

examples.en: Many species of frog could vanish completely within the next few decades.
examples.zh: 许多种类的青蛙可能在未来几十年内完全消失。

examples.en: Water vapour in the air turns into rain when it cools.
examples.zh: 空气中的水蒸气冷却后变成雨。

examples.en: The study found great variability in the way that children develop speech.
examples.zh: 研究发现,儿童语言发展的方式差异很大。

examples.en: Age was the most important variable in predicting how people responded.
examples.zh: 年龄是预测人们反应的最重要变量。

examples.en: Rainfall in this region is highly variable from one year to the next.
examples.zh: 该地区的降雨量每年变化很大。

examples.en: A new variant of the virus spread rapidly across the region.
examples.zh: 这种病毒的一种新变体在该地区迅速传播。

examples.en: Average temperatures vary greatly from one part of the country to another.
examples.zh: 全国各地的平均气温差异很大。

examples.en: A vector shows both the size and the direction of a force.
examples.zh: 向量同时表示力的大小和方向。

examples.en: Our new chef offers a separate menu for vegans and people with allergies.
examples.zh: 新厨师为严格素食者和过敏人群提供单独的菜单。

examples.en: As a vegetarian, I find it hard to eat out in this town.
examples.zh: 我是素食者,在这个镇上外出吃饭很难。

examples.en: Does the menu include any vegetarian dishes for our guests?
examples.zh: 菜单上有适合我们客人的素菜吗?

examples.en: The vegetation on the northern side of the hill is much thicker.
examples.zh: 山丘北侧的植被要茂密得多。

examples.en: Every vehicle entering the city centre must now pay a daily charge.
examples.zh: 现在每辆进入市中心的车辆都要付每日费用。

examples.en: Blood returns to the heart through a vein after delivering oxygen.
examples.zh: 血液输送氧气后通过静脉回到心脏。

examples.en: The velocity of the river increases as it flows down the steep slope.
examples.zh: 河水流下陡坡时,流速会增加。

examples.en: My grandmother's old sofa was covered in dark green velvet.
examples.zh: 我奶奶的旧沙发上覆盖着深绿色的天鹅绒。

examples.en: Snake venom is now used in the development of some medicines.
examples.zh: 蛇毒现在被用于开发一些药物。

examples.en: Only a small number of the country's snakes are venomous.
examples.zh: 该国只有少数蛇是有毒的。

examples.en: Good ventilation is essential in buildings with a large number of people.
examples.zh: 在人员众多的建筑里,良好的通风至关重要。

examples.en: Her first business venture failed, but she learned a great deal from it.
examples.zh: 她第一次创业失败了,但从中学到了很多。

examples.en: The venue for this year's concert is the town hall, not the park.
examples.zh: 今年音乐会的场地是市政厅,不是公园。

examples.en: Thick clouds trap heat on Venus, making it the hottest planet.
examples.zh: 厚厚的云层把热量困在金星上,使它成为最热的行星。

examples.en: Verbal skills develop rapidly between the ages of two and five.
examples.zh: 语言能力在两岁到五岁之间迅速发展。

examples.en: The verdict surprised many people who had followed the case closely.
examples.zh: 这项判决令许多密切关注此案的人感到意外。

examples.en: Rare wild flowers can sometimes be found growing on the verge of the road.
examples.zh: 有时能在路边发现生长着的珍稀野花。

examples.en: Other laboratories must verify these results before they can be accepted.
examples.zh: 这些结果必须经其他实验室核实后才能被接受。

examples.en: Bamboo is a versatile material used for building, cooking and making paper.
examples.zh: 竹子是一种多用途材料,可用于建筑、烹饪和造纸。

examples.en: Many early histories were written in verse so that they could be remembered.
examples.zh: 许多早期历史用韵文写成,以便记忆。

examples.en: Fish were the first vertebrates to appear on Earth.
examples.zh: 鱼类是地球上最早出现的脊椎动物。

examples.en: The vertical axis of the graph shows the average temperature each month.
examples.zh: 图表的纵轴显示每月的平均气温。

examples.en: The liquid is heated in a sealed vessel to keep it pure.
examples.zh: 液体在密封容器中加热,以保持纯净。

examples.en: Fishing vessels from several countries operate in these waters.
examples.zh: 来自几个国家的渔船在这片海域作业。

examples.en: Regular exercise helps to keep the blood vessels healthy.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼有助于保持血管健康。

examples.en: As a veteran of the hotel trade, he knows what guests really want.
examples.zh: 作为酒店业的老手,他知道客人真正想要什么。

examples.en: The president used his veto to stop the bill from becoming law.
examples.zh: 总统行使否决权,阻止这项法案成为法律。

examples.en: Electric buses are now a viable alternative to those powered by diesel.
examples.zh: 电动公交车现在是柴油公交车的可行替代品。

examples.en: What I like most about my hometown is its vibrant night market.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢家乡的一点是它充满活力的夜市。

examples.en: Sensors can detect the slightest vibration in the walls of the bridge.
examples.zh: 传感器能检测到桥壁最轻微的振动。

examples.en: Several ancient tombs have been found in the vicinity of the village.
examples.zh: 在这个村庄附近发现了几座古墓。

examples.en: The victim of a crime often needs emotional as well as practical support.
examples.zh: 犯罪受害者往往既需要实际帮助,也需要情感支持。

examples.en: From the viewpoint at the top, you can see the whole valley.
examples.zh: 从山顶的观景点可以看到整个山谷。

examples.en: Thirty minutes of vigorous exercise a day can greatly reduce the risk of illness.
examples.zh: 每天三十分钟的高强度运动可以大大降低患病风险。

examples.en: Every villager came out to welcome us when we arrived.
examples.zh: 我们到达时,每个村民都出来欢迎我们。

examples.en: The vine climbs up the trunks of tall trees to reach the light.
examples.zh: 藤蔓沿着高树的树干向上攀爬,以获取阳光。

examples.en: Add a spoonful of vinegar to the sauce to give it a sharper taste.
examples.zh: 往酱汁里加一勺醋,味道会更酸爽。

examples.en: I love looking for vintage clothes in the little shops near my flat.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在公寓附近的小店里淘复古衣服。

examples.en: Companies that violate environmental rules should be forced to pay for the damage.
examples.zh: 违反环境法规的公司应被迫赔偿损失。

examples.en: Violent crime is more common in areas with high unemployment.
examples.zh: 暴力犯罪在失业率高的地区更为常见。

examples.en: Students can now take a virtual tour of the museum on the internet.
examples.zh: 学生现在可以在网上虚拟参观博物馆。

examples.en: Medical students can practise operations safely using virtual reality.
examples.zh: 医学生可以利用虚拟现实安全地练习手术。

examples.en: Virtually all the land in the valley is now used for farming.
examples.zh: 山谷里几乎所有的土地现在都用于耕作。

examples.en: The virus spreads through the air when an infected person coughs.
examples.zh: 感染者咳嗽时,病毒通过空气传播。

examples.en: A computer virus damaged the hospital's records and delayed treatment.
examples.zh: 一种计算机病毒损坏了医院的记录,延误了治疗。

examples.en: Students from some countries need a visa before they can enter.
examples.zh: 来自部分国家的学生入境前需要办理签证。

examples.en: The effects of pollution are clearly visible on the old stone walls.
examples.zh: 污染的影响在古老的石墙上清晰可见。

examples.en: Using a visual aid can make your talk much easier to follow.
examples.zh: 使用视觉辅助工具能让你的发言更容易理解。

examples.en: Clean water is vital for the health of any community.
examples.zh: 清洁的水对任何社区的健康都至关重要。

examples.en: Oranges and other fresh fruit contain plenty of vitamin C.
examples.zh: 橙子和其他新鲜水果含有丰富的维生素 C。

examples.en: I still have vivid memories of my first day at school.
examples.zh: 我至今还清晰地记得上学第一天。

examples.en: Some people believe vivisection is cruel and should be banned.
examples.zh: 有些人认为活体解剖很残忍,应该被禁止。

examples.en: Children who read often tend to have a much larger vocabulary.
examples.zh: 经常阅读的孩子往往词汇量更大。

examples.en: Vocational courses can prepare young people well for skilled jobs.
examples.zh: 职业课程能帮助年轻人为技术工作做好准备。

examples.en: Vocational training is often more useful than a university degree for some jobs.
examples.zh: 对某些工作来说,职业培训往往比大学学位更有用。

examples.en: Food prices can be volatile when harvests vary greatly from year to year.
examples.zh: 当每年收成差异很大时,粮价可能波动剧烈。

examples.en: Volatile chemicals quickly turn into gas at room temperature.
examples.zh: 易挥发的化学物质在室温下很快变成气体。

examples.en: Volcanic soils are often very rich and good for growing crops.
examples.zh: 火山土壤往往非常肥沃,适合种植庄稼。

examples.en: The volcano last erupted about four hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 这座火山最后一次喷发是在大约四百年前。

examples.en: Participants took part of their own volition and could leave at any time.
examples.zh: 参与者是自愿参加的,可以随时退出。

examples.en: High voltage power lines carry electricity over long distances.
examples.zh: 高压输电线路进行远距离输电。

examples.en: The second volume of the encyclopedia is missing from the shelf.
examples.zh: 书架上缺了这部百科全书的第二卷。

examples.en: Please turn down the volume on your computer in the study room.
examples.zh: 在自习室请把电脑音量调低。

examples.en: Participation in the study was voluntary, and people could leave at any time.
examples.zh: 参与这项研究是自愿的,人们可以随时退出。

examples.en: We need a volunteer to help serve drinks at the charity event.
examples.zh: 我们需要一名志愿者在慈善活动上帮忙倒饮料。

examples.en: I volunteered to clean the beach with a local group last weekend.
examples.zh: 上周末,我主动和当地一个团体去清理了海滩。

examples.en: Some people believe that the age to vote should be lowered to sixteen.
examples.zh: 有些人认为投票年龄应该降低到十六岁。

examples.en: This voucher gives you £5 off your next meal at the restaurant.
examples.zh: 这张代金券可以让你下次在这家餐厅用餐时减 5 英镑。

examples.en: Hawaiian has only five vowels and a small number of other sounds.
examples.zh: 夏威夷语只有五个元音和少量其他音。

examples.en: Governments have a special duty to protect the most vulnerable people in society.
examples.zh: 政府有特别的责任保护社会中最脆弱的人。

examples.en: The hourly wage at the supermarket is higher than at the café.
examples.zh: 超市的时薪比咖啡馆高。

examples.en: My parents learned to waltz before their wedding, and they still dance sometimes.
examples.zh: 我父母婚前学了华尔兹,现在有时还会跳。

examples.en: Speak to the warden if you lose the key to your room.
examples.zh: 如果丢了房间钥匙,请联系宿舍管理员。

examples.en: There's a large wardrobe in the bedroom for your clothes and shoes.
examples.zh: 卧室里有一个大衣柜,可以放你的衣服和鞋子。

examples.en: The goods are stored in a large warehouse beside the motorway.
examples.zh: 这些货物存放在高速公路旁的一个大仓库里。

examples.en: The washing machine comes with a two-year warranty on all parts.
examples.zh: 这台洗衣机所有零件都有两年保修。

examples.en: Wild animals are usually wary of humans and keep their distance.
examples.zh: 野生动物通常对人类很警惕,并保持距离。

examples.en: Each room has its own washbasin, but the toilets are shared.
examples.zh: 每个房间都有自己的洗脸盆,但厕所是公用的。

examples.en: Some types of wasp lay their eggs inside the bodies of other insects.
examples.zh: 有些种类的黄蜂把卵产在其他昆虫体内。

examples.en: Most household waste could be recycled if people sorted it properly.
examples.zh: 如果人们正确分类,大部分生活垃圾都可以回收。

examples.en: Many people waste water by leaving taps running while they brush their teeth.
examples.zh: 许多人刷牙时不关水龙头,浪费了水。

examples.en: Waste disposal is becoming a serious problem for fast-growing cities.
examples.zh: 废物处理正成为快速发展城市的严重问题。

examples.en: Waste water from the factory must be cleaned before it reaches the river.
examples.zh: 工厂废水流入河流前必须经过净化。

examples.en: Water pollution from mines has killed most of the fish in the river.
examples.zh: 矿山造成的水污染杀死了河里的大部分鱼。

examples.en: Water shortage is already a serious problem in many dry regions.
examples.zh: 缺水已是许多干旱地区的严重问题。

examples.en: Each watercolour in the exhibition shows a different view of the river.
examples.zh: 展览中的每幅水彩画都展现了河流的不同景色。

examples.en: The waterfall drops nearly a hundred metres into the valley below.
examples.zh: 瀑布落差近一百米,直泻下方的山谷。

examples.en: You'll need a waterproof jacket for the boat trip this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午的乘船游你需要一件防水夹克。

examples.en: The mountains form a watershed between rivers flowing east and those flowing west.
examples.zh: 这些山脉构成了东流河与西流河之间的分水岭。

examples.en: The invention of the steam engine was a watershed in human history.
examples.zh: 蒸汽机的发明是人类历史的转折点。

examples.en: Red light has a longer wavelength than blue light.
examples.zh: 红光的波长比蓝光长。

examples.en: Bees make wax to build the small cells in their hives.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂分泌蜡来建造蜂巢里的小巢室。

examples.en: The town's wealth came mainly from trade in wool and cloth.
examples.zh: 这个城镇的财富主要来自羊毛和布匹贸易。

examples.en: Higher taxes on the rich could help to reduce the wealth gap.
examples.zh: 提高对富人的税收有助于缩小贫富差距。

examples.en: Millions of visitors cause wear and tear on these ancient buildings.
examples.zh: 数百万游客造成这些古建筑的损耗。

examples.en: I was so weary after work that I went straight to bed.
examples.zh: 下班后我累极了,直接上床睡觉。

examples.en: Weathering by wind and rain slowly breaks down even the hardest rock.
examples.zh: 风雨的风化作用能慢慢分解最坚硬的岩石。

examples.en: Older women in the village still weave cloth using traditional methods.
examples.zh: 村里年长的妇女仍用传统方法织布。

examples.en: The growth of the web has changed how scientists share their research.
examples.zh: 互联网的发展改变了科学家分享研究成果的方式。

examples.en: Ducks have webbed feet that help them to swim quickly.
examples.zh: 鸭子有蹼足,这有助于它们快速游泳。

examples.en: We've been invited to a wedding in Scotland at the end of June.
examples.zh: 我们受邀参加六月底在苏格兰举行的一场婚礼。

examples.en: Weeds compete with crops for sunlight, water and space.
examples.zh: 杂草与庄稼争夺阳光、水分和空间。

examples.en: The chart shows the average weekly spending of students on food.
examples.zh: 图表显示了学生每周在食品上的平均支出。

examples.en: It felt weird going back to my old school after so many years.
examples.zh: 这么多年后回到以前的学校,感觉很奇怪。

examples.en: The welfare system should support people who are unable to work.
examples.zh: 福利制度应该支持无法工作的人。

examples.en: Spending time outdoors can improve people's general sense of well-being.
examples.zh: 在户外活动可以提升人们整体的幸福感。

examples.en: The new security guard at my office is tall and well-built.
examples.zh: 我们办公室新来的保安又高又壮。

examples.en: My area is well-connected, with buses and trains to the city centre.
examples.zh: 我住的地方交通便利,有公交车和火车通往市中心。

examples.en: My manager is always well-dressed, even on casual Fridays at work.
examples.zh: 我的经理总是穿着讲究,哪怕是公司的休闲星期五也一样。

examples.en: I read the news every morning because I like to stay well-informed.
examples.zh: 我每天早上看新闻,因为我喜欢保持消息灵通。

examples.en: The old town is really well-preserved, and tourists love walking around it.
examples.zh: 老城保存得非常完好,游客们很喜欢在那里漫步。

examples.en: Sports and the arts help students to become well-rounded adults.
examples.zh: 体育和艺术帮助学生成长为全面发展的成年人。

examples.en: The westernisation of diets has led to more cases of obesity in Asia.
examples.zh: 饮食西化导致亚洲的肥胖病例增多。

examples.en: Wetlands act as natural filters that clean water before it reaches the sea.
examples.zh: 湿地就像天然过滤器,在水流入海洋前将其净化。

examples.en: The blue whale is the largest animal that has ever lived.
examples.zh: 蓝鲸是有史以来最大的动物。

examples.en: Bread made from wheat became the main food in much of Europe.
examples.zh: 小麦做的面包成为欧洲大部分地区的主食。

examples.en: Some birds fly south in winter, whereas others remain in the same area.
examples.zh: 有些鸟冬天飞往南方,而另一些则留在原地。

examples.en: Photosynthesis is the process whereby plants turn sunlight into food.
examples.zh: 光合作用是植物把阳光转化为养分的过程。

examples.en: Animals usually take whichever route uses the least energy.
examples.zh: 动物通常会选择耗能最少的路线,无论是哪一条。

examples.en: While the first study found a clear link, the second did not.
examples.zh: 第一项研究发现了明显的关联,然而第二项没有。

examples.en: A whirlwind lifted sand high into the air above the desert.
examples.zh: 一股旋风把沙子卷到沙漠上空。

examples.en: White-collar workers usually spend most of their day sitting at a desk.
examples.zh: 白领工人一天大部分时间通常都坐在办公桌前。

examples.en: Whoever built this wall had a good knowledge of engineering.
examples.zh: 无论这堵墙是谁建的,此人都很懂工程学。

examples.en: Wholegrain bread and rice are better for you than the white kinds.
examples.zh: 全谷物面包和糙米比白面包、白米更健康。

examples.en: The shop buys its goods at wholesale and sells them at a higher price.
examples.zh: 这家店以批发价进货,然后以更高的价格出售。

examples.en: The use of the plough became widespread across Europe in the Middle Ages.
examples.zh: 中世纪时,犁在欧洲各地得到了广泛使用。

examples.en: An elderly widow may feel very lonely after the death of her husband.
examples.zh: 年迈的寡妇在丈夫去世后可能感到非常孤独。

examples.en: The width of the road increased from two lanes to four.
examples.zh: 道路的宽度从两车道增加到四车道。

examples.en: Large parts of the northern wilderness are still untouched by humans.
examples.zh: 北部荒野的大部分地区仍未被人类涉足。

examples.en: The national park is famous for its rich and varied wildlife.
examples.zh: 这个国家公园以丰富多样的野生动物闻名。

examples.en: A wildlife reserve gives rare animals a safe place to live and breed.
examples.zh: 野生动物保护区为珍稀动物提供了安全的生活和繁殖场所。

examples.en: The company was fined for the wilful destruction of the forest.
examples.zh: 这家公司因故意破坏森林被罚款。

examples.en: Wind energy is now one of the cheapest sources of electricity.
examples.zh: 风能现在是最便宜的电力来源之一。

examples.en: A single wind turbine can supply power to hundreds of homes.
examples.zh: 一台风力涡轮机能为数百户家庭供电。

examples.en: The old windmill on the hill was once used to grind flour.
examples.zh: 山上那座旧风车过去用来磨面粉。

examples.en: On rainy days, my friends and I often go window-shopping at the mall.
examples.zh: 下雨天,我和朋友经常去商场逛街看橱窗。

examples.en: Laminated glass prevents the windscreen from breaking into sharp pieces.
examples.zh: 夹层玻璃防止挡风玻璃碎成锋利的碎片。

examples.en: Most of the rain falls on the windward side of the mountains.
examples.zh: 大部分雨水落在山脉的迎风面。

examples.en: Wireless technology allows farmers to monitor their fields from their phones.
examples.zh: 无线技术让农民能用手机监控农田。

examples.en: Older people can pass on their wisdom to younger members of society.
examples.zh: 老年人可以把智慧传给社会的年轻成员。

examples.en: Little is known with regard to the diet of these early humans.
examples.zh: 关于这些早期人类的饮食,人们所知甚少。

examples.en: You can withdraw up to £300 a day from any cash machine.
examples.zh: 你每天可以从任何一台取款机取款,最多 300 英镑。

examples.en: There's no charge for a withdrawal from machines at our own branches.
examples.zh: 在我们自己网点的机器上取款不收费。

examples.en: The government threatened to withhold funding from schools that broke the rules.
examples.zh: 政府威胁要扣留违规学校的经费。

examples.en: Everything I need is within walking distance of my flat.
examples.zh: 我需要的一切都在公寓步行可达的范围内。

examples.en: The new buildings are designed to withstand strong earthquakes.
examples.zh: 新建筑的设计能够承受强烈地震。

examples.en: A witness told the court that she had seen the man leave the shop.
examples.zh: 一名证人告诉法庭,她看到该男子离开了商店。

examples.en: He's so witty that everyone laughs whenever he tells a story.
examples.zh: 他特别风趣,每次讲故事大家都会笑。

examples.en: My grandfather made this little wooden horse for me when I was three.
examples.zh: 我三岁时,爷爷给我做了这匹小木马。

examples.en: A woodpecker uses its strong beak to search for insects under tree bark.
examples.zh: 啄木鸟用强壮的喙在树皮下寻找昆虫。

examples.en: My mum knitted me a thick wool jumper for the winter.
examples.zh: 我妈妈给我织了一件厚羊毛衫过冬。

examples.en: Your essay will lose marks if it goes over the word limit.
examples.zh: 论文超出字数限制会被扣分。

examples.en: Your essay is rather wordy, so try to cut out some sentences.
examples.zh: 你的论文有些啰嗦,试着删掉一些句子。

examples.en: Flexible hours can help employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
examples.zh: 弹性工作时间能帮助员工更好地实现工作与生活的平衡。

examples.en: A workaholic may damage both their health and their family life.
examples.zh: 工作狂可能既损害健康,也损害家庭生活。

examples.en: Automation has reduced the size of the workforce in many manufacturing industries.
examples.zh: 自动化缩减了许多制造行业的劳动力规模。

examples.en: A workforce shortage could slow economic growth in countries with fewer young people.
examples.zh: 在年轻人较少的国家,劳动力短缺可能减缓经济增长。

examples.en: Teachers complain that their heavy workload leaves little time for their families.
examples.zh: 老师们抱怨繁重的工作量让他们几乎没有时间陪家人。

examples.en: I do a short workout at home before I start work each morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上开始工作前,我都在家做一次短时间的锻炼。

examples.en: There's a free workshop on academic writing in the library this Friday.
examples.zh: 本周五图书馆有一场免费的学术写作工作坊。

examples.en: Birds use their sharp eyesight to find a worm in the grass.
examples.zh: 鸟用敏锐的视力在草丛中寻找蠕虫。

examples.en: These old trainers are completely worn-out, so I need a new pair.
examples.zh: 这双旧运动鞋完全穿破了,我得买双新的。

examples.en: Ancient people often worshipped the sun as the source of life.
examples.zh: 古人常常把太阳当作生命之源来崇拜。

examples.en: Learning a second language is a worthwhile activity at any age.
examples.zh: 无论什么年龄,学习第二语言都是值得的。

examples.en: Oil from the wreck spread along the coast for many miles.
examples.zh: 残骸漏出的石油沿海岸扩散了许多英里。

examples.en: My mum has a few wrinkles now, but her smile still looks young.
examples.zh: 我妈妈现在有几条皱纹了,但她的笑容依然年轻。

examples.en: No written records of the language survive from before the tenth century.
examples.zh: 这种语言没有十世纪以前的书面记录留存下来。

examples.en: You can hire a yacht with a crew for a day at the harbour.
examples.zh: 你可以在港口租一艘配船员的游艇玩一天。

examples.en: Yeast is added to the mixture to make the bread rise.
examples.zh: 在面团中加入酵母,面包才能发起来。

examples.en: The new variety of rice can yield twice as much as older types.
examples.zh: 这种新水稻品种的产量可达旧品种的两倍。

examples.en: The wheat yield fell sharply during the years of low rainfall.
examples.zh: 在降雨少的年份,小麦产量急剧下降。

examples.en: I go to a yoga class twice a week to help me relax.
examples.zh: 我每周上两次瑜伽课来帮助放松。

examples.en: A youngster with a good role model is less likely to get into trouble.
examples.zh: 有好榜样的年轻人不太可能惹上麻烦。

examples.en: The youth hostel offers cheap beds and a shared kitchen for guests.
examples.zh: 这家青年旅舍为客人提供便宜的床位和公用厨房。

examples.en: Steel is often covered with a thin layer of zinc to prevent rust.
examples.zh: 钢常覆盖一层薄薄的锌来防锈。

examples.en: Cars are not allowed in the pedestrian zone at the centre of town.
examples.zh: 市中心的步行区不允许汽车通行。

examples.en: My degree in zoology included a field trip to study wild birds.
examples.zh: 我的动物学学位课程包括一次研究野生鸟类的实地考察。
